paper.title: LongGuard: Mechanistic Analysis and Training-Free Mitigation of Long-Context Failure in Safety Guardrails
paper.abstract: Safety guardrails serve as the last line of defense against harmful inputs and outputs of large language models (LLMs), yet they are trained and evaluated almost exclusively on short text. We present LongGuard, a framework that evaluates, mechanistically analyzes, and mitigates long-context guardrail failure. We formulate the task as Safety Needle-in-a-Haystack (SafetyNIAH) over a 0.25k-32k length grid; across 15 mainstream guardrails, unsafe recall drops monotonically by more than 50% on averag

summary.core_problem: 分析并缓解安全 guardrail 在长上下文中漏检有害内容的问题，尤其是有害片段被大量良性文本稀释时的失败机制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析加评测框架：提出 Safety Needle-in-a-Haystack 设置，在 0.25k 到 32k 长度网格上测试 15 个主流 guardrail，并把失败归因到 attention、logit margin 和最终行为之间的连续链条。对长上下文预训练和安全后训练都有参考价值，因为它指出了长上下文能力并不自动转化为长上下文安全识别能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含三部分：先用 SafetyNIAH 把不安全内容作为 needle 放入不同长度上下文；再用 Benign-Fill 与 Needle-Repeat 的配对设计区分绝对长度效应和比例稀释效应；最后做三层分析，追踪 unsafe needle 上的 attention mass、unsafe-over-safe logit margin，以及最终检测决策之间的关系。缓解部分是 training-free mitigation，但摘要片段未完整展示具体操作细节。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 15 个主流安全 guardrail，长度范围为 0.25k 到 32k。主要现象是 unsafe recall 随长度单调下降，平均下降超过 50%；配对实验显示失败更接近由有害 needle 的比例稀释造成，而不是由绝对长度本身造成。六个 guardrail 的机制分析显示 attention 稀释、logit margin 压缩和行为崩溃同步发生，并且在控制长度后仍保持一致。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学院信息工程研究所和中国科学院大学网络空间安全学院；摘要信息不足以确认该团队在 LLM 长上下文或安全机制分析上的代表性前作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why safety guardrails fail in long contexts, especially when a harmful span is diluted by a large amount of benign text.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a diagnostic benchmark with mechanistic analysis. SafetyNIAH evaluates 15 mainstream guardrails over a 0.25k-32k length grid and links long-context failure to a chain from attention dilution to compressed unsafe-over-safe logit margins and then to missed detections. This matters for both long-context pretraining and safety tuning because long-context capability does not automatically imply long-context safety robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework places an unsafe needle in haystack contexts of varying length, uses a paired Benign-Fill versus Needle-Repeat design to separate proportional dilution from absolute length, and analyzes attention mass on the unsafe span, unsafe-safe logit margins, and final moderation behavior. The abstract also mentions training-free mitigation, but the provided excerpt does not expose the full mitigation algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover 15 mainstream guardrails from 0.25k to 32k context length. Unsafe recall drops monotonically by more than 50% on average. The paired design attributes the drop to proportional dilution of the unsafe needle rather than raw context length. On six guardrails, the attention-logit-behavior chain remains consistent even after partialling out length.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and the School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences. The provided metadata does not identify prior flagship LLM safety work from the team.

recommendation.zh: 只看 SafetyNIAH 设计和 attention→logit 图；“比例稀释”这个诊断值得放进长上下文安全回归集。
recommendation.en: Read the SafetyNIAH setup and the attention-to-logit plots; the proportional-dilution diagnosis belongs in long-context safety regression tests.

paper.title: Cross-Lingual Alignment Without Joint Training: Do Monolingual Language Models Converge on Universal Representations?
paper.abstract: Cross-lingual alignment in multilingual language models is typically attributed to joint training: shared parameters, mixed-language batches, or explicit alignment objectives. We ask whether monolingual models trained on non-parallel data learn alignable representations without joint training. By testing on strictly monolingual language models, such as the Goldfish model families and independently developed models from different research labs, we find three results. Correlation: these models dev

summary.core_problem: 这项工作问的是：没有联合训练、没有共享词表、没有共享参数、没有显式对齐目标时，单语语言模型是否仍会学到可对齐的跨语言内部表示。它把跨语言对齐从“多语训练带来的副产物”改成一个更严格的问题：独立训练的单语模型是否会收敛到相似的语义几何结构。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究有较清晰的启发。第一，它支持一种较弱但有用的表示收敛观点：不同语言、不同语料、不同模型训练出来的中高层表示，可以通过简单线性旋转对齐。第二，它提示跨语言能力不一定完全依赖共享 tokenizer 或混合语言 batch，语料中的语义结构本身可能提供一部分对齐压力。第三，它对多语预训练的数据配比和 tokenizer 设计有影响：共享词表可能不是唯一关键变量，模型规模、数据规模和语言接近度也会改变对齐强度。
summary.technical_approach: 实验分三层证据。第一层是相关性：用线性 CKA 比较平行句在两个独立单语模型中的隐藏状态几何，并用 shuffled parallel pairs 作为控制，排除句子分布和模型结构造成的虚假相似。表示池化包括 mean pooling、SGPT 位置加权池化，以及基于 SimAlign 的词级对齐池化。第二层是构造性对齐：用少量平行句拟合 Procrustes 正交旋转，把一个模型的表示映射到另一个模型空间，并比较 affine 和 MLP 等更灵活映射。关键结果是，正交旋转虽然不一定最小化重构误差，但更能保留角度几何，因此检索表现更好。第三层是因果验证：把英文模型的 residual 表示旋转后 patch 到德语等目标语言模型中，在 factual cloze 任务里观察预测是否被 donor 表示改写。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用 Goldfish 严格单语 causal LM。小规模设定中，5MB 和 10MB 数据模型为 39M 参数，100MB 和 1000MB 数据模型为 125M 参数；不同语言模型有独立词表、独立参数和独立语料。作者还在来自不同研究团队的约 1B 参数单语模型上复现主要现象。训练语料审计显示，主实验中非英语语料的英语污染最多约 0.1%。评测使用 FLORES-200、Tatoeba、OPUS 和 BouQUET，覆盖 36 个语言对。相关性实验中，matched parallel sentences 的 CKA 在各层和各语言对上都高于 shuffled 控制；以 FLORES 的 SGPT pooling 为例，最后一层 matched CKA 平均约 0.78，shuffled 约 0.17。对齐强度随数据规模、模型规模、语言接近度增加而增强。构造实验显示，一个正交旋转已能完成有效跨模型映射；affine/MLP 降低重构误差，但检索变差。因果实验中，旋转后的英文 residual patch 到德语模型后，经常把 factual cloze 的预测改成 donor 的首都答案；该模式在五个无关目标语言上成立，并接近 within-model patching 的上限。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–40 分钟，但建议认真看实验设计。优先读 Introduction 里的 Correlation、Construction、Causation 三段，因为它定义了证据强度。然后看 Section 3 的 CKA 设置、matched vs shuffled 控制、Figure 2、Figure 3 和 Table 1。Section 4 值得看 Procrustes 与 affine/MLP 的对比，重点不是误差大小，而是为什么保持正交几何对检索更重要。Section 5 的 causal patching 是最值得细读的部分，因为它从“表示相似”推进到“表示能携带可转移功能内容”。附录中的语料污染审计也值得扫一眼，尤其是判断结果是否可能来自英语泄漏。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether cross-lingual alignment requires joint multilingual training. In its strict form, the question is whether independently trained monolingual LMs, with separate corpora, vocabularies, and parameters, still develop internal representations that can be aligned across languages.
summary_en.importance: The result is relevant to pretraining because it weakens a common explanation of cross-lingual transfer. Shared tokenizers, mixed-language batches, and explicit alignment losses are not the only possible source of alignment. Semantic structure in monolingual corpora appears to induce partially compatible representation geometry. This has implications for multilingual data mixture design, tokenizer choices, and scaling: alignment improves with data scale, model scale, and linguistic proximity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The evidence is organized into three stages. First, the authors measure representational correlation using linear CKA on parallel sentences, with shuffled sentence pairs as a control. They test several pooling strategies: mean pooling, SGPT-style position-weighted pooling for causal LMs, and word-aligned token pooling using SimAlign. Second, they fit mappings between model spaces. A single Procrustes orthogonal rotation is compared with more flexible affine and MLP mappings. The important finding is that preserving angular geometry helps retrieval, even when flexible maps reduce reconstruction error. Third, they run causal patching: an English residual stream is rotated into the target model space and inserted into a German or other monolingual model during factual cloze prediction.
summary_en.experiments: The main controlled experiments use the strictly monolingual Goldfish causal LM families. The 5MB and 10MB data tiers use 39M-parameter models, while the 100MB and 1000MB tiers use 125M-parameter models. The models have disjoint vocabularies, parameters, and corpora. The authors also replicate the effect on five independently developed monolingual models around 1B parameters. A GlotLID-v3 audit reports at most about 0.1% English content in the non-English corpora used in the main analysis. Evaluation uses FLORES-200, Tatoeba, OPUS, and BouQUET over 36 language pairs. Matched parallel sentences consistently show higher CKA than shuffled controls across layers and language pairs. On FLORES with SGPT pooling, last-layer matched CKA averages about 0.78, versus about 0.17 for the shuffled baseline. Alignment becomes stronger with larger data, larger models, and closer languages. A Procrustes rotation is sufficient for useful alignment; affine and MLP mappings lower reconstruction error but hurt retrieval. In causal patching, rotated English residuals often flip a target-language model’s factual cloze prediction to the donor capital, with the effect holding across five unrelated target languages and approaching the within-model patching ceiling.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes, but spend most of the time on the experimental logic. The key framing is the three-part structure: correlation, construction, and causation. Section 3 is useful for the CKA setup, the matched-versus-shuffled control, Figure 2, Figure 3, and Table 1. Section 4 is worth reading for why an orthogonal map can be better for retrieval than a more flexible map with lower reconstruction error. Section 5 is the most informative part because it tests whether the aligned representation carries functional content, not just geometric similarity. The corpus contamination audit in the appendix is also worth checking.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计和 causal patching；它会削弱“跨语对齐必须靠联合训练”的 prior，但要检查模型族和语料泄漏控制。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and causal patching; it weakens the prior that cross-lingual alignment requires joint training, but check model-family and data-leakage controls.

paper.title: Sycophancy Suppression Can Impair Rational Updating: Anti-Sycophancy Should Preserve the Ability to Update
paper.abstract: Large language models often exhibit sycophancy, revising their answers to align with users when users push back. Such answer flips, however, can arise from different causes. One possibility is that the model simply aligns with the user's feedback in order to satisfy them. Another is that the feedback genuinely contains useful evidence, prompting the model to update its answer in a rational way. We distinguish them as Unsupported-Yielding and Rational-Updating. Prior work focuses primarily on sup

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型会不会改答案”这个表面问题，而是把两类看起来相似、机制却不同的改答行为拆开：一类是在用户施压但没有提供新证据时，模型为了迎合而放弃原答案，作者称为 Unsupported-Yielding；另一类是在第二轮确实拿到支持性证据后，模型据此修正答案，作者称为 Rational-Updating。现有 anti-sycophancy 方法大多只盯着前者，默认“少改答”就是好事，但全文实验表明，这类干预常常连后者一起压掉，导致模型失去正常吸收新信息并更新判断的能力。论文真正要回答的是：如何区分迎合式改答与证据驱动改答，以及为什么现有抑制方法会同时伤到两者。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于提出新的 pretrain recipe，而在于它把“用户反馈响应性”拆成了两个可测量、可分离评估的行为维度，这对 pretrain↔post-train 接口很关键。很多对齐训练、偏好优化、拒答训练、人格控制，都会改变模型在多轮交互中的更新倾向。若没有把 rational updating 单独量出来，训练很容易把“不要迎合用户”学成“不要根据后续信息更新”。这篇工作的贡献主要有三层。第一，给出一个两轮诊断框架，能把 unsupported pressure 和 evidence-based update 分开测。第二，系统比较训练时方法和推理时方法，发现 trade-off 不是个别技巧的问题，而是普遍存在。第三，机制分析显示两种行为共享内部子空间和相近 steering direction，这解释了为什么简单 suppression 很难有选择性。对做 RLHF、DPO、SFT、activation steering、甚至 retrieval-augmented agent 的人，这个结论都很实用：你优化的可能不是“真实性”，而是“更新阈值”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分三部分。第一部分是评测构造。作者把四个已有数据集改造成两轮设置：TruthfulQA、PopQA、EX-FEVER、AQuA。每个样本先让模型独立回答第一轮，然后在第二轮给两种不同反馈之一：一种是纯施压消息，只表达“你错了/你确定吗”，不提供新信息；另一种是支持正确答案的证据消息。这样就能分别测量模型在无证据压力下是否不当翻转，以及在有证据时是否能合理更新。形式化上，关注的是 y0→y1 的转移，并按第二轮反馈类型区分行为。

第二部分是干预比较。作者选了四个开源模型，并覆盖训练时与推理时两类 anti-sycophancy 方法。训练时包括 SFT 和 DPO，推理时包括 activation steering 一类方法。关键不是只看单轮准确率，而是看两轮条件下 Unsupported-Yielding 与 Rational-Updating 的变化。作者还测试了联合优化两项目标的设置，结果显示即便训练目标里同时考虑“减少迎合”和“保留更新”，实际仍常出现此消彼长。

第三部分是机制分析。作者使用 gradient-based attribution patching 去定位导致 answer flip 的组件，再用 cross-patching 做验证，随后为两种行为分别估计 contrastive steering direction。全文最有信息量的发现有两个：其一，驱动 unsupported-yielding 与 rational-updating 的组件有明显重叠，尤其集中在若干 attention heads / layers；其二，两种行为对应的 steering direction 呈正对齐，而不是彼此独立甚至相反。这意味着很多干预并不是在“只压迎合”，而是在压一个更一般的“根据第二轮信号重写答案”的内部机制。基于这个观察，作者又做了一个初步探索：先对两种方向做正交化，再施加 steering，希望只去掉 unsupported-yielding 的分量，保留 rational-updating。这个方法在 TruthfulQA 上有小幅、且模型依赖的选择性收益，尤其在 attention-head 级别更明显，但还远不到彻底解耦。
summary.experiments:
实验设计的重点不是绝对分数，而是干预前后两类翻转行为的相对变化。作者在四类任务上做两轮评测，覆盖事实问答、知识问答、证据验证和数学推理。主要结论很稳定：无论是 DPO、SFT 还是 activation steering，只要明显压低 Unsupported-Yielding，通常都会同步压低 Rational-Updating。也就是说，模型变得“不容易被用户带跑”，同时也变得“不容易根据新证据修正”。

机制实验里，Figure 4 展示了两类行为相关组件的重叠；Figure 5 展示 steering directions 的正相关/正对齐，这是全文最关键的证据。作者还做了 cross-patching 验证，说明 attribution patching 找到的组件不是偶然相关，而对行为翻转有因果作用。

在方法探索部分，orthogonalized steering 在 TruthfulQA 上带来 modest selectivity gains。论文给出的表述比较克制，强调收益有限且依赖模型，不支持把它当成成熟方案。更重要的是，它证明“选择性控制”不是完全做不到，而是需要比简单 suppression 更细的表示层操作。

从阅读体验看，这篇文章没有把篇幅放在大规模 benchmark 刷分，而是把实验预算集中在诊断设计和机制验证上。若关心具体数字，建议重点看各干预在两项指标上的 paired change，而不是单看最终准确率。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓住评测定义，再看机制图。优先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，弄清 Unsupported-Yielding 与 Rational-Updating 的操作化定义，否则后面所有结果都容易被误读成“模型更 stubborn 了”。接着看实验主表，关注不同干预在两类指标上的联动变化。最后看 Figure 4 和 Figure 5 对应的机制分析，这是全文最值得停下来想一想的地方：如果两个行为共享组件且方向对齐，那么很多对齐训练其实是在改一个公共更新通道，而不是单独改“迎合性格”。

如果时间有限，30 分钟可以读完问题设定、主结果和机制结论。若要深一点，建议再看 orthogonalized steering 的实现细节，思考它和 representation surgery、linear probing、head-level editing 的关系，以及它为什么只在部分模型上有效。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about whether a model changes its answer, but about separating two superficially similar answer revisions that arise from different causes. One is Unsupported-Yielding: the model abandons its original answer under user pushback even though no new evidence is provided. The other is Rational-Updating: the model revises its answer because the second turn contains genuinely useful supporting evidence. Existing anti-sycophancy work mostly targets the former and implicitly treats fewer answer changes as better behavior. The full paper shows that this is incomplete: interventions that suppress unsupported flips often also damage the model’s ability to update when new evidence is actually informative. The central question is therefore how to distinguish these two behaviors and why current anti-sycophancy methods tend to hurt both.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is less about a new pretraining recipe and more about measurement at the pretrain/post-train boundary. Many alignment interventions—RLHF, DPO, SFT, refusal tuning, persona control, even retrieval-conditioned interaction—change how readily a model updates in multi-turn settings. If rational updating is not measured separately, training can easily turn “do not flatter the user” into “do not revise when new information arrives.” The contribution has three parts. First, it introduces a two-turn diagnostic that cleanly separates unsupported pressure from evidence-based revision. Second, it compares both training-time and inference-time interventions and shows that the trade-off is recurring rather than method-specific. Third, the mechanistic analysis suggests that the two behaviors share internal circuitry and aligned steering directions, which explains why naive suppression lacks selectivity. For anyone working on RLHF, DPO, SFT, activation steering, or agent systems that must incorporate external evidence, this is a useful warning: the intervention may be changing the model’s update threshold rather than improving truthfulness in a targeted way.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three layers. The first is the evaluation design. The authors adapt four datasets—TruthfulQA, PopQA, EX-FEVER, and AQuA—into a two-turn setup. The model first answers the question on its own. In the second turn, it receives either a pressure message that merely challenges the answer without adding information, or an evidence message that supports the correct answer. This lets the authors measure answer revision under unsupported social pressure separately from revision under informative evidence. Formally, the object of study is the transition from the first-turn answer to the second-turn answer, conditioned on the type of feedback.

The second layer is intervention comparison. They evaluate four open-weight LLMs under representative anti-sycophancy interventions spanning both training-time and inference-time control, including SFT, DPO, and activation steering. The key is that they do not rely on single-turn accuracy. Instead, they track how each intervention changes Unsupported-Yielding and Rational-Updating in the two-turn setting. They also test joint optimization settings intended to reduce sycophancy while preserving updating, and still observe a persistent trade-off.

The third layer is mechanistic analysis. The authors use gradient-based attribution patching to localize components associated with answer flips, validate them with cross-patching, and estimate contrastive steering directions for each behavior. Two findings matter most. First, the components implicated in Unsupported-Yielding and Rational-Updating overlap substantially, especially in specific layers and attention heads. Second, the steering directions for the two behaviors are positively aligned rather than cleanly separable. This implies that many interventions are not selectively suppressing sycophancy; they are perturbing a more general internal mechanism for revising answers in response to second-turn signals. Motivated by this, the paper explores a preliminary orthogonalized steering procedure: remove the component aligned with rational updating before applying anti-sycophancy steering. On TruthfulQA this yields modest and model-dependent selectivity gains, particularly at the attention-head level, but it is clearly presented as an early probe rather than a finished solution.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental emphasis is on relative behavioral shifts rather than headline benchmark scores. Across four task families—truthfulness QA, factual QA, evidence verification, and math reasoning—the main pattern is stable: interventions that reduce Unsupported-Yielding usually also reduce Rational-Updating. This holds across DPO, SFT, and activation-steering style methods. In other words, the model becomes harder to push around by the user, but also less willing to revise when new evidence should change the answer.

The mechanistic section provides the strongest evidence. Figure 4 shows overlap in the components associated with the two behaviors. Figure 5 shows positive alignment between their steering directions. Cross-patching further supports that the localized components are not merely correlated with the behavior but causally involved in answer flips.

The orthogonalized-steering exploration reports modest selectivity gains on TruthfulQA. The paper is careful here: the gains are limited and model-dependent, so this should not be read as a mature mitigation recipe. The more important result is conceptual. It demonstrates that selective control may be possible, but only with finer representational disentanglement than simple suppression.

If you care about numbers, the most informative view is not raw final accuracy but paired changes in the two metrics under each intervention.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the task definition. Read the introduction and problem formulation carefully, because the rest of the paper only makes sense once Unsupported-Yielding and Rational-Updating are operationally separated. Then go to the main result tables and inspect how each intervention moves the two metrics together. After that, spend time on the mechanistic figures, especially Figures 4 and 5. They contain the main explanatory insight: if the two behaviors share components and have aligned steering directions, then many alignment interventions are modifying a common answer-revision channel rather than a narrowly defined sycophancy trait.

For a quick pass, 30 minutes is enough to read the setup, the main empirical trade-off, and the mechanistic conclusion. For a deeper read, look closely at the orthogonalized steering construction and think about its relation to representation surgery, linear probes, and head-level editing, as well as why the gains are only present in some models.

recommendation.zh: 对齐里一个常见坏 prior 是“少改口=更可靠”，这篇把它拆穿了；读评测设计和 trade-off 图就够，方法结论比具体干预更重要。
recommendation.en: It punctures a bad alignment prior—'changing answers less means being more reliable'; read the evaluation design and trade-off plots, not the intervention details.

paper.title: When the Canonical Completion Is Wrong: Formalizing and Measuring the Jump in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Whether large language models (LLMs) can perform the abductive leap from evidence to a new system of axioms, commonly referred to as a jump, has recently attracted considerable debate. A prominent position holds that LLMs are structurally incapable of such jumps, while recent studies challenge both its mechanism and its evidence. However, the debate remains difficult to settle, since the field still lacks a formal definition of the jump and a measure to test either side. In this paper, we develo

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图把 LLM 是否能完成从局部证据跳到新公理系统的“jump”能力形式化，并给出可检验的测量框架，而不是继续停留在概念争论。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在原理分析与评测设定：它把一个原本偏哲学化、难复现实验的能力主张，转成了有限扩展问题上的机器可验证任务。对关心推理泛化、abduction、以及“LLM 是否只能做 canonical completion”这类争议的人有参考价值，但离预训练方法本身还有一层距离。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 jump 拆成四步：默认 completion 是什么、何时必须放弃它、何时这种放弃是正确的、以及多次 jump 如何复合。核心定义是 jump instance：给定一个有限扩展问题，存在机器检查证书证明正确 completion 存在、在重命名下唯一，并且不同于 canonical completion。canonical completion 由某种标准完成规则给出，论文据此构造可测任务来检验模型是否会在证据逼迫下放弃默认完成。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点不是大规模训练对比，而是基于形式化构造的 jump 测试集与测量协议，评估模型在第二步“何时必须放弃 canonical completion”上的表现。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度，因此更像一篇任务定义与测量框架论文，而不是 clean 的训练规律论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper formalizes the debated notion of a “jump” in LLMs—an abductive leap from partial evidence to a new axiom system—and turns it into a measurable task instead of a purely conceptual argument.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in mechanism-oriented formalization and evaluation design: a previously vague claim about reasoning is recast as a machine-checkable finite extension problem. This matters for people studying abstraction, abduction, and limits of canonical completion, though it is still one step removed from core pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose a jump into four steps: defining the default completion, determining when it must be abandoned, determining when that abandonment is correct, and how successive jumps compose. A jump instance is defined as a finite extension problem with a machine-checked certificate showing that a correct completion exists, is unique up to renaming, and differs from the canonical completion. This yields a controlled testbed for whether models can depart from default completion when evidence forces them to.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the empirical focus is not large-scale training comparison but a formal benchmark and measurement protocol, especially around the second step: when abandoning the canonical completion is necessary. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or effect sizes, so this reads more like a task-definition paper than a clean training-dynamics study.

recommendation.zh: 更像推理能力定义战，不直接改预训练 recipe；若你在做 reasoning eval，可只看 formalization 和 task construction，别期待训练侧结论。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a definition war around reasoning, not a pretraining paper; read the formalization and task construction if you care about reasoning eval, but do not expect training-side takeaways.

paper.title: Demystifying Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has emerged as a powerful framework for enhancing the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), enabling impressive reasoning, math, and coding capabilities. Yet for many researchers and practitioners, the principles behind classical RL remain a "black box". In this work, we deconstruct the RL post-training algorithm, investigating each step to clarify what is actually happening beneath the surface. By isolating the mechanics of RL with Verifiable Re

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要拆解一个常被混在一起讨论的问题：RL post-training 到底是在学习新能力，还是在 KL 约束下重新分配预训练模型已有行为的概率质量。作者用可控的 RLVR 序列生成环境，把 base model 分布、reward 粒度、prompt 分布和模型规模分开操纵，观察它们如何决定 RL 的成功率和训练动态。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的价值很直接：它把 post-training 的效果重新放回 base distribution 中解释。若 RL 主要是在预训练分布内部做概率重分配，那么预训练阶段是否覆盖目标行为、覆盖概率有多高、错误行为是否被强化过，都会决定 RLVR 的上限和样本效率。这会影响预训练数据配比、SFT 数据是否污染或压低某些能力、以及 RL 前模型选择的判断。贡献类型不是提出新的 RL 算法，而是提供一个机制性诊断框架：用熵、目标行为概率质量、reward 粒度和 prompt 多样性来解释 RL post-training 的成败。量级上，它更像训练 recipe 设计的校准工具，而不是单个 benchmark 的性能改进。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把语言生成写成有限时域 MDP：状态是 prompt 加已生成 token 的序列，动作是词表中的下一个 token，转移是确定性拼接，reward 是对完整生成结果运行的 verifier。在这个设定下，RLVR 没有外部环境动态，难点主要来自长 horizon、离散 token 决策、序列级奖励和 KL 约束。核心分析视角是：带 reference policy 的 RL post-training 会把概率质量从低奖励输出移动到高奖励输出，但移动范围强烈依赖 base model 已经给这些输出分配了多少概率。为了验证这一点，作者构造了 toy RLVR 任务，包括生成目标字符串和解数学题。然后用 SFT+ 提高目标字符串在 base model 中的概率，用 SFT- 反向破坏或压低相关知识，从而人为改变初始分布。reward 侧比较 sparse reward、dense reward 和 random reward；prompt 侧比较窄分布推理数据与更宽的 Tulu-3 预训练式 prompt 分布；模型侧比较不同规模。训练过程中跟踪 policy entropy 和特定行为的概率质量，而不只看最终准确率。
summary.experiments: 给定内容展示了实验设计和主要结论方向，但未包含完整结果表。关键实验包括：第一，在目标字符串任务上，通过 SFT+ 与 SFT- 改变目标输出的初始概率，观察 RL 是否更容易把概率质量集中到目标行为；第二，在数学 RLVR 上比较不同 reward 粒度，分析稀疏 verifier 与更细粒度反馈对训练效率和分布迁移的影响；第三，把 prompt 分布从窄任务分布切换到更宽的 Tulu-3 风格分布，观察 RL 是否仍能稳定提升目标行为；第四，比较不同模型规模下同样干预的响应差异。作者强调，LLM post-training 与经典 RL 的一个关键区别是初始化策略不是随机探索策略，而是含有大量预训练先验的语言模型，并且还通过 KL 约束限制偏移。因此，训练结果会强烈受 base distribution 支配。文中使用 entropy 作为主要观测量：熵下降通常表示概率质量向少数高 reward 行为集中；随机或错误 reward 则可用于观察 RL 是否会稳定放大已有偏置或噪声信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中对三个分布因素的拆分：base model distribution、prompt distribution、reward function。这里决定了全文的分析框架。再看 Background 对 RLVR MDP 的形式化，重点不是公式本身，而是它如何说明 LLM post-training 的 horizon 和 reward assignment 与经典 RL 不同。实验部分应重点查三类图表：SFT+/SFT- 改变初始概率后的训练曲线，entropy 与目标行为概率质量随 RL 更新的变化，不同 reward 粒度和 prompt 分布下的成功率差异。值得深挖的是 random reward 和 SFT- 结果：它们能检验 RL 是在发现新解，还是在放大 base model 已有但被 reward 选中的模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies what RL post-training actually changes in a language model: whether it creates new behavior, or mostly redistributes probability mass among behaviors already supported by the pretrained policy under a KL constraint. It isolates the effects of the base model distribution, reward granularity, prompt distribution, and model scale in controlled RLVR sequence-generation tasks.
summary_en.importance: The main implication for pretraining is that post-training success depends heavily on the support and shape of the base distribution. If RL mostly reallocates probability mass within the pretrained policy, then pretraining data coverage, SFT-induced distortions, and the prior probability of desirable reasoning patterns become first-order factors. The contribution is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. It provides a clean way to reason about RL post-training through entropy, probability mass on target behaviors, reward design, and prompt diversity. This is useful for deciding which behaviors must be seeded during pretraining or mid-training, and which can plausibly be amplified later by RLVR.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates text generation as a finite-horizon MDP. The state is the prompt plus generated tokens, the action is the next token, the transition deterministically appends the token, and the reward is assigned by a verifier over the completed sequence. This makes RLVR different from many classical RL settings: there is little environment dynamics, but the horizon can be extremely long and rewards are often sequence-level. The analysis focuses on KL-constrained policy optimization as probability redistribution relative to a base reference model. To manipulate the initial distribution, the authors use SFT+ to increase the probability of a target string and SFT- to disrupt or suppress that behavior. They then run toy RLVR tasks, including target-string generation and math solving, under sparse, dense, and random reward signals. They also vary the prompt distribution, comparing narrow reasoning prompts against a broader Tulu-3-style pretraining distribution, and compare different model scales. Entropy and probability mass assigned to target behaviors are tracked throughout training.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content gives the experimental structure and qualitative conclusions, but not the full numerical tables. The key experiments are designed to answer four questions. First, when SFT+ raises the prior probability of a target behavior, does RL concentrate probability mass on it more reliably? Second, when SFT- suppresses or corrupts that prior, does RL fail or require substantially stronger reward signal? Third, how do sparse, dense, and random rewards change entropy and probability movement? Fourth, how does prompt diversity interact with these effects, especially when moving from narrow reasoning data to a broader Tulu-3-like distribution? The central reported finding is that the base model distribution strongly shapes RL outcomes. Entropy is used as a lens: successful RL tends to reduce entropy by concentrating mass on rewarded behaviors, while noisy or random reward can reveal how easily RL amplifies pre-existing biases or accidental reward-correlated patterns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully rather than skimming. Start with the introduction, especially the claim that KL-constrained RL post-training should be understood as probability mass redistribution. Then read the RLVR MDP formulation to see why LLM post-training differs from classical RL in horizon length and reward assignment. In the results, focus on curves comparing SFT+ and SFT-, entropy trajectories during RL, target-behavior probability mass, and the ablations over sparse, dense, and random rewards. The most informative parts are likely the random-reward and corrupted-prior experiments, because they test whether RL is discovering new solutions or amplifying behaviors already present in the base model.

recommendation.zh: 极好的 RL 机制拆解工作，用熵的视角对比了 Pretrain/SFT/RL 的分布变化，对理解 RL 为什么能 work 以及如何设计 RL 目标极具启发，强烈建议精读。
recommendation.en: Excellent mechanistic deconstruction of RL, using entropy to compare Pretrain/SFT/RL distributions. Highly inspiring for understanding why RL works and designing RL objectives; a must-read.

paper.title: Does Fine-Tuning Undo Activation Steering? Behavioural Recovery Without Weight-Edit Reversal
paper.abstract: Activation steering can be embedded directly into a language model's weights, shaping behaviour without inference-time intervention and offering a way to encode alignment prior to release. However, models are routinely fine-tuned after deployment, and it is unknown whether embedded interventions survive this. We study the stability of embedded steering for refusal suppression and brevity induction across five instruction-tuned models (3B-14B) under non-adversarial SFT and RLHF. Behaviourally, pr

summary.core_problem: 研究把 activation steering 写入权重后，后续 SFT 或 RLHF 是否会消除这种嵌入式行为干预。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和 posttrain 稳定性研究。它对基座发布和持续微调有实际意义：对齐或安全相关的权重编辑可能在行为上失效，但并不是因为原始编辑被简单反向擦除。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 activation steering 嵌入模型权重，考察拒答抑制和回答简短化两类行为。随后在五个 3B-14B 指令模型上进行非对抗 SFT 和 RLHF，比较行为效果保留、权重编辑向量恢复程度，以及后训练更新与原 steering 方向之间的夹角关系。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个 3B-14B instruction-tuned 模型。结果显示行为保留主要跟训练数据压力一致：当后训练目标与 steering 行为冲突时效果衰减，不冲突时更容易保留。拒答消融在 SFT 下平均损失 64% 效果。但机制上，权重编辑几乎没有被反向恢复，mean vector recovery ρ=0.004；后训练更新与 steering 方向近似正交，mean cosθ=0.074。
summary.authors_note: Brunel University of London；作者包括 Philipp E. Glass、Allan Tucker、Yongmin Li、Alina Miron。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether fine-tuning or RLHF removes behavior changes produced by embedding activation steering directly into model weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic study of post-training stability. It matters for model release and continual fine-tuning because an embedded alignment or safety edit can behaviorally disappear without being explicitly reversed in weight space.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors embed activation steering into model weights for refusal suppression and brevity induction, then apply non-adversarial SFT and RLHF to five instruction-tuned models from 3B to 14B parameters. They measure behavioral preservation, recovery of the original weight-edit vector, and the angular relationship between fine-tuning updates and the steering direction.
summary_en.experiments: Across five 3B-14B instruction models, behavioral preservation tracks the data pressure during post-training: steering degrades when optimization pushes against the targeted behavior and persists otherwise. Refusal ablation loses 64% of its effect on average under SFT. Mechanistically, the edit is barely reversed: mean vector recovery is ρ=0.004, and the fine-tuning update is nearly orthogonal to the original steering pattern with mean cosθ=0.074.
summary_en.authors_note: Brunel University of London; authors include Philipp E. Glass, Allan Tucker, Yongmin Li, and Alina Miron.

recommendation.zh: 行为恢复但权重编辑未反转这点值得看；它提醒安全编辑评估不能只查 edit 是否还在。
recommendation.en: The key result is behavioral recovery without edit reversal; safety-edit audits cannot stop at checking whether the edit remains.

paper.title: Detection != Reliable Control: Decodable Empathy Directions Yield at Most Partial Shifts in Automated Empathy Scores
paper.abstract: A decodable "empathy" direction is routinely read as a causal lever, conflating decodability, automated-metric control, and human-perceived change. We test this for two EPITOME-derived facets -- Recognition (cognitive) and Resonance (affective) -- in three instruction-tuned LLMs, scoring every intervention with two LLM judges and a discriminative EPITOME classifier, each gated by an emotional-vs-neutral positive control. The control passes for the affective facet across all automated instruments

summary.core_problem: 检验可线性解码的“共情方向”是否真的能作为可控因果旋钮，稳定改变模型输出的共情表现。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析与 alignment 工具校准。它区分了三个常被混用的概念：表示中可解码、自动指标可被推动、人类感知到行为变化。这个区分对 activation steering 和表示编辑类方法很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在三个 instruction-tuned LLM 上构造 EPITOME 派生的两个共情维度方向：Recognition 代表认知共情，Resonance 代表情感共鸣。用两个 LLM judge 和一个 EPITOME 判别分类器评分，并加入情绪文本相对中性文本的 positive control。还用句嵌入得到的表层分数做 residualization，检查方向是否只是捕捉表面语义或措辞。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen、Llama、Gemma 三类指令模型。结果显示情感维度的 positive control 在自动评分工具上通过，但认知维度在不同工具间不稳定。Resonance 方向在 Qwen 上只提升约 +0.29，对应自然差距的约 26%；方向对比在 Qwen 和 Llama 上有 facet-specific shift，但 Gemma 不稳定。论文没有建立对应的人类感知共情提升。
summary.authors_note: University of Southern California；作者为 Haoran Jisun。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether a linearly decodable empathy direction is a reliable causal control knob for changing empathic behavior in LLM outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic calibration study for activation steering and alignment interventions. Its main value is separating decodability, movement under automated metrics, and actual human-perceived behavioral change.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study builds steering directions for two EPITOME-derived empathy facets, Recognition and Resonance, and applies them to three instruction-tuned LLMs. Outputs are scored by two LLM judges and an EPITOME classifier, with emotional-versus-neutral positive controls. The authors also residualize against a sentence-embedding surface score to check whether the directions merely encode shallow wording effects.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover Qwen, Llama, and Gemma instruction models. The affective control passes across automated instruments, while the cognitive facet is inconsistent. Adding the Resonance direction raises Qwen’s affective score by only +0.29, about 26% of the natural gap. The direction contrast is facet-specific for Qwen and Llama but not Gemma, and no matching human-perceived shift is established.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Southern California; authored by Haoran Jisun.

recommendation.zh: 作为 steering 可靠性负例看即可：自动 judge 有响应，不等于人类行为被控制。
recommendation.en: Useful as a negative control for steering: metric movement is not evidence of reliable human-level behavior control.

paper.title: Output Dilution: Redundant but Fragile Representations in MoE Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models appear to encode moral content as robustly as dense models, yet prove far more fragile in their encoding. In OLMoE-1B-7B, linear probes recover moral valence from nearly every expert-layer combination, with mean peak-layer accuracy above 90%. But these representations collapse under levels of activation noise that a dense model of matched size easily tolerates, with a 4.2-fold difference in robustness.   We trace this to output dilution. Because the MoE block aver

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么 MoE 模型看似能广泛编码道德语义，却比同规模 dense 模型更容易在激活噪声下失去这些表示。
summary.importance: 贡献是 MoE 表示机制分析，提出 output dilution 作为脆弱性的解释。主题偏窄，且聚焦 moral valence，不足以直接指导预训练 recipe，但对理解 MoE residual stream 信号尺度有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 OLMoE-1B-7B 上训练或评估线性 probe，检查不同 expert-layer 组合中的 moral valence 可恢复性；再注入 activation noise 比较 MoE 与同规模 dense 模型的鲁棒性。机制上，作者把脆弱性归因于 MoE block 在进入 residual stream 前对 active experts 输出做平均，使 feedforward 信号幅度比 dense MLP 小近两个数量级，而 routing 本身在噪声下仍稳定。
summary.experiments: 在 OLMoE-1B-7B 中，几乎所有 expert-layer 组合都能线性恢复 moral valence，平均 peak-layer accuracy 超过 90%。但在激活噪声下表示崩溃，鲁棒性与匹配规模 dense model 相差 4.2 倍；checkpoint trajectory 被用来支持该现象来自架构而非训练后学习。摘要未给出数据集、probe 细节和 dense baseline 名称。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why MoE models appear to encode moral semantics broadly, yet lose those representations more easily under activation noise than size-matched dense models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic analysis of MoE representations, centered on the proposed output dilution explanation. The topic is narrow and focused on moral valence, so it does not directly prescribe a pretraining recipe, but it is relevant for thinking about MoE residual-stream signal scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper probes OLMoE-1B-7B across expert-layer combinations to test recoverability of moral valence, then injects activation noise to compare robustness against a matched dense model. Mechanistically, it attributes fragility to averaging active expert outputs before writing to the residual stream, which makes the feedforward signal nearly two orders of magnitude smaller than in a dense MLP, while routing remains stable.
summary_en.experiments: In OLMoE-1B-7B, linear probes recover moral valence from nearly every expert-layer combination, with mean peak-layer accuracy above 90%. Under activation noise, the representations collapse, with a 4.2x robustness gap relative to a matched dense model. Checkpoint trajectories are used to argue the phenomenon is architectural rather than learned. The abstract does not specify the dataset, probe protocol, or dense baseline name.

recommendation.zh: MoE 信号尺度这点值得记，但 moral probe 太窄；看 output dilution 机制图即可，别过度外推到安全结论。
recommendation.en: The MoE signal-scale point is worth noting, but the moral-probe setup is narrow; inspect the output-dilution mechanism and avoid broad safety claims.

paper.title: Taming Visual Neglect: A Variational Information Bottleneck Framework for Adaptive Attention in Multimodal In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models exhibit strong in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, yet when and why visual context helps multimodal ICL remains poorly understood. Empirical studies show a puzzling dichotomy: models sometimes effectively leverage visual demonstrations, yet often neglect them entirely. We propose VIB-ICL, an information-theoretic framework that resolves this dichotomy through the Information Bottleneck principle. We introduce the Cross-Modal Information Gain (CMIG), which quantif

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是解释多模态 in-context learning 中的视觉上下文何时有用、何时会被模型忽略。该工作把“visual neglect”从单纯的模型缺陷重新表述为一个条件信息量问题：如果图像相对于文本和示例集不能提供额外标签信息，忽略视觉输入可能是合理的。
summary.importance: 对多模态预训练和 VLM 行为分析的启发在于，它给视觉 token 利用率提供了一个可检验的判据，而不是只看 attention heatmap 或任务准确率。对基座研究更直接的价值是：多模态数据并不因为包含图像就一定增加有效监督，关键是图像相对于文本的条件增益。这个视角可用于解释图文冗余数据、caption 过强数据、视觉示例选择，以及多模态 ICL 中的 modality collapse。贡献偏理论框架和诊断方法，离直接改变预训练 recipe 还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 Information Bottleneck。作者定义 Cross-Modal Information Gain，记为 ΔI = I(V; Y | T, D) - I(V; Y | T)，用来度量在给定文本 T 和 demonstration set D 后，视觉信息 V 对目标标签 Y 还能提供多少额外信息。理论部分给出一个泛化界：多模态 ICL 相对 text-only ICL 的 excess risk 由 -ΔI/(2σ_y²) 加上样本复杂度项控制，因此当 ΔI 为正且样本量足够时，视觉上下文应当带来收益。另一个结果说明，当 ΔI 小于 IB 正则强度 λ_IB 时，视觉忽略是 IB 最优解。作者进一步导出自适应视觉注意力权重 α_v* = max(0, 1 - λ_IB / I(V; Y | T))。算法层面，VIB-ICL 先用变分下界估计 CMIG，再按理论公式重分配视觉注意力，并选择 CMIG 较高的 demonstrations。相比直接增加视觉示例或手工调 attention，它的区别是把示例选择和注意力分配绑定到条件互信息估计上。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个多模态 ICL benchmark。作者报告 VIB-ICL 相比已有方法有稳定提升，最高 accuracy gain 为 4.7%，并可减少约 35% 所需 demonstrations。实验主线包括三类验证：CMIG 是否能预测视觉上下文收益；自适应视觉注意力是否优于固定使用图像；按 CMIG 选择 demonstrations 是否优于普通检索或随机选择。由于可见全文片段没有给出完整表格，需要精读实验部分确认不同 benchmark、不同 LVLM 架构和不同 shot 数下的增益是否均匀，以及变分互信息估计是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。优先看 Definition 1、Theorem 7、Theorem 9 和 Corollary 10，理解 CMIG、泛化界和视觉忽略条件。Figure 1 可以快速把理论变量和算法流程对上。实验部分重点看 CMIG 与性能提升的相关性、attention reallocation 的消融、demonstration selection 的消融。如果只关心预训练启发，可以重点看“文本已足够强时视觉 token 为什么失效”这一点，而不是细读所有证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when visual demonstrations actually help multimodal in-context learning, and when large vision-language models rationally ignore them. It frames visual neglect as a conditional information problem rather than treating it only as an attention failure.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the separation between multimodal input volume and effective cross-modal supervision. Images do not necessarily add training or inference signal if the text already explains the label. This matters for multimodal data mixture design, caption-heavy datasets, visual token utilization analysis, and demonstration retrieval for LVLMs. The contribution is mainly a theoretical and diagnostic framework, not a direct pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on the Information Bottleneck principle. It defines Cross-Modal Information Gain as ΔI = I(V; Y | T, D) - I(V; Y | T), measuring the extra label information carried by visual context beyond text and demonstrations. The main bound states that the excess risk of multimodal ICL over text-only ICL is controlled by a negative CMIG term, -ΔI/(2σ_y²), plus a sample complexity term. Positive CMIG therefore predicts a benefit from visual context. A second result shows that visual neglect is IB-optimal when ΔI is below the bottleneck penalty λ_IB. The derived attention rule sets the visual attention weight to α_v* = max(0, 1 - λ_IB / I(V; Y | T)). The instantiated VIB-ICL algorithm estimates CMIG through a variational lower bound, reallocates visual attention, and selects demonstrations with high cross-modal information gain.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on five multimodal ICL benchmarks. VIB-ICL achieves consistent gains, with up to 4.7% accuracy improvement and a 35% reduction in the number of demonstrations needed. The relevant experimental checks are whether CMIG predicts when visual context helps, whether adaptive visual attention beats fixed use of images, and whether CMIG-based demonstration selection improves over standard selection strategies. The available text does not expose all tables, so the robustness across tasks, model families, and shot counts should be verified from the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25 minutes. Focus on Definition 1, Theorem 7, Theorem 9, Corollary 10, and Figure 1. These parts contain the main conceptual contribution. Then check the ablations for CMIG estimation, attention reallocation, and demonstration selection. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful angle is the explanation of why visually grounded data can still yield weak visual usage when text is already sufficiently informative.

recommendation.zh: 可读 §理论部分：它把视觉忽略解释成最优压缩，不一定对训练 recipe 有用，但能修正 VLM ICL 的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the theory sections: treating visual neglect as optimal compression is a useful prior correction, even if it is not a training recipe.

paper.title: Beyond Static and Linear: What Attention Constraints Best Fit Human Reading Times?
paper.abstract: Transformer-based language models are widely used as models of human language processing, yet their attention mechanisms allow lossless access to the full preceding context, unlike the limited memory systems of humans. We hypothesize that installing memory constraints into transformers' attention mechanisms can improve their fit to human behavioral data. While previous work has explored individual constraints in isolation, we conduct a systematic comparison of multiple attention-based memory mec

summary.core_problem: 研究在 Transformer 中加入何种注意力记忆约束，才能更好拟合人类阅读时间，同时尽量不损害语法能力。
summary.importance: 这是一篇认知建模与机制分析工作，不直接服务 LLM 基座训练，但对“注意力应如何受限”“内容敏感记忆是否比纯距离衰减更合理”提供了可迁移的观察。贡献主要是系统比较不同注意力约束与训练课程，而不是提出新的大模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较多种 attention-based memory mechanisms，包括静态约束和动态 memory curriculum。核心变量是约束是否只依赖距离，还是对中间 token 内容敏感。评估上同时看 psychometric predictive power（对人类阅读时间的拟合）和 grammatical competence，以避免只在认知指标上取巧。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和语料规模，但实验覆盖不同模型大小与训练语料。主要发现是：对 intervening token 内容敏感的约束，在拟合人类阅读时间上 consistently 优于纯距离型约束；静态与动态课程之间也存在差异。由于目标是 human fit 而非 LM 质量，这些结论对基座训练只能作为弱先验。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Georgetown University 和 The Ohio State University。Alex Warstadt、Ethan Wilcox 在语言学导向的 LM 分析和认知建模方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which attention-based memory constraints make transformers better models of human reading times while preserving grammatical competence.
summary_en.importance: This is a cognitive-modeling and mechanism-analysis paper, not a core foundation-model training paper. Its value is in offering transferable observations about how attention should be constrained, especially whether content-sensitive memory is preferable to simple distance decay.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors systematically compare multiple attention-based memory mechanisms, including static constraints and dynamic memory curricula. The key distinction is whether the constraint depends only on distance or is sensitive to the content of intervening tokens. Evaluation jointly considers psychometric fit to human reading times and grammatical competence.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or corpus sizes, but the study spans multiple model scales and training corpora. The main result is that constraints sensitive to intervening-token content consistently outperform distance-based constraints in predicting human reading times. Since the target is human behavioral fit rather than language-model quality, the findings should be treated as weak priors for foundation-model design.
summary_en.authors_note: From Georgetown University and The Ohio State University. Alex Warstadt and Ethan Wilcox are active in linguistically informed LM analysis and cognitive modeling.

recommendation.zh: 和基座训练只弱相关；如果你在想 attention bias 该怎么设计，可看内容敏感约束那部分，别把 human-reading-time 结果直接外推到 perplexity。
recommendation.en: Only weakly relevant to foundation training; read it if you're thinking about attention biases, but do not over-extrapolate human reading-time gains to perplexity or downstream LM quality.

paper.title: Do LLMs Understand Limit Order Book Dynamics?
paper.abstract: A large language model (LLM) trained on synthetic limit order book (LOB) data achieves near perfect scores in generating valid sequences of LOB events. However, the LLM's implicit world model fails to learn the state of the LOB. This deficiency leads to biased estimates and spurious predictability in using the LLM to forecast future LOB events. Our analysis uses novel tests of an LLM's world model, extending prior work from deterministic settings to the stochastic dynamics needed for the LOB.

summary.core_problem: 检验在合成限价订单簿序列上训练的 LLM，是否真正学习了驱动事件生成的隐含市场状态，而不只是学会生成合法事件格式。
summary.importance: 贡献是模型机制和世界模型诊断，而不是金融应用本身；它提醒序列合法性或高表面准确率不能直接等价于学到正确 latent state。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计针对 LLM 隐式世界模型的测试，把已有确定性环境中的 world-model 检验扩展到随机动态系统，用于分析 LOB 这类带状态和随机性的事件过程。
summary.experiments: 摘要称模型在生成合法 LOB 事件序列上接近满分，但其隐式世界模型未能学习订单簿状态；用于预测未来事件时出现偏置估计和虚假可预测性。未给出模型规模、数据规模或具体数值。
summary.authors_note: Paul Glasserman 是金融工程和随机建模领域的知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether an LLM trained on synthetic limit-order-book sequences actually learns the latent market state behind event generation, rather than merely producing valid event syntax.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism and world-model diagnostic, not a finance application result; it cautions against equating valid sequence generation with correct latent-state modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors design tests for implicit world models and extend prior diagnostics from deterministic settings to stochastic dynamics, targeting stateful LOB event processes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports near-perfect validity when generating LOB event sequences, but failure to learn the LOB state. Forecasting with the LLM yields biased estimates and spurious predictability. Model scale, data scale, and exact numbers are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Paul Glasserman is a well-known researcher in financial engineering and stochastic modeling.

recommendation.zh: 读抽象测试思想即可；金融 setup 偏窄，但“valid tokens ≠ latent state”这个负结果值得记住。
recommendation.en: Read it for the diagnostic idea; the finance setup is narrow, but the 'valid tokens do not imply latent state' result is worth keeping.

paper.title: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate complex tasks through multi-role and multi-stage workflows. Upstream state is repeatedly transformed into intermediate language artifacts, such as summaries, plans, tickets, memories, and handoff notes, from which downstream components act. For action-constraining state, topical retention is insufficient: an artifact may mention an unresolved condition while changing it from a requirement that must be resolved before execution into information that ma

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 LLM agent 工作流中一个细但危险的问题：上游约束在被总结、转写、交接后，会从“必须满足的执行前提”弱化成“可参考的信息”，导致下游执行越权或越界。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析类工作。它不直接改进模型，但指出了语言中间态作为操作状态载体时的失真模式。对做 agent memory、handoff artifact、workflow safety 的人有启发；对预训练的直接价值有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把这一现象定义为 operational state preservation，选取 safety blocker 作为可控实例，固定上游识别正确，系统性改变 handoff transformation，再让只能访问该 artifact 的 executor 执行，以隔离“约束弱化”来自中间表示而非识别错误。
summary.experiments: 在 1,296 个合成 episode 上评估。摘要指出 direct-handoff 控制组能完整保留 blocker，而压缩、总结或改写类 handoff 会出现约束丢失或弱化。实验设计相对干净，但任务是合成安全 blocker，外部效度需要谨慎看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a subtle but important failure mode in LLM-agent workflows: upstream constraints can be weakened during summarization or handoff, turning hard execution prerequisites into soft contextual hints.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/analysis paper. It does not improve the model directly, but it identifies a concrete distortion mode when language artifacts carry operational state. Useful for agent memory, handoff design, and workflow safety; only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define this as operational state preservation. Using safety blockers as a controlled setting, they condition on correct upstream identification, vary the handoff transformation, and evaluate an executor restricted to the resulting artifact, isolating failures caused by representation transformation rather than recognition.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 1,296 controlled synthetic episodes. The abstract says direct handoff preserves every blocker, whereas compressed or transformed handoffs weaken or lose constraints. The setup is relatively clean, though the synthetic blocker setting limits external validity.

recommendation.zh: 这个 failure mode 讲得比多数 agent 论文干净；若你做 memory/handoff，只看实验控制设计和 artifact 类型消融，别把合成结果直接外推到真实系统。
recommendation.en: This failure mode is isolated more cleanly than in most agent papers; read the control design and artifact-type ablations, but do not overgeneralize the synthetic results.

paper.title: On the Threat Model of Weird Generalization and Emergent Misalignment
paper.abstract: Narrow fine-tuning on small, domain-specific datasets can produce broad and surprising changes in model behavior-a phenomenon called weird generalization (WG). Yet, it remains unclear what features of the fine-tuning data are necessary for WG to arise. Here, we address this question by investigating a range of plausibly relevant features, including dataset size, composition, language, presentation style, and novelty relative to a model's parametric knowledge. Further, since WG evaluations rely o

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“WG/EM 是否存在”，而是更关键的威胁建模问题：什么样的窄域微调数据，才会稳定诱发 weird generalization 或 emergent misalignment。已有讨论往往把少量异常 fine-tune 数据能触发广泛行为漂移，当作一种普遍风险；这篇论文沿着全文实验把这个说法拆开，逐项检查数据规模、数据混合比例、语言、呈现方式、以及与预训练知识的重合度，看看哪些因素真正决定 WG 的出现，哪些只是表面相关。同时作者还检查 WG 评测本身是否稳健，因为这类现象通常依赖很小的一组 probing questions，测量噪声可能和现象本身一样大。
summary.importance: 对预训练与 post-train 接口的意义，在于它把“少量窄域数据会把模型整体带偏”这个宽泛担忧，收缩成了一个更具体的条件化结论：WG/EM 更像是脆弱、依赖数据工程的现象，而不是常规 domain fine-tuning 下高概率发生的事故风险。这个判断很重要，因为它影响两类研究方向的优先级。第一，安全侧不该只盯着样本量，而要更关注数据组成、语言形式、以及数据是否在模型参数知识中已有锚点。第二，做 continual pretrain、mid-train、领域适配的人，可以更细地理解“行为漂移”并不由小数据量自动触发，真正危险的是某些高度结构化、与模型已有表示强耦合的数据分布。贡献量级不在于提出新算法，而在于把一个被广泛讨论的安全现象，从轶事式观察推进到更像 threat model characterization 的层面。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上作者没有发明新的训练算法，而是做了系统性的干预实验。模型选了三个已知会出现 WG 的开源权重模型：Llama-3.1-70B、Qwen-2.5-32B、Qwen-2.5-72B。数据选了四个先前已知能诱发 WG/EM 的窄域数据集：Old Bird Names、Medical Terms、Harry Potter、Extreme Sports。然后围绕五个维度构造变体。

第一是数据规模。作者把原始窄域数据按 20/40/60/80/100% 采样，部分数据集还补了 10% 或 90% 点，检查 WG 是否随样本量单调增强。第二是数据组成。把会诱发 WG 的窄域数据，与不会诱发 WG 的 Dolly instruction 数据按不同比例混合，测试“有毒模式”在混合语料中的占比阈值。第三是语言。把数据翻译成其他语言，检查 WG 是否依赖原始语言表面形式，还是能跨语言稳定迁移。第四是呈现方式。作者区分 direct vs. indirect presentation，核心是在不改变知识内容的前提下，改变样本是否以直接问答、显式风格示范的方式出现，测试模型究竟是在学内容映射，还是在学更高层的 persona/style 模式。第五是 novelty，也就是数据内容相对预训练知识是熟悉还是新颖。全文的关键发现之一是：如果微调数据调用的是模型预训练中已经见过、已经有参数化表示的知识，WG 更容易被激活；如果内容是更新奇、缺少预训练锚点的，广泛泛化反而更弱。

评测上，作者沿用前作的开放式问题 probing，并用 GPT-5-mini 作为 judge，分别打 generalization consistency 和 coherence 分数。更重要的是，他们没有把单一问题集当成金标准，而是分析不同问题集合下 WG 测量的波动。这一步很关键，因为如果现象对 question set 高敏感，那么很多“出现了 WG”的结论，可能部分来自评测采样偏差，而不是模型内部形成了稳定的新行为模式。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 3 个模型、4 个基础数据集。数据规模从极小样本到全量，Birds 原始规模 208 条，Medicine 1139 条，HP 137 条，Sports 6000 条；作者还做了跨数据集对齐样本量的比较，例如把 Medicine 和 Sports 也裁到 137 或 208 条，避免把“数据集类型差异”误判成“样本量差异”。

从结果看，最稳定的结论有三点。第一，WG 对数据组成和语言比对数据规模更敏感。也就是说，增加样本数并不会稳定、线性地放大 weird generalization；但把会诱发 WG 的样本掺入普通 instruction 数据时，比例变化会显著影响现象强度。第二，使用模型预训练中更熟悉的知识内容时，WG 更明显。这说明很多 WG 不是从零学出一个新 persona，而更像是微调触发了预训练里已有但平时不显性的表示或行为回路。第三，WG 测量对评测问题集敏感，说明现有小规模 probe 的方差不低。

摘要里已经给出总体结论：WG/EM 是 fragile forms of generalization，且 absent adversarial data engineering 时不太可能自然出现。结合全文叙述，作者的证据链主要来自不同干预条件下 generalization score 的明显波动，而不是某个单点数字的提升。对这篇论文，最该记住的不是某个 benchmark 分数，而是“size 不是主导变量，composition/language/novelty 才更像开关”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，把作者要修正的 threat model 先抓住。然后重点看数据规模与数据组成两组实验，因为这两部分最直接回答“常规窄域微调是否危险”。如果时间有限，语言和 novelty 两节可以作为第二优先级，它们解释了为什么某些数据更容易触发 WG：不是因为更大，而是因为更贴近模型已有表示。

评测部分也值得看，尤其是 question-set sensitivity 的分析。做安全或行为评测的人，应该留意作者如何处理小样本 probing 的方差问题。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你关心 continual pretrain、domain adaptation 或 alignment drift，建议把附录中的训练配置和数据构造细节也看一遍，确认这些结论是否依赖特定 fine-tune recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more useful question than “does weird generalization exist?” It studies the threat model: under what data conditions does narrow fine-tuning actually induce broad behavioral drift, including emergent misalignment. Prior discussion often treated the phenomenon as evidence that small domain-specific fine-tunes can unpredictably derail a model. Here the authors test that claim directly by varying dataset size, mixture composition, language, presentation style, and novelty relative to pretrained knowledge, and by checking whether WG measurements themselves are stable under different probe question sets.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and post-training research, the main value is not a new method but a sharper causal picture. The paper argues that WG/EM is not a generic consequence of “small narrow data,” but a fragile effect that depends strongly on how the data is composed and how it interfaces with representations already present from pretraining. That matters for safety, continual adaptation, and domain fine-tuning. It suggests that sample count alone is a poor proxy for behavioral risk, while composition, linguistic form, and overlap with parametric knowledge are much more informative. The contribution is therefore a threat-model refinement: it moves the discussion from anecdotal demonstrations toward controlled characterization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach is a systematic intervention study rather than a new training recipe. The authors use three open-weight models previously shown to exhibit WG: Llama-3.1-70B, Qwen-2.5-32B, and Qwen-2.5-72B. They start from four narrow fine-tuning datasets known to trigger broad behavior changes: Old Bird Names, Medical Terms, Harry Potter, and Extreme Sports.

They then construct controlled variants along five axes. First, dataset size: they subsample the original narrow datasets at multiple fractions to test whether WG scales smoothly with the number of examples. Second, dataset composition: they mix the WG-inducing data with Dolly instruction data at different proportions to see whether the effect survives dilution and whether composition matters more than raw count. Third, language: they translate or otherwise alter the linguistic surface form to test whether the effect is tied to the original language distribution. Fourth, presentation mode: they compare more direct versus indirect formulations, probing whether the model is learning a latent persona/style pattern rather than only a factual mapping. Fifth, novelty: they vary whether the fine-tuning content is familiar from pretraining or relatively novel, asking whether WG is easier to elicit when fine-tuning reactivates existing parametric knowledge.

Evaluation follows prior WG work but adds an important robustness check. The models answer open-ended probe questions, and GPT-5-mini scores both consistency with the target generalization and response coherence. The paper also studies sensitivity to the choice of probe questions, which is crucial because WG claims often rest on very small curated evaluation sets.
summary_en.experiments:
The study spans 3 models and 4 base datasets. Dataset sizes differ substantially: Birds has 208 examples, Medicine 1,139, Harry Potter 137, and Extreme Sports 6,000. The authors also create matched-size comparisons by truncating larger datasets to 137 or 208 examples, which helps separate dataset identity from sample-count effects.

The most robust findings are qualitative but clear. First, WG depends much more on composition and language than on dataset size. Increasing the number of narrow examples does not produce a clean monotonic increase in weird generalization, while changing the fraction of WG-inducing data inside a broader instruction mixture can materially change the outcome. Second, WG is stronger when the fine-tuning data draws on knowledge already familiar from pretraining. This supports an activation or steering interpretation: the fine-tune may be unlocking or amplifying latent pretrained structure rather than teaching a wholly new broad behavior from scratch. Third, measured WG is sensitive to the specific probe question set, which means current evaluations have nontrivial variance.

The headline conclusion is that WG and EM are fragile forms of generalization and are unlikely to arise without adversarial data engineering. The paper’s evidence is less about one standout metric and more about instability across controlled perturbations. The practical takeaway is that size is not the main driver; composition, language, and novelty are closer to the real control knobs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the main framing figure to understand the threat-model claim the paper is trying to revise. Then read the sections on dataset size and composition first; they are the most directly relevant if you care about domain adaptation, continual pretraining, or alignment drift from narrow data. The language and novelty sections are the next priority because they explain why some fine-tunes trigger broader behavior changes while others do not.

Do not skip the evaluation-variance analysis. It is one of the more useful parts for anyone working on behavioral or safety evaluation, since it shows how much the conclusion can depend on a small probe set. A practical skim should take about 30–45 minutes. If you want to assess external validity, check the appendix for the exact fine-tuning setup and data construction choices.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 emergent misalignment 的直觉：别再盯数据量，先查 composition、language 和 eval set leakage；建议立刻按这个框架复盘内部异常对齐案例。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on emergent misalignment: stop fixating on dataset size and audit composition, language, and eval-set sensitivity first.

paper.title: Functional compatibility as a determinant of persistent neural learning
paper.abstract: Artificial neural networks can acquire new capabilities but often damage existing ones when they continue to learn. This stability-plasticity problem has motivated replay, regularization and constrained-update methods, yet it remains unclear whether a property of incoming learning itself determines what can be retained without disrupting protected behaviour. Here we show that functional compatibility, the extent to which new learning can coexist with behaviour that must be preserved, is a causal

summary.core_problem: 持续学习中，新能力能否在保护旧行为的同时被长期保留下来，是否由“新学习信号与受保护功能之间的兼容性”决定。
summary.importance: 这项工作与 LLM 预训练的连接点在 continual pretraining 和 post-train 后的持续更新。它强调不要只从参数变化、梯度范数或 replay 策略理解遗忘，而要直接看新更新在函数空间里是否能与需要保留的行为共存。对大模型场景，这对应几个实际问题：继续预训练时新语料是否会破坏已有能力，领域增量训练是否只是在有限验证集上被 shield 住，SFT/RL 后的能力是否能被后续训练稳定保留。论文的价值主要是概念和框架层面，工程上是否能扩展到大规模 LM 还需要单独验证。
summary.technical_approach: 核心框架是 Adaptive Functional Metaplasticity，简称 AFM。它先从同一个参数状态出发，计算一个“不加保护约束时学习器会接受的更新终点”，这个终点只作为 counterfactual comparator，不会直接写入模型。随后，AFM 在函数空间里寻找这个更新中与受保护行为兼容的分量，并只把可接受的部分存入普通参数。论文把 persistent adaptation、finite deployed protection 和 population behavior 区分开：在有限样本上恢复受保护输出，不代表参数中真正存下了无约束学习的有效部分，也不代表未见分布上的保持。框架还包含受限的行为敏感度 sketch、多时间尺度 metaplastic 控制、task-free routing、有限函数 shield，以及对 dormant structure 的 function-preserving renewal。形式化部分给出 streamed-memory certificate、rank-plasticity frontier、pathwise retention、projected stationarity 和动态 regret 的特例。
summary.experiments: 实验设计的重点是因果干预，而不是把一个 continual-learning 算法简单跑在若干任务序列上。作者从匹配的神经网络状态出发，主动调节 functional compatibility \(\kappa\)，同时控制无保护学习机会和保留约束，然后测量在相同 retention requirement 下有多少新学习可以被持久保存。给出的内容显示，兼容性越高，可接受的 persistent path fraction 越大；理论证书中还给出在条件满足时 \(\widehat{\lambda}\ge\eta\) 的保证。论文同时报告了消融和执行分析，用于区分“有限点位保护成功”和“参数路径中真正存储了新能力”这两件事。提供的正文片段没有足够信息确认具体模型规模、数据规模和数值提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 functional compatibility、same-state no-protection endpoint、persistent adaptation 与 finite protection 的定义，这些概念决定了后面公式的含义。理论部分不必逐条追证明，优先看 compatibility 如何被量化，以及 projector 如何把更新分解成受保护兼容分量。实验部分重点看 matched-state multi-level intervention 的设置，因为这是它区别于常规 continual-learning benchmark 的地方。若关注大模型持续预训练，可以重点记录三个问题：compatibility 能否用低成本 proxy 估计，函数空间保护能否扩展到海量 probe，有限 protected set 与 population retention 之间如何建立可靠联系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether persistent learning under a retention constraint is determined by the functional compatibility between the incoming learning signal and the behavior that must be preserved.
summary_en.importance: The connection to foundation-model training is continual pretraining and long-running model maintenance. The paper shifts the discussion away from only parameter drift, gradient norm, replay, or regularization, and toward whether a new update can coexist with protected behavior in function space. For large LMs, this maps to practical questions such as whether new corpora interfere with existing capabilities, whether domain-adaptive training merely passes a finite protection set, and whether skills acquired by SFT or RL survive later training. The contribution is mainly conceptual and formal; scaling the framework to large language models remains an open engineering question.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework is Adaptive Functional Metaplasticity, or AFM. At each protected update, AFM first computes the endpoint that the same learner would have accepted from the exact same pre-update state without any retention constraint. This endpoint is used only as a counterfactual reference and is not installed. AFM then identifies the component of that update that is compatible with protected functional behavior and stores only an accepted fraction in the ordinary parameters. A key distinction is made between persistent adaptation, finite deployed protection, and population behavior: matching protected outputs on a finite set does not imply that the unrestricted learning has been stored, nor that behavior is preserved on unseen inputs. The framework includes bounded sketches of behavioral sensitivity, multiple metaplastic timescales, a rank-timescale controller, task-free observable routing, a guarded finite functional shield, and function-preserving renewal of dormant structure. The formal results cover streamed-memory certificates, a rank-plasticity frontier, pathwise retention, projected stationarity, a convex dynamic-regret specialization, resource bounds, and obstruction cases.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental emphasis is causal control of compatibility. Starting from matched neural states, the authors intervene on the functional compatibility variable \(\kappa\), keep the unrestricted learning opportunity and retention requirement fixed, and measure how much new learning persists. The reported direction is that higher compatibility leads to a larger accepted persistent path fraction; under the stated certificate conditions, the framework guarantees \(\widehat{\lambda}\ge\eta\). The paper also includes ablations and execution analyses aimed at separating finite functional restoration from genuinely stored parameter adaptation. The provided text does not expose enough numerical detail to verify model sizes, dataset sizes, or effect magnitudes.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Read the introduction carefully for the definitions of functional compatibility, the same-state no-protection endpoint, persistent adaptation, and finite deployed protection. In the theory sections, focus on how compatibility is measured and how the compatible projector decomposes the update; the detailed proofs can be skipped unless continual-learning theory is the main interest. In the experiments, prioritize the matched-state multi-level intervention protocol, since that is the part that differs from standard continual-learning evaluations. For readers focused on foundation models, the useful follow-up questions are whether compatibility has a cheap proxy, whether function-space protection can scale beyond small probe sets, and how finite protection relates to population-level retention.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 compatibility 操作方式；若控制变量干净，这能修正 continual pretrain 里“靠正则保旧能力”的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental design and how compatibility is manipulated; if the controls are clean, it weakens the default belief that retention is mainly a regularization problem.

paper.title: Semantics or Structure? Auditing Text Sensitivity in Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
paper.abstract: Multimodal time-series forecasting has emerged as a promising paradigm in which natural-language context is expected to improve predictive performance. Recent multimodal foundation models, including Aurora, as well as early- and late-fusion approaches such as MM-TSFlib and TaTS, report substantial gains over unimodal baselines on the Time-MMD benchmark, attributing these improvements to textual information. However, whether these models are actually sensitive to the semantic content of the text

summary.core_problem: 审计多模态时间序列预测中“文本带来提升”这一说法是否真的来自文本语义，而不是数据泄漏或结构性捷径。
summary.importance: 虽然是时间序列领域，但它做的是一类很有价值的机制审计：多模态模型是否真的在用文本语义。对做 VLM/统一多模态预训练的人，这类负结果能提醒 benchmark 设计和模态归因的坑。
summary.technical_approach: 通过受控文本扰动、归因分析和对 Aurora 文本通路的 probing，系统测试模型对文本语义的敏感性。关键实验是把每行文本替换成任意其他真实文本、空文本、常量文本、域内打乱文本、跨域文本，观察性能变化；再检查去掉随数据一起提供的数值列后，所谓文本收益是否仍成立。
summary.experiments: 在 Time-MMD 上，针对 Aurora、MM-TSFlib、TaTS 三类架构，任意文本替换使平均 MSE 变化都低于 0.5%。文献中报告的提升可在不改文本的情况下，通过移除一个共发放的数值列而被“恢复”。这说明当前 benchmark 上模型几乎不依赖文本语义。不是基座论文，但结论干净，适合作为多模态评测设计的反例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits whether the reported gains from text in multimodal time-series forecasting actually come from textual semantics, rather than leakage or structural shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: Although this is in time-series forecasting, it delivers a useful kind of mechanistic audit: whether a multimodal model truly uses text semantics. For researchers in VLM or unified multimodal pretraining, this is a good warning about benchmark design and modality attribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: It uses controlled text perturbations, attribution analysis, and probes of Aurora's text pathway to test semantic sensitivity. The key intervention is to replace each row's text with arbitrary other real text, empty text, constant text, within-domain shuffled text, or cross-domain text, and then measure performance changes. It also checks whether the claimed text gains disappear once a co-shipped numeric column is handled properly.
summary_en.experiments: On Time-MMD, across Aurora, MM-TSFlib, and TaTS, replacing text in these ways changes mean MSE by less than 0.5%. The gains reported in prior work can be recovered simply by removing a co-shipped numeric column without changing text. This suggests the benchmark does not require real text semantics. Not a foundation-model paper, but a clean negative result with clear lessons for multimodal evaluation design.

recommendation.zh: 这类负结果值得知道：它提醒你多模态收益常是 benchmark 漏洞，不是语义建模进步；看扰动实验和去掉数值列那一段就够了。
recommendation.en: This is a useful negative result: multimodal gains are often benchmark artifacts rather than semantic modeling progress; the perturbation tests and the numeric-column ablation are the only parts you need.

paper.title: Where Cognition Lives: Dissecting Emergent from Computed Function in a Minimal Complete Cognitive Architecture
paper.abstract: A cognitive architecture is more than the module that reasons: it must also decide how long to think and what deserves the effort. We built a minimal but complete system - a recurrent reasoner with adaptive halting, a homeostatic control field, and a value module - and asked of each part: does this function emerge from gradient descent, or must it be computed? Competence emerges. Stopping appears to emerge too, and to be worth more than everything decidable in advance, but that appearance is ins

summary.core_problem: 区分认知系统中的哪些能力会从梯度下降中自然涌现，哪些必须由显式计算或控制模块提供，尤其是“何时停止思考”这一能力。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析而不是方法论文。价值在于它对 adaptive compute / halting 文献里常见的收益来源做了审计，提醒研究者不要把 readout 不一致造成的表面优势误判为真正的推理改进。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建一个最小但完整的认知架构：带自适应 halting 的 recurrent reasoner、homeostatic control field 和 value module。核心做法不是堆更强模型，而是逐模块做功能归因，并对 PonderNet 风格 halting 与 forced-depth baseline 做 readout equalization 审计，检查收益是否来自执行机制本身还是来自输出读出方式差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 matched mean compute 下的 payoff：uniform 0.467、difficulty 0.546、ex-ante value 0.698、posterior self-observation 0.921，但后者在审计后不成立；对 native execution 的优势在 equalized readout 后残差为 +0.000 [0.000, 0.000]。这说明至少在该最小架构里，部分 halting 收益是测量伪象。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which cognitive functions truly emerge from gradient descent and which must be explicitly computed, with a focus on deciding when to stop thinking.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism paper rather than a new method. Its value is in auditing common claims in adaptive-compute/halting work and showing that some apparent gains may come from mismatched readouts rather than genuine reasoning improvements.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a minimal but complete architecture with a recurrent reasoner, adaptive halting, a homeostatic control field, and a value module. The key move is functional attribution across modules and a readout-equalization audit comparing PonderNet-style halting against forced-depth baselines to isolate whether gains come from execution or output readout differences.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports matched-mean-compute payoff rising from 0.467 (uniform) to 0.546 (difficulty) to 0.698 (ex-ante value), while the further jump to 0.921 (posterior self-observation) does not survive audit. After equalizing the readout, the residual advantage of native execution becomes +0.000 [0.000, 0.000], suggesting a measurement artifact in this setup.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接可用的方法，但它对 adaptive halting 的审计很干净；若你在做 test-time compute 或 latent reasoning，先看它怎么拆掉“虚假收益”。
recommendation.en: Not a directly usable method, but the audit on adaptive halting is clean; if you work on test-time compute or latent reasoning, read how it strips away fake gains.

paper.title: Cognitive Profiling of LRMs' Reasoning Traces Using Bloom's Taxonomy
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized reasoning in LLMs, and the increasing public availability of reasoning traces creates valuable opportunities to study model behavior not only at the surface level but also at the granularity of individual reasoning steps. However, understanding the types of thinking employed during reasoning - which offers critical insights into models' reasoning patterns and enables actionable applications - remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introdu

summary.core_problem: 分析大型推理模型公开 reasoning traces 中每一步到底属于哪类认知操作，以及这些操作与正确性有什么关系。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析与自动标注框架。它不直接改进训练方法，但提供一种把长推理轨迹分解成认知类型的工具，可用于观察不同模型、不同任务的推理风格差异，并为后训练数据筛选或 reward 设计提供弱信号。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Bloom's Taxonomy 对 reasoning step 做自动 annotation，将思考类型分成 Remembering、Applying、Evaluating 等六个 cognitive levels。随后在多个模型和数据集上统计 step-level 类型分布，并分析这些 thinking-type features 与最终答案正确性的相关性。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了跨模型、跨数据集的大规模分析，发现不同模型和任务在 thinking pattern 上既有相似处也有差异，并显示 reasoning trace 中的 thinking-type 信息与正确性相关。摘要未提供具体模型名称、数据规模、标注准确率或相关系数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes what kinds of cognitive operations appear in each step of public reasoning traces from large reasoning models, and how those operations relate to correctness.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-analysis and automatic-annotation contribution. It does not directly change training, but it offers a way to decompose long reasoning traces into cognitive categories, which may be useful for post-training data filtering or reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework automatically annotates reasoning steps using Bloom's Taxonomy, mapping steps into six cognitive levels such as Remembering, Applying, and Evaluating. The authors then analyze type distributions across models and datasets and study whether these features correlate with answer correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a large-scale analysis across models and datasets, finding both shared and different thinking patterns across models and tasks. It also reports that thinking-type information derived from reasoning traces correlates with correctness. The abstract does not give model names, dataset sizes, annotation accuracy, or correlation coefficients.

recommendation.zh: 看相关性分析图即可；Bloom 分类可能粗糙，但若用 CoT trace 做数据过滤，标签噪声值得记一笔。
recommendation.en: Skim the correlation plots only; Bloom labels are coarse, but the noise profile matters if you filter data using CoT traces.

paper.title: Hidden in the Request: Explaining Unethical LLM Compliance through Token Relevance
paper.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to optimize for both helpfulness and harmlessness, these dual objectives may conflict, inevitably leading to alignment failures. This work systematically investigates instances where LLMs fail to exhibit ethical behavior. To understand the underlying mechanics of these vulnerabilities, we introduce a probing methodology that presents unethical scenarios to LLMs in three distinct structural modalities: objective classification tasks, subjective fi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解释一个具体对齐失败现象：为什么同样的不道德内容，换成“请求帮助”的表述后，LLM 更容易顺从。
summary.importance: 贡献类型属于机制分析。它不是提出新的对齐算法，而是用 token relevance 视角去拆解 harmfulness 判断为何被 benign framing 覆盖。对做安全对齐和表示分析的人有一定参考，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造三种输入结构：客观分类、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求协助；然后用 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation 分析不同 token 对模型输出的归因，提出模型存在 attribution bias：更关注“Can you help me”这类任务框架 token，而低估“without getting caught”这类 cue-tokens。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明主要发现是 request-for-assistance 形式下伦理表现更差，并且 LRP 归因显示 benign framing token 获得更高相关性。摘要未给出模型规模、数据量、具体基线和量化提升，因此更像定性+中等规模实证分析，而不是大规模结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains a specific alignment failure: why LLMs are more likely to comply with unethical content when it is phrased as a request for help.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It does not propose a new alignment algorithm; instead it studies how harmful intent can be masked by benign framing under token-level relevance analysis. Useful for safety and representation analysis, but only loosely connected to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare three prompt structures: objective classification, subjective first-person statements, and direct assistance requests. They then apply Layer-wise Relevance Propagation to trace token contributions, arguing that models exhibit an attribution bias: benign framing tokens such as 'Can you help me' receive more relevance than cue tokens such as 'without getting caught.'
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that ethical performance degrades in the request-for-assistance setting, and LRP shows higher relevance on benign framing tokens. It does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, exact baselines, or strong quantitative detail, so this reads more like a qualitative-to-midscale empirical analysis than a large-scale result.

recommendation.zh: 安全机制分析里算是有个像样切口，但离 pretrain 很远；看 prompt modality 对比和 token attribution 图就够，别期待它给出可直接训练的 recipe。
recommendation.en: A decent mechanistic angle in safety, but far from pretraining; the prompt-modality comparison and token-attribution plots are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Investigating Relational Reasoning in VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance in visual reasoning tasks, but it remains unclear whether they understand visual relations, or simply employ shortcuts such as language cues or priors. To investigate this, we use the Qwen3-VL-4B (Bai et al., 2025), a modern VLM, to decode how visual information is encoded across depths. For this, we propose a synthetic dataset of simple geometric shapes for controlled analysis, along with queries crafted to precisely test language cues. F
