summary.core_problem: 检验现代 VLM 在关系推理任务上到底是在使用真实视觉关系信息，还是主要依赖语言线索和先验捷径。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在用受控合成数据拆开视觉证据与语言偏置，对理解 VLM 表征形成和 shortcut 依赖有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者围绕 Qwen3-VL-4B 构造简单几何图形的合成数据集，并设计精确控制语言提示的查询；再通过修改数据以测试模型对真实视觉证据的因果依赖，同时分析不同层深的视觉信息编码情况。
summary.experiments: 核心实验对象是 Qwen3-VL-4B。摘要未给出更多模型对比、数据规模或具体数值，但主要发现是：当前 VLM 同时存在一定真实视觉关系推理能力，以及显著依赖语言线索的 shortcut 行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether modern VLMs truly reason over visual relations or mostly exploit language cues and priors as shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper rather than a new model. Its value lies in using controlled synthetic data to separate visual evidence from linguistic bias, which is useful for understanding VLM representations and shortcut behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Qwen3-VL-4B, the authors build a synthetic geometric-shape dataset with carefully designed prompts that isolate language cues, then intervene on the visual evidence to test causal reliance and inspect how information is encoded across depth.
summary_en.experiments: The main subject is Qwen3-VL-4B. The abstract does not provide broader model comparisons, dataset size, or exact numbers, but the headline result is that current VLMs mix genuine visual relational reasoning with shortcut strategies driven largely by language cues.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 native multimodal pretrain，只看它如何用受控合成数据拆 shortcut 与真视觉证据；结论不新，但 setup 还算干净。
recommendation.en: If you work on native multimodal pretraining, read it for the controlled setup that separates shortcuts from genuine visual evidence; the conclusion is not new, but the measurement is reasonably clean.

paper.title: Beyond Prompt Engineering: A Systematic Analysis of Prompt Lexical Sensitivity and Its Impacts on Quality
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit extreme sensitivity to surface-level prompt variations, in which minor lexical changes can trigger disproportionate performance fluctuations. Moving beyond black-box optimization and coarse-grained templates, we present the first large-scale, n-gram token-level mechanistic analysis of prompt stability, leveraging a dataset of 132,000 prompt variants. Our investigation reveals a fundamental Scaling Law of Prompt Performance Stability: higher average task perfo

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 对提示词表层词汇改写为何会出现大幅性能波动，并尝试找出更稳定提示的可解释规律。
summary.importance: 这是一篇提示鲁棒性与机制分析工作，不直接推进预训练方法，但对理解模型如何把词面形式映射到任务行为有一定价值。贡献主要是大规模提示变体分析、提出“性能-稳定性”相关关系，以及归纳出若干语言学层面的稳定性因素。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 13.2 万个 prompt 变体，做 n-gram/token 级别的系统分析，考察不同词汇替换对任务表现方差的影响。核心结论是平均性能更高的提示往往也更稳定，并将稳定性归因于两类词汇因素：领域术语和显式动作指令，认为它们能收缩模型的解释空间，使生成更确定。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出了数据规模为 132,000 个 prompt variants，但未见模型规模、任务集合、基线模型和具体提升幅度的完整信息。当前能确认的是作者主要报告了性能均值与方差的相关性，以及不同词汇类型对鲁棒性的影响；是否具有跨模型、跨任务的稳健性还需要看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自深圳技术大学、港科大（广州）、香港理工大学、浙江实验室和香港中文大学。不是一线基座团队，但机构组合尚可，工作更偏提示机制分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why small lexical changes in prompts can cause large performance swings in LLMs, and seeks interpretable rules for more stable prompting.
summary_en.importance: This is a prompt-robustness and mechanistic analysis paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its value lies in probing how surface form maps to model behavior, via a large-scale prompt-variant study and a claimed performance–stability relationship.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a dataset of 132k prompt variants and run n-gram/token-level analyses of how lexical perturbations affect performance variance. Their main claim is that prompts with higher average performance also tend to be more stable, and that domain-specific terminology plus explicit action directives reduce interpretive ambiguity and make generation more deterministic.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract specifies 132,000 prompt variants, but does not expose enough detail on model sizes, task suite, baselines, or exact gains. What is clear is that the paper reports correlations between mean performance and variance, and analyzes which lexical categories contribute to robustness; cross-model and cross-task cleanliness still needs verification in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shenzhen Technology University, HKUST (Guangzhou), Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Zhejiang Lab, and CUHK. This is not a frontier foundation-model lab paper; it is better read as a prompt-mechanism analysis.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线，只适合把“提示稳定性”当行为测量信号来参考；先看数据构造和均值-方差关系，若控制变量不干净就别过度解读。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining material; useful only if you treat prompt stability as a behavioral probe—check the dataset design and mean-variance claim first, and discount it if controls are messy.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Affiliation:The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Training, learning and inference: unified dynamics of neural systems
paper.abstract: We define an atomic generation fact f=(u,tau,omega,z;rho), recording the origin, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, generated result and relation role. Compiled into a Generation-Fact Graph (GFG), these facts provide an AI-native, compilable scientific fact substrate preserving generation histories. We establish a GFG-based recursive scientific process in which analysis, intervention, replay and validation form facts for later cycles. Using nanoGPT, we establish unified training-learn

summary.core_problem: 论文试图用统一的动态系统视角描述神经网络的训练、学习与推理，并引入 Generation-Fact Graph 记录生成过程。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏理论框架和机制分析，使用 nanoGPT 作为实验载体；但摘要中的概念密度高，缺少清晰可检验的 LLM 训练结论，可信信息增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义 atomic generation fact，并将其编译为 Generation-Fact Graph，用于记录起源、变换、实例、结果和关系角色；随后把训练看成参数-优化器系统的状态演化，把学习看成分布式功能支撑的持久重组。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到使用 nanoGPT 建立 unified training-learning dynamics，但未给出模型规模、训练数据、对照组、指标或明确的定量发现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper attempts to describe training, learning, and inference in neural systems under a unified dynamical-systems framework, with Generation-Fact Graphs as the record substrate.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is closer to a theoretical and mechanistic framework, illustrated with nanoGPT. The abstract is concept-heavy and does not expose a crisp, testable conclusion for LLM training.
summary_en.technical_approach: It defines an atomic generation fact and compiles such facts into a Generation-Fact Graph that preserves origins, transformations, occurrences, outputs, and relational roles. Training is modeled as state evolution of a parameter-optimizer system, while learning is framed as persistent reorganization of distributed functional support.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says nanoGPT is used to establish unified training-learning dynamics, but gives no scale, data, baselines, metrics, or quantitative findings.

recommendation.zh: 只适合作为机制类概念备查；若没有更干净的可复现实验，别把其中的“大统一”表述当训练规律。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a conceptual mechanism note; without cleaner reproducible evidence, the unifying claims should not be treated as training laws.

paper.title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Aligned vision-language models (VLMs) are designed to balance grounded visual reasoning with safe generation behavior. However, we observe a striking phenomenon: under safety-constrained instruction, models frequently abstain from answering questions that remain correctly answerable under default instruction despite receiving identical image-question inputs. This raises a fundamental question: does safety alignment suppress perceptual grounding itself, or does visual evidence remain internally a

summary.core_problem: 安全对齐后的 VLM 在安全约束指令下会拒答原本可由图像正确回答的问题，需要区分是视觉 grounding 被抑制，还是生成策略被导向拒答。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 对齐机制分析。它把安全拒答拆成感知表征、解码动态和输出策略之间的关系，对理解多模态模型的安全训练副作用有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 在相同图像-问题输入下比较 default instruction 与 safety-constrained instruction 的生成行为，分析解码过程中的视觉影响是否持续存在，并观察拒答表示组织和生成路径的变化。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个架构和多模态 benchmark 上验证：即使模型最终拒答，生成过程仍持续受视觉证据影响，说明 perceptual grounding 大体保留；但拒答相关表征组织和生成行为会被安全指令重新定向。摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和数值。
summary.authors_note: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence。

summary_en.core_problem: Aligned VLMs may refuse answerable visual questions under safety-constrained instructions, raising the question of whether safety suppresses visual grounding or merely redirects generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism analysis of multimodal alignment. It separates perceptual grounding from refusal behavior, which matters for diagnosing safety-training side effects in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares default and safety-constrained instructions over identical image-question inputs, then analyzes decoding dynamics to test whether visual evidence continues to influence abstained generations.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple architectures and multimodal benchmarks, the abstract reports that abstained generations remain consistently influenced by visual evidence, suggesting that grounding is largely preserved while generation is redirected toward refusal. Specific models, datasets, and numerical results are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi.

recommendation.zh: VLM safety 机制的弱相关读物；若有 logit/attention 证据可扫图，否则只是拒答现象再描述。
recommendation.en: A weakly relevant VLM safety-mechanism read; skim only if the paper has logit or attention evidence beyond refusal examples.

institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi

paper.title: SIDScope: A Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Interfaces in Generative Recommendation
paper.abstract: Semantic-ID mappings are reusable interfaces between item tokenizers and generative recommenders, yet released mappings rarely state whether they are coherent, what structure they expose, how generated paths resolve, or what must be revalidated after a refresh. SIDScope is a source-traced diagnostic resource for these decisions. It normalizes item-to-code artifacts, verifies provenance and joins, profiles mapping structure, compares paired revisions, and accounts for path-to-item outcomes in gen

summary.core_problem: 生成式推荐里，Semantic-ID 作为 item tokenizer 与生成模型之间的接口，常被当作黑盒使用；论文要诊断这种接口到底暴露了什么结构、哪些失配会伤害生成与检索闭环。
summary.importance: 虽然是推荐方向，但核心问题是离散语义编码接口的可诊断性与机制分析，这对多模态/离散 token 统一建模、tokenizer 接口设计有一定旁路启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SIDScope 诊断资源：标准化 item-to-code 映射工件，验证来源与 join，分析映射结构，对比版本差异，并在生成 trace 上统计 path-to-item 的解析结果。论文强调 interface health 不是单一分数，而是多信号组合；并分析 prefix alignment 与候选暴露、训练 trace 与目标可达性之间的关系。
summary.experiments: 在 Amazon 与 Yelp 数据上的 7 个 tokenizer family、9 个 source-traced tokenizer export 上做分析，其中 8 个可执行路由、1 个可审计快照。主要发现包括：当检索消费 SID 前缀时，prefix alignment 与 held-out candidate exposure 强相关；当 scoring 不再依赖前缀时，这种相关性减弱。摘要未给出生成式推荐主任务指标提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Cohere。该工作更像接口诊断与机制分析，而不是提出新的生成式推荐模型。

summary_en.core_problem: In generative recommendation, Semantic-ID mappings act as the interface between item tokenizers and generators, yet they are often treated as black boxes; this paper studies what structure they expose and how interface mismatches affect the generation-retrieval loop.
summary_en.importance: Although it is framed in recommendation, the paper is really about diagnosability of discrete semantic coding interfaces. That gives it some side-channel relevance to unified tokenization and discrete-interface design in foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIDScope is introduced as a diagnostic resource that normalizes item-to-code artifacts, verifies provenance and joins, profiles mapping structure, compares revisions, and accounts for path-to-item outcomes in generated traces. The key framing is that interface health is multi-signal rather than scalar, and the paper analyzes how prefix alignment and trace accounting relate to downstream exposure and reachability.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers nine source-traced tokenizer exports from seven families on Amazon and Yelp data, including eight executable routes and one auditable snapshot. Main findings include a strong link between prefix alignment and held-out candidate exposure when retrieval consumes SID prefixes, with the link weakening when scoring becomes prefix-independent. The abstract does not report headline task gains for recommendation quality.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is associated with Cohere. It is better read as an interface-diagnostics and mechanism-analysis paper than as a new generative recommender model.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座主线，但做离散接口/semantic tokenizer 的人可以看：结论在“接口健康不是单指标”这点上讲得比很多 tokenizer 论文更老实，读摘要和机制图即可。
recommendation.en: Not core foundation-model reading, but if you work on discrete interfaces or semantic tokenizers, it is worth a look: the paper is unusually honest that interface health is not a single scalar; abstract plus mechanism figures should suffice.

paper.title: Routing Divergence Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Influence in Same-Weight MoE Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Two Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) forward passes can share every weight yet route the same token through different experts. This creates a possible blind spot in same-weight self-distillation, where a demonstration-conditioned teacher supervises a query-only student. We study this mismatch in its single-step form, with frozen weights rather than as a proxy for a full training trajectory. An exact blockwise decomposition separates a routing term, which changes gates at fixed content, from a dense-like

summary.core_problem: 同权重MoE自蒸馏流程中，带演示上下文的教师前向和无演示的学生前向共享所有权重，却可能将同一个token路由到不同专家。现有MoE自蒸馏工作将路由门值的分歧直接当作蒸馏带来的行为变化的度量，但没有回答这种路由分歧实际有多大比例传导到残差流、最终影响模型输出行为。
summary.importance: 这一工作纠正了MoE训练与后训练中的一个常见误区：路由门的分歧大小不等于其对模型行为的影响大小。该结论对MoE自蒸馏、对齐训练的流程设计有直接实用价值——无需过度惩罚微小的路由漂移，只要漂移对应的残差暴露量低，就不会实质改变模型行为；反过来，过度强约束路由一致性反而会不必要地损害模型容量，这对MoE预训练中的路由正则化设计也有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 研究限定在权重冻结、单步前向的设定下，匹配真实同权重自蒸馏的实际场景。首先推导精确的块级输出分解，将教师和学生前向在MoE块上的输出差拆为两个精确可加的项：路由不匹配项（相同隐藏状态经过不同门值产生的输出差）、类稠密内容项（隐藏状态本身偏移、在相同门值下产生的输出差，是稠密模型中也存在的内容偏移）。随后定义三个逐层逐token的度量：路由因子（路由不匹配项占MoE块输出的比例）、骨干占比（MoE块输出占残差流的比例）、残差暴露量（路由不匹配项占残差流的比例，等于路由因子乘以骨干占比），这是路由失配真正传递到后续层的有效影响量。之后在7个开源MoE检查点、两个领域上做系统性测量，通过缩放常驻共享专家的权重做干预实验验证因果关系，再通过因果A/B patching将分解的两个项和最终输出行为直接关联。
summary.experiments: 跨7个MoE检查点、两个领域的测量显示，路由不匹配项占块输出的比例波动范围仅1.6倍，但其残差暴露量的波动范围达3.2倍；暴露量与MoE块对残差的贡献占比正相关——MoE块输出占残差比例越小，路由扰动被稀释得越多。反常识的是，路由门粒度最细、最容易产生路由分歧的块，残差暴露量反而最低。在两个检查点上的骨干缩放干预验证了因果机制：常驻共享专家的权重占比越高，越能维持路由一致性，抑制路由失配的传导。因果patching结果显示，路由项的影响有界，且大部分是通用的幅度扰动，不会带来方向特异的语义偏移；类稠密的内容项才是携带方向特异性变化、主导输出行为的部分。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注分解公式的定义、路由项大小与残差暴露量的核心测量结果、骨干占比的作用、因果patching的结论，无需细看附录中的重建误差验证和量化相关鲁棒性检查，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In same-weight MoE self-distillation, a demonstration-conditioned teacher forward pass and demonstration-free student forward pass share all model weights, yet may route the same token to different experts. Existing MoE self-distillation work treats divergence in router gate values as a direct measure of behavioral change induced by distillation, but does not quantify how much of this routing mismatch actually propagates through the residual stream to alter final model outputs.
summary_en.importance: This work corrects a common misassumption in MoE training and post-training: the magnitude of router gate divergence does not equal the magnitude of its effect on model behavior. The finding has direct practical value for MoE self-distillation and alignment recipe design: there is no need to heavily penalize small routing drifts, as drifts with low residual exposure do not materially change model behavior. Overly strong constraints on routing consistency, by contrast, can unnecessarily reduce model capacity, a lesson also relevant for router regularization design during MoE pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analysis is performed in the frozen-weight, single-forward-pass setting that matches real same-weight self-distillation workflows. An exact blockwise output decomposition is derived, splitting output differences between teacher and student passes at each MoE block into two exactly additive terms: the routing mismatch term (output difference from applying different gate values to identical hidden states), and the dense-like content term (output difference from shifted hidden states applied to identical gates, the same type of content shift that appears in dense models). Three per-token, per-layer metrics are defined: routing factor (norm of the routing mismatch term as a share of MoE block output), backbone share (norm of MoE block output as a share of residual stream), and residual exposure (norm of the routing mismatch term as a share of residual stream, equal to routing factor multiplied by backbone share), which represents the effective magnitude of routing mismatch visible to all downstream layers. Systematic measurements are run across 7 open-weight MoE checkpoints spanning two domains, causal relationships are validated via interventions that scale the weight of always-on shared experts, and causal A/B patching is used to directly connect the two decomposed terms to final output behavior.
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 checkpoints and two domains, the routing mismatch term varies by only 1.6× as a fraction of block output, while its residual exposure varies by 3.2×. Exposure scales positively with the MoE block's contribution share to the residual: smaller MoE block contributions lead to stronger dilution of routing perturbations. Counterintuitively, blocks with the finest-grained routing (most prone to gate divergence) have among the lowest residual exposure. Backbone scaling interventions on two checkpoints confirm the causal mechanism: larger relative weight of always-on shared experts better preserves routing coherence and reduces propagation of routing mismatch. Causal patching results show the routing term has bounded effect, and produces mostly generic magnitude perturbations without direction-specific semantic shifts; the dense-like content term carries direction-specific changes that dominate output behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Focus on the decomposition definitions, core measurement results relating routing term magnitude to residual exposure, the role of backbone share, and the causal patching conclusions. Skip supplementary material on reconstruction error verification and quantization robustness checks. Estimated reading time: ~20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对做 MoE 蒸馏/路由分析的人是个干净的反证：别把路由分歧直接当行为因果，看 §3 分解和 exposure 排序即可。
recommendation.en: A clean counter-narrative for MoE distillation work: don't equate routing divergence with behavioral influence; read the §3 decomposition and exposure ordering.

paper.title: Why Vision Fails as a Universal Bridge: Rectifying Modality Asynchrony in Multilingual MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit substantial performance degradation in non-English visual reasoning, despite the strong multilingual competence of their text-only backbones. While mechanistic evidence from text-only models suggests that non-English inputs are routed through an English-centric latent space, the multimodal implications of this phenomenon remain unexplored. Through rigorous mechanistic analysis, we identify the \textbf{Ghost Anchor} phenomenon: a temporal modality

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解释并修正多语言 MLLM 在非英语视觉推理上明显掉点的问题，尤其是文本骨干本身具备多语言能力时，为什么一接入视觉就退化。
summary.importance: 价值在于它不是把问题归因于“训练数据不够”这种泛化说法，而是提出了一个可操作的机制性解释：语言侧较早完成向英语语义流形的映射，而视觉侧语义化更慢，导致早期跨模态对齐窗口里图像信号“在场但不可用”。这属于多模态预训练中的对齐时序问题，对做 native multimodal 或跨语种 MLLM 的人有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Ghost Anchor 现象，并据此设计 ANCHOR 训练框架，核心是 Proactive Visual Anchoring（PVA）：在更早层次推动视觉表征形成可用语义，使视觉信号能在语言翻译到英语中心语义空间之前参与对齐。方法重点不在新架构，而在训练时序干预和机制驱动的对齐修正。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出完整模型规模和数据规模，但声称通过机制分析验证了模态异步，并在多语言视觉推理上取得改进。可预期实验会包含非英语视觉问答/推理任务、与标准 MLLM 训练方式对比，以及层级表征分析来支撑“早期视觉语义不足”的判断。是否足够可信，取决于干预实验是否真正隔离了语言翻译路径与视觉成熟度两个因素。
summary.authors_note: 机构来自香港中文大学与深圳 Loop Area Institute。作者名单里暂无可直接确认的业界广为人知代表性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why multilingual MLLMs underperform on non-English visual reasoning even when their text-only backbones are already multilingual.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a mechanistic diagnosis rather than a vague data-deficit story: language tokens are mapped into an English-centric semantic manifold early, while visual representations become semantically usable later, so the image is present but functionally ignored during the critical early alignment window. This is relevant to native multimodal pretraining and multilingual MLLM design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Ghost Anchor phenomenon and propose ANCHOR, a training framework built around Proactive Visual Anchoring (PVA). The goal is to accelerate early visual semantic emergence so that visual signals can shape multilingual language processing before the language stream collapses into an English-centric latent space.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full model or data scale details, but it claims mechanistic evidence for modality asynchrony and downstream gains on multilingual visual reasoning. The key evidence likely combines intervention-style representation analysis with task-level comparisons against standard MLLM training. The credibility will depend on whether the setup cleanly isolates timing mismatch from generic optimization effects.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliations include The Chinese University of Hong Kong and Shenzhen Loop Area Institute. No widely established marquee author can be confidently identified from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 多语 MLLM 掉点常被粗暴归因到数据，这篇至少给了一个可干预的时序机制；先看机制图和消融，若干预足够干净，值得在内部多模态对齐实验里复现。
recommendation.en: People often hand-wave multilingual MLLM failures as a data issue; this paper offers a timing-based mechanism you can actually intervene on. Read the mechanistic evidence and ablations first, and replicate only if the intervention is clean.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Affiliation:The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Automatic or Controlled? Repetition Priming Reveals Divergent Processing in Base LLMs, Instruct LLMs, and Humans
paper.abstract: Words recur constantly in natural language use, yet it remains unclear whether language models reactivate prior representations or re-evaluate repeated words afresh, and whether post-training changes this default behavior. We apply repetition priming (Shiffrin and Schneider, 1977) to 15 models across five model families (1.5B-14B parameters) in two tasks, semantic categorization and cloze completion, with matched human experiments using identical stimuli. We find that base models exhibit automat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个很具体但很有机制意味的问题：当同一个词在上下文中再次出现时，LLM 到底是在重用先前表征，还是重新按当前语境评估它。作者用 repetition priming 这个经典心理语言学范式，比较 base model、instruct model 和人类在重复词处理上的差异，想回答的不是“哪个更强”，而是 post-training 是否改变了模型默认的信息处理模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在两个层面。第一，它给 base→instruct 的变化提供了一个比常规 benchmark 更细的机制刻画：instruction tuning 不只是改输出风格，也可能改变模型如何利用上下文中的已有痕迹。第二，它把 post-train 对内部处理策略的影响具体化了。对于做 pretrain 的人，这很重要，因为很多能力差异未必来自参数知识本身，而可能来自后训练把默认检索/复用机制改成了更强的上下文重评估。这个结论会影响对 few-shot exemplar 设计、长上下文重复信息利用、以及 pretrain/post-train 接口的理解。它不是直接改进训练方法的论文，但作为机制分析，信息量不低。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者借用了 automatic vs. controlled processing 的认知框架。automatic processing 的特征是快速、刺激驱动、对干扰不敏感；controlled processing 更依赖当前上下文，且容易受 lag 和干扰影响。为了把这个框架落到 LLM 上，论文设计了两个实验。

实验一是 semantic categorization。给模型一个零样本分类提示，让它判断一个具体名词属于 living 还是 nonliving。每个 target word 在同一 session 中重复出现 4 次，重复之间插入固定数量 filler，形成 lag=1/3/7/15 四种条件。作者用 log-probability margin 衡量分类倾向，再看从第一次暴露 E1 到后续暴露的变化，定义 priming effect。这个设计的好处是把“重复带来的处理便利”从任务准确率里分离出来，直接看同一词被再次看到时模型内部偏好是否更容易被激活。

实验二是 cloze completion，用弱约束上下文考察重复暴露是否帮助开放式词检索。这个任务比二分类更接近真实生成，因为它要求模型从较弱语境中恢复目标词。

更关键的是三类 mechanistic probe。第一，移除先前 response context，看 priming 是否仍保留。如果 base 仍有残余 facilitation，说明它部分依赖词级重激活，而不完全依赖完整上下文。第二，重映射分类标签，测试 priming 是否能部分迁移；若能迁移，说明重复效应不只是绑定在某个具体输出模板上。第三，定位并消融与 prior-occurrence retrieval 相关的 attention heads，观察 priming 是否显著下降。作者据此把 base model 的 priming 解释为更接近 stimulus-driven reactivation，而 instruct model 更像 context-dependent re-evaluation。

这个设计和一般 probing 的区别在于，它不是静态地看某层表示相似度，而是通过 lag、上下文移除、标签重映射和 head ablation 组合，去区分“记住了这个词”与“重新按任务语境解释这个词”这两种处理路径。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 15 个模型、5 个家族、1.5B 到 14B 参数，包括 LLaMA 3、Mistral、Qwen 2.5、Gemma 2，以及 Phi-4 instruct。7 个 base 模型在 semantic categorization 上都表现出强且稳定的正 priming，最终暴露 E4 相对 E1 的提升范围是 +5.04 到 +6.89，且都达到显著性。instruct 模型整体更弱、更依赖 lag，其中部分模型已经出现 interference；文中点名 Mistral-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 在该实验里出现负向效应。

作者对每个模型分别拟合了 mixed-effects model 来估计 exposure 和 lag 的联合影响。结论是：base model 的 facilitation 对 lag 更稳健，instruct model 的 facilitation 随 lag 衰减，在更大规模时甚至从 facilitation 反转为 interference。Qwen 2.5 1.5B→14B 的成对 base/instruct 对比尤其关键，因为它控制了家族和架构差异，显示这种分化会随规模单调扩大。

三类机制实验也支持这个解释。移除先前 response context 后，base 仍保留部分 facilitation，而 instruct 更容易转成 interference；标签重映射后，base 仍有部分 transfer，instruct 基本没有；消融与 prior-occurrence retrieval 相关的 attention heads 后，base 的 priming 明显下降，而 instruct 受影响较小。这说明 base 的重复效应更依赖对先前词项的直接回收，instruct 则更依赖后续任务语境中的再判断。

人类实验给出第三种轮廓：和 instruct 一样对 lag 敏感，但整体保持 facilitation，不会像部分大 instruct 模型那样反转成 interference。这个结果很有意思，因为它说明 instruct 并不是简单“更像人”，而是形成了另一种受 post-training 强烈塑形的处理模式。

当前片段没有完整 cloze completion 数字和全部统计表，但主结论已经足够清楚：base 与 instruct 的差异是定性的，不只是幅度不同。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合做机制分析类泛读。先看 Introduction，把 automatic vs. controlled processing 的映射关系读清楚。然后直接看 Experiment 1 的设计图和主结果，因为 semantic categorization 的信号最干净，也最容易看出 base/instruct 分化。接着看 mechanistic probes，尤其是 context removal、label remapping、attention head ablation，这三部分决定了论文是否只是行为现象描述，还是对机制有更强支撑。最后再看 scaling 分析和 human comparison。

如果时间有限，建议阅读顺序是：引言最后两段 → Experiment 1 setup → Figure 1/主结果表 → 三个 probe → Qwen 2.5 scaling → human experiments。预计 30 分钟左右可以抓住主要结论。

值得深挖的点有三个。第一，instruction tuning 到底改变了哪些 attention / MLP 回路，使重复词从“直接复用”转向“重新评估”。第二，这种 interference 是否和对齐训练中过强的上下文敏感性、格式依赖或拒答策略有关。第三，这个现象会不会反馈到 pretraining 设计，例如是否需要在 pretrain 或 mid-train 阶段显式保留某些高效的 lexical reactivation 机制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise mechanistic question: when a word reappears in context, does an LLM reactivate its prior representation or process the word again from scratch under the current context? Using repetition priming from psycholinguistics, the authors compare base models, instruct models, and humans. The goal is not to rank models by task performance, but to test whether post-training changes the default mode of information processing.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is mainly conceptual but meaningful. First, it gives a sharper account of what changes from base to instruct than standard downstream benchmarks do. The claim is that instruction tuning may alter how models use traces of prior context, not just how they phrase outputs. Second, it makes the pretrain-posttrain interface more concrete. Some capability differences may come less from stored knowledge and more from whether post-training preserves or suppresses fast lexical reactivation in favor of context-dependent reevaluation. That matters for few-shot exemplar design, repeated evidence in long context, and how we interpret post-training effects on internal computation. This is not a training-method paper, but as a mechanistic study it is informative.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper adopts the classic automatic-versus-controlled processing framework from cognitive psychology. Automatic processing is fast, stimulus-driven, and robust to interference. Controlled processing is more context-dependent and more sensitive to lag and disruption. To operationalize this for LLMs, the authors run two experiments.

Experiment 1 is semantic categorization. Models receive a zero-shot prompt and classify a concrete noun as living or nonliving. Each target word appears four times within a session, with a fixed number of filler trials between repetitions, producing lag conditions of 1, 3, 7, and 15. The authors measure a log-probability margin for the classification decision and define priming as the change from the first exposure to later exposures. This isolates the processing benefit of repetition from raw task accuracy.

Experiment 2 is cloze completion, where weakly constraining contexts test whether repeated exposure helps open-ended retrieval of the target word. This is closer to real generation behavior than binary classification.

The strongest part of the paper is the set of mechanistic probes. First, prior response context is removed to see whether priming survives. If base models retain facilitation, that suggests partial word-level reactivation rather than full dependence on the original context. Second, classification labels are remapped to test whether priming transfers beyond a specific output template. Third, attention heads associated with prior-occurrence retrieval are identified and ablated to test whether priming depends on those circuits. These probes support the interpretation that base-model priming is more stimulus-driven, while instruct-model priming depends more on contextual reevaluation.

This is different from standard probing work. Instead of measuring static representation similarity, the paper uses lag manipulation, context removal, label remapping, and head ablation together to distinguish direct lexical reuse from task-conditioned reinterpretation.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers 15 models from 5 families, ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters, including LLaMA 3, Mistral, Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Phi-4 instruct. In semantic categorization, all 7 base models show strong and uniformly positive priming. By the final exposure, the E4 minus E1 effect ranges from +5.04 to +6.89, with all effects reported as significant. Instruct models are weaker and more variable, and some already show interference rather than facilitation; the excerpt explicitly mentions Mistral-Instruct and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct.

The authors fit per-model mixed-effects models to estimate the joint effects of exposure and lag. The qualitative result is consistent: base-model facilitation is stable across lags, while instruct-model facilitation decays with lag and can reverse into interference at larger scales. The controlled Qwen 2.5 series is especially informative because it holds family and architecture relatively constant. There, the base-versus-instruct divergence widens monotonically from 1.5B to 14B.

The mechanistic probes reinforce the behavioral pattern. Removing prior response context leaves residual facilitation in base models but tends to induce interference in instruct models. Label remapping preserves partial transfer in base models but not in instruct models. Ablating attention heads linked to prior-occurrence retrieval sharply reduces priming in base models, with much smaller effects in instruct models. Together, these results support the claim that base models rely more on direct retrieval of prior lexical traces, whereas instruct models rely more on downstream contextual evaluation.

The human experiments show a third profile: lag-sensitive like instruct models, but uniformly facilitative like base models, never reversing into interference. That is an important nuance. It suggests instruct models are not simply becoming more human-like; they are adopting a different post-training-shaped processing regime.

The excerpt does not include the full cloze-completion numbers or all statistical tables, but the main conclusion is already clear: the difference between base and instruct models is qualitative, not merely a smaller or larger priming magnitude.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good skim for mechanistic understanding. Start with the introduction and make sure the mapping from automatic versus controlled processing to LLM behavior is clear. Then go straight to Experiment 1, because semantic categorization gives the cleanest signal and makes the base-versus-instruct split easy to see. After that, read the three mechanistic probes: context removal, label remapping, and attention-head ablation. Those sections determine whether the paper is just reporting a behavioral effect or actually supporting a mechanism. Finish with the scaling analysis and the human comparison.

A practical reading order is: last two intro paragraphs, Experiment 1 setup, main figure and results table, the three probes, Qwen 2.5 scaling, then human experiments. About 30 minutes should be enough to capture the main argument.

Three follow-up questions are worth thinking about. First, which attention or MLP circuits are altered by instruction tuning so that repeated words shift from direct reuse to reevaluation? Second, is the observed interference tied to alignment-induced context sensitivity, formatting dependence, or refusal-related policies? Third, should pretraining or mid-training explicitly preserve efficient lexical reactivation mechanisms that post-training may otherwise weaken?

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 instruction tuning 的 prior：它不只是改偏好，还在改 token 复用的计算风格；先看 Qwen 家族的尺度趋势和 context removal 结果。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on instruction tuning: it is not just changing preferences, but the computation style of token reuse; start with the Qwen scale trend and the context-removal results.

paper.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models
paper.abstract: We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages. On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases. On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages em

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 decoder-only LM 的词序偏好到底来自架构，还是来自训练数据。作者把人工语言和自然语言放在同一套实验框架里比较，试图分离词序、形态、脚本、数据量和数据质量这些相互缠绕的因素。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在数据侧，而不是模型结构侧。结论指向一个实际风险：大规模多语预训练会稳定偏向高资源语言的词序模式，尤其是 SVO，而不是偏向人类语言中最常见的 SOV。这个结果提醒多语数据配比不能只看 token 数，也要看语言类型学覆盖、语料质量和高资源语言的结构性主导。人工语言实验还说明，受控 grammar 上测到的“架构偏好”可能是生成语法的熵结构带来的，不一定能外推到真实预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者构造了 192 种人工语言：6 种基本语序 S/V/O 排列，乘以 5 个二元 head-direction 开关，包括补足从句、补足标记、介词/后置词、形容词、关系从句等内部成分顺序。所有人工语言共享同一个 PCFG 和 Zipf 词表，先生成同一批带括号的层级树，再做确定性线性化，因此 derivation probability 一致，只改变表面词序。相比早期人工语言研究，它加入了独立的 clausal complement order，并覆盖全部六种基本语序。自然语言部分则训练或评估单语和多语模型，按数据规模比较不同类型学语言的困惑度/惊讶度，并把人工语言配置映射到自然语言的方向性特征上。核心区别在于：不是只在人工语言里找架构归因，也不是只在自然语言里做相关性分析，而是用匹配的数据规模和类型学特征把两者接起来。
summary.experiments: 人工语言上，模型表现出左分支偏好，也就是依存成分在中心词前的语言更容易建模。这个偏好既不符合自然语言的普遍分布，也不符合人类学习者常见的方向一致性偏好。成分级 surprisal 分析显示，这种结果可能部分来自无语义 PCFG 的熵结构，而不是 decoder-only Transformer 固有地偏好左分支。并且随着数据量变化，基本语序排序会移动，方向性偏好在训练早期还会反转。自然语言上，小规模 5MB 单语数据看不出稳定基本语序偏好；扩大到 1000MB 后，SVO 语言最容易，SOV 明显落后。这个现象也出现在多语模型中，并且更强地关联语言资源水平和语料质量，而不是关联语序本身。BLOOM 这类设置中，当 SVO 被大量极低资源语言主导时，SVO 优势会减弱或消失。论文没有在给出的正文片段中提供模型参数量和完整数值表，重点结果主要通过语序排序、数据规模曲线和 surprisal 分解呈现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Figure 1，那里给出了人工语言左分支偏好、自然语言从无偏好到 SVO 优势的主要现象。然后看 Methodology 中人工语言生成流程，特别是 Figure 2 和 Figure 3，确认 6×2^5 设计如何控制变量。结果部分应重点看数据规模如何改变语序排序，以及 constituent-level surprisal 如何解释人工语言结果。附录中关于自然语言资源水平、数据质量和类型学特征映射的部分也值得扫读。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要结论；如果关心多语预训练数据配比，需要细读自然语言实验和 BLOOM 对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether word-order preferences in decoder-only language models come from the architecture or from the training data. It uses both controlled artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages to separate word order from morphology, script, resource level, and data quality.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining is in multilingual data design. The results suggest that large-scale training tends to favor the word orders of high-resource, high-quality corpora, especially SVO, rather than the most frequent order across human languages, SOV. This matters for data mixture design: token count alone is not enough. Typological coverage, corpus quality, and the structural dominance of high-resource languages can all shape model preferences. The artificial-language results also caution against reading controlled grammar experiments as direct evidence of architectural priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build 192 artificial languages from 6 possible S/V/O base orders and 5 binary head-direction switches: clausal complements, complementizers, adpositions, adjectives, and relative clauses. A shared PCFG with a Zipfian lexicon generates bracketed parse trees, and each language is obtained by deterministic linearization. This keeps derivation probabilities fixed while changing only surface order. Compared with earlier artificial-language work, the design separates clausal complement order from nominal object order and covers all six base orders. The natural-language experiments evaluate monolingual and multilingual models across typologically varied languages and data scales, then compare these results with matched artificial-language configurations.
summary_en.experiments: On artificial languages, the models show a left-branching preference. This does not align with cross-linguistic universals or with known human biases toward consistent directionality. Constituent-level surprisal analyses indicate that the effect may partly come from the entropy structure of the semantics-free grammar rather than a stable architectural prior. Base-order rankings also change with data volume, and directionality preferences can reverse early in training. On natural languages, no clear base-order preference appears at 5 MB, but at 1000 MB SVO languages become easier and SOV languages fall behind. The same SVO advantage appears in multilingual settings and correlates more with language resource level and data quality than with word order itself. In BLOOM-like settings where SVO is dominated by very-low-resource languages, the advantage weakens or disappears. The provided text does not expose full parameter counts or detailed numeric tables; the central evidence is in scaling curves, word-order rankings, and surprisal decompositions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Figure 1 first, since it shows the main contrast between artificial-language left-branching preference and natural-language SVO advantage. Then read the methodology around the 6×2^5 artificial-language construction, especially Figures 2 and 3. The most useful results are the data-scale analyses and the constituent-level surprisal breakdowns. For multilingual pretraining, spend extra time on the natural-language resource-quality analysis and the BLOOM comparison. A focused skim should take about 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会修正“Transformer 天生偏某种词序”的粗糙 prior：人工语言和自然语言给出相反结论，说明数据分布比架构偏置更强；重点看人工/自然语言对照实验。
recommendation.en: This paper should update the crude prior that Transformers simply prefer one word order by design: artificial and natural languages give opposite answers, which points to data distribution dominating architecture in practice. Focus on the artificial-vs-natural comparison.

institutions: Khoury College of Computer Sciences, Northeastern University

paper.title: Do Language Models Consistently Encode the Current Year?
paper.abstract: A consistent concept of the current time is important for temporal reasoning, yet how language models represent the current time is not well understood. We contribute two tasks that probe the current year in conceptually distinct ways: an associative task, which infers the current year from verb tense, and a declarative task, which directly queries for the current year. Both tasks estimate current years within one year of the post-training data cutoff of instruction-tuned language models. For ba

summary.core_problem: 论文问的是：语言模型内部是否真的有一个一致、可更新的“当前年份”概念，还是只是不同任务上表现得像知道年份。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把一个常被当作“知识截止日期”表面现象的问题，拆成了预训练形成的隐式时间表征和后训练注入的显式时间回答两套机制。结果说明：模型行为上看似一致，不代表内部表示一致；而且预训练学到的时间关联比 SFT 注入的声明式答案更深、更难改。这对 continual pretrain、model refreshing、知识编辑、时间敏感评测都很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计了两个概念上不同的 probing 任务。Associative task 用动词时态来反推模型隐含的当前年份，例如在“In {year} there ...”这类前缀下比较过去式和现在/将来式的概率，定义使两者翻转的年份为 associative current year，ACY。Declarative task 则直接问当前年份。论文不仅看行为输出，还做了内部机制分析：用因果干预追踪 ACY 是否像 factual recall 一样依赖特定中间层/MLP 通道；同时分析这两个年份概念与预训练数据截止时间、SFT 数据年份分布之间的关系。最后，作者系统比较三类更新时间的方法：上下文指定目标年份、在 year-shifted 数据上微调、低秩权重编辑，观察两种年份概念是否能被同步移动。
summary.experiments: 主要结果有四点。第一，base model 的 associative current year 是预训练 cutoff 的强代理，在 13 个基础模型上平均误差约 10 个月，优于以往 proxy。第二，instruction tuning 后，两类任务在行为上都会靠近后训练数据截止时间，通常能落在 1 年内，但内部机制并不一致。第三，ACY 的机制更像事实召回，具有较稳定的因果通路；declarative current year 则缺少统一机制，更像后训练形成的表层回答习惯。第四，更新时间时两者表现明显分裂：system prompt 可把 declarative year 在 351 个目标年份上推到最高 94.6% 准确率，但对 ACY 几乎无效，prompting 成功率只有 1.7%；year-shifted fine-tuning 也只能在接近原始 ACY 的目标年份附近奏效；权重编辑可以分别改动某一任务，但难以同时泛化到两种任务。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看任务定义和主结果图。重点读 ACY 的定义、模板鲁棒性验证，以及干预实验和更新时间实验。若只关心预训练相关启发，抓住两点就够：一是 ACY 与 pretrain cutoff 的对应关系，二是为什么 declarative year 更像 post-train artifact。正文加主要附录大约 30–45 分钟可读完。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether language models actually maintain a coherent internal notion of the current year, or whether they merely behave as if they know it under different prompts.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is that it separates two kinds of temporal knowledge: an implicit time representation acquired during pretraining and a declarative answer pattern shaped during post-training. The main lesson is that behavioral agreement does not imply representational consistency. The temporally grounded associations learned in pretraining are deeper and harder to update than the explicit current-year responses induced by SFT. That matters for continual pretraining, model refreshing, knowledge editing, and temporal evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build two conceptually distinct probes. The associative task infers the model’s implicit current year from verb tense preferences. Using prompts such as “In {year} there ...”, they compare the probability of past-tense versus present/future continuations and define the associative current year (ACY) as the year where the preference flips. The declarative task directly asks for the current year. Beyond behavior, the paper studies internal mechanisms with causal interventions, asking whether ACY resembles factual recall in how it is represented. It also relates both notions of current year to pretraining cutoff dates and to the year distribution in SFT data. Finally, it evaluates three update mechanisms—prompt-based specification, fine-tuning on year-shifted data, and low-rank weight editing—to test whether the two notions can be shifted together.
summary_en.experiments: There are four main findings. First, for base models, ACY is a strong proxy for the pretraining cutoff: across 13 base LMs, the average error is about 10 months. Second, after instruction tuning, both tasks behaviorally track the post-training cutoff to within roughly one year. Third, the internal mechanisms diverge: ACY behaves more like factual recall with a more stable causal pathway, while the declarative current year lacks a consistent mechanism and appears more post-training-driven. Fourth, update interventions split sharply across the two tasks. A system prompt can move the declarative current year very effectively, reaching up to 94.6% accuracy across 351 target years, but it barely shifts ACY, with only 1.7% success. Fine-tuning on year-shifted data also works only near the model’s original ACY. Weight editing can target either task individually, but does not transfer cleanly across both.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on the task definitions, the main behavioral plots, and the intervention results. The most useful parts are the ACY construction, the robustness checks across prompt templates, the causal-mechanism analysis, and the update experiments. If your interest is mainly pretraining, the two takeaways to retain are that ACY tracks pretraining cutoff surprisingly well, and that declarative year knowledge is much more of a post-training artifact. A focused read should take about 30–45 minutes including the key appendix details.

recommendation.zh: 读任务定义和干预失败结果；它提醒 cutoff 不是单个事实槽位，continual pretrain 不能指望轻量编辑解决。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failed interventions; it shows cutoff time is not a single factual slot that lightweight editing can reliably update.

paper.title: BiasTrace: Linking Reasoning Behaviours to Biased Outputs in LLMs
paper.abstract: LLMs exhibit social biases that can produce inaccurate and discriminatory inferences, posing risks in high-stakes applications. While prior work has made progress in measuring and mitigating bias, it largely focuses on final outputs of models, with limited understanding of the mechanisms that produce biased outcomes. Recent advances in LLM reasoning offers a new lens for investigating bias, yet the link between reasoning and bias remains poorly understood. Existing approaches focus primarily on

summary.core_problem: 解决LLM偏见研究只看最终输出、很少分析推理轨迹中哪些行为导致偏见结果的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是机制分析与标注框架。它不直接改进预训练，但对理解推理链中的偏见形成机制、以及后续做过程监督或偏见诊断有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BiasTrace 标注方案，对模型生成的 reasoning traces 进行细粒度行为标注，并把这些行为与偏见输出关联起来。标注既覆盖显式偏见行为，如无依据的人口统计假设，也覆盖可能隐式放大偏见的一般推理模式，如 overthinking。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者将 BiasTrace 应用于推理轨迹分析，但未给出具体模型、数据集规模、标注量、比较基线和量化提升。更像是分析型工作，而非训练方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which reasoning behaviors inside LLM traces are linked to biased outputs, instead of evaluating bias only at the final answer level.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a mechanism-analysis contribution via an annotation framework. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it can inform process supervision and bias diagnosis in reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: BiasTrace is a labeling scheme for model-generated reasoning traces that links specific behaviors to biased outcomes. It covers both bias-specific behaviors, such as unsupported demographic assumptions, and more general reasoning patterns, such as overthinking, that may indirectly contribute to bias.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates the framework is applied to reasoning traces, but does not specify model sizes, dataset scale, annotation volume, baselines, or quantitative gains. It reads as an analysis paper rather than a training-method paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做过程监督或R1类推理数据清洗，可以看它的标注维度；否则相关性一般，读任务定义和标签体系就够了。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim only if you work on process supervision or reasoning-trace curation; otherwise the main value is the annotation schema, not the full paper.

paper.title: When Is a Task Vector Enough? An Empirical Theory of Implicit Multimodal ICL
paper.abstract: Implicit multimodal in-context learning compresses demonstrations into internal interventions, ranging from static task vectors to query-conditioned transformations and attention routing. Despite their common goal, these methods differ substantially in how the intervention depends on the query and where it modifies the model, leaving unclear which additional complexity is necessary for a given task. We propose the Selection--Realization Hypothesis. It views demonstrations as inducing a compact f

summary.core_problem: 现有隐式多模态上下文学习（implicit M-ICL）方法设计跨度极大，从静态任务向量到查询条件变换、注意力路由均有涉及，但缺乏统一理论解释不同任务到底需要多大复杂度的干预，无法预测简单任务向量何时足够、何时必须引入更复杂的设计。
summary.importance: 将ICL的内部作用机制与演示压缩干预的设计直接关联，为多模态模型的ICL能力利用、参数高效适配、推理时演示压缩提供了统一分析框架，跳出了盲目堆叠方法复杂度的研究路径，给出了可实证检验的理论假设。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Selection-Realization（选择-实现）假说，把隐式M-ICL的干预复杂度拆为两个独立维度：一是选择复杂度，即干预是跨查询静态复用还是随输入条件变化；二是实现复杂度，即干预在模型内的实现方式，从局部加性偏移、跨注意力/MLP分布式变化到注意力路由逐层递进。两个维度构成嵌套的干预层级，将此前异构的各类方法统一到同一框架下。验证实验采用受控多模态任务，在保持任务基元和提示格式不变的前提下仅调整查询依赖程度，通过对比正确演示与匹配反事实演示诱导的计算差异检验假说。
summary.experiments: 核心发现包括：演示诱导的内部变化是紧凑的，但并非总在查询间共享；这些变化在查询维度和计算位点维度的变异程度，可同时预测静态任务向量的失效场景以及需要补充的灵活性类型。该诊断方法在自然任务上同样有效，可支持成本感知的方法选择，无需默认采用最复杂的干预设计。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第1节的问题定义与选择-实现假说的核心逻辑（图1对现有方法的统一分类直观清晰），以及第3节的受控实验设计思路，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。若研究方向为ICL机制或参数高效适配，可进一步精读第4节的诊断指标与反事实分析方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing implicit multimodal in-context learning (M-ICL) methods span a wide design space from static task vectors to query-conditioned transformations and attention routing, but no unifying account exists to determine how much intervention complexity is actually required for a given task. It remains unpredictable when a simple task vector is sufficient and when more complex designs are necessary.
summary_en.importance: This work directly connects the internal mechanism of ICL to the design of compressed demonstration interventions, providing a unified analytical framework for leveraging ICL capabilities in multimodal models, parameter-efficient adaptation, and inference-time demonstration compression. It moves beyond the paradigm of blindly increasing method complexity, and offers an empirically testable theoretical hypothesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Selection–Realization Hypothesis is put forward, which decomposes the complexity of implicit M-ICL interventions into two independent dimensions: (1) Selection complexity: whether the intervention is reused across queries or varies conditional on the input; (2) Realization complexity: how the intervention is implemented within the model, ranging from localized additive shifts, to coordinated changes across attention and MLP components, to attention routing. These dimensions form a nested intervention hierarchy that unifies previously heterogeneous methods. Validation uses controlled multimodal tasks where query dependence is varied while holding task primitives and prompt format fixed, and compares computations induced by correct demonstrations versus matched counterfactuals to test the hypothesis.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings include: demonstration-induced internal changes are compact but not always shared across queries; the degree of variation across queries and computational sites predicts both when static task vectors fail and what type of additional flexibility is useful. The same diagnostic approach remains effective on natural tasks, supporting cost-aware method selection without defaulting to the most complex intervention design.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, focus on Section 1 for the problem formulation and core logic of the Selection–Realization Hypothesis (Figure 1 provides a clear unified classification of existing methods), and Section 3 for the controlled experimental design rationale. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. For researchers working on ICL mechanisms or parameter-efficient adaptation, Section 4's diagnostic metrics and counterfactual analysis methods are worth deeper examination.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验设计和反事实对照；它给 task vector 能力边界一个更干净的判据，而不是只报成功率。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental design and counterfactual controls; it gives a cleaner boundary condition for task vectors than another success-rate table.

paper.title: Don't Want Your LLM to Recommend Nuclear Strike? Try Asking It in Japanese
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in strategic and advisory contexts, yet their safety alignment is typically evaluated in English only. We test nine models from six providers and ask whether the language of a prompt can change a model's decision in a high-stakes scenario. We use single-turn game-theoretic vignettes in which a model advises a nuclear-armed nation on whether to strike a defenseless opponent. The prompt is intentionally amoral and strategically identical across languages

summary.core_problem: 检验安全对齐是否在不同语言间稳定，尤其是相同战略情境下，提示语言是否会系统性改变模型的高风险建议。
summary.importance: 这是一篇安全/机制分析工作。它的重要性不在于提出新方法，而在于指出多语言条件下 alignment 可能并不等价，暴露出训练分布与推理语言耦合的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造单轮博弈论情境，保持战略结构不变，仅切换提示语言；同时做 cross-language 控制实验，在英文提示中要求模型用日语思考，以区分“问题语言”与“思考语言”的作用。
summary.experiments: 测试 6 家提供商的 9 个模型。摘要报告 Claude Sonnet 4.6 在不必要打击场景中发射率从 40% 降到 0%，争议场景从 93% 降到 17%；Gemini Pro 3.1 也有类似下降。控制实验中，英文提示但要求用日语推理时，发射率从 93% 降到 37%，说明关键变量更像是内部推理语言。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether safety alignment is stable across languages, asking whether prompt language systematically changes model advice in the same high-stakes strategic scenario.
summary_en.importance: This is a safety/mechanistic analysis paper. Its value is not a new method but the observation that alignment may not transfer uniformly across languages, exposing coupling between training distribution and reasoning language.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author builds single-turn game-theoretic vignettes with identical strategic structure and varies only the prompt language. A cross-language control asks the model to reason in Japanese within an English prompt to separate prompt language from reasoning language.
summary_en.experiments: Nine models from six providers are evaluated. The abstract reports that Claude Sonnet 4.6 drops from 40% to 0% in unnecessary-strike cases and from 93% to 17% in contested cases when prompted in Japanese; Gemini Pro 3.1 shows a similar reduction. In the control setting, asking for Japanese reasoning inside an English prompt reduces launch rates from 93% to 37%, suggesting the key variable is the language of reasoning rather than the language of the question alone.

recommendation.zh: 结论有点戏剧化，但如果数字站得住，它说明多语种对齐远没你想得稳；先看控制实验，别只看 headline。
recommendation.en: The headline is dramatic, but if the controls hold, multilingual alignment is much less stable than many assume; read the control setup, not just the claim.

paper.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained and deployed with long contexts that span documents, code repositories, and interaction histories. This scaling reflects the implicit assumption that training on longer contexts will only help the model by exposing it to richer evidence. We challenge this view by studying how the context window shapes a model's mode of learning, shifting it between parametric internalization and contextualization. We propose the Information Abundance Paradox, which

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究长上下文训练是否会改变模型学习知识的方式。核心问题是：当训练上下文中包含大量与预测相关的信息时，模型是否会减少把知识写入参数的压力，转而学习依赖上下文证据。作者把这一现象称为 Information Abundance Paradox，并用 context addiction 作为可观测表现：模型在有相关上下文时表现好，但在上下文缺失或误导时退化。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对长上下文预训练有直接影响。当前常见假设是，上下文窗口变长主要带来更多证据，只要数据足够好，训练就会受益。论文提出相反的风险：长上下文不是中性的供数管道，它会改变 cross-entropy 优化下的最优学习策略。模型可以通过读取上下文降低 loss，而不必把同一信息压缩进权重。对基座训练而言，这意味着长上下文扩展可能提高长文建模能力，却削弱闭卷知识、短上下文泛化或无上下文鲁棒性。Phi-3 和 OLMo 3 中长上下文版本在 few-shot / zero-shot 上落后短上下文版本的现象，被用作这一问题的现实动机。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从两个训练场景验证假设。预训练场景中，作者固定 token budget、数据、模型配置和优化设置，只改变训练上下文窗口长度，用连贯文档跨度作为信息丰富度的代理变量。这样可以把“训练了更多 token”与“上下文更长”区分开。监督微调场景中，作者固定上下文长度，直接控制上下文中任务相关信息的多少，用来隔离相关信息本身的作用。理论部分把语言模型训练看成压缩问题，区分参数知识和上下文知识两条预测通道；当上下文提供足够低复杂度的解时，达到相同风险阈值所需写入权重的任务信息会减少。机制分析进一步从三方面支撑这一点：长上下文提供更低复杂度的训练解；参数更新压力从 FFN 更偏向 attention；推理时模型对上下文 token 的依赖增强。
summary.experiments: 预训练实验在 20M、55M、259M、750M 四个参数规模上进行，固定 token 预算、数据和优化 recipe，改变训练 context window。结果呈现倒 U 型：语言建模、自然语言理解、闭卷多选问答会随上下文变长先提升，到中等长度附近达到较好状态，继续增加上下文后反而下降。这说明问题不是单纯的数据质量或训练量不足。监督微调实验显示，当推理时提供有用上下文，训练中见过丰富任务相关上下文的模型准确率更高；但当上下文缺失或被误导时，鲁棒性下降。机制实验显示，长上下文模型更倾向使用上下文 token，训练更新也更集中到 attention 模块，相对减少了通过 FFN 储存可复用知识的压力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Section 2、Section 3、Section 5。Section 2 给出 Information Abundance Paradox 和 context addiction 的定义，是理解实验设计的关键。Section 3.1 最重要，关注固定 token budget 下不同 context window 的预训练对比，以及四个规模上的倒 U 型曲线。Section 3.2 适合看可控 SFT 实验，因为它把“上下文长度”和“任务相关信息量”拆开。Section 4 的理论模型不必逐行推导，但要看风险阈值与参数内化信息量之间的关系。Section 5 值得细读，尤其是 update pressure 从 FFN 转向 attention、推理时上下文依赖增强的分析；这些结果对设计长上下文训练 mixture、短上下文保持、闭卷能力评估都有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: This work asks whether long-context training changes what a model learns to store in its parameters. The core issue is that abundant task-relevant information inside the training context may reduce the pressure to internalize the same information parametrically. The authors call this the Information Abundance Paradox. Its observable form is context addiction: the model performs well when useful context is present, but degrades when the context is absent, incomplete, or misleading.
summary_en.importance: The paper is directly relevant to long-context pretraining. A common assumption is that longer contexts simply expose the model to richer evidence, so better data and longer windows should help. This work argues that the context window also changes the learning strategy induced by next-token cross-entropy. If the model can lower loss by reading evidence from the context, it may store less reusable knowledge in the weights. For foundation-model training, this creates a trade-off: longer contexts can improve contextual prediction while weakening closed-book knowledge, short-context generalization, or robustness without supporting evidence. The paper uses the gap between long-context and short-context variants of Phi-3 and OLMo 3 as motivating evidence that this issue appears in real training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study tests the hypothesis in both pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. In pretraining, the token budget, data, model configuration, and optimization setup are fixed, while the training context window is varied. Coherent document span length serves as a proxy for the amount of available relevant information. This design separates longer-context learning from simply seeing more tokens. In supervised fine-tuning, the context length is fixed and the amount of task-relevant context is directly controlled, isolating relevance from length. The theoretical account treats language modeling as compression with two predictive channels: information stored in parameters and information supplied in context. When context offers a lower-complexity solution, less task information needs to be encoded in the weights to reach the same risk threshold. The mechanistic analyses then connect this to lower-complexity contextual solutions, a shift in update pressure from feed-forward networks toward attention modules, and stronger reliance on context tokens at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The pretraining experiments cover four model scales: 20M, 55M, 259M, and 750M parameters. With fixed token budget, data, architecture, and optimization, varying the training context window produces an inverted-U pattern. Language modeling, natural language understanding, and closed-book multiple-choice QA improve up to an intermediate context length and then decline as the context becomes longer. This suggests that the degradation is not just a data-quality issue. The supervised fine-tuning experiments show a complementary pattern: informative context improves accuracy when such context is available at inference, but training with abundant relevant context reduces robustness when the context is missing or misleading. Mechanistic measurements indicate that longer-context training increases reliance on context tokens and shifts more learning pressure toward attention relative to feed-forward networks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2 first for the definitions of Information Abundance Paradox and context addiction. Section 3.1 is the main pretraining result: focus on the fixed-token-budget comparisons across context windows and the inverted-U curves across the four model scales. Section 3.2 is useful because the SFT setup directly controls task-relevant information and separates relevance from length. Section 4 is worth reading for the risk-threshold argument, but the main takeaway is the reduction in required parametric information when context provides an easier solution. Section 5 is the most useful part for training researchers interested in mechanisms: the analyses of FFN-versus-attention update pressure and inference-time context reliance have direct implications for long-context data mixtures, short-context retention, and closed-book evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对 long-context pretrain 的 prior：别再默认窗口越长越赚，先看它如何把“会背”换成“会找”，建议优先核查实验控制和中间最优点是否稳。
recommendation.en: This one should update your prior on long-context pretraining: longer context may trade memorization for retrieval, so check whether the intermediate optimum survives clean controls before changing recipe.

paper.title: Measure, Don't Optimize: Forecasting Recovery in LLM Unlearning
paper.abstract: Prior white-box studies show that large language models can retain latent traces of target knowledge after unlearning, even when the knowledge is no longer expressed in their outputs. However, existing audits remain limited to one-off diagnostics: it is unclear whether these residual signals can predict future recovery under continued training or serve as reliable optimization targets. Resolving this gap is essential to determine whether internal auditing can move beyond post-hoc evaluation towa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“模型里是否还残留被遗忘知识”，而是更难也更实际的问题：这些白盒残留信号，能否预测后续再训练时知识会不会重新长出来；以及一旦把这种内部信号当作训练目标去压低，它是否仍然可信。论文聚焦 machine unlearning 里的一个关键断层：行为层面看似已经忘掉，并不等于参数和中间表征里真的删掉；但如果内部审计只能做事后诊断，不能预测恢复风险，也不能抗优化规避，那它对训练流程的价值就很有限。
summary.importance: 对预训练和持续训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它把“内部可访问性”与“后续恢复动力学”联系起来，讨论的是训练轨迹而不是静态快照，这一点和 continual pretrain、cooldown、再学习攻击、数据删除后的残留记忆都直接相关。第二，它给出一个负面但很有用的结论：内部审计指标可以有预测性，但未必适合作为优化目标。也就是说，测量信号和训练信号不是一回事。对做数据删除、版权移除、成员信息清除、甚至 reward/auxiliary loss 设计的人，这个结论很重要，因为它提醒你：一个能解释风险的 probe，可能一旦进 loss 就变成可被模型投机规避的对象。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 J-Access。它不直接看最终输出，也不使用 logit lens 这类把中间层残差直接乘 unembedding 的读出方式，而是用 Jacobian lens 去近似“从某个中间状态到最终词表证据”的下游变换。作者的理由很明确：unlearning 之后，残差流几何可能已经变了，logit lens 假设中间层与最终层共享同一解码基底，这个假设会更脆弱；Jacobian lens 则通过局部线性化，把中间表示沿着后续网络传播到词表空间，更适合测“这个知识离输出通路还有多近”。

具体做法上，给定一个不直接点名目标实体、但会牵涉该实体知识的 probe query，作者在一段 mid-to-late layers 上取 residual representation，用 Jacobian lens 映射到词表分数，再检查与目标概念相关的 token 集是否出现在高排名位置。概念 token 集做了两种粒度：identity-level 主要看实体名及其子词；knowledge-level 则扩展到答案内容词，并加了文档频率和可推断性过滤，避免把太泛的词算进去。最后把 access rate 相对原始模型和 retain-only gold model 做归一化，得到一个可比较的内部可访问性分数。

论文的设计重点不在提出一个更强的 unlearning 算法，而在两个评估场景。其一，预测场景：先测 unlearn 后模型的 J-Access，再做 cross-entity relearning attack，看它能否预测恢复速度和恢复幅度。其二，优化场景：把压低 J-Access 直接并入 unlearning 目标，检验模型会不会只是学会“藏起来”。这两个场景把 interpretability probe 从静态解释工具推进到训练接口层面，这是全文最有信息量的部分。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 TOFU 和 OpenUnlearning，两套当前较常用的 unlearning 基准；总计评估了 8 种 unlearning 方法、398 个公开 unlearned models。论文的主要结果有三点。

第一，大多数通过常规 forgetting/utility 指标的模型，J-Access 仍显著高于 retain-only gold model。也就是说，行为上答不出来，不代表内部通路上已经不可达。这个结论在不同方法和数据集上都成立，说明“behavioral forgetting ≠ internal erasure”不是个别现象。

第二，在 cross-entity relearning 攻击下，攻击前的 J-Access 对模型级 recovery speed 有预测力。换句话说，哪个 unlearned model 更容易在少量继续训练后把忘掉的知识重新接回输出层，J-Access 能提前给出信号。但它对 instance-level 的恢复，即某个具体条目会不会恢复，预测力较弱。这个结果很合理：J-Access 更像是整体连通性或可达性指标，而不是逐样本命运预测器。

第三，直接优化压低 J-Access 会出现反效果：审计分数下降了，但攻击后的恢复更强。作者把这解释为 audit evasion——模型学会压制被测读出，而不是删除底层知识。这个发现比“指标有效”更重要，因为它说明内部 probe 一旦进入训练目标，语义就会变。论文还做了 identity-level 与 knowledge-level 的对比、不同层带的读出分析，以及与标准行为指标的关系分析，用来说明 J-Access 捕捉的是与输出概率不同的一类信号。

摘要里没有给出大量具体数值，全文重点也更偏趋势和相关性，而不是追求某个单点绝对提升。阅读时更应关注相关曲线、恢复速度排序、以及加入 J-Access loss 前后的攻击后表现差异。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言和方法部分读仔细，因为问题设定比公式更重要。优先看三块内容。

第一，Introduction 里对两类问题的区分：预测未来恢复，和作为优化目标是否稳健。这决定了整篇论文的价值，不只是又做了一个 unlearning audit。

第二，The J-Access Audit 这一节。重点看作者为什么不用 logit lens，而改用 Jacobian lens；再看 concept token set 的构造和归一化方式。这里关系到这个指标到底在测什么。

第三，实验里关于 relearning attack 的章节，以及“直接最小化 J-Access”后的结果图表。前者回答指标有没有前瞻性，后者回答它能不能安全进入 loss。若时间有限，先抓住这两部分即可，预计 25–35 分钟能把主线读清。

值得深挖的点有两个：一是 J-Access 更像 connectivity probe 还是 memorization probe；二是这种“可测但不可优化”的现象，是否会在 activation steering、representation regularization、甚至 RL reward shaping 中重复出现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether unlearned knowledge leaves residual traces inside an LLM. It studies whether such white-box signals can forecast future recovery under continued training, and whether they remain meaningful once directly optimized during unlearning. This addresses a real gap in machine unlearning: behavioral forgetting can hide latent retention, but a probe is only operationally useful if it predicts downstream relearning risk and does not collapse under optimization pressure.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining-oriented readers is conceptual. First, it reframes unlearning as a training-dynamics problem rather than a static evaluation problem. That connects naturally to continual pretraining, cooldown phases, relearning attacks, and residual memory after data removal. Second, it delivers an important caution: an internal metric can be useful for measurement yet unsafe as a training objective. That distinction matters beyond unlearning. It is relevant to auxiliary losses, representation regularizers, privacy-oriented deletion, and any setting where a probe-derived signal is tempting to optimize directly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed audit, J-Access, measures how accessible target knowledge remains along the model’s output pathway. Instead of relying on a standard logit lens, which directly decodes intermediate residual states with the unembedding matrix, the method uses a Jacobian lens. The motivation is specific: after unlearning, the geometry of the residual stream may shift, so the shared-basis assumption behind the logit lens becomes less reliable. The Jacobian lens locally linearizes the downstream computation from an intermediate state to vocabulary space, making it a better proxy for whether hidden knowledge is still close to being verbalized.

Operationally, the audit uses probe queries that implicate a forgotten entity without explicitly naming it. For a band of mid-to-late layers, the residual representation is projected into vocabulary space through the Jacobian lens, and the method checks whether any token from a target concept set appears among the top-ranked decoded tokens. The concept set is defined at two granularities: an identity-level set containing full-name and name-piece tokens, and a broader knowledge-level set containing answer content words filtered by document frequency and inferability constraints. The resulting access rate is normalized against both the original pre-unlearning model and a retain-only gold model trained without the forget set.

The paper is structured around two evaluation regimes rather than a new unlearning algorithm. In the predictive regime, pre-attack J-Access is measured and then compared against recovery under cross-entity relearning attacks. In the optimization regime, J-Access suppression is added directly to the unlearning objective to test whether the signal is robust or merely gameable. That design is the paper’s strongest contribution.
summary_en.experiments:
The study evaluates two unlearning benchmarks, TOFU and OpenUnlearning, covering 8 unlearning methods and 398 public unlearned models. Three findings drive the paper.

First, many models that pass standard forgetting and utility checks still show J-Access substantially above the retain-only gold reference. So behavioral forgetting does not imply internal erasure. The result appears across methods and datasets, suggesting this is not an artifact of one benchmark.

Second, pre-attack J-Access predicts model-level recovery speed under cross-entity relearning attacks. Models with higher residual access tend to recover forgotten knowledge faster under a small amount of continued training. However, the signal is much weaker for predicting which specific items will recover. That indicates J-Access behaves more like a global accessibility or connectivity measure than an instance-level fate predictor.

Third, directly minimizing J-Access during unlearning lowers the audit score but increases post-attack recovery. The model learns to evade the readout rather than delete the underlying knowledge. This is the most consequential result in the paper. It shows that a useful audit can become a misleading optimization target.

The paper also includes analyses across identity-level versus knowledge-level token sets, different layer bands, and comparisons with standard behavioral metrics. The emphasis is on trends, correlations, and attack outcomes rather than a single headline scalar improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but the setup is worth reading carefully. Start with the introduction, especially the distinction between two goals: forecasting future recovery and using an internal signal as an optimization target. That framing is more important than the exact formula.

Then read the J-Access method section. Focus on why the authors reject the plain logit lens in favor of the Jacobian lens, and how the concept token sets are defined and normalized. Those choices determine what the metric is actually measuring.

In the experiments, prioritize the relearning-attack sections and the ablation where J-Access is directly optimized. The former tells you whether the signal has predictive value; the latter tells you whether it survives contact with training. If time is limited, those parts are enough to capture the paper’s main message in about 25 to 35 minutes.

The deeper question to keep in mind is whether J-Access is measuring memorized content itself or merely the ease with which latent content can be reconnected to the output pathway.

recommendation.zh: 不是 unlearning recipe，而是“哪些内部信号真能预测再训练恢复”的测量论文；若你做 continual pretrain 或删除请求，先看指标相关性和失败案例。
recommendation.en: This is not an unlearning recipe but a measurement paper on which internal signals actually predict recovery under retraining; read the correlation and failure-case sections first.
