paper.title: Disentangling the Expressivity of RoPE
paper.abstract: Two accounts recur in explanations of the success of rotary position embeddings (RoPE). Expressivity studies associate periodic position information with modular predicates, whereas mechanistic and long-context studies emphasize positional anchors and local offsets. We formalize both accounts for fully uniform, finite-precision soft-attention transformers. We find that, if every rotary component is periodic, RoPE transformers recognize exactly the languages definable in past temporal logic with

summary.core_problem: RoPE 为何有效？现有两种解释——周期性带来的模块化谓词表达能力，与位置锚点/局部偏移的机制性偏好——看似矛盾。论文在有限精度、fully uniform soft-attention transformer 框架下把两者区分开。
summary.importance: 对理解主流位置编码方案的实际能力边界有参考价值。结论解释了 RoPE 在长上下文泛化上的局限：常规 RoPE 的旋转相位与 2π 不可公度、永不重复，它实现的是精度依赖的有界固定偏移回看，而非任意长度的模块化构造；这为长上下文外推失败和 fixed-offset attention head 的存在提供了形式化依据。
summary.technical_approach: 区分两种 RoPE 变体。组件周期性 RoPE（RoPE_P）把每个旋转分量的角度取为 2π 的有理数倍，相位有限重复，在有限精度下等价于带模块化谓词的过去时态逻辑 LTL[P, MOD]。常规 RoPE 的频率相位与 2π 不可公度，旋转永不重复，其相对注意力分数只能在精度维持的分数间隔内模拟 k 步回看算子，因此对应有界局部注意力而非全长度模块化刻画。这把 RoPE 与 local attention 和实践中观察到的 fixed-offset head 联系起来。
summary.experiments: 在受控形式语言上训练 transformer。周期性 RoPE 调度在需要模块化谓词的语言上实现长度泛化；常规 RoPE 在所有 base 取值下都无法在 (aa)* 和 (ab)* 上泛化，说明调 base 不能恢复模块化构造。在 LTL[Y] 语言上，常规 RoPE 的平均最长完美长度在七个 base 中六个优于 NoPE，但在 LTL[P] 语言和同时需要 P 与 Y 的语言上每个 base 都弱于 NoPE。结果支持局部性解释，并显示局部偏置可能干扰长距离条件化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 §1 引言的两种解释对比、§2.4 对常规 RoPE 非周期性的论证，以及实验部分形式语言上的对比结果。形式逻辑定义（LTL、FO²、自动机等价）可按需跳过。预计 20–30 分钟。对做长上下文和位置编码改进的研究者，值得思考的是：能否设计混合调度，让部分维度承担周期性模块化构造、其余维度承担局部偏移，以兼得两种能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Why does RoPE work? Two accounts recur—periodicity enabling modular-predicate expressivity, versus positional anchors and local-offset biases—and they appear incompatible. The paper disentangles them within a fully uniform, finite-precision soft-attention transformer framework.
summary_en.importance: Useful for understanding the actual capability boundary of the dominant positional encoding scheme. The result explains RoPE's long-context extrapolation failures: conventional RoPE uses phases incommensurate with 2π that never repeat, so it realizes a precision-dependent bounded simulation of fixed-offset look-back rather than an all-length modular construction. This gives a formal account of both extrapolation limits and the fixed-offset heads observed in practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two RoPE variants are distinguished. Component-periodic RoPE (RoPE_P) rotates each subspace by rational multiples of 2π, so phases repeat finitely and, under finite precision, the model recognizes exactly the languages definable in past temporal logic with modular predicates, LTL[P, MOD]. Conventional RoPE uses frequencies whose phases are incommensurate with 2π and never repeat; its relative attention scores can simulate k-step look-back only while a precision-dependent score gap is maintained, yielding bounded local attention rather than an all-length modular characterization. This connects RoPE to local attention and to empirically observed fixed-offset heads.
summary_en.experiments: Transformers are trained on controlled formal languages. Periodic RoPE schedules length-generalize on languages requiring modular predicates. No conventional base value generalizes on (aa)* or (ab)*, indicating that changing the base does not recover the modular construction. On an LTL[Y] language, conventional RoPE's mean longest-perfect length beats NoPE at six of seven bases, but underperforms NoPE at every base on an LTL[P] language and on a language requiring both P and Y. The results support the locality account and suggest the local bias can interfere with long-distance conditioning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim §1 for the contrast between the two accounts, §2.4 for the non-periodicity argument for conventional RoPE, and the formal-language experiments. The LTL/FO²/automata formalisms can be skipped as needed. Estimated 20–30 minutes. For researchers working on long-context or positional-encoding improvements, a natural question is whether a hybrid schedule—some dimensions carrying periodic modular constructions, others carrying local offsets—could combine both capabilities.

recommendation.zh: RoPE 的周期性和局部回看被拆开了；只看形式化定义和实验分离，也能校正长上下文外推直觉。
recommendation.en: It cleanly separates RoPE periodicity from local look-back behavior; read the formal setup and controlled separation experiments to recalibrate long-context intuitions.

paper.title: Orientation, not magnitude: the causal structure of task-vector interference in merged language models
paper.abstract: Model merging by task arithmetic works until it doesn't, and the field diagnoses why with magnitudes: layerwise representation bias, deviations from cross-task linearity, parameter overlap. Tracking the exact layerwise cross-term of merged LLMs through a factorial ledger and intervening on it directly, we find magnitude insufficient - and inconsistent across model families - as a diagnostic axis. An exact decomposition of the layerwise flux shows it is dominated by amplifying transport of the ex

summary.core_problem: 解释 task-vector model merging 中不同任务相互干扰的因果结构，尤其判断干扰来自向量大小还是方向。
summary.importance: 这是模型合并和参数空间机制分析工作。它对 continual finetuning、能力合成、checkpoint arithmetic 有参考意义，因为这些场景常用 task vector，但现有诊断多看 norm、overlap 或线性偏差，未必能解释干扰真正如何传播。
summary.technical_approach: 论文追踪 merged LLM 每层 cross-term 的精确分解，用 factorial ledger 分账，并直接干预该 cross-term。核心分析包括 layerwise flux decomposition、在不同层擦除 cross-term、从六个起始 displacement 做 basin test，以及用同 norm 但错误方向的控制向量做因果对照。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在两个模型家族上观察到一致现象：late block 中已有 cross-term 的 amplifying transport 占主导，约 65-70%，每个 late block gain 大于 1；如果不在靠近输出处擦除，传播会把 cross-term 重建到 99% norm 且 cosine 0.99。沿正确方向擦除会按剂量移除 expressed interference，而同 norm 错误方向控制无效或效果弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes the causal structure of task-vector interference in merged language models, asking whether interference is governed by magnitude or direction.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic study of model merging and parameter-space composition. It matters for continual finetuning, capability merging, and checkpoint arithmetic, where task vectors are often used but interference diagnostics are usually based on norms, overlap, or linearity deviations.
summary_en.technical_approach: It tracks the exact layerwise cross-term in merged LLMs through a factorial ledger and intervenes on that term directly. The analysis includes layerwise flux decomposition, cross-term erasure at different depths, basin tests from six starting displacements, and norm-matched wrong-direction controls.
summary_en.experiments: Across two model families, the cross-term flux is dominated by amplifying transport of the existing cross-term, around 65-70%, with gain above 1 in late blocks. Erasing the term is undone by propagation unless applied near the output, rebuilding to 99% of its norm at cosine 0.99. Directional erasure removes expressed interference dose-dependently, while norm-matched wrong-direction controls fail or are much weaker.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 后看干预实验；“方向而非大小”若成立，会改变 task-vector merge 的调参诊断轴。
recommendation.en: Read the intervention results after the abstract; if the direction-over-magnitude claim holds, it changes the diagnostic axis for task-vector merging.

paper.title: Locating and Controlling Implicit Personalization in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often shift their outputs in response to implicit demographic cues even when users never state a demographic identity. Previous work has documented this behavior, but the connection between these behavioral changes and the model's internal activations remains unclear. Using matched cued and neutral conversations across five LLMs, we establish that a localized internal activation signal tracks changes in recommendations, with correlations up to r=0.87. When multiple c

summary.core_problem: 定位 LLM 如何在用户未显式声明身份时，仍根据隐式人口统计线索改变推荐和输出。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析与控制工作。它把隐式个性化从行为现象推进到 activation-level signal，并尝试用内部信号移除来控制人口统计线索影响。对 pretrain 研究员的价值主要在于理解模型如何编码和组合用户线索，以及提示约束为何不总是可靠。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造成对的 cued 与 neutral conversations，在五个 LLM 上比较输出变化和内部激活。作者寻找可局部化的 activation signal，测量其与推荐变化的相关性，并在推理时移除特定 cue 对应的内部信号，比较该方法与“忽略人口统计信息”提示的效果。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个 LLM。摘要报告内部激活信号与推荐变化的相关性最高达到 r=0.87；多个 cue 同时出现时，内部信号大体可组合，但输出变化不是简单相加。移除某个 cue 的内部信号通常比提示模型忽略人口统计更有效，同时大体保持通用 benchmark 表现；但选择性移除一个维度且保留其他维度的能力依赖模型和属性。
summary.authors_note: Indiana University Bloomington。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper locates how LLMs change their outputs in response to implicit demographic cues even when users do not explicitly state an identity.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and control study. It moves implicit personalization from a behavioral observation to an activation-level signal, and tests whether removing that signal can control demographic influence. For pretraining researchers, the useful angle is how models encode and combine user cues, and why prompt-level constraints may be insufficient.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build matched cued and neutral conversations across five LLMs, compare output shifts with internal activations, and identify localized activation signals. They then remove the signal associated with a cue at inference time and compare this intervention against prompting the model to ignore demographic information.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers five LLMs. The abstract reports correlations up to r=0.87 between localized activation signals and recommendation changes. With multiple cues, internal signals mostly combine, while output changes are not simply additive. Removing one cue signal often suppresses its influence more effectively than prompting, with general benchmark performance largely preserved, though selectivity varies by model and attribute.
summary_en.authors_note: Indiana University Bloomington.

recommendation.zh: 适合备查 activation steering 的边界；相关性 r=0.87 亮眼，但 selective removal 的不稳定才是该看的坑。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference on activation steering limits; the r=0.87 correlation is notable, but the unstable selective removal is the part to watch.

paper.title: What Iterated Self-Feeding Probes of Language Models Measure, and a test that separates the construction from the model
paper.abstract: A growing class of methods probes a language model by feeding it its own output: self-consistency, iterated refinement, agentic loops. We ask what such a probe measures, in a construction chosen to make the question sharp: a ring of token cells resampled in place by the model's own windowed conditional p_r(x_i | x_{i+-r}). The substrate is Glauber dynamics on token sequences and is not new; what we change is the coupling. Advancing two rings that differ in one token under common random numbers m

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问一个很具体的问题：把语言模型的输出反复喂回给模型时，观测到的动力学指标到底是在测模型，还是在测 probe 构造本身。作者用一个环形 token 系统把问题固定下来，并说明两者很容易混在一起。
summary.importance: 它不是训练 recipe，也不直接改进预训练效果。价值在于测量方法：self-consistency、iterated refinement、agent loop、masked iterative generation 都把静态模型变成了动态系统。如果 probe 自身会制造相变或吸收态，那么从这些循环行为推断模型能力、稳定性或推理机制就会出错。对研究非 AR 生成、masked LM 动力学、agent 循环稳定性和机制分析的人有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造一个长度为 N 的环形 token 序列，每个位置按随机顺序被原地重采样。重采样分布来自语言模型在半径 r 窗口上的条件分布 p_r(x_i | x_{i±r})，中心 token 被 mask，温度为 T。关键变化不是 Glauber dynamics 本身，而是 coupling 方式。作者不用 maximal coupling 去测 mixing time，而是用 common random numbers：两条环形链初始只差一个 token，之后使用相同的随机数流和访问顺序推进。这样当两个窗口完全一致时，两条链会抽到同一个 token；任何差异都可以归因于初始扰动的传播。基于这个构造，作者定义了 token-space Lyapunov exponent λ_ca、归一化阻尼长度 D_norm 和空间 light cone。论文还提出一个判别原则：固定模型改构造、固定构造改模型，观察指标是否移动，用实验而不是直觉区分 probe-determined 和 model-determined readout。
summary.experiments: 实验包含几类校准和控制。第一，在 Domany–Kinzel automaton 上做 reproduction calibration，damage field 可由已知自动机独立预测，结果 bit-exact，mismatching cells 为 0；离线 control 会失败，用来确认测量工具没有把无关相关性当信号。第二，方法能区分 elementary cellular automata 中 damage 是否存活，并恢复已知 transition matrix。第三，作者观察到一个 sharp absorbing-state transition，可测到三位小数，但进一步证明它来自 probe 构造：机制是 argmax map 的吸引固定点，且只出现在 r∈{1,2}。masked-LM control 没有这个固定点，因此没有对应 transition。第四，五组 manipulation 用来分离构造因素和模型因素：改变构造会移动 manufactured transition；跨模型 family 改变模型不移动它；改变训练 checkpoint 会移动 developmental transition。第五，作者报告了 estimator gating 的必要性：黑盒 LM 动力学上的指数估计如果不按测量几何做 gating，会给出看似自信但错误的结论，文中列出四个被已知答案系统拦下的错误 verdict。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–45 分钟。重点看 §2 的构造设定，尤其是 in-place resampling、环形边界、中心 mask、随机访问顺序，以及这些设定和真实 AR generation 的差异。§3 的 Domany–Kinzel 校准决定了测量工具是否可信。§4 的 manufactured phase transition 是全文最重要的警示案例：一个看似模型性质的现象可能来自 probe。§5 的 vary-one-factor test 值得细看，可迁移到 agent loop、self-refinement 和 iterative decoding 的评估设计。§6 的 estimator gating 对做黑盒行为测量的人也很实用。§7 明确说它不是 interpretability 结果，这一点有助于避免过度解读 λ_ca。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what is actually measured when a language model is repeatedly fed its own outputs. In a controlled ring-of-tokens construction, the observed dynamics can reflect either the model or the probe, and the two can look similar unless explicitly separated.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method paper, but it is useful for measurement. Many modern procedures turn a static predictor into a dynamical system: self-consistency, iterative refinement, agent loops, and masked iterative generation. If the probing construction itself can create absorbing states or phase transitions, then behavioral conclusions about model stability, reasoning, or self-correction can be misleading. The paper is most relevant to researchers studying non-autoregressive generation, masked-LM dynamics, agent-loop stability, and mechanistic evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is a ring of N token cells. Each site is resampled in place from the model’s windowed conditional distribution p_r(x_i | x_{i±r}) at temperature T, with the center token masked. The substrate is Glauber dynamics on token sequences. The main change is the coupling. Instead of maximal coupling, which is suited to mixing-time questions, the authors use common random numbers: two rings differ in one initial token and are then advanced with the same random-number stream and visit order. If their local windows agree, they draw the same token, so any later difference can be attributed to the injected perturbation. This makes damage spreading measurable through a token-space Lyapunov exponent λ_ca, a normalized damping length D_norm, and a spatial light cone. The paper also gives a practical discriminator: vary the construction while holding the model fixed, and vary the model while holding the construction fixed. This separates probe-determined readings from model-determined readings.
summary_en.experiments: The measurement instrument is first calibrated on the Domany–Kinzel automaton, where the damage field is known. The independent prediction matches bit-for-bit with zero mismatching cells, while an offline control fails as expected. The method also separates elementary cellular automata by whether damage survives and recovers known transition matrices. In language-model experiments, the construction exhibits a sharp absorbing-state transition measurable to three decimal places, but the paper attributes it to the probe rather than the model. The mechanism is an attracting fixed point of the argmax map, and it appears only for radii r∈{1,2}. A masked-LM control, whose map lacks the same fixed point, shows no such transition. Five manipulations are used to separate readings: changing the construction moves the instrument; changing model families does not move the manufactured transition; changing training checkpoints moves a developmental transition. The paper also reports four retracted conclusions caught by known-answer systems, motivating estimator gating for black-box LM dynamics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Read the construction section carefully: in-place resampling, periodic boundaries, center masking, random site order, and the mismatch with normal autoregressive generation all matter. The Domany–Kinzel calibration is the main sanity check for the measurement tool. The manufactured phase transition section is the key warning case: an apparently model-level phenomenon can be created by the probe. The discriminator section is the most reusable part for evaluating self-refinement loops, agent loops, and iterative decoding. The estimator-gating section is useful if you measure black-box dynamics. The paper explicitly states that λ_ca is not a localized interpretability mechanism, which is important for keeping the claims bounded.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验分解和 coupling 设计；它会让你少把 agent loop 的动力学伪信号误读成模型能力。
recommendation.en: Skim the coupling design and decomposition results; it helps avoid reading agent-loop dynamics as model capability when the probe creates the signal.

paper.title: When Visual Signals Mislead: A Mechanistic Study of Attribute Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Attribute hallucination---where vision-language models (VLMs) correctly identify an object but mischaracterize its properties---is prevalent yet mechanistically poorly understood. The dominant explanation, language-prior dominance, has motivated prior-suppression methods, but this explanation has not been directly tested at the attribute level. We present VISOR (Visual-Operational Remediation), a unified framework that couples null-image-based diagnosis with routed remediation. Its VSNR diagnost

summary.core_problem: 论文要回答一个被默认但很少被直接检验的问题：VLM 的“属性幻觉”（物体识别对，但颜色/材质/状态等属性说错）到底是语言先验压过视觉证据，还是视觉表征/读出本身出了问题，或是两者的决策边界设置不当？作者把问题收敛到可控的 yes/no 属性探测，并希望给出可诊断、可对症修复的机制解释。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不强（更偏 VLM 机制分析与推理时干预），但它提供了一个很实用的“把错误归因到视觉信号 vs 语言先验”的可操作分解：用 null-image（空白图）估计语言侧偏置，用真实图估计视觉驱动的 logit 差。结论与常见叙事相反：在作者的设定与数据上，属性假阳性更常由视觉信号导致，而不是语言先验主导。这会影响后续做 VLM 预训练/中训时的诊断思路：与其一味做 prior suppression，不如优先检查视觉 token/视觉编码器到 LM head 的对齐与读出质量，尤其是“材质”这类属性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 VISOR，由诊断 VSNR + 路由式修复三件套组成。
1) 诊断分解：对同一 (image, query) 做两次前向。一次用真实图像 I，得到 yes/no 首 token 的 logit 差 δ_vis = logit(yes|I) - logit(no|I)；一次用 uniform gray 的 null image I_∅，得到 δ_prior = logit(yes|I_∅) - logit(no|I_∅)。作者把 δ_prior 当作“语言先验偏置”的估计，把 δ_vis 当作“视觉驱动的最终决策变量”。在负样本（GT=No）上，δ_vis≥0 即为幻觉。
2) 层级追踪坐标：把最终的 norm+LM head 也作用到中间层 hidden state，定义每层的 δ_vis^(l)，并用 SNR(w,l)=|mean(δ_vis^(l))|/std(δ_vis^(l)) 追踪某个属性词 w 的视觉信号在何处变得低边际或方向错误。
3) 机制分类：作者区分两类视觉失败模式：
- 低边际/阈值可校正（visual signal direction 对，但 margin 不够）：更常见于颜色/状态。
- 方向性失败（在 yes/no logit 空间里视觉信号指向了错误方向）：更常见于材质。
4) 路由式修复（同一框架下按诊断选操作）：
- Calib：当视觉方向正确但 margin 小时，用校准的 prior 项移动决策边界（相当于只在“prior subtraction 有理论可能奏效”的区域使用它）。
- Abstain：当视觉信号低 SNR 时不训练直接拒答/弃权，避免把不稳定信号硬判成 yes。
- Adapt：当出现方向性失败时，用小型、定向的 adapter 修复“视觉投影/读出”，而不是做输出层 prior suppression（作者给出推导说明：若 δ_prior 非正，输出层减 prior 根本无法把 δ_vis>0 翻到负）。
整体上，论文的关键不是提出一个更强的解码技巧，而是把“prior suppression 何时有效、何时无效”用可测量的 δ_vis/δ_prior 条件写清楚，并据此做机制对齐的干预。
summary.experiments: 作者在 3 个 VLM 家族、3 类属性上评估，使用 VAW 上 10,791 个负样本做机制检验。核心结果是：用 δ_vis 预测属性假阳性显著强于 δ_prior；δ_prior 在该任务上接近随机水平，而 δ_vis 的符号几乎直接决定是否幻觉（文中表述为 sign(δ_vis) 与幻觉标签在全部 10,791 样本上匹配）。此外，作者报告材质类（B2 words）存在“prior 估计非正但 δ_vis>0”的区域，解释了为什么对这类错误做对比解码/先验抑制在输出层往往无效。修复侧，VISOR 的 routed 方案（Calib/Abstain/Adapt）在对应失败模式上优于 prior-suppression 基线；论文强调其优势来自机制匹配与避免跨任务/跨属性的负迁移。给出的全文片段未包含完整表格数字（提升幅度、各基线对比、adapter 规模等），需要以原文实验章节与附录为准。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“先诊断、再推导、再修复”的顺序读：
- 先看 VSNR 定义与两次前向的 δ_vis/δ_prior（方法章节开头的 formulation），这是全文的坐标系。
- 精读“Bayesian decomposition and the CD-method failure mode”这一段：它把 prior subtraction 何时可能翻转决策写成不等式条件，并用材质词的 δ_prior≤0 解释失败。
- 看 layer-wise 的 δ_vis^(l) 与 SNR(w,l) 图/表：这里给出“信号在层间何时变坏”的证据链。
- 最后看 routed remediation 的触发条件与三种 operator 的边界：重点不是 operator 本身，而是路由规则如何避免把不适用的修复硬套到所有错误上。
预计泛读 30–45 分钟可抓住主线；若要复现或迁移到别的 VLM/别的属性集，需要细看 null image 选择的验证与适用范围讨论（通常在附录）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a concrete causal question behind attribute hallucination in VLMs (object correct, attribute wrong): are false positives primarily driven by language priors overriding vision, by failures in the visual signal/readout itself, or by a mis-set decision boundary between the two? It reframes the problem into controlled yes/no attribute probing and aims to produce a diagnosis that directly determines the right intervention.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper; it is closer to mechanistic diagnosis plus inference-time/low-cost remediation. Still, it contributes a useful operational decomposition for VLM debugging: estimate a language-only bias via a null image forward pass, and compare it to the real-image decision logit. Their main empirical claim challenges the common “language prior dominance” narrative at the attribute level: on their setup, the visual logit signal is the stronger predictor of attribute false positives, while the prior term is near chance. For pretraining/mid-training work, the implication is practical: many attribute errors may be better addressed by improving visual tokenization/encoding and the vision-to-LM readout alignment, rather than blanket prior-suppression decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VISOR couples a diagnostic module (VSNR) with routed remediation.
- Two-pass decomposition: For each (image I, yes/no query), compute δ_vis = logit(yes|I) − logit(no|I). Then run the same query on a uniform gray null image I_∅ to get δ_prior = logit(yes|I_∅) − logit(no|I_∅), treated as a language-only bias estimate for the attribute word.
- Decision coordinate and layer tracing: Since the first answer token fixes the label under deterministic decoding, δ_vis=0 is the boundary. They also apply the final norm+LM head to intermediate layer states to define δ_vis^(l), and define SNR(w,l)=|E[δ_vis^(l)]|/Std[δ_vis^(l)] to localize where the decision-relevant visual signal becomes low-margin or misaligned.
- Mechanistic taxonomy: (1) threshold-correctable low-margin cases (direction correct, margin insufficient), reported more for color/state; (2) directional failures in the final yes/no logit space, reported more for material.
- Mechanism-aligned remediation (routed operators): Calib shifts the boundary using a calibrated prior term when the visual direction is correct but underweighted; Abstain handles low-SNR cases without training by refusing to answer; Adapt uses a targeted adapter to repair the visual projection/readout when the visual signal is directionally wrong. A key argument is that output-level prior subtraction cannot fix cases where the estimated prior is non-positive yet δ_vis>0 on hallucinations (observed for material words), so the intervention must target the visual pathway instead of suppressing priors.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate across three VLM families and three attribute types, using 10,791 negative-ground-truth samples from VAW for the main causal test. Reported headline findings: sign(δ_vis) matches the hallucination label across all 10,791 negatives; δ_vis is a much stronger predictor of false positives than δ_prior, with δ_prior near chance. They also highlight a material-word regime where δ_prior≤0 while δ_vis>0 on hallucinating samples, explaining systematic failure of contrastive/prior-suppression decoding there. VISOR’s routed remediation (Calib/Abstain/Adapt) outperforms prior-suppression baselines by applying only the operator consistent with the diagnosed failure mode. The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables (per-benchmark gains, adapter size, etc.); those need to be taken from the main experiment section and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it around the δ_vis/δ_prior coordinate:
1) Start with the VSNR formulation (two forward passes) to understand what is being measured.
2) Focus on the “Bayesian decomposition / CD-method failure mode” derivation: it states when prior subtraction can or cannot flip a decision, and motivates why material errors require visual repair.
3) Inspect the layer-wise δ_vis^(l) and SNR(w,l) analyses to see where the visual signal degrades.
4) Finally, study the routing conditions for Calib vs Abstain vs Adapt; the main idea is not the operators themselves but the mechanism-matched routing that avoids misapplied fixes.
Skimming for the main idea takes ~30–45 minutes; reproducing/porting the method requires careful attention to the null-image choice validation and scope limits (often in the appendix).

recommendation.zh: VSNR 分解值得扫，结论会修正把 VLM 属性幻觉全归咎于语言先验的习惯；重点看诊断实验而非修复模块。
recommendation.en: Skim the VSNR decomposition: it weakens the habit of blaming VLM attribute hallucination on language priors; focus on diagnosis, not the fix.

paper.title: Decomposition-Induced Context-Memory Conflict: When Fact-Checking Pipelines Contradict Their Own Source Text
paper.abstract: Decompose-then-verify pipelines, including FActScore-style fact-checkers and long-form factuality evaluators, first split a passage into atomic claims before checking each one. Decomposition itself is treated as a neutral preprocessing step. We show it is not: a decomposer can be induced to substitute its own parametric belief for what the source passage says, producing a claim that contradicts the text it was supposed to summarize faithfully. We call this Decomposition-Induced Context-Memory Co

summary.core_problem: 揭示 decompose-then-verify 事实核查管线中，claim decomposition 本身会把模型参数记忆替换进源文本，生成与原文矛盾的原子 claim。
summary.importance: 这是事实性评估管线的机制分析。它指出 FActScore 类方法中的分解步骤不是中性预处理，而是可能引入 context-memory conflict，从而污染后续 verifier 的判断。
summary.technical_approach: 定义 Decomposition-Induced Context-Memory Conflict（DI-CC），并把它与经典 context-memory conflict 连接起来。作者使用只在 NQ-Swap 经典冲突数据上训练的 linear probe，检测 decomposition 位置是否会产生 DI-CC；还与 SelfCheckGPT-style reference-free baseline 做对照。
summary.experiments: 线性探针从未见过 decomposition 输出，却能显著区分会产生 DI-CC 的位置与 faithful decomposition，AUC 为 0.86-0.88，permutation p < 0.0005。摘要未提供模型规模、分解器类型、样本量或完整 baseline 数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者；未从给定信息中确认机构团队或代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper shows that claim decomposition in decompose-then-verify factuality pipelines can substitute parametric memory for the source text and produce claims that contradict the passage.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-level critique of factuality evaluation pipelines. It argues that the decomposition stage in FActScore-style systems is not neutral preprocessing and can inject context-memory conflict before verification even begins.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines Decomposition-Induced Context-Memory Conflict and links it to classical context-memory conflict. A linear probe trained only on NQ-Swap conflict data is used to identify decomposition positions likely to yield DI-CC, and a SelfCheckGPT-style reference-free baseline is considered for comparison.
summary_en.experiments: A linear probe trained without exposure to decomposition outputs separates DI-CC-producing positions from faithful decompositions with AUC 0.86-0.88 and permutation p < 0.0005. The abstract does not specify model scale, decomposer details, sample size, or full baseline results.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher; no institutional team or prior flagship work is identifiable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 看摘要和 probe 结果即可；它提醒 factuality pipeline 的预处理也会幻觉，别只盯 verifier。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and probe result; the useful warning is that factuality pipelines can hallucinate during preprocessing, not only verification.

paper.title: Attention-Path Fragility as an Uncertainty Signal in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: We propose that a model's uncertainty about a token is reflected not only in the breadth of its output distribution but also in whether a confident prediction is \emph{fragile} under perturbation of its attention pathways. We instantiate this as ASMI (Attention-Subnetwork Mutual Information), a training-free estimator that masks attention heads and measures the BALD mutual information among the resulting subnetworks, with a semantic-agreement kernel to discount surface-form disagreement. The sig

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决的是：LLM 的不确定性是否不仅体现在输出分布熵上，还体现在“高置信预测对注意力路径扰动是否脆弱”这一内部结构信号上。
summary.importance: 它的重要性在于给出一种训练外、结构感知的不确定性估计方法，试图补足 token probability/entropy 对 confident-but-wrong 样本识别不足的问题。贡献类型是机制分析加 inference-time uncertainty estimation，不直接服务 pretrain，但对理解内部路由与可靠性有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ASMI（Attention-Subnetwork Mutual Information）：通过遮蔽不同 attention heads，构造多个 attention 子网络，然后计算这些子网络预测之间的 BALD mutual information，作为 attention-path fragility 信号。为避免只因表面措辞不同而高估分歧，还加入 semantic-agreement kernel。方法是 training-free 的，重点检测“模型看起来很自信，但其内部注意力路径并不稳”的 token。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 grounded QA 上进行。摘要声称在 out-of-fold 测试中，ASMI 在单次置信度和熵之外提供额外的 error-predictive information，尤其集中在 confident-but-fragile 区域；若用它过滤预测，保留样本中的错误率大约减半。作者还指出该信号有 regime dependence：当答案主要经由给定上下文路由时更强，而对参数记忆型回答天然受限。没有看到大规模预训练或跨模型训练动态分析，因此更适合作为可靠性工具而非基座结论。
summary.authors_note: POSCO Holdings Future Technology Research Institute。不是一线基座实验室，工作更偏可靠性分析与推理时不确定性估计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM uncertainty is reflected not only in output entropy, but also in whether a confident prediction is fragile to perturbations of its attention pathways.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in proposing a training-free, structure-aware uncertainty signal that may catch confident-but-wrong cases missed by token probabilities or entropy. The contribution is mechanism-flavored reliability analysis plus inference-time uncertainty estimation, not a direct pretraining result.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce ASMI (Attention-Subnetwork Mutual Information): they mask attention heads to create multiple attention subnetworks, then compute BALD-style mutual information among their predictions as a measure of attention-path fragility. A semantic-agreement kernel is added so that superficial wording differences do not inflate disagreement. The method is training-free and targets cases where the model appears confident but its internal routing is unstable.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are mainly on grounded QA. The abstract claims that, in out-of-fold tests, ASMI adds error-predictive information beyond single-pass confidence and entropy, especially in the confident-but-fragile regime; acting on this signal roughly halves the retained error of a confidence filter. The authors also note a regime dependence: the signal is strong when answers are routed through provided context and bounded when answers are recalled from parametric memory. There is no large-scale pretraining or training-dynamics angle, so this is better read as a reliability tool than a foundation-model result.
summary_en.authors_note: POSCO Holdings Future Technology Research Institute. This is not a frontier foundation-model lab; the work is more about reliability analysis and inference-time uncertainty estimation.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 核心文献，但“高置信且脆弱”这个切分值得记住；只看方法定义和 grounded QA 结果，别把它误读成通用 uncertainty 解法。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining reading, but the ‘confident yet fragile’ split is worth keeping; read the method definition and grounded-QA results, and don’t overgeneralize it as a universal uncertainty estimator.

institutions: POSCO Holdings Future Technology Research Institute

paper.title: The Knowing-Saying Gap: When Probes See Errors that Confidence Misses
paper.abstract: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. The result is a dissociation with direct implications for deployment monitoring. Across multi-hop arithmetic chains, probes that detect corruption turn out to be uninformative about final answer correctness; models forced into structured confidence formats collapse to two values with indistinguishable error rates; and probe persistence across hops fa

summary.core_problem: 研究多跳推理场景下的「知-说鸿沟」现象：LLM内部残差流表征中存在可被线性探针近乎完美检测的上下文损坏信号，但该信号既无法通过模型的 verbal 置信度输出体现，也不能可靠预测最终答案的正确性，同时验证基于探针的部署监控与干预策略的实际效用。
summary.importance: 揭示了LLM内部表征与生成行为之间的稳定信息断层，说明预训练学到的内部状态不一定会外显为输出行为，为可解释性、对齐、推理模型可靠性设计提供了实证边界；同时明确了直接用探针信号做通用错误干预的局限性，给生产环境的可靠性监控方案提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建对比式多跳算术数据集，包含500道基础题衍生的1400条推理轨迹，覆盖5种确定性注入的错误类型（数值加一、运算符错误、单位错误、量级错误、百分比基数错误），错误注入后下游跳数的内容会基于错误值重新生成，保证错误传播的真实性。在Qwen和Llama两个模型族（含指令微调和推理变体）上冻结权重，提取残差流激活训练线性探针检测上下文损坏，对比探针检测结果、模型结构化置信度输出、最终答案正确性三者的关联，同时测试三种探针触发的干预策略（branch-and-pick、reprompt、replace-prior）的效果。另外设置了预注册假设：探针激活在推理跳间的持续性可以预测最终错误，对其进行验证。
summary.experiments: 核心结果包括：1. 线性探针检测上下文损坏的准确率接近完美，但对最终答案是否错误的预测几乎没有信息量；2. 结构化置信度引导的模型输出会坍缩为两类值，两类对应的错误率没有显著差异；3. 探针激活在推理跳间的持续性无法区分正确与错误结果，预注册的「持续性优于峰值」假设被证伪；4. 探针触发的干预效果高度依赖模型与错误类型：只有branch-and-pick策略不会破坏正确轨迹，reprompt和replace-prior在挽救错误轨迹的同时，会以相近比例破坏正确轨迹；5. 基础题分组交叉验证和留一错误类型实验证明，探针检测信号不是数据泄露或错误类型表面特征导致的伪相关。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节数据集构建（理解控制变量设计与错误注入逻辑）、第5节核心实验结果（检测与错误预测的解离现象、干预策略对比），附录K的预注册假设证伪部分可快速浏览。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates the "knowing-saying gap" in multi-hop reasoning: linear probes can detect corrupted context in LLM residual stream representations with near-perfect accuracy, but this signal neither appears in the model's verbalized confidence outputs nor reliably predicts final answer correctness. The work also evaluates the practical utility of probe-based monitoring and intervention policies for deployment.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates a stable information dissociation between LLM internal representations and generated behavior, showing that internally encoded states learned during pre-training do not necessarily manifest in output actions. This provides empirical boundaries for work on interpretability, alignment, and reasoning model reliability, and clarifies the limits of using probe signals for general-purpose error intervention in production systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a contrastive multi-hop arithmetic dataset with 1,400 traces derived from 500 base problems, covering 5 deterministic error injection types (off-by-one, wrong operator, wrong unit, magnitude error, wrong percentage base). Downstream hops are re-generated from the corrupted value to ensure realistic error propagation. Linear probes are trained on residual stream activations from frozen Qwen and Llama family models (including instruction-tuned and reasoning variants) to detect context corruption. The work compares probe detection performance, elicited structured confidence, and final answer correctness, and evaluates three probe-triggered intervention policies: branch-and-pick, reprompt, and replace-prior. A pre-registered hypothesis that probe activation persistence across hops predicts final failure is explicitly tested.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings: (1) Linear probes detect context corruption near-perfectly but are nearly uninformative about final answer correctness. (2) Structured confidence elicitation collapses to a binary signal with indistinguishable error rates between the two levels. (3) Probe activation persistence across reasoning hops does not separate correct from incorrect outcomes, refuting the pre-registered "persistence beats peak" hypothesis. (4) Intervention effectiveness varies sharply by model and error type: only branch-and-pick is strictly non-breaking for correct traces, while reprompt and replace-prior rescue wrong traces and break correct ones at comparable rates. (5) Base-problem-grouped cross-validation and leave-one-error-type-out controls confirm the probe signal is not an artifact of fold leakage or surface per-type features.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 3 (dataset construction and controlled experimental design) and Section 5 (core results on detection-prediction dissociation and intervention evaluation). Appendix K (pre-registered hypothesis refutation) can be browsed quickly. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验设计和失败案例；它提醒 probe 可分性不是 verifier 信号，别把表征诊断直接塞进推理时控制。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the setup and negative results; linear separability is not a verifier signal, so do not wire probes directly into inference control.

paper.title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing
paper.abstract: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters becau

summary.core_problem: 独立复现并跨模型、跨领域压力测试两类提升 LLM 推理可靠性的方法：测试时概率聚合和逻辑表征编辑。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是复现与机制压力测试。它关注推理可靠性论文常见的弱点：原作者自评、域内验证、代码不公开、表示干预缺少直接 probe。对判断推理增强方法是否可迁移有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: 复现 RPC 的 published-path aggregation，即结合 token probability aggregation 与 self-consistency；重新实现 LCF 的 projector、contrastive training 和 intervention pipeline，将隐藏状态拆成 content 与 logic 并把 logic 部分编辑到有效区域。随后扩展到 text-to-SQL、法律抽取、谬误识别和判例评分，并直接 probe LCF 的表示。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 RPC 在四个新任务域上使用 Qwen3-8B，LCF 在四个 7-8B 模型上测试。摘要说明 RPC 在作者发布设置上可精确复现；后续跨域、跨模型结论因摘要截断需要看正文表格确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper independently reproduces and stress-tests two approaches for improving LLM reasoning reliability: test-time probability aggregation and logic-representation editing.
summary_en.importance: This is a reproduction and mechanism-analysis contribution. It targets a common weakness in reasoning-reliability work: author-only evaluation, in-domain testing, missing code, and insufficient probing of claimed representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors rerun RPC’s published-path aggregation, combining token probability aggregation and self-consistency. They reimplement LCF’s projector, contrastive objective, and intervention pipeline, which separates hidden states into content and logic components and edits the logic component toward a valid region. They then test transfer to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe the LCF representation directly.
summary_en.experiments: RPC is tested across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B. LCF is tested across four 7-8B models. The abstract states that RPC exactly reproduces the original grid on the authors’ released setup; the cross-domain and cross-model outcomes need the full paper because the abstract is truncated.

recommendation.zh: 只看复现表和表示 probe；这类论文的价值在拆穿“域内可靠性”，不是再发明一个推理技巧。
recommendation.en: Read the reproduction tables and representation probes; the value is in testing in-domain reliability claims, not in adding another reasoning trick.

paper.title: Diffusion LLMs as Targets and Adversaries: Mechanistic Safety Exploits
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) replace autoregressive next-token prediction with iterative parallel denoising, yet their internal safety mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate DLLMs both as targets and as adversaries, exposing mechanistic vulnerabilities in diffusion-based alignment. We first show that safety alignment in DLLMs remains sparse and transferable across architectures. DLLMs initialized from autoregressive predecessors inherit the same mechanistic

summary.core_problem: 刻画扩散大语言模型（DLLM）的安全对齐机制的结构特性与脆弱性，同时探索利用DLLM双向建模能力构造跨架构通用越狱攻击的方法。
summary.importance: 验证了当前主流DLLM（包括原生训练和AR权重初始化的DLLM）的安全对齐机制和AR模型一致，由稀疏的、可定位的安全神经元集合承载；从AR模型初始化的DLLM会直接继承源模型的安全神经元足迹，不会因扩散训练目标产生本质变化。这一观察对非AR语言模型的预训练对齐设计、安全评估有直接参考，说明生成范式的切换不会自动消除AR模型已有的对齐脆弱性。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过激活轮廓分析加逻辑回归，定位原生DLLM（如LLaDA）和AR初始化DLLM（如Dream、Fast-dLLM）中负责拒答行为的稀疏安全神经元，测量AR源模型和DLLM之间的神经元重叠度；随后基于定位到的神经元激活值和回归系数构造加权安全神经元损失（SN loss），作为区分安全/不安全激活区域的连续优化信号；最后利用DLLM双向并行去噪的特性实现离线推理时对抗优化：先通过生成剪枝级联（用剪枝强度逐步放松的代理DLLM迭代提纯恶意prompt，过滤语义漂移和退化），再用SN loss引导去噪轨迹避开安全触发区域，无需在线查询目标模型或RL训练。
summary.experiments: 直接剪枝LLaDA自身定位到的安全神经元，可将攻击成功率从2.6%提升至73.8%；从Qwen2.5迁移安全神经元到Dream模型做跨架构剪枝，攻击成功率从1.9%提升至73.2%，Dream自剪枝攻击成功率可达86.6%，所有剪枝操作对通用能力的损伤极小。SN loss对良性prompt和越狱prompt的区分AUROC达到1.0。提出的SN引导扩散攻击每个prompt仅需20次离线扩散采样，即可在Qwen、LLaMA、DeepSeek等开源模型，以及Gemini、Claude、GPT系列闭源模型上实现高迁移攻击成功率，计算成本远低于现有需要上千次查询的越狱基线方法。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注安全神经元跨架构迁移的实验结论，以及为什么DLLM的双向建模特性天然适合低成本离线对抗优化；跳过底层攻击实现的工程细节即可，核心关注非AR范式下安全对齐机制的结构特性，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Characterizes structural properties and vulnerabilities of safety alignment in diffusion large language models (DLLMs), and develops a transferable jailbreak framework leveraging DLLMs' bidirectional generation capabilities.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that safety alignment in mainstream DLLMs—both natively trained and those initialized from autoregressive (AR) checkpoints—relies on sparse, localizable safety neurons, consistent with findings in AR models. DLLMs initialized from AR predecessors directly inherit the mechanistic safety footprint of their source models, with no fundamental restructuring of safety representations from diffusion training. This finding has direct implications for alignment design and safety evaluation of non-AR language models, showing that a shift away from next-token prediction does not automatically eliminate known alignment failure modes from AR systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: First identifies sparse safety neurons driving refusal behavior in both native DLLMs (e.g., LLaDA) and AR-initialized DLLMs (e.g., Dream, Fast-dLLM) via activation profiling and logistic regression, and measures neuron overlap between AR source models and their diffusion derivatives. A weighted Safety Neuron (SN) loss is constructed from identified neuron activations and corresponding regression coefficients, serving as a continuous signal to distinguish safe and unsafe activation regions. The bidirectional denoising process of DLLMs is then used to run fully offline inference-time adversarial optimization: a Generative Pruning Cascade uses surrogate DLLMs with progressively relaxed neuron pruning to iteratively refine malicious prompts and filter semantic drift or degeneration, before SN-guidance steers denoising trajectories away from safety-triggering regions, requiring no iterative black-box queries to target models or RL fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Self-pruning of identified safety neurons raises attack success rate (ASR) from 2.6% to 73.8% on LLaDA. Cross-architecture transfer pruning of safety neurons mapped from Qwen2.5 raises ASR from 1.9% to 73.2% on Dream, while Dream self-pruning reaches 86.6% ASR, with all pruning operations causing minimal degradation to general model utility. The proposed SN loss achieves AUROC = 1.0 for distinguishing benign and jailbreak prompts. The full SN-guided diffusion attack requires only 20 offline diffusion episodes per prompt, and achieves high transfer ASR across both open-weight (Qwen, LLaMA, DeepSeek) and proprietary (Gemini, Claude, GPT-family) targets at a fraction of the compute cost of existing query-heavy jailbreak baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core observations about safety representation structure across generative paradigms; focus on the cross-architecture safety neuron transfer results and the argument for why DLLMs' bidirectional modeling enables lower-cost offline adversarial optimization. Low-level attack engineering details can be skipped unless working directly on LLM safety; estimated reading time 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM安全机制的重要发现，AR初始化会继承安全神经元的结论直接影响DLLM的预训练初始化策略，重点看§3的机制分析和Table 2
recommendation.en: Important finding on diffusion LM safety mechanisms, the conclusion that AR initialization inherits safety neurons directly affects DLLM pretraining initialization strategies, focus on §3 mechanistic analysis and Table 2

paper.title: Faster Query-Key Learning Sharpens Attention in Self-Attention Models
paper.abstract: A standard self-attention layer consists of two interacting circuits: the query-key circuit that governs attention allocation, and the output-value circuit that maps attended representations to predictions. Collapsed and factorized parameterizations of the query-key and output-value circuits lead to qualitatively different attention patterns. In particular, some parameterizations give sharper attention to task-relevant tokens, at a similar training loss. We analyze how the parameterizations of t

summary.core_problem: 在相同预测性能下，自注意力模型会出现差异极大的注意力模式；现有理论只解释了 Transformer 的表达能力，没有说明架构参数化方式与梯度优化如何共同塑造注意力结构，特别是 query-key 电路和 output-value 电路的相对学习速度如何影响注意力锐度。
summary.importance: 给出了注意力模式形成的机制性解释：不是表达能力差异，而是参数化和优化速度差异决定了注意力是否集中在任务相关 token 上。对预训练实践的直接启发是：可以通过调整 Q/K 与 O/V 的参数化形式或相对学习率，在不损失训练损失的前提下得到更可解释、更锐利的注意力，而不需要改动模型结构或数据。
summary.technical_approach: 将单层自注意力拆分为两个线性电路：query-key 电路（W_K W_Q^T，决定注意力分布）和 output-value 电路（W_O W_V，将注意力后的表示映射为预测 logits）。对比四种参数化：FAFO（两路都分解）、CAFO（注意力合并、输出分解）、FACO（注意力分解、输出合并）、CACO（两路都合并）。通过梯度流分析证明：分解式参数化会在对应的合并参数空间中引入状态依赖的梯度重缩放，使得分解模型和合并模型即使损失相近，优化轨迹也不同。在正交性与对称性假设下推导出闭式群体梯度流动力学：output-value 标量按 log(t) 增长，query-key 标量按 log^2(t) 增长，增长常数由两路学习率比值 η_QK / η_OV 控制。由于 query-key 电路通过饱和非线性（softmax）作用于注意力，这种增长速度差异直接解释了相对学习速度如何驱动注意力在训练过程中逐渐锐化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖合成数据和三个带 token 级相关性标注的真实数据集：HateXplain、主谓一致数据集、SQuAD。核心观察：1）提升 query-key 电路相对学习速度，或使用分解式 Q/K 参数化，都会让注意力更集中在任务相关 token 上；2）上述改动对预测损失和下游任务指标几乎没有影响；3）合成数据上的参数演化轨迹与闭式动力学推导高度吻合，验证了 log(t) 与 log^2(t) 的增长规律。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 40-60 分钟。重点看：1）Introduction 中对两个电路的拆分和问题定义；2）第 3 节参数化对比与梯度流推导的核心结论（不必深究全部数学细节）；3）第 5 节真实数据实验的注意力可视化与定量指标。值得深挖的点：把该结论推广到多层、多头、大模型预训练的可行性；是否可以通过分组学习率调度直接控制注意力锐度，进而改善长上下文或可解释性。

summary_en.core_problem: Self-attention models with nearly identical predictive performance can develop drastically different attention patterns. Existing theory focuses on Transformer expressivity but does not explain how architectural parameterization and gradient-based optimization jointly shape attention structure — in particular, how the relative learning speed of the query-key circuit and the output-value circuit affects attention sharpness.
summary_en.importance: Provides a mechanistic account of attention pattern formation: differences in attention sharpness come from parameterization and optimization speed, not from differences in expressivity. A direct practical implication for pretraining is that one can obtain sharper, more interpretable attention on task-relevant tokens without changing model architecture or data, simply by adjusting the parameterization or relative learning rates of the Q/K and O/V paths.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes a single-layer self-attention model into two linear circuits: the query-key circuit (W_K W_Q^T, which controls the attention distribution) and the output-value circuit (W_O W_V, which maps attended representations to prediction logits). Four parameterizations are compared: FAFO (both circuits factorized), CAFO (collapsed attention, factorized output), FACO (factorized attention, collapsed output), CACO (both collapsed). Gradient-flow analysis shows that factorized parameterizations induce a state-dependent rescaling of gradient updates in the corresponding collapsed parameter space, so factorized and collapsed models follow different optimization trajectories even when they reach similar losses. Under orthogonality and symmetry assumptions, closed-form population gradient-flow dynamics are derived: the output-value scalar grows as log(t), while the query-key scalar grows as log^2(t), with constants controlled by the learning-rate ratio η_QK / η_OV. Because the query-key circuit acts on attention through a saturating nonlinearity (softmax), this difference in growth rate directly explains how relative optimization speed drives attention sharpening during training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover synthetic data and three real-world datasets with token-level relevance annotations: HateXplain, subject-verb agreement, and SQuAD. Key observations: (1) increasing the relative learning speed of the query-key circuit, or using a factorized Q/K parameterization, both concentrate attention more strongly on task-relevant tokens; (2) these changes barely affect training loss or downstream task metrics; (3) parameter evolution trajectories on synthetic data match the closed-form dynamics closely, validating the log(t) and log^2(t) scaling laws.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, estimated 40–60 minutes. Focus on: (1) the two-circuit decomposition and problem framing in the Introduction; (2) the core conclusions of the parameterization comparison and gradient-flow derivation in Section 3 (full mathematical detail is optional); (3) attention visualizations and quantitative metrics on real datasets in Section 5. Open directions worth pursuing: whether the findings generalize to multi-layer, multi-head, large-scale pretraining; whether grouped learning-rate scheduling can directly control attention sharpness to improve long-context behavior or interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 把 QK/OV 学习率比与注意力锐度用闭式动态连起来，是少有的干净机制分析；玩具 setup，结论需在大模型上验证，看 §3 推导即可。
recommendation.en: Cleanly links QK/OV LR ratio to attention sharpness via closed-form dynamics; toy setup—read §3 for the derivation, verify at scale yourself.

paper.title: Explicit, Not Longer: What Makes Epistemic Stance Survive Memory Compression
paper.abstract: Agent memory systems compress what they store, and compression is built to drop qualifiers, so a claim's epistemic standing tends not to survive being written to memory. We ask what governs whether it does. Matched notes carry the identical claim and identical stance and differ only in where that stance sits; one model compresses both under the same budget among the same filler notes, and a blind reader that never sees the condition scores the result. Across 60 claims in seven registers, writing

summary.core_problem: 研究 agent memory compression 在压缩笔记时为什么会丢失 claim 的 epistemic stance，以及什么格式能让不确定性标记保留下来。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是小规模但设计较干净的机制实验。它不直接推进预训练，但对长期记忆、摘要压缩、RAG 记忆写入和不确定性传播有实用警示：模型可能保留事实主张，却丢掉“是否确定、是否传闻、是否推测”的限定。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造 matched notes：claim 和 stance 相同，只改变 stance 的位置或格式。一个模型在相同 filler notes 和相同预算下压缩这些 notes，盲读者模型在看不到条件标签的情况下评分压缩结果是否保留 stance。主要比较 labelled field、bracketed aside、长度、完整句式等因素。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 60 个 claims、7 种 register，并在两个模型上测试。把 stance 写成 labelled field 相比 bracketed aside 约提升 15 个百分点；一个模型上为 37 claims 对 2，另一个为 30 对 8，permutation p=0.00005。预注册的 Haiku 复现实验给出 +15.6 points，38 claims 对 1。消融显示 label 本身带来提升（+9.7 和 +12.8），长度没有帮助。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why epistemic stance is lost during agent memory compression and which note formats make uncertainty markers survive compression.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a small but clean mechanistic experiment. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is useful for long-term memory, summarization, RAG memory writing, and uncertainty propagation: models may preserve claims while dropping whether they were certain, hearsay, or speculative.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper constructs matched notes where the claim and stance are identical but the placement or format of the stance differs. A model compresses both under the same budget and filler-note context, and a blind reader model scores whether the compressed result preserved the stance. The study compares labelled fields, bracketed asides, length, and full-sentence wording.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 60 claims in seven registers and two models. Writing stance as a labelled field rather than a bracketed aside improves retention by about 15 points: 37 claims versus 2 on one model, 30 versus 8 on another, with permutation p=0.00005. A pre-registered replication on Haiku gives +15.6 points, 38 claims versus 1. Ablations show labels help on both models (+9.7 and +12.8), while length does not help.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和消融即可；小实验但 setup 干净，能提醒记忆写入别把 stance 当普通修饰语。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and ablations only; it is small but clean, and it warns against treating epistemic stance as ordinary modifier text in memory writes.

paper.title: Depth-Wise Probing and Pruning of the Planning Token in a Driving Vision-Language-Action Model
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models route driving decisions through a deep language model, but it is unclear how much of that depth the action itself requires. We study a representative driving VLA whose entire plan is carried by a single planning token that a generative planner decodes into a trajectory. Borrowing the planner as a trajectory-space logit lens, we decode the planning token from every one of the 32 decoder layers and measure two signals: the linear decodability of the navigation c

summary.core_problem: 分析驾驶 VLA 中单个 planning token 在 32 层语言解码器各深度上何时编码语义意图、何时变得可被轨迹规划器使用。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析而非新模型。它提供了一个关于 VLA 深度使用的细粒度观察：高层导航语义很早可线性读出，但与冻结轨迹 planner 的接口兼容性仍随深度逐步改善。这对理解 action token、logit lens 和模型剪枝有弱启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者借用原生 generative planner 作为 trajectory-space logit lens，从 32 个 decoder layer 的每一层解码 planning token。测量两个信号：导航命令的线性可解码性，以及该层 planning token 经冻结 native planner 解码出的轨迹与目标轨迹的兼容性。还训练 learned readout 检查早层表示是否已经包含可恢复的规划信息。
summary.experiments: 研究对象是一个代表性 driving VLA，整个计划由单个 planning token 承载，并由生成式 planner 解码成轨迹。命令 probe 在第 1 个 decoder layer 后达到 97.7% accuracy，而随机水平为 16.7%；open-loop Avg-L2 随深度改善，最终层达到最低 2.11 m。learned readout 可从第 1 层恢复相当一部分轨迹差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper probes a driving VLA to determine at which decoder depths a single planning token encodes semantic intent and when it becomes compatible with the trajectory planner.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism study rather than a new model. It gives a fine-grained observation about depth usage in VLA models: high-level navigation intent is linearly decodable very early, while compatibility with the frozen trajectory planner improves gradually through depth. This is mildly useful for thinking about action tokens, logit-lens-style probes, and pruning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use the native generative planner as a trajectory-space logit lens and decode the planning token from each of 32 decoder layers. They measure command linear decodability and trajectory compatibility with the frozen planner. Learned readouts are also trained to test whether early-layer representations already contain recoverable planning information.
summary_en.experiments: The studied driving VLA carries the whole plan in one planning token, decoded by a generative planner. Command-probe accuracy reaches 97.7% after the first decoder layer versus 16.7% chance. Open-loop Avg-L2 improves across depth and reaches its minimum, 2.11 m, at the final layer. Learned readouts from the first layer recover much of the remaining gap.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 数字和 probing 设计即可；它提醒别把“早层不可用”和“planner 接口没对齐”混为一谈。
recommendation.en: Read the probing setup and headline numbers; it usefully separates early representational availability from planner-interface compatibility.

paper.title: Mean-Field Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) with chain-of-thought reasoning have been widely applied in recent years, and theoretical explanations of their behavior may help deepen our understanding and guide model optimization. In this study, we introduce a framework that seeks statistical regularities and theoretical interpretations in LLM reasoning without simplifying the model architecture or making analogies to existing physical systems. We formulate LLM reasoning as a guided discovery process on a clue g

summary.core_problem: 尝试用统计动力学描述 LLM 的 chain-of-thought 推理过程，解释推理链中线索如何逐步被发现。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和理论建模；它不直接改进预训练 recipe，但试图给 CoT 推理的宏观统计规律提供可拟合模型，对理解后训练推理行为有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 LLM 推理表述为 clue graph 上的 guided discovery process，用 mean-field approximation 推导“已发现线索比例”的一维常微分方程；实验上用 student LLM 对 teacher LLM 输出的 normalized surprisal 来识别 clue tokens，再对大量 CoT 轨迹做统计平均。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在同一数据集内观察到可复现的统计规律，并可由推导出的 ODE 拟合；未从摘要确认模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 或拟合误差等关键实验细节。
summary.authors_note: Tsinghua University；未见可确认的知名作者背景信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to model chain-of-thought reasoning in LLMs as a statistical dynamic process in which reasoning clues are gradually discovered.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic and theoretical analysis rather than a pretraining method. Its value is indirect: it may offer a compact macro-level description of reasoning trajectories after instruction tuning or prompting.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formulates reasoning as guided discovery on a clue graph and derives a one-dimensional ODE for the fraction of discovered clues using a mean-field approximation. Empirically, clue tokens are identified through the normalized surprisal of a student LLM on teacher-generated reasoning traces, then regularities are estimated by averaging many CoT chains.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports reproducible statistical regularities within the same dataset and ODE fits to those regularities, but does not provide enough metadata to verify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or fitting errors.
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University; no clearly identifiable widely known author background from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 结论先当弱信号；如果读，只看 clue token 定义和 ODE 拟合残差，别被 mean-field 形式本身带跑。
recommendation.en: Treat the conclusion as a weak signal; if reading, focus on the clue-token definition and ODE residuals rather than the mean-field framing itself.

paper.title: Human-Like Anaphor Resolution in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Anaphors are expressions that refer to other expressions, called antecedents. The process of connecting the two is called resolution. Cognitive science has identified multiple factors that affect the speed and success of anaphor resolution, including discourse structure, situation-model properties, and semantic factors. Here, we investigate whether these factors also affect anaphor resolution in five Large Language Models (LLMs) with open weights: GPT-2-XL, Llama-3.1-8B, Pythia-12B, Mistral-7B,

summary.core_problem: 检验开源 LLM 在指代消解上是否表现出与人类相似的认知敏感性，以及这种相似性具体体现在哪些因素上。
summary.importance: 这是机制与认知对齐分析工作。价值在于用 surprisal 和理解准确率把语言模型行为与人类阅读研究接起来，但它不直接推进预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于认知科学中的 anaphor resolution 因素，考察 discourse prominence、距离、情境模型和语义因素对模型 surprisal 与问答准确率的影响；使用 anaphor 位置 surprisal 作为处理难度代理，并与人类行为数据对比。
summary.experiments: 评测对象包括 GPT-2-XL、Llama-3.1-8B、Pythia-12B、Mistral-7B、Mistral-24B。结果显示模型只在部分因素上与人类一致，对 discourse prominence 和距离因素较敏感，但对其他语义或情境因素较弱或缺失。属于分析性实验，不是方法论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Georgia Institute of Technology，偏认知科学与 NLP 交叉。

summary_en.core_problem: It tests whether open-weight LLMs show human-like cognitive sensitivity in anaphor resolution, and if so, along which factors.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and cognitive-alignment analysis paper. Its value is in linking LM behavior to human reading research via surprisal and comprehension accuracy, but it does not directly advance pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using factors from cognitive science on anaphor resolution, the paper studies how discourse prominence, distance, situation-model properties, and semantic factors affect model surprisal and question-answering accuracy. Surprisal at the anaphor is used as a proxy for processing difficulty and compared against human behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates GPT-2-XL, Llama-3.1-8B, Pythia-12B, Mistral-7B, and Mistral-24B. Results show selective cognitive alignment: models are somewhat human-like on discourse prominence and distance effects, but weaker or absent on other semantic or situation-model factors. This is an analysis paper rather than a method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Georgia Tech, at the intersection of cognitive science and NLP.

recommendation.zh: 不直接服务 pretrain，但如果你在意 surprisal 是否真能当认知代理，这篇的任务设计比常见 probing 干净一些。
recommendation.en: Not directly useful for pretraining, but if you care whether surprisal is a meaningful cognitive proxy, this setup is cleaner than most probing papers.

paper.title: Not All Redundant Tokens Are Alike: Analyzing Visual Token Pruning through Token Roles
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) process an image as a sequence of visual tokens, which creates a substantial computational bottleneck during inference. Recent visual token pruning methods address this issue by removing seemingly redundant tokens, yet it remains unclear how these pruning decisions relate to the functional roles of visual tokens. In this work, we analyze visual token pruning through the lens of token roles identified by EmbedLens. We first show that representative pruning methods ex

summary.core_problem: 分析 VLM 中视觉 token 剪枝决策与 token 功能角色之间的关系，解释为何看似冗余的 token 被剪去后会影响性能。
summary.importance: 属于视觉 token 剪枝的机制分析工作；主要贡献是用 EmbedLens 定义的 token role 审视现有剪枝方法的偏差，并发现弱语义 token 不一定可安全删除。
summary.technical_approach: 先用 EmbedLens 识别视觉 token 角色，比较多种代表性剪枝方法的角色偏好；再改进 token-role 分配流程，设计 role-protected pruning 变体，观察保留不同角色 token 对下游性能的影响。
summary.experiments: 在多种视觉 token 剪枝方法上做角色偏差分析和受控剪枝实验；结果显示保留 non-alive tokens 有时能维持或提升性能。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Analyze how visual token pruning decisions in VLMs relate to the functional roles of visual tokens, and why pruning seemingly redundant tokens can hurt behavior.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis of visual token pruning; its main contribution is using EmbedLens-derived token roles to reveal biases in existing pruners and show that weakly semantic tokens are not always safe to remove.
summary_en.technical_approach: It identifies token roles with EmbedLens, compares role biases across representative pruning methods, refines the role-assignment procedure, and evaluates role-protected pruning variants that preserve specific token groups.
summary_en.experiments: It analyzes role biases and runs controlled pruning experiments across several pruning methods; preserving non-alive tokens sometimes maintains or improves performance. The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 视觉 token 剪枝的小分析，结论对 VLM 推理优化有边际参考；只看 role-protected pruning 的对照实验即可。
recommendation.en: A small analysis of visual token pruning; marginally useful for VLM inference work. Read only the role-protected pruning comparisons.

paper.title: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Reasoning Models: Robustness over Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong performance on Theory of Mind (ToM) tests, prompting debate about the nature and validity of the underlying capabilities. At the same time, reasoning-oriented LLMs trained via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards have demonstrated notable improvements across a range of benchmarks. In this work, we examine the behavior of such reasoning models in ToM tasks using novel adaptations of machine psychological experiments together with r

summary.core_problem: 检验推理型 LLM 在 Theory of Mind 任务上的提升，究竟来自新的 ToM 能力，还是仅仅来自对 prompt 与任务扰动更稳健。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制解释与评测分析工作。它的价值不在于提出新训练法，而在于给近期“reasoning model 是否学会更深层认知能力”这类讨论降温：至少在 ToM 上，提升可能更多是 robustness，而不是能力范式变化。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把机器心理学实验改写为适合 LLM 的 ToM 测试，并结合已有 benchmark，对 reasoning-oriented、经 RL with verifiable rewards 训练的模型进行 prompt variation 和 task perturbation 下的稳健性分析。核心不是看单点准确率，而是看答案在扰动下是否保持正确。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 reasoning models 在 ToM 任务上表现出更高的鲁棒性，并且这种增益至少部分来自更稳定地到达正确答案，而非出现新的 ToM-specific ability。未在摘要中给出具体模型名单、参数量和数值幅度，因此更适合作为 interpretive evidence，而不是强结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Leiden University 的 LIACS 团队；未见顶级工业实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether gains of reasoning-oriented LLMs on Theory of Mind tasks reflect a new ToM capability or simply greater robustness to prompt and task perturbations.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and evaluation paper. Its value is not in proposing a new training recipe, but in tempering claims that reasoning models have acquired qualitatively new cognitive abilities: at least for ToM, the gains may be better explained by robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt machine-psychology experiments into LLM-friendly ToM tests and combine them with established benchmarks. They evaluate reasoning models trained with reinforcement learning and verifiable rewards under prompt variations and task perturbations, focusing on stability of correct answers rather than single-shot accuracy alone.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, reasoning models consistently show improved robustness on ToM tasks, and the gains appear to come at least partly from being more reliable at reaching the correct answer under variation, rather than from a new ToM-specific ability. The abstract does not provide model names, scales, or detailed effect sizes, so this should be read as interpretive evidence rather than a definitive claim.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from LIACS at Leiden University; no major frontier-industry lab affiliation is indicated.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 RL 后 reasoning 对 pretrain 能力边界的反哺，这篇可作弱证据：别急着把 benchmark 提升解释成新能力，先看 robustness；正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Useful as weak evidence when thinking about how RL-style reasoning feeds back into base-model capability: do not over-interpret benchmark gains as new abilities before checking robustness; not worth a deep read.
