paper.title: In-Context Collapse in Vision-Language Models and How to Mitigate it?
paper.abstract: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) lets vision-language models (VLMs) adapt from image--label demonstrations without weight updates, and is widely assumed to improve as more demonstrations are supplied. We show the opposite: as demonstrations accumulate, a subset of VLMs undergo an \emph{in-context collapse}, a sharp, sometimes catastrophic accuracy drop spanning synthetic classification, natural-image classification, and VQA benchmarks, in some models falling below chance while outputs remain

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型在多示例上下文学习时，示例数量增加并不会带来性能单调提升，反而会出现准确率骤降甚至低于随机猜测的上下文崩溃现象，现有研究未定位其底层机制，也未提出通用修复方案。
summary.importance: 揭示了VLM多模态ICL的一个关键失效模式，通过因果实验将问题锁定在视觉-语言连接通路而非语言模型深层，给出的轻量化、可迁移修复方案对多模态预训练阶段的视觉-语言连接器设计、训练目标设计有明确启发，解释了长期以来VLM长上下文多示例适配效果远差于纯文本LLM的原因。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过无预训练污染的合成概念任务（答案无法从预训练记忆中检索，必须从上下文学习），将VLM的ICL能力拆分为两个可分离的维度：对示例数量增加的鲁棒性、从上下文中学习新规则的能力。之后通过参数匹配的损伤-救援实验，因果定位崩溃来源为视觉-语言集成通路（连接器和语言模型早中层），而非后期读出层。最后提出CircA方法，仅需在一个合成任务上一次性训练一个小型适配模块，即可将崩溃抗性迁移到未见的任务族，无需针对下游任务微调。
summary.experiments: 在0.5B到11B参数规模的多个开源VLM（覆盖不同连接器设计）以及闭源前沿模型Claude Sonnet上均观测到上下文崩溃现象：例如Qwen2-VL-2B在CIFAR四分类任务上0样本准确率为94%，64个示例时准确率降至38%；LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B在相同设置下准确率降至低于25%的随机猜测水平。提出的CircA适配模块可以消除崩溃现象，同时恢复模型从上下文学习新规则的能力，效果可跨任务族迁移。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注上下文崩溃的现象刻画、因果定位的损伤-救援实验逻辑，无需细读修复方法的实现细节。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Unlike text LLMs where in-context learning (ICL) performance generally improves with more demonstrations, vision-language models often suffer sharp, sometimes catastrophic accuracy drops as in-context examples accumulate, even falling below random chance. Prior work has not localized the underlying mechanism or proposed a general mitigation for this phenomenon, termed in-context collapse.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a critical failure mode of multimodal ICL in VLMs, and causally localizes the issue to the vision-language integration pathway rather than deep language model layers. The proposed lightweight, transferable mitigation provides clear insights for VLM pretraining, particularly for vision-language connector design and training objective design, and explains the persistent performance gap between VLMs and pure text LLMs on many-shot in-context adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the authors decompose VLM ICL capability into two separable axes using contamination-free synthetic concept tasks (where answers cannot be retrieved from pretraining memory and must be learned from context): robustness to increasing demonstration count, and ability to learn novel rules from in-context examples. Second, parameter-matched lesion-and-rescue experiments causally locate in-context collapse to the vision-language integration pathway (the connector and early/mid layers of the language model), rather than late readout layers. Third, they propose CircA, a method that trains a small adapter once on a single synthetic task that transfers collapse resistance to unseen task families without downstream fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: In-context collapse is observed across open VLMs ranging from 0.5B to 11B parameters with varying connector designs, as well as the frontier closed model Claude Sonnet. For example, Qwen2-VL-2B achieves 94% accuracy on 4-way CIFAR classification with zero demonstrations, but accuracy drops to 38% at 64 shots; LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B drops below the 25% random chance baseline under the same setting. The CircA adapter eliminates collapse and restores in-context novel rule learning, with benefits transferring across unseen task families.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the behavioral characterization of in-context collapse and the causal lesion-and-rescue experimental design for failure localization. There is no need to dive into implementation details of the mitigation. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看崩溃曲线和 lesion-rescue 实验；它提醒 connector 不是小头，many-shot VLM ICL 不能按文本 ICL 直觉外推。
recommendation.en: Read the collapse curves and lesion-rescue setup; it is a useful warning that VLM connectors are not a minor detail and text-ICL priors do not transfer cleanly.

paper.title: Your Agentic LLMs Secretly Encode Latent Signals of Indirect Prompt-Injection Exposure
paper.abstract: Agentic LLMs are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, e.g., malicious side-tasks hidden in external tool results. While many efforts have sought to address the threats, little is known about the internals of agentic LLMs when they are exposed to IPI attacks, a condition which we call IPI exposure. In this paper, we study this problem in depth from three aspects. (1) Probing: Across six models, including the giant 753B-parameter GLM-5.2, simple linear probes trained on pre-gener

summary.core_problem: Agentic LLM 会把外部工具结果、网页内容或用户文档放入上下文，间接提示注入可能隐藏在这些非可信输入中。该工作研究一个内部机制问题：模型在暴露于间接提示注入时，隐藏状态里是否已经编码了“我看到了可疑注入内容”的信号；如果有，为什么仍会执行攻击指令，以及如何把这个信号转化为更可靠的防御动作。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 agent safety 与模型可观测性工作，不是预训练方法论文。对基座和 post-train 研究仍有启发：隐藏状态中存在可线性读出的风险暴露信号，说明模型在生成前已经部分识别了攻击环境，但识别并不自动带来安全行为。这个 recognition–action gap 对 RLHF、RLAIF、工具使用训练和 agent 数据构造都有参考意义。它提示训练信号不能只奖励最终任务成功，也要约束中间决策如何处理非可信上下文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是 probing：在 assistant 生成前的 hidden states 上训练简单线性探针，用来预测当前上下文是否包含 IPI exposure。探针不依赖生成结果，因此能在动作发生前给出风险分数。第二层是机制诊断：通过 CoT measurement 分析模型是否在推理中识别到注入风险，以及这种识别是否转化为安全动作。结果显示模型常能表现出某种识别，但后续仍可能执行攻击目标。第三层是防御方法 AGRI，即 Action-Guiding Reasoning Intervention。它在 prefilling 阶段用探针计算 IPI 风险分数；若超过阈值 t，则主动 prepend 一段短的 anti-injection reasoning prefill，引导模型把外部内容视为不可信并坚持原始 agent 任务。为处理多轮工具链中的滞后影响，触发后会在后续 3 个 assistant turn 保持干预。与总是加入安全推理不同，probe-gated 版本只在高风险时触发，目标是改善安全性和干净任务效用之间的取舍。
summary.experiments: 探针实验覆盖六个模型，包括文中提到的 753B 参数 GLM-5.2，以及 Qwen、GPT-oss、Gemma 系列模型。简单线性探针在未见过的攻击、agent instruction 和 task suite 上取得 90% 以上 AUROC，并在自适应攻击和跨语言场景中保持鲁棒性。防御实验在五个模型上进行，使用 held-out banking 和 travel suite 中最难的 8 个 IPI grid points，并在四个 suite 的 clean tasks 上评估效用；每个 model-method 组合按 temperature 1.0 采样三条轨迹，总计 3,408 个 injected trials 和 291 个 clean runs。指标为 attack success rate（ASR，越低越好）和 clean utility（越高越好）。无干预时，Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.5-27B、GPT-oss-20B、Gemma-4-31B 的 ASR 分别为 47.2、43.2、34.6、44.0、6.9。probe-gated AGRI 后分别降至 2.9、3.0、0.0、7.0、0.0，同时 clean utility 分别为 69.1、88.2、89.7、66.8、91.8。相比 always-on AGRI，probe gating 通常保持相近 ASR，但干净任务效用更高。例如 Qwen3-8B 的 always-on utility 为 54.3，probe-gated 为 69.1；Qwen3.5-9B 从 82.6 提到 88.2。基线中 tool-result reminder 通常强于简单系统提示，SAFEPATH 的安全收益较弱且更容易损害 utility。文中还报告 no_failure 分类在 IPI-exposed assistant turn 对安全 agent trace 有 92.9% precision，支持用高精度中间信号触发防御。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟。先看 probing 设置，重点确认 hidden-state 层位、时间点、训练/测试划分，以及 unseen attacks 和 unseen task suites 的定义；这些决定探针结果是否能说明可迁移风险信号。再看 recognition–action gap 的 CoT 分析，那里是机制解释的核心。防御部分重点读 AGRI 的触发逻辑、阈值 t=0.5 的统一设置、触发后持续 3 turn 的设计，以及 Table 4 的 ASR/utility 对照。附录 F 的失败分析值得看，因为这类方法最容易在自适应攻击、误报成本和多轮状态管理上出问题。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的是把它当作“隐藏状态风险信号如何进入 post-train 和 inference control”的案例，而不是通用 agent 架构论文。

summary_en.core_problem: Agentic LLMs consume untrusted tool outputs, web pages, and documents. Indirect prompt injection can be hidden in those inputs. The paper asks whether the model’s internal states already encode exposure to such attacks before generation, why that recognition does not always lead to safe behavior, and how to convert the latent signal into an inference-time defense.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety and model-observability paper rather than a core pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the recognition–action gap: a model can contain a linearly decodable signal that it has seen a prompt-injection attempt, yet still follow the malicious instruction. That matters for tool-use training, RLHF/RLAIF data design, and agent evaluation. It suggests that final-task reward alone is not enough; training and inference controls need to shape how the model treats untrusted context before it commits to an action.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has three components. First, it trains simple linear probes on pre-generation hidden states to predict IPI exposure. Because the probe is evaluated during prefilling, it can fire before the model emits an unsafe action. Second, it measures chain-of-thought behavior to separate recognition from action: models may show signs of noticing the injection but still fail to act safely. Third, it introduces AGRI, Action-Guiding Reasoning Intervention. At each assistant turn, a hidden-state probe computes an exposure score. If the score exceeds a threshold, the system prepends a short anti-injection reasoning prefill that instructs the model to treat external content as untrusted and preserve the original agent objective. Once triggered, the intervention remains active for three subsequent assistant turns to handle delayed multi-turn effects. The probe-gated variant differs from always-on safety reasoning by applying the intervention only when the latent risk signal is present.
summary_en.experiments: The probing study spans six models, including the reported 753B-parameter GLM-5.2 and models from the Qwen, GPT-oss, and Gemma families. Linear probes achieve over 90% AUROC on unseen attacks, unseen agent instructions, and unseen task suites, and remain robust under adaptive and cross-lingual settings. The defense study evaluates five models on the eight hardest IPI grid points from held-out banking and travel suites, plus clean tasks from four suites. For each model-method pair, three trajectories are sampled at temperature 1.0, yielding 3,408 injected trials and 291 clean runs. Metrics are attack success rate and clean-task utility. Without intervention, ASR is 47.2 for Qwen3-8B, 43.2 for Qwen3.5-9B, 34.6 for Qwen3.5-27B, 44.0 for GPT-oss-20B, and 6.9 for Gemma-4-31B. Probe-gated AGRI reduces these to 2.9, 3.0, 0.0, 7.0, and 0.0, respectively, with clean utilities of 69.1, 88.2, 89.7, 66.8, and 91.8. Compared with always-on AGRI, probe gating usually preserves similar attack mitigation while improving utility; for example, Qwen3-8B utility rises from 54.3 to 69.1, and Qwen3.5-9B from 82.6 to 88.2. Tool-result reminders are generally stronger than generic prompting, while SAFEPATH tends to provide weaker mitigation and often hurts clean utility. The paper also reports that a no_failure classification at the IPI-exposed assistant turn predicts a secure trace with 92.9% precision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with the probing setup: which hidden states are used, when the probe is applied, and how unseen attacks, instructions, and task suites are split. Those details determine whether the probe is detecting a transferable exposure signal or dataset artifacts. Then read the chain-of-thought analysis of the recognition–action gap. For the defense, focus on the AGRI trigger rule, the shared threshold t = 0.5, the three-turn persistence design, and Table 4’s ASR-utility tradeoff. Appendix F is worth reading for failure cases, since this type of defense is sensitive to adaptive attacks, false positives, and multi-turn state handling. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the evidence that hidden-state safety signals can be exposed and routed into post-training or inference-time controls.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是“recognition-action gap”而不是 defense 本身；先查 probe 训练切分是否干净，若成立，会影响你对对齐信号应加在表征层还是行为层的判断。
recommendation.en: The real value is the recognition-action gap, not the defense wrapper; check whether the probe split is clean, because if it holds, it changes where you inject alignment signal—representation or behavior.

paper.title: DUD: Decoupled Update Dynamics for Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Accurate Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is critical for reliable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet traditional probability-based metrics often fail to capture the model's true epistemic state. While recent mechanistic approaches leverage hidden state dynamics, they typically aggregate residual stream updates, conflating the distinct roles of parametric memory (Feed-Forward Networks) and contextual processing (Attention). We argue that this aggregation obscures fine-grained mechani

summary.core_problem: 为 LLM uncertainty quantification 提供更细粒度的内部机制信号，避免只用输出概率或聚合 residual stream 动态来估计不确定性。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析和 UQ 方法。它把 Attention 的上下文处理与 FFN 的参数记忆分开看，认为二者的冲突和恢复能力能揭示模型内部脆弱性；对幻觉检测、置信度估计和训练动态分析都有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Decoupled Update Dynamics (DUD)。方法通过 noise-induced causal interventions 分别干预 FFN 和 Attention 的贡献，量化两个模块各自恢复正确内部状态或输出的能力，形成 dual-stream dynamic profile，用于捕捉 memory-context misalignment 等不确定性来源。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了广泛实验，证明 DUD 能捕捉模型内部 fragility，并优于传统 probability-based UQ 与聚合 hidden-state dynamics 方法。具体模型规模、数据集、baseline、提升幅度和显著性需要看正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics、The Key Laboratory of Brain-Machine Intelligence Technology 等。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper seeks a finer-grained internal signal for LLM uncertainty quantification, beyond output probabilities or aggregated residual-stream dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic UQ method. It separates Attention as contextual processing from FFNs as parametric memory, arguing that conflicts between the two streams reveal internal fragility. This is indirectly useful for hallucination detection, confidence estimation, and training-dynamics analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Decoupled Update Dynamics (DUD). It uses noise-induced causal interventions to decouple FFN and Attention contributions, measures each module's independent restoration capability, and builds a dual-stream dynamic profile that captures uncertainty sources such as memory-context misalignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments showing that DUD captures internal fragility and improves over probability-based UQ and aggregated hidden-state dynamics methods. The exact model sizes, datasets, baselines, effect sizes, and significance tests require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics and The Key Laboratory of Brain-Machine Intelligence Technology.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §方法和主表；FFN/Attention 分流诊断比单看 logprob 更像可迁移的 UQ 信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and main table; the FFN/Attention split looks more transferable as a UQ signal than raw logprob.

institutions: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
The Key Laboratory of Brain-Machine Intelligence Technology

paper.title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
paper.abstract: In human visual perception, uppercase lettering serves as a natural salience cue that captures attention within lowercase text. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical characterization study revealing that Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit an analogous property: letter casing modulates internal attention allocation. Through analysis across 13 models, nine LLMs and four Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with diverse tokenization schemes, we show that formatting target information in alte

summary.core_problem: 字母大小写差异通常被视为tokenizer的被动附带产物，此前没有系统研究预训练Transformer（包括LLM和VLM）中是否存在类似人类视觉感知的、由大小写调节内部注意力分配的效应，以及该效应的边界条件。
summary.importance: 揭示了预训练过程中Transformer会将排版大小写内隐学习为一种潜在的注意力优先级信号，而非无关紧要的tokenization细节。这一发现有助于理解预训练数据中的表层排版特征如何塑造模型内部行为，为注意力操控、模型可解释性研究提供了新的切入角度。推理模型与非推理模型的效应差异也为理解推理过程的语义重对齐功能提供了实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 研究采用完全训练无关的实验范式，仅在tokenization之前修改输入文本的大小写，严格保持词序和语义不变。实验设计将目标span（标注的正确答案span或对应图像区域的文本描述）设置为大写或交替大小写、周围上下文保持小写，同时设置反向干预（上下文大写、目标小写）用于因果验证。评估覆盖13个模型：9个LLM（7个非推理、2个推理）和4个VLM（2个非推理、2个推理），涵盖不同规模和tokenizer类型。测量指标包括目标span上的跨层注意力集中度变化，以及下游任务性能的变化。核心贡献是系统刻画了此前未被充分研究的“大小写显著性”效应，以及发现推理模型的审慎推理过程会过滤这类表层排版信号。
summary.experiments: 大小写显著性效应在所有被测非推理LLM中普遍存在：格式化为大写或交替大小写的目标span，跨层注意力集中度显著提升。该效应延伸到VLM场景：将文本描述中的目标词改为大写，会使图像注意力向对应视觉区域偏移。反向干预实验中，大写上下文中的小写目标注意力下降，验证了大小写变化的因果作用。注意力集中度提升并不总能改善下游性能，根据任务上下文不同可能带来提升也可能造成下降。推理模型在文本任务中的大小写效应明显减弱，因为其审慎推理过程会进行语义重对齐，优先保证逻辑一致性而非遵循表层排版信号。所有实验仅通过prompt层面的大小写修改实现，未进行微调、添加适配器或运行时模型内部探测。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中的问题提出、方法论部分的控制变量设计（如何排除语义混淆因素），以及推理模型与非推理模型的对比结果。无需深挖数学细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。从事可解释性或注意力操控研究的读者可额外关注因果分析的实验设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Letter case variation is conventionally treated as a passive artifact of tokenization. There is no systematic characterization of whether typographic case modulates internal attention allocation in pretrained LLMs and VLMs — analogous to the case-based salience effect observed in human visual perception — nor of the boundary conditions of such an effect.
summary_en.importance: The findings demonstrate that pretrained transformers implicitly internalize typographic case as a latent attention priority signal during pretraining, rather than it being a trivial tokenization quirk. This informs understanding of how surface-level formatting features in pretraining data shape model internal behavior, and provides a new angle for attention steering and interpretability research. The observed difference between reasoning and non-reasoning models also offers empirical evidence for the semantic realignment function of deliberative reasoning processes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses an entirely training-free experimental paradigm: it modifies only the letter case of input text before tokenization, while strictly preserving word order and semantic content. The experimental design formats target spans (ground-truth answer spans or text descriptions corresponding to image regions) in uppercase or alternating case against a lowercase context, and runs reverse interventions (uppercase context, lowercase targets) for causal validation. The evaluation covers 13 models: 9 LLMs (7 non-reasoning, 2 reasoning) and 4 VLMs (2 non-reasoning, 2 reasoning) across different scales and tokenizer types. Measured outcomes include changes in cross-layer attention concentration on target spans, as well as downstream task performance shifts. Core contributions include systematic characterization of the under-explored "casing-salience" effect, and the finding that deliberative reasoning processes in reasoning models filter out such surface-level typographic cues.
summary_en.experiments: The casing-salience effect is universal across all evaluated non-reasoning LLMs: target spans formatted in uppercase or alternating case show significantly higher cross-layer attention concentration. The effect extends to VLMs: uppercasing target words in text descriptions shifts image attention toward corresponding visual regions. Reverse intervention experiments reduce attention on lowercase targets embedded in uppercase context, confirming the causal role of case variation. Increased attention concentration does not consistently improve downstream performance — it can lead to both gains and degradations depending on task context. Reasoning models show weakened casing effects in text tasks, as their deliberative reasoning process performs semantic realignment that prioritizes logical coherence over surface typographic signals. All experiments use only prompt-level case modification, with no fine-tuning, adapters, or runtime model introspection.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem framing in the introduction, the controlled variable design in the methodology (how semantic confounders are excluded), and the comparison results between reasoning and non-reasoning models. No deep dive into mathematical details is needed; estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. Researchers working on interpretability or attention steering may pay extra attention to the causal analysis experiment design.

recommendation.zh: 这篇改变的是对“格式噪声无害”的默认假设；先看 attention-performance divergence 的图。
recommendation.en: This weakens the default assumption that casing is harmless formatting noise; start with the attention-performance divergence plots.

paper.title: LLMs Can Annotate Attribution Graphs
paper.abstract: Circuit tracing is an exciting technique for revealing the internal computation of language models, but it requires a time-intensive manual step of grouping individual features or MLP neurons into supernodes. We present a simple pipeline for automating this step: directly presenting feature descriptions to a language model that groups them into supernodes. Using automated interpretability metrics, we confirm that supernodes generated by our pipeline are as interpretable as those generated by hum

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 attribution graph 标注中的人工瓶颈：circuit tracing 能生成由 MLP neuron 或 SAE feature 构成的计算图，但把大量底层节点合并成有语义的 supernode 通常需要人工完成，单个图可能耗费一到两个研究小时。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在机制分析工具链。它降低了大规模检查模型内部计算图的成本，使 circuit tracing 更适合作为假设生成工具。对研究 ICL、planning、multi-hop reasoning 或训练后行为变化的团队，这类自动标注可以帮助更快定位候选 circuit，再用干预实验或 steering 做验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接。实验对象是 Gemma-2-2B，特征来自 Gemma Scope single-layer transcoders，attribution graph 由 circuit-tracer 生成。对每个剪枝后的 feature，先用 LLM 根据 5 个 Neuronpedia top-activating examples 生成 feature description，并额外提供该 feature 最促进和最抑制的 token logit 信息。随后用 GPT-5 mini 做三阶段 supernode grouping：先处理影响最高的 50 个 feature，识别并命名有意义的 supernode；再把剩余 feature 按 50 个一批分配到已有 supernode、新 supernode 或未分组；最后做 refinement，删除无关组、合并等价组并修正错误分配。提示词里加入了粒度控制，例如 output feature 只能和 output feature 合并，分组粒度要相对原 prompt 判断，并避免为标点、停用词等低信息模式建组。
summary.experiments: 实验包含三类证据。第一，与 circuit-tracer 中 15 个 human-annotated reference graphs 比较，使用两个自动可解释性指标评估 supernode 描述质量：Feature Detection Score 让 LLM 根据 supernode 描述从 10 个 feature 描述中找出成员 feature；Text Detection Score 用文本层面的检测来评估描述是否可操作。结果显示自动 supernode 与人工标注在这些指标上相当，并优于随机基线。第二，在 two-hop Capitals 任务上，自动流程在 100 个 prompt 中有 97 个恢复出对应 intermediate hop 的 supernode。第三，作为开放探索示例，自动标注了 1000 个 Wikipedia prompts 的 attribution graphs，并筛选可能有趣或异常的行为。成本方面，40–80 个节点的重剪枝图约 3–6 美分；约 585 个节点的较密图约 60 美分，输入约 728K tokens、输出约 214K tokens。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。优先看 Methods 中 feature description 和三阶段 grouping prompt 设计，再看 human annotation comparison 的两个自动指标。two-hop Capitals 结果适合快速判断方法是否能恢复已知中间变量。开放 Wikipedia 探索部分可以略读，它更多展示工具使用方式，而不是给出强机制结论。若要复现，Appendix A 的提示词和剪枝阈值设置比主结果更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets a practical bottleneck in circuit tracing: attribution graphs expose model components such as MLP neurons or SAE features, but grouping many low-level nodes into semantically meaningful supernodes still requires substantial manual annotation.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is through mechanistic analysis rather than training. Automating supernode annotation makes circuit tracing more scalable as a hypothesis-generation tool. This can help researchers inspect reasoning, planning, multi-hop retrieval, or behavioral changes after fine-tuning and RL before committing to more expensive causal interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline is intentionally simple. Experiments use Gemma-2-2B with Gemma Scope single-layer transcoders, and attribution graphs are produced with circuit-tracer. For each pruned feature, an LLM first writes a feature description using five Neuronpedia top-activating examples, augmented with promoted and suppressed token-logit information. GPT-5 mini then groups feature descriptions into supernodes in three stages. It first names and groups meaningful supernodes among the top 50 highest-influence features. It then assigns remaining features in batches of 50 to existing groups, new groups, or an ungrouped bucket. A final refinement pass removes irrelevant groups, merges equivalent groups, and fixes misplaced features. The prompts include constraints on grouping granularity, output-feature handling, and low-information patterns such as punctuation or stop words.
summary_en.experiments: The study compares automated supernodes with 15 human-annotated reference graphs from circuit-tracer using two automated interpretability metrics. Feature Detection Score asks whether an LLM can recover a member feature from a supernode description among distractors. Text Detection Score evaluates whether the description is useful at the text level. The automated groupings are reported to be comparable to human groupings on these metrics and better than random baselines. On a two-hop Capitals task, the pipeline recovers a supernode corresponding to the intermediate hop in 97 out of 100 prompts. The authors also annotate 1000 Wikipedia-prompt attribution graphs as a proof of concept for open-ended exploration. Cost scales roughly with graph size: about 3–6 cents for heavily pruned 40–80 node graphs and about 60 cents for denser graphs with roughly 585 nodes.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 15–25 minutes. Read the methods for the feature-description step and the three-stage grouping procedure, then check the human-comparison metrics and the two-hop Capitals result. The Wikipedia exploration is useful for understanding workflow, but it should not be treated as strong mechanistic evidence by itself. For implementation, the appendix prompts and pruning thresholds are likely the most reusable parts.

recommendation.zh: 研究circuit tracing或神经元可解释性的人员读方法部分即可，可直接复用流水线减少人工标注成本，无机制层面的新发现
recommendation.en: Read the method section if you work on circuit tracing or neuron interpretability; directly reusable pipeline to reduce manual annotation, no new mechanistic insights

paper.title: On the Diversity of Analogy Making in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for analogy making, a core cognitive capability that drives novelty and creativity. While prior research has extensively investigated the applications and underlying mechanisms of LLM-based analogy making, its output diversity remains largely unexplored, despite being essential for broadening cross-domain connections and fostering scientific innovation. In this work, we present a comprehensive evaluation of analogy diversity acr

summary.core_problem: 评估大语言模型在类比生成上的“多样性”是否真实存在，以及提升多样性是否必然牺牲质量。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制与评测结合的分析工作，贡献不在新模型，而在把“类比能力”从正确性扩展到多样性维度，并指出现有解码/多样性增强手段存在质量代价。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统评测 10 个开源与闭源 LLM 的类比生成，区分跨查询与模型内多样性，分析目标域同质化问题；同时比较现有 diversity-enhancement 方法，并做信息流因果分析，试图解释多样性受限的内部原因。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 10 个主流模型，核心发现是类比输出集中在少数目标域，存在明显 domain homogeneity；提升多样性的常见方法会带来质量下降。摘要未给出参数规模与具体增益数字，更偏分析而非方法突破。
summary.authors_note: 可确认作者 Xiaodan Zhu；其团队长期做 NLP、推理与生成分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs truly exhibit diversity in analogy generation and whether improving diversity necessarily hurts quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis-oriented contribution rather than a new model. Its value is in extending analogy evaluation beyond correctness to diversity, and in showing a quality-diversity trade-off in current methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors benchmark analogy diversity across 10 open and closed LLMs, separating inter-query and intra-model diversity, diagnosing domain homogeneity, and comparing existing diversity-enhancement methods. They also run causal information-flow analysis to probe why diversity is limited.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 10 mainstream models and finds that analogy outputs collapse onto a narrow set of target domains. Existing diversity-boosting methods improve diversity only by sacrificing output quality. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact effect sizes, indicating a primarily analytical paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Xiaodan Zhu is a recognizable author here; the group has prior work in NLP, reasoning, and generation analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但如果你关心生成分布塌缩而不只看 pass@1，这篇对“多样性—质量”张力给了还算干净的证据；看实验结论即可。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but if you care about distributional collapse beyond pass@1, this gives reasonably clean evidence for a diversity-quality trade-off; the experimental findings are enough.

paper.title: Probing Character-level Transformers for the Spanish L-shaped Morphome
paper.abstract: When a transformer learns an irregular morphological pattern, what has it learned? Our test case is the Spanish \emph{L-shaped morphome}, a complex irregular pattern in which the verb's stem alternates in exactly the first-person singular indicative and all subjunctive forms, and whose membership no phonological, semantic, or syntactic feature predicts. Prior studies have shown that character-level transformers can reproduce this pattern, but that evidence describes what models produce, not what

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答：字符级 Transformer 在学习西班牙语 L-shaped morphome 这类不规则形态模式时，学到的到底是表面词干交替，还是更抽象的“形态类别”表示。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在机制分析而不是方法创新。它提供了一个较干净的语言学测试床，去区分模型是在记忆表面形式，还是形成了超越可见交替的抽象类概念。这对理解小粒度 tokenization 下模型内部表示有一定启发，但离通用 LLM 预训练方法还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在五种字符级 Transformer 架构上做 probing，采用 lemma-disjoint cross-validation，并设置控制组与 surface baselines。核心设计是把“是否属于 L-shaped 类”与“是否在表面上出现词干交替”拆开：包括所有词形都显示同一词干的实例，以及只在交替样本上训练 probe、再测试到非交替样本上，从而检验模型是否编码了抽象类别。还分析了表示在词干决策位置附近的局部化现象。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五种架构、每种 12 个训练模型，重点不是大规模性能，而是 probing 可分性与对照实验。主要结论是：L-shaped 类别信息在模型表示中可被稳定解码，且优于所有表面基线；即便在没有显式交替线索的样本中，这种类别信息仍然存在；表示位置集中在词干选择发生的区域。论文没有提供与大规模 LLM 直接相关的参数规模或预训练语料规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf 和 University of Florida，偏计算语言学与语言学建模方向，不属于主流大模型预训练团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether character-level Transformers learning the Spanish L-shaped morphome encode only visible stem alternations or a more abstract morphological class.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly mechanistic rather than methodological. It offers a relatively clean linguistic testbed for separating surface memorization from abstract class representation under fine-grained tokenization, though the connection to mainstream LLM pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors probe five character-level Transformer architectures with lemma-disjoint cross-validation, plus controls and surface baselines. The key design is to disentangle class membership from visible alternation: they include cases where all forms share the same stem and train probes on alternating instances before testing on non-alternating ones. This tests whether the model encodes the abstract class itself. They also localize the signal near the position where stem choice is made.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers five architectures with twelve trained models each. The focus is not scale but probe decodability and controlled comparisons. The main result is that L-shaped class information is decodable above all surface baselines, persists even when explicit alternation cues are absent, and is localized near the stem-selection region. No large-scale LLM-style parameter or corpus scaling is involved.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf and the University of Florida, with a computational linguistics / linguistics profile rather than a frontier LLM pretraining lab.

recommendation.zh: 偏语言学 probing，不会直接改你的 pretrain recipe；若你关心字符级 tokenizer 学到的是规则还是类概念，只看实验控制设计即可。
recommendation.en: This is linguistics-heavy probing, not a pretraining paper; worth a quick look only if you care whether character-level models encode abstract classes beyond surface alternations.

paper.title: Recompute or Reuse? Diagnosing and Mitigating Textual Shortcuts in VLM Self-Reflection
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to revise their reasoning when visual evidence changes. Failures to do so are often attributed to insufficient visual attention or contextual inertia, leaving unclear what models reuse instead of recomputing from the current image. We show that evidence-bearing reasoning in a prior chain of thought (CoT) can form a textual shortcut that competes behaviorally with visual recomputation. Across 16 VLMs, a matched counterfactual analysis identifies evidence

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 VLM 在视觉状态改变后的自我反思失败：模型没有重新读取当前图像时，究竟复用了什么信息。核心结论是，旧 CoT 中承载视觉证据的文本片段会形成“textual shortcut”，与当前图像的重新计算竞争。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 multimodal reasoning 的训练信号质量。论文说明，CoT 不只是推理轨迹，也可能把旧视觉状态离散化成可复用文本证据。只用最终答案是否修正来评估视觉更新是不够的，因为模型可能仍保留旧证据的分数偏置。对 VLM 预训练、SFT、反思式数据构造都有提醒：如果训练中大量暴露带证据描述的历史 CoT，模型可能学会优先走文本捷径，而不是重新绑定当前视觉输入。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个 matched counterfactual 框架。每个样本包含当前图像 I、问题 Q、正确答案 y，以及结构相近但关键视觉证据不同的反事实图像 I- 和答案 y-。先让被测模型在 I- 上生成一个支持 y- 的旧 CoT R-，再把当前图像 I、同一问题 Q 和旧 CoT 放入反思上下文，观察模型是否被旧推理牵引。论文进一步做受控删除：删除旧 CoT 中 evidence-bearing content、删除等长非证据文本、删除最终答案 span，并比较答案偏移。这样可以区分三类影响：上下文长度、答案锚定、以及旧视觉证据文本本身。还测试了 evidence 顺序打乱，说明文本证据的组织结构也会影响捷径被复用的程度。干预方法 FSAF 不是 prompt 提醒，而是在注意力层面阻断新一轮计算访问旧 CoT，使当前计算不能直接 attend 到旧推理轨迹。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 16 个 VLM。数据使用 800 个经人工检查的 VS-Bench paired counterfactual 样本，来源包括 MathVista-MINI、MathVerse-MINI、MathVision 和 MMMU-Pro。样本筛选要求模型在反事实图像上能得到 y-，且在无历史条件下对当前图像能得到 y，因此测到的是旧 CoT 的干扰，而不是任务本身不可解。主要发现是：删除旧 CoT 中承载证据的内容，比删除等长非证据文本或最终答案片段更能改变答案偏好；这种 content-specific effect 在 16 个模型上均为正，并且随着删除更多旧证据而增强。即使模型给出了当前正确答案，在后续 matched support withdrawal 下仍比 history-free control 更容易回到旧答案，说明答案修正不等于证据状态更新。FSAF 在 5 个 Qwen VLM 上将 visual update rate 从 35.28% 提升到 53.61%，将 prior-answer rate 从 39.22% 降到 3.67%。prompt-only 版本没有稳定提升，支持“控制旧推理访问”比“要求模型重新看图”更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。重点看 Controlled Evaluation of Prior-CoT Influence 中的任务构造、eligibility 条件和 deletion controls，这部分决定实验是否真的隔离了文本捷径。结果部分优先看 evidence removal、final-answer removal、order disruption 的对比图表。FSAF 部分适合关注 attention mask 具体怎么施加，以及是否影响正常上下文利用。对做 VLM pretrain 或 multimodal CoT 数据的人，最值得深挖的是“evidence-bearing CoT 会不会成为训练时的错误归因路径”：模型可能学到从文本证据恢复答案，而不是从图像重新抽取证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what a VLM reuses when it fails to update its reasoning after the visual evidence changes. The central finding is that evidence-bearing spans in a previous CoT can act as a textual shortcut, competing with recomputation from the current image.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal reasoning supervision. CoT traces are not neutral explanations; they can serialize visual observations into text and make stale evidence easier to reuse than fresh visual evidence. This matters for VLM pretraining and post-training pipelines that rely on reflective reasoning, self-correction, or multimodal CoT data. A corrected final answer is not a reliable certificate that the model has refreshed its visual state.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a matched counterfactual setup. Each example contains a current image-question-answer triple and a structurally similar counterfactual image with a different answer. The model first produces a coherent prior CoT on the counterfactual image. The same model is then asked to reflect under the current image while the stale CoT remains in context. The analysis compares this prior-conditioned path with a history-free direct path. Controlled removals separate three effects: removing evidence-bearing spans, removing length-matched non-evidence spans, and removing the final-answer span. The paper also perturbs evidence order to test whether the organization of the stale reasoning path affects reuse. The proposed intervention, Fresh-State Attention Firewall, blocks fresh computation from attending to the prior CoT instead of merely prompting the model to inspect the image again.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 16 VLMs and 800 human-checked VS-Bench counterfactual pairs drawn from MathVista-MINI, MathVerse-MINI, MathVision, and MMMU-Pro. Eligibility requires the model to answer the counterfactual image correctly and to answer the current image correctly without history, so the measured effect is prior-CoT interference rather than base task failure. Removing evidence-bearing content shifts answer preference more than removing length-matched non-evidence context or the final-answer span. The content-specific effect is positive for all 16 models and grows as more stale evidence is removed. Even when a model recovers the current answer, matched support withdrawal reveals residual dependence on the old reasoning path. On five Qwen VLMs, FSAF improves visual update rate from 35.28% to 53.61% and reduces prior-answer rate from 39.22% to 3.67%. A prompt-only variant does not provide a reliable update gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the matched counterfactual construction, the eligibility filter, and the deletion controls, since these determine whether the shortcut effect is well isolated. The most useful result tables or figures are those comparing evidence removal, non-evidence removal, final-answer removal, and evidence-order disruption. The FSAF section is worth checking for the exact attention restriction and whether it sacrifices useful context. For VLM pretraining work, the key question to carry forward is whether multimodal CoT supervision encourages models to recover answers from textualized evidence rather than bind reasoning to the current visual input.

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练论文，但把“反思失败”从注意力问题改写成文本捷径竞争问题，值得看干预设计；只读 counterfactual setup 和证据删除结果就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it reframes reflection failure from weak visual attention to textual-shortcut competition; read the counterfactual setup and evidence-ablation results, not the whole story.

paper.title: Exemplars in Disguise: Pure Exemplar Models Mimic Abstraction-First Learning
paper.abstract: Whether idiosyncratic, item-specific knowledge is learned before abstract class-level generalizations, or vice versa, is a central question in language learning, with exemplar and abstraction-based theories making opposite predictions. Recent methods have claimed to show that, at least for large language models, abstract knowledge is learned first. We show that these methods fall short: pure memorizer models with no abstract representations can appear, by the same criteria, to learn either item-

summary.core_problem: 质疑现有关于“LLM 先学抽象类级知识、后学个体记忆”的判定方法，指出这些诊断可能把纯 exemplar 记忆误判为 abstraction-first 学习。
summary.importance: 这是机制与认知解释层面的反驳型工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在提醒研究者：很多关于学习顺序的结论依赖诊断定义，未必真正识别了抽象表示。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造纯 memorizer/exemplar 模型，证明在现有判据下，这类没有抽象表示的模型也可能表现出“先学类级知识”或“先学个体知识”的表象；并进一步论证在分布式表示里，item-specific 与 class-level 属性未必可清晰分离。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出大规模 LLM 训练实验，更像是方法学反例与分析性实验。核心比较对象是先前声称 LLM abstraction-first 的诊断方法，而不是新的基座模型或训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: It challenges existing claims that LLMs learn abstract class-level knowledge before item-specific knowledge, arguing that current diagnostics can misclassify pure exemplar memorization as abstraction-first learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/interpretation critique rather than a new model. Its value is methodological: many conclusions about learning order may be artifacts of the diagnostic definition rather than evidence of genuine abstract representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct pure memorizer/exemplar models and show that, under the same evaluation criteria used in prior work, such models can appear to learn either class-level or item-specific knowledge first. They further argue that in distributed representations, the distinction between item-specific and class-level properties may itself be ill-posed.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests analytical or controlled counterexample-style experiments rather than large-scale LLM training. The main target is prior diagnostic methodology claiming abstraction-first learning, not a new base model or training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 这类论文的价值在拆诊断，不在给新答案；如果你最近在看 learning dynamics/abstraction 论文，先读它再信那些漂亮曲线。
recommendation.en: Its value is in breaking the diagnostic, not offering a new grand theory; read this before trusting clean-looking abstraction-first learning curves.

paper.title: Mask-Based Priors Are More Persistent than Query-Key Initializations
paper.abstract: Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can

summary.core_problem: 研究 Transformer 在布尔外推任务上为何会拟合训练域但学到系统性错误的外推规则，以及结构化注意力先验能否修正这种归纳偏置。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和小型结构干预。它不直接改进大模型预训练 recipe，但把注意力先验分成 QK 初始化和 additive mask 两类，并比较它们在训练中的可保持性，对理解 Transformer 归纳偏置有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较两种注入结构先验的方式：一种是通过 query/key 投影初始化间接形成期望的 attention pattern，另一种是直接初始化 additive attention mask/bias。核心判断是 QK 先验会在训练早期被覆盖，而 mask-based prior 更稳定，因而更可能影响最终外推规则。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在受控布尔外推任务。模型需要在已观测输入域拟合目标函数，并在未观测域外推。论文观察训练过程中不同 attention prior 的保持程度，以及最终外推是否从简单的 minimum-degree interpolator 转向目标结构。摘要未给出参数量、数据规模或具体提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why Transformers fit observed Boolean domains yet extrapolate with systematically wrong rules, and whether explicit attention priors can correct that inductive bias.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic study with a small architectural intervention. It does not change large-scale pretraining practice directly, but it separates query-key initialization from additive mask priors and studies which kind of prior survives optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method compares QK-based structured initialization, which indirectly induces a target attention pattern through projection similarities, against directly initialized additive attention masks or biases. The central claim is that QK priors are quickly overwritten during training, while mask-based priors persist and can affect extrapolation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on controlled Boolean extrapolation tasks where models fit the observed domain and are tested on unseen regions. The paper tracks whether attention priors remain during training and whether the learned extrapolation rule changes away from a minimum-degree interpolator. The abstract does not report model size, data scale, or exact quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 玩具任务不应外推到预训练结论；但“QK 初始化先验会被优化洗掉”这个负结果值得记住。
recommendation.en: Do not overgeneralize from the toy setup, but the negative result that QK priors get washed out by optimization is worth remembering.

paper.title: On the Generalization of Steering Vectors for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
paper.abstract: Model capabilities have improved in large part due to scaling chain of thought. This has been a promising development for AI safety--where models verbalize their reasoning, it is possible to monitor it. However, in some cases, models do not verbalize important steps in their reasoning process. For example, models prompted with a cue suggesting the incorrect answer may fail to acknowledge that cue, even when it appears instrumental to their conclusion. When chain of thought (CoT) fails to disclos

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 CoT faithfulness 的 activation steering 是否能泛化：一个为某类提示线索、某个数据集或某种构造方法得到的 steering vector，能否在其他线索、数据集和模型上继续提升模型对真实影响因素的披露。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析和可监控推理。CoT 监控只有在模型愿意写出影响答案的因素时才有意义；如果模型受错误提示线索影响，却在推理文本中不承认，监控会失效。该工作把 faithfulness steering 从单一设置扩展到模型、数据集、线索类型和向量构造方法的泛化测试。结论比较克制：steering 的有效性并不稳定，主要在更大的 Gemma-3 12B 上可靠出现；但一旦有效，向量在不同 cue 和 dataset 之间的迁移性较强。这说明相关表征可能不是狭窄的 cue 模板特征，而更接近“承认外部线索影响”的通用方向。
summary.technical_approach: 实验使用 residual stream activation steering。作者比较四类向量构造方式：第一是 labeled on-policy contrastive vector，用模型在带 cue prompt 上生成的轨迹，经 judge 标注为承认 cue 或不承认 cue 后，对两类平均激活做差；第二是 synthetic vector，用模板化的 cue-acknowledging 和 cue-ignoring completion 代替真实 rollout，因此不需要模型采样和 judge 标签；第三是 cue-specific optimized vector，通过梯度优化一个方向，使被 steering 的模型提高特定 cue 承认文本的似然；第四是 cue-agnostic optimized direction，优化目标不点名具体 cue，测试是否存在更通用的 faithfulness 方向。评估时区分 efficacy generalization 和 transfer generalization：前者看某个 setting 下 steering 是否有效，后者看在一个 setting 构造的 vector 能否迁移到另一个 setting。
summary.experiments: 模型包括 Gemma-3 4B、Qwen-3.5 9B 和 Gemma-3 12B。数据集包括 BBH、GPQA 和 MMLU。提示线索来自 Meek et al. 的四类错误 cue：Stanford professor 式 sycophancy、XML metadata、grader-hacking hint、unethical insider tip，均指向错误选项。GPQA 上改变 cue 类型；固定 Stanford cue 时改变数据集。每个 scenario 保留非退化样本，不要求模型一定受 cue 影响，也不要求无 cue 时答案不同；训练和测试约 67/33 划分，每个 scenario 测试集约 129–165 个样本。生成使用 greedy decoding，并在同一模型内匹配 token limit 和 penalty。主要结果是：steering 稳定提升 cue acknowledgment 的范围较窄，主要出现在 Gemma-3 12B，且受数据集影响明显；但在 GPQA 上，一个 cue 训练出的向量与目标 cue 自身训练出的向量效果接近；固定 cue 时，一个数据集训练出的向量也能在其他数据集上产生相近变化。synthetic vector 和通用优化方向的效果接近 labeled contrastive vector。作者还检查了 cue use 与 hidden cue use，发现有效 steering 大致不改变模型使用 cue 的比例，而是降低未披露 cue use 的部分。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Setup and Methods 中四种 vector 构造方式，以及 efficacy generalization 和 transfer generalization 的定义。结果部分建议重点看按模型大小拆分的表格或图，因为小模型和 12B 模型的差异是结论的边界。还应看 cue use / hidden cue use 分析，这是判断 steering 是否真的提高 faithfulness，而不是简单诱导模型更多使用 cue 的关键。对基座研究员来说，值得关注的是 synthetic vector 不依赖 rollout 和 judge 标签却能接近 contrastive vector，这暗示某些推理披露方向可能可以用很轻的数据构造出来。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether activation steering for chain-of-thought faithfulness generalizes. If a steering vector is built for one cue type, dataset, or construction procedure, does it still make the model disclose influential prompt cues in other settings?
summary_en.importance: The main value is in mechanistic analysis and monitorable reasoning. CoT monitoring is only useful when the model verbalizes the factors that drive its answer. If a model follows a misleading cue but hides that influence in its reasoning, the monitor loses signal. This study moves faithfulness steering beyond a single experimental setting and tests variation across models, datasets, cue types, and vector construction methods. The result is nuanced: efficacy is narrow and reliable mainly for Gemma-3 12B, while transfer is broad once the effect exists. This suggests that the steered feature is not merely a memorized cue template, but may correspond to a more general tendency to acknowledge external cue influence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method applies residual-stream activation steering and compares four ways to construct the steering direction. The contrastive vector is the difference between mean activations from judge-labeled cue-acknowledging and cue-ignoring on-policy rollouts. The synthetic vector replaces rollouts with templated cue-acknowledging and cue-ignoring completions, avoiding both model sampling and judge labels. The cue-specific optimized vector is learned by gradient descent so that the steered model assigns higher likelihood to cue-acknowledging target completions. The cue-agnostic optimized direction uses a target that does not name a particular cue, testing whether a more generic faithfulness direction exists. The evaluation separates efficacy generalization, meaning whether steering works at all in a given setting, from transfer generalization, meaning whether a vector built in one setting remains useful in another.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates Gemma-3 4B, Qwen-3.5 9B, and Gemma-3 12B on BBH, GPQA, and MMLU. It uses four misleading cue types adapted from Meek et al.: a Stanford-professor sycophancy cue, XML metadata, a grader-hacking hint, and an unethical insider tip, each pointing to an incorrect option. Cue type is varied on GPQA, while dataset transfer is tested with the Stanford cue fixed. For each scenario, degenerate rollouts are filtered, but examples are not conditioned on whether the model follows the cue or whether the uncued answer differs. The split is roughly 67/33 train/test, with about 129–165 test items per scenario. Generation uses greedy decoding with matched limits and penalties within each model. The main findings are that reliable increases in cue acknowledgment appear mostly in Gemma-3 12B and vary by dataset; however, vectors trained on one cue perform similarly to vectors trained on the evaluated cue, and vectors trained on one dataset transfer comparably to target-dataset vectors when the cue is fixed. Synthetic and cue-agnostic optimized directions perform similarly to labeled contrastive vectors. Additional analysis shows that successful steering leaves the overall rate of cue use roughly unchanged while reducing hidden cue use.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the setup carefully, especially the four vector construction methods and the distinction between efficacy and transfer generalization. In the results, focus on model-wise breakdowns, since the contrast between smaller models and Gemma-3 12B defines the boundary of the claim. Also read the cue-use versus hidden-cue-use analysis; it is the key check that steering improves disclosure rather than simply making the model rely more on the cue. For foundation-model researchers, the most interesting detail is that synthetic vectors can approach labeled contrastive vectors without rollouts or judge labels.

recommendation.zh: 结论会削弱“一个 steering vector 到处管用”的乐观 prior；看跨 cue 泛化表和最大模型对比。
recommendation.en: This weakens the optimistic prior that one steering vector transfers broadly; read the cross-cue generalization table and the largest-model comparison.

paper.title: Same Evidence, Different Target: Decoding How Diagnostic Evidence Bears on Causal Questions from Language-Model States
paper.abstract: The same diagnostic result can support or challenge one causal claim yet fail to address another when the claims concern different populations, outcomes, estimands, pathways, or identifying assumptions. When the evidence and target vary together, a correct answer may reflect favorable or adverse wording, lexical overlap, or a familiar diagnostic pattern rather than matching the evidence to the causal question. We introduce paired prompts that repeat the same diagnostic evidence verbatim while ch

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个更细的因果推理问题：同一条诊断证据，对不同 causal target 的含义可能不同。模型如果只看证据措辞、正负倾向或词面重合，可能把同一证据错误地套到另一个因果问题上。作者构造 paired prompts，固定诊断证据不变，只改变因果目标，用 Favors、Challenges、Unresolved、Wrong Target 四类标签测试模型是否真的匹配 evidence 和 target。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近评测和机制分析，不是预训练方法。对基座研究的启发在于，它把“模型是否做了目标条件化的证据解释”拆成了可测问题，并进一步检查这个判断能否从 hidden state 中线性读出。对于研究预训练模型的因果推理、shortcut、表示可分性有参考意义。但 benchmark 规模较小，49 对样本更适合作为诊断工具，而不是能力排名工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成。第一是 paired benchmark：每对 prompt 保持 study setting 和 diagnostic evidence 完全相同，只替换 causal target。一个 endpoint 的标签可能是 Favors 或 Challenges，另一个则是 Wrong Target，因为证据虽然有效，但回答的是另一个因果问题。pair recovery 只有在一对中的两个 endpoint 都预测正确时才计成功，这能抑制简单的正负情绪或证据模式捷径。第二是表示探测：作者从三个 instruction-tuned checkpoint 的倒数第二个 transformer block 取 final-token hidden state，在独立 development set 上训练线性 readout。还设计了 evidence-only、evidence-omitted 输入消融，scenario-grouped permutation null，leave-family-out 设置，以及 option logits 和文本基线。
summary.experiments: 主 benchmark 包含 49 对 prompt，覆盖九类 diagnostic families。三个 instruction-tuned checkpoint 的 hidden-state linear readout 在主集上的 balanced accuracy 为 0.654 到 0.659，完整恢复 18 到 21 对；所有 checkpoint 都超过 scenario-grouped permutation null，并且同时恢复了 Favors pair 和 Challenges pair。Qwen2.5 上，full-prompt hidden state 恢复 21 对；evidence-omitted 和 evidence-only 输入都没有恢复任何完整 pair。去掉被评估 diagnostic family 的 development examples 后，readout 仍恢复 21 对，并且九个 family 中每个至少恢复一对。最高分 option baseline 只恢复 4 对，基于四个 option logits 的线性分类器恢复 8 对，文本基线最多恢复 4 对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 25 分钟。先看 Benchmark 部分，确认四类标签的定义，尤其是 Wrong Target 与 Unresolved 的边界。然后看 complete-pair recovery 指标，因为这是论文比普通四分类评测更严格的地方。实验部分重点看 hidden-state readout、restricted input ablation、leave-family-out 和 option-logit baseline。需要谨慎阅读的是数据规模和标注一致性：49 对样本能说明一个清晰现象，但不足以支撑广泛结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a language model can determine how the same diagnostic evidence bears on different causal targets. The evidence may support one causal claim, challenge another, or be irrelevant to a third because the population, outcome, estimand, pathway, or identifying assumption has changed. Standard benchmarks often vary evidence and target together, leaving room for shortcuts based on wording or familiar diagnostic patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and probing paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance lies in the diagnostic design: it isolates target-conditioned causal interpretation and tests whether that information is linearly recoverable from model states. For researchers studying pretrained representations, causal reasoning, and shortcut behavior, the setup is useful. The benchmark is small, so it is better treated as a controlled probe than as a general-purpose leaderboard.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses paired prompts. Each pair repeats the same study setting and diagnostic evidence verbatim, while changing only the causal target. Labels are Favors, Challenges, Unresolved, and Wrong Target. A pair is counted as recovered only when both endpoints are classified correctly, which prevents a model from succeeding by assigning the same favorable or adverse label to both prompts. The probing experiment extracts the final-token hidden state from the penultimate transformer block of three instruction-tuned checkpoints and trains a linear readout on a separate development set. The paper also includes evidence-only and evidence-omitted ablations, scenario-grouped permutation nulls, leave-family-out tests, option-logit baselines, and text baselines.
summary_en.experiments: The primary benchmark contains 49 pairs across nine diagnostic families. Linear readouts from hidden states reach balanced accuracy between 0.654 and 0.659 and recover 18 to 21 complete pairs, exceeding the grouped permutation null for all three checkpoints. In Qwen2.5, the full-prompt hidden state recovers 21 pairs, while neither the evidence-only nor the evidence-omitted input recovers a complete pair. When development examples from the evaluated diagnostic family are removed, the readout still recovers 21 pairs and recovers at least one pair in every family. The highest-scoring option baseline recovers four pairs, a linear classifier over the four option logits recovers eight, and text baselines recover at most four.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: 20 to 25 minutes. Read the benchmark construction first, especially the distinction between Wrong Target and Unresolved. Then inspect the complete-pair recovery metric, since it is the main safeguard against shortcut solutions. In the results, focus on the hidden-state readout, restricted-input ablations, leave-family-out setting, and option-logit baselines. The main limitation to keep in mind is scale: 49 pairs are enough for a controlled diagnostic, but not enough for broad claims about causal reasoning ability.

recommendation.zh: setup 比多数 probing paper 干净，适合借鉴到 reasoning representation 分析；先看 paired-prompt 设计和 pair recovery 指标，正文不必细抠。
recommendation.en: Cleaner than most probing papers; borrow the paired-prompt design and pair-recovery metric for reasoning-state analysis, and you can stop there.

paper.title: Understanding Knowledge Transfer Mechanism in Heterogeneous MLLM Fusion: A Simple Linear Approach
paper.abstract: Training-free fusion of heterogeneous multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provides a direct route for cross-scale capability transfer, yet improvements in aggregate performance do not reveal what a smaller model actually inherits. Existing studies are largely designed and evaluated on limited task sets or aggregate metrics; as evaluation expands to broader task collections, whether different capabilities can transfer across scales remains poorly understood. To investigate this question, we

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“融合后总分有没有涨”，而是更细的三个问题：跨尺度、异构的 MLLM 在训练免费融合时，究竟哪些能力能从大模型转到小模型；这些能力主要寄存在什么参数和什么模块里；层对齐、参数选择和注入强度为什么会决定转移是否有效。作者指出，已有 heterogeneous fusion 工作大多只看聚合指标，难以区分真实知识迁移、结构失配带来的干扰、以及不同能力之间的非均匀变化。为此，他们把“融合”降成一个局部线性探针问题，用很小幅度的参数方向注入去测 transfer signal，而不是直接追求一次性最优融合结果。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了新的可部署融合算法，而在于给出了一套分析跨模型知识可迁移性的可操作框架。它把参数空间中的迁移拆成一阶有益信号和二阶结构干扰两部分，这个视角对理解 model merging、continual pretrain、跨尺寸蒸馏、甚至 mid-training 阶段的参数迁移都很有参考价值。更具体地说，结论是：跨尺度迁移明显具有能力选择性，高层推理比感知更容易迁移；LLM 部分比视觉编码器更承载这类可迁移增益；有效迁移只出现在很窄的小注入区间。这些观察对“哪些能力是局部线性可搬运的，哪些能力强依赖整体表征几何”给出了较清楚的经验边界。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CDPI，Cross-Scale Directional Parameter Injection。给定同一家族中较大的 source MLLM 和较小的 target MLLM，先把模型拆成 ViT、跨模态 projector、LLM 三个组件，再定义注入空间 E=(C,P)：C 决定注入哪些组件，P 决定只注入 linear-layer 参数还是注入所有可对齐参数。由于 source 和 target 在 hidden size、attention head 数、LLM 深度上都不同，作者构造了异构对齐算子 A_pi，把 source 参数投影到 target 参数空间。这里的 pi 是 LLM 层映射策略，决定深层到浅层、均匀抽样还是其他配对方式。得到投影方向 ΔΘ 后，不做训练，只沿着这个方向对 target 做小步移动：Θ_F = Θ_T + αΔ。关键不在大步融合，而在扫描 α、组件、参数子集和层映射，观察不同能力的局部响应。

理论部分用了 target 点附近的二阶展开。对某一能力类别 c 的泛化损失 L_c(Θ)，局部增益近似写成 αA_c - 1/2 α^2 I_c，其中 A_c = -∇L_c(Θ_T)^TΔ 表示一阶 transfer signal，衡量 source 投影方向是否与该能力的改进方向对齐；I_c = Δ^T H_c Δ 表示二阶 curvature response，刻画结构失配、参数耦合和局部曲率带来的干扰。这个分解很重要，因为它解释了为什么同一个 source 方向会对 reasoning 有帮助、对 perception 几乎无效，或者在 α 稍大时迅速转负：不是没有信号，而是二阶干扰开始主导。

和常见 model merging 不同，这里不追求构造一个全局最优 merged model，也不依赖训练 learned mapping。它更像一个诊断工具：通过受控的小幅参数注入，测量不同模块和不同参数类型的可迁移性。作者还特别比较了 linear 参数与 full 参数，发现线性层权重往往具有更高的 transfer efficiency，这暗示可迁移知识更集中在可直接作用于表示变换的主干线性映射，而不是所有可对齐参数平均分布。
summary.experiments:
实验基于四组 Qwen3-VL 跨尺度模型对，在 12 个 benchmark 上分析 transfer pattern。全文给出的主结果不是单一总分，而是按能力拆分后的变化。最稳定的发现有四点。

第一，增益主要集中在 reasoning，尤其是 high-level reasoning；perception 类任务基本贴着 target 原始水平，变化很小。这说明跨尺度训练免费融合更像是在搬运高层决策或语言推理方向，而不是把视觉感知能力直接“拷贝”过去。

第二，从组件上看，high-level reasoning 的提升主要来自 LLM 注入，而不是 ViT 或 projector。ViT 注入对感知也没有带来同等显著的正迁移，说明视觉侧能力更受表示空间和编码细节约束，局部线性投影不够。

第三，参数范围上，linear-only 注入通常比 full-parameter 注入更稳，单位注入强度下的收益更高、干扰更小。这个结果和理论分解一致：full 注入虽然包含更多潜在有益信号，但也引入更多二阶结构冲突。

第四，层映射和注入比例都很敏感。有效 layer mapping 明显依赖具体 source-target 配对，不存在一个通用最优映射。注入比例 α 只有在较小区间内才出现正向 selective transfer；一旦 α 继续增大，性能很快被 interference 吞掉。作者把这一现象解释为一阶收益先线性增长、二阶损伤按平方项放大，因此最佳点天然落在窄小区间。

从阅读价值看，最有信息量的是这些消融：按组件拆分、按参数类型拆分、按 layer mapping 拆分、按 α 扫描的能力曲线。如果只看 aggregate score，会错过论文真正的结论。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题设定—理论分解—消融结果”三步读。

先看 Introduction 和方法图，明确 CDPI 不是为了做更强融合，而是为了测 transfer mechanism。这个定位如果没抓住，后面的实验会被误读成“为什么不用更复杂映射”。

然后重点看方法部分关于 injection space、alignment operator 和 layer mapping 的定义。这里决定了实验到底在控制什么变量。尤其要注意作者为什么区分 linear 与 full 参数，以及为什么把 ViT、Proj、LLM 分开分析。

理论部分值得细读二阶展开。核心不是公式本身，而是 A_c 和 I_c 的解释：一个代表能力相关的一阶对齐信号，一个代表结构干扰。后面所有“只在小 α 有效”“reasoning 比 perception 更能迁移”的现象，都是围绕这个框架展开的。

实验部分优先看四类图表：1）不同能力类别的增益分布；2）组件级注入对比；3）linear vs full；4）layer mapping 与 α 扫描。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要深挖，可进一步想两个问题：为什么 reasoning 更线性、而 perception 更依赖整体几何；为什么 LLM 中的可迁移方向能跨尺度保留，而视觉侧不行。这两个问题和预训练表征的可压缩性直接相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than “does fusion improve the average score?” In training-free fusion between heterogeneous, cross-scale MLLMs, what capabilities actually transfer from the larger model to the smaller one, where those transferable signals reside, and how layer mapping, parameter scope, and injection strength shape the outcome. Prior heterogeneous fusion work mostly reports aggregate gains, which makes it hard to separate genuine knowledge transfer from architectural mismatch and interference. This work reframes fusion as a local probing problem: inject a small projected parameter direction and measure capability-specific response.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. CDPI provides a concrete way to study transferability in parameter space and decomposes local transfer into a first-order beneficial signal and a second-order structural interference term. That perspective is useful beyond model fusion: it also informs cross-scale distillation, continual pretraining, parameter reuse during mid-training, and more generally the question of which capabilities are locally portable across models. The main empirical message is sharp: transfer is highly capability-selective, high-level reasoning transfers much more readily than perception, most of that gain lives in the LLM rather than the vision stack, and positive transfer only survives in a narrow low-ratio regime.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is Cross-Scale Directional Parameter Injection (CDPI). Given a larger source MLLM and a smaller target MLLM from the same family, the model is partitioned into three components: vision encoder (ViT), cross-modal projector, and LLM. An injection space E=(C,P) specifies which components are selected and whether the injection is restricted to linear-layer parameters or extended to all alignable parameters. Because source and target differ in hidden size, attention-head count, and LLM depth, the paper defines a heterogeneous alignment operator A_pi that projects source parameters into the target parameter space. The layer mapping pi controls how source LLM layers are matched to target layers.

After obtaining the projected source direction Δ, the target is perturbed without training: Θ_F = Θ_T + αΔ. The point is not to perform aggressive fusion, but to scan α, parameter scope, component choice, and layer mapping, and then observe capability-specific local changes.

The theoretical analysis uses a second-order expansion around the target parameters. For a capability-specific loss L_c(Θ), the local gain is approximated by a first-order term αA_c minus a second-order term proportional to α^2 I_c, where A_c = -∇L_c(Θ_T)^TΔ is the transfer signal and I_c = Δ^T H_c Δ is the curvature response. This decomposition is the conceptual center of the paper. It explains why the same injected direction can help reasoning but barely affect perception, and why gains vanish once α becomes too large: the first-order alignment may be positive, but structural interference grows quadratically.

Unlike standard model merging, the method is not trying to build the best merged model, and it does not rely on learned mappings. It is a controlled probe for transferability. One notable design choice is the comparison between linear-only and full-parameter injection. The results suggest that transferable knowledge is more concentrated in linear transformations than in the full set of alignable weights, which is an interesting clue about where portable computation lives in MLLMs.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use four Qwen3-VL cross-scale model pairs and evaluate them on twelve benchmarks. The most informative results are capability-wise rather than aggregate.

First, gains are concentrated in reasoning, especially high-level reasoning, while perception remains close to the original target performance. This suggests that training-free cross-scale fusion is much better at transferring high-level decision or language-side computation than low-level visual competence.

Second, component-level ablations show that the LLM carries most of the high-level reasoning gains. Injecting the ViT or projector does not produce comparable positive transfer. This is consistent with the idea that visual capability is more tightly coupled to representation geometry and encoder-specific details, making it less amenable to local linear projection.

Third, restricting injection to linear-layer parameters is usually more efficient and more stable than injecting all alignable parameters. Full-parameter injection may contain more useful signal, but it also introduces substantially more structural conflict, which matches the second-order analysis.

Fourth, both layer mapping and injection ratio are highly sensitive. Effective layer mappings depend on the specific source-target pair; there is no universal best mapping. Positive selective transfer appears only in a narrow low-α regime, and performance degrades quickly as α increases, consistent with a linear benefit term competing against a quadratic interference term.

The most useful ablations are the capability breakdown, component-wise injection, linear-vs-full comparison, and α sweeps. Those are where the paper’s actual contribution sits.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes: setup, theory, then ablations.

Start with the introduction and the main method figure to lock in the paper’s goal. CDPI is not proposed as a stronger fusion recipe; it is a probe for transfer mechanisms. Missing that point makes the rest look underpowered when it is actually intentionally controlled.

Then focus on the definitions of the injection space, the alignment operator, and the layer mapping. These choices determine what is being held fixed and what is being varied. Pay attention to why the paper separates ViT, projector, and LLM, and why it distinguishes linear-only from full-parameter injection.

The theory section is worth careful reading, especially the interpretation of A_c and I_c. The formula itself is simple; the value lies in the explanation. Most empirical findings in the paper are direct manifestations of that decomposition.

In the experiments, prioritize four groups of figures/tables: capability-specific gains, component-level ablations, linear vs full injection, and layer-mapping / α sweeps. Around 30–45 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If reading more deeply, the two questions worth pursuing are: why reasoning appears more locally linear and portable than perception, and why transferable directions in the LLM survive cross-scale projection better than those in the vision stack.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫理论和能力分解图；它把模型融合从总分游戏拉回参数方向和曲率，结论需看setup干净度。
recommendation.en: Skim the theory and capability breakdowns; it moves fusion analysis beyond aggregate scores, but the setup cleanliness decides how much to trust it.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Thinking Under Uncertainty: Evidence Use and Information-Seeking in Language Models
paper.abstract: Inference-time thinking improves the performance of large language models, but aggregate outcomes do not reveal whether models use available evidence more effectively or seek information that could improve future decisions. We distinguish these responses by measuring action preference, thinking length, and reported confidence under matched uncertainty. Ten open-weight models completed matched horizon-style two-armed bandit trials in thinking and non-thinking modes. A cognitive model separated va

summary.core_problem: 推理期“思考”（chain-of-thought / reasoning trace）到底是让模型更好地利用已有证据，还是让模型更主动地寻找能减少不确定性的信息，现有工作只用聚合性能指标无法区分这两种效应。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于预训练方法本身，但对理解 reasoning 模型的行为边界有参考价值：它把“思考提升性能”拆成了证据利用、信息搜寻、元认知监控/控制几个可测量的成分，结论是思考主要强化价值一致的行动、降低噪声，并没有让模型表现出更强的主动探索/信息搜寻行为。这个判断对解释 o1/R1 类模型在训练后出现的“会思考但未必会主动收集信息”现象有启发，也提示 post-training 阶段如果要获得真正的信息寻求策略，需要显式训练信号，而不能仅依赖更长的思考链。
summary.technical_approach: 作者采用心理学中的 horizon two-armed bandit 范式，在受控的不确定性条件下测试十款开源模型（Gemma 4、GPT-OSS、Nemotron 3、Qwen 3.5/3.6 系列）。实验分思考/非思考两种模式，观测三个输出：动作选择、思考长度、报告的置信度。核心分析工具是一个认知模型，把行为分解为四项：价值导向的动作选择（value-guided action）、UCB 式的偏好奇知臂、Thompson 式的随不确定性增加而升高的选择变异性，以及与不确定性无关的选择噪声。之后再通过调整 temperature/top-p/top-k 的 decoder sweep 检查观察到的效应是否只是采样参数变化带来的。
summary.experiments: 在匹配的 warm-up history 和三种观测计数条件（(1,1)/(3,3)/(2,6)）下，思考模式一致增强了价值导向选择、降低了不确定性无关噪声，但没有显著提升 UCB-like 或 Thompson-like 这两种信息搜寻特征。思考长度会随信息不平衡历史变长，报告置信度对决策难度和证据强度更敏感。decoder sweep 表明单纯改变采样参数不能复现这组跨输出模式，因此效应不是简单的“思考模式 = 温度更低/更高”。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Introduction 里四个假设（行为收敛、信息搜寻、元认知控制、元认知监控），再看 cognitive model 对四种行为成分的分解图和结果表。decoder sweep 部分值得看，因为它排除了“思考只是改变采样分布”这个过于简单的解释。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Aggregate performance gains from inference-time thinking do not distinguish between two possible mechanisms: better use of available evidence versus active information-seeking that reduces uncertainty for future decisions.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining method paper, but it is useful for reasoning about post-trained reasoning models. It decomposes the behavioral effect of thinking into evidence use, information-seeking exploration, metacognitive control, and metacognitive monitoring, and finds that thinking mainly strengthens value-consistent action and reduces noise rather than producing genuine exploration. This is a useful constraint on interpreting o1/R1-style behavior: longer chains alone do not implement an active information-acquisition policy unless the training objective explicitly rewards it.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt the horizon two-armed bandit paradigm from cognitive psychology and test ten open-weight models across Gemma 4, GPT-OSS, Nemotron 3, and Qwen 3.5/3.6 families, with and without thinking. They measure three outputs under matched uncertainty: action choice, thinking length, and reported confidence. A cognitive model decomposes behavior into value-guided action, UCB-like preference for the less-known arm, Thompson-like uncertainty-dependent choice variability, and uncertainty-independent choice noise. A decoder sweep over temperature, top-p, and top-k tests whether the observed pattern can be reproduced by sampling changes alone.
summary_en.experiments: Across controlled warm-up histories with observation-count conditions (1,1), (3,3), and (2,6), thinking consistently strengthened value-guided action and reduced choice noise, but did not increase either UCB-like or Thompson-like exploration signatures. Thinking length increased under information-imbalanced histories, and reported confidence became more sensitive to decision difficulty and evidence strength. The decoder sweep showed that changing sampling parameters alone could not reproduce the full cross-output pattern.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Read the introduction for the four candidate accounts, then the cognitive-model decomposition and the main behavioral results. The decoder-sweep section is the most informative control because it rules out a trivial “thinking is just temperature tuning” explanation. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和行为分解；它把“thinking 提升推理”修正为“更会利用证据，但不更会探索”。
recommendation.en: Read the behavioral decomposition; it reframes thinking gains as better evidence use, not stronger exploration.

paper.title: From Representations to Behaviors: Exploring the Person-Situation-Behavior Triad in LLMs
paper.abstract: Human personality theories characterize traits not as isolated attributes captured by a single score, but as stable individual tendencies expressed through the interplay among persons, situations, and behaviors. Existing studies of personality-related behavior in LLMs have primarily focused on outputs elicited under personality conditioning, characterizing observable trait-related expressions while lacking mechanistic evidence for the existence of internal personality-related representations, th

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 是否存在可发现、可控制、跨情境表达的 personality-related internal representations，并分析这些表示如何影响社会行为输出。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析框架，而不是预训练方法。它把人格研究从 prompt-conditioned output 评测推进到内部表示、情境和行为三者关系的分析，对表示控制和 persona 安全有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文借用 Funder 的 person-situation-behavior triad：Person 对应人格相关内部表示，Situation 对应触发特质表达的上下文，Behavior 对应更广泛社会任务中的响应模式。方法包括通过对比行为发现表示、控制表示并验证行为变化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型列表、参数量、任务规模、控制强度或定量结果。可确认的是论文进行了发现、控制和验证三步实验，但具体 baseline 和效果需要看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Peking University 和 Beijing Institute of Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper investigates whether LLMs contain controllable personality-related internal representations and how those representations shape behavior across situations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic analysis framework rather than a pretraining method. It moves personality studies beyond prompt-conditioned outputs toward representation-level evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework adapts Funder's person-situation-behavior triad: Person maps to internal trait-related representations, Situation to contexts that afford trait-relevant responses, and Behavior to response patterns on social tasks. The paper uses contrastive behavior to discover, control, and validate these representations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model families, parameter counts, dataset size, baselines, or quantitative gains. It indicates experiments for representation discovery, control, and validation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Peking University and Beijing Institute of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 人格方向偏应用机制；若关心 activation steering 可看方法框架，不必为 pretrain 决策读全篇。
recommendation.en: This is persona-oriented mechanism work; read the steering framework if relevant, but it should not drive pretraining decisions.

paper.title: Do Latent Channels Actually Communicate? A Causal Audit of Latent Multi-Agent LLM
paper.abstract: Latent communication in large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) transmits continuous internal representations instead of text, but greater representational capacity does not establish that the receiver uses task-relevant information. End-task performance alone also cannot reveal whether an observed effect depends on message presence, content generated for the evaluated example, or information supplied by a separate agent. We introduce a causal audit that applies controlled mes

summary.core_problem: 解决 latent multi-agent LLM 中“连续隐表示是否真的在传递并被利用了任务相关信息”这一因果可识别性问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析与评估方法。它不提出新的 agent 架构，而是指出仅看最终任务分数无法判断 latent communication 是否真正起作用，这对后续做多智能体、隐通信、甚至中间表征蒸馏的人有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 causal audit，在 sender 输出表示进入 receiver 的边界处做受控消息替换。通过四种消息设置，定义五类测量：sender 信息编码量、receiver 对消息存在与身份的敏感性、样本特异内容的任务价值，以及独立 agent 额外提供的信息价值。核心是把“有消息”“什么消息”“是否来自另一个 agent”拆开测。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的 latent relay 设置，在 GSM8K、ARC-C、MATH-500 上做审计。摘要给出 GSM8K 上 Qwen3-4B 的总体性能效应仅约 -1.00 个百分点的量级，说明 latent channel 的表面容量不等于有效通信；但从摘要看，规模和任务都较有限，更像诊断性 study 而非定论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems actually carries task-relevant information that the receiver uses, rather than merely existing as a high-capacity channel.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-evaluation contribution, not a new agent architecture. Its value is methodological: end-task accuracy alone cannot tell whether latent messages matter, what content matters, or whether gains truly come from another agent.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a causal audit that intervenes exactly at the sender-to-receiver message boundary. With four controlled message settings, they derive five measurements covering sender information encoding, receiver sensitivity to message presence and identity, the value of example-specific content, and the incremental value of having a separate agent.
summary_en.experiments: The audit is applied to latent relay with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on GSM8K, ARC-C, and MATH-500. The abstract reports only about a -1.00 percentage-point overall effect on GSM8K for Qwen3-4B, suggesting that apparent latent-channel capacity may translate into little usable communication. The study is informative but still small-scale and diagnostic.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 latent communication、hidden-state routing 或中间表征蒸馏，只读审计设计和替换实验即可；结论不大，但测量框架是干净的。
recommendation.en: If you care about latent communication, hidden-state routing, or representation passing, read the audit design and replacement tests; the headline is modest, but the measurement setup is clean.

paper.title: What Can Latent World Models Know? Physical Parameter Identifiability in Multimodal Predictive Representations
paper.abstract: A central premise of latent world models is that predicting the future forces a representation to internalize the physics of its environment. Which physical quantities does a trained latent actually contain, and what decides this? We answer with controlled interventions in POKEWORLD, an interactive environment whose visually identical objects hide mass, drag, and contact stiffness. summary.core_problem: 回答 latent world model 的表示到底能不能学到隐藏物理参数，以及哪些训练信号决定参数是否进入 latent。
summary.importance: 这是一个机制分析工作。它用受控环境和可恢复性证书区分“环境中不可观测”和“目标函数没有保留”两种失败原因，对预测式表示学习、world model 训练目标设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 POKEWORLD 交互环境，其中视觉上相同的物体具有隐藏的 mass、drag、contact stiffness。先用 certificate-gated protocol 证明某个物理参数可从原始观测恢复，再检查训练后的 latent 是否包含该参数。分析输入模态、预测目标和预测步长对参数可识别性的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出一个关键结果：contact stiffness 只有在模型被要求预测 touch 时才进入 latent，R^2=0.50；如果同样的触觉信号只是作为输入融合而不是预测目标，R^2=-0.02。摘要还指出，在 single-step prediction 下，vision-only latent 甚至会丢弃原本可从视觉恢复的参数。未提供模型规模和完整 baseline 列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which hidden physical parameters are actually represented inside latent world models, and what training signals determine whether those parameters enter the latent state.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism study. By separating raw-observation recoverability from latent retention, it clarifies whether a missing physical variable is due to the environment or to the predictive objective. The result is relevant to predictive representation learning and world-model objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use POKEWORLD, an interactive environment where visually identical objects hide mass, drag, and contact stiffness. A certificate-gated protocol first verifies that a parameter is recoverable from raw observations, then measures whether the trained latent encodes it. They vary input modalities, prediction targets, and prediction horizon.
summary_en.experiments: One headline result is that contact stiffness enters the latent only when touch is forecast, with R^2=0.50, while merely fusing the same touch signal into the input gives R^2=-0.02. The abstract also reports that under single-step prediction, a vision-only latent can discard parameters that are recoverable from vision. Model scale and full baselines are not available from the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和实验主表即可；它把“输入可见”和“目标保留”拆开，对设计预测式预训练目标有用。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and main result table; the clean separation between observability and target-driven retention is the useful part for predictive pretraining objectives.

paper.title: A scaling law of contextual persistence in human language
paper.abstract: Human language exhibits lawful structure at the level of words (frequency, vocabulary growth) and word pairs (co-occurrence across distance). Here we show that the arrangement of words in sequence -- a central determinant of meaning -- obeys a comparable law. Using large language models as probabilistic probes, we measured the reduction in target perplexity conferred by prior context at distance d beyond that of the same words scrambled; this difference, the contextual persistence function P(d),

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“语言有长程依赖吗”，而是更细的一层：在固定词汇内容和大致话题信息之后，词序本身对未来词预测的影响，随距离如何衰减。以往 Zipf、Heaps、长程 mutual information 这些统计规律，要么只看词频，要么看词对共现，无法把“同一批词以不同顺序排列”带来的信息单独剥离出来。作者用大语言模型作为概率探针，定义 contextual persistence function, CPF：当逐步揭示更远处的真实上下文时，目标 token 的 surprisal 下降了多少；再减去把同样上下文打乱顺序后的下降量，剩下的就是纯粹由顺序结构贡献的预测增益。核心问题因此被精确定义为：自然语言中，order-specific contextual influence 是否存在稳定的距离律，以及这个律是否跨语言、跨体裁、跨模态成立。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它给“长上下文为什么有用”提供了一个比 perplexity-length curve 更干净的分解：不是单纯更多词更有用，而是有一部分收益明确来自远距离顺序结构，而且这一部分近似按 1/d 衰减。第二，这个结果为语言建模目标提供了新的诊断量。标准 next-token loss 把 lexical content、topic recurrence、order dependence 混在一起；CPF 试图把其中的 arrangement signal 单独量化，这对分析 AR LM 学到了什么、长程依赖是否真实被利用、不同架构是否更擅长保留顺序信息，都有直接启发。第三，它对 scaling law 研究有方法论价值：作者不是再拟合 loss 对 compute 的幂律，而是提出一个“语言本身的统计律”，并用 LLM 作为测量仪器去估计。这种思路对 tokenizer、masked/any-order LM、长上下文架构、memory 机制的比较都可能有用。贡献量级上，它更像一个新的测量框架和经验规律，而不是直接改变训练 recipe 的方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
