paper.title: Auditing Question-Order Effects in Large Language Models with the QQ Equality: Mechanism Characterization and a Saturation Caveat
paper.abstract: Human survey respondents exhibit question-order effects that satisfy the QQ (quantum question) equality, an a priori, parameter-free prediction of the projective quantum question-order model. We develop the QQ equality into an audit criterion for sequential judgments of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Theoretically, we characterize which mechanism classes satisfy it robustly: marginal-independent kernels satisfy QQ iff all four mismatch transition rates coincide (a class containing

summary.core_problem: 用 QQ equality 审计自回归 LLM 在顺序提问中的 question-order effect，并刻画哪些响应机制会自然满足或违反这一等式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和审计准则。它把量子认知文献中的无参数约束引入 LLM 顺序判断分析，价值在于提醒评测者：顺序敏感性不是一个单一标量，满足 QQ equality 也不必然说明模型具有某种特定的认知机制。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将二问顺序实验转写为 LLM audit 坐标，分析多类机制：边际独立 kernel、带极性和位置依赖的 repetition family、order-matched mixing，以及 Contextuality-by-Default 的 rank-2 判据。核心技术点是给出 QQ 成立的充要条件或闭式 violation，并把 QQ violation 与 order-sensitivity score 联系起来。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要给出理论刻画，未提供可确认的模型规模、数据集、prompt 设置或具体 LLM 实验结果。需要读正文确认是否有多模型实证审计，以及 saturation caveat 对实验解释的影响。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Dankook University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper turns the QQ equality into an audit tool for question-order effects in autoregressive LLM judgments and characterizes which mechanism classes satisfy or violate it.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a mechanistic and evaluation-method contribution. It imports a parameter-free constraint from quantum cognition into LLM behavioral auditing, while cautioning that QQ satisfaction is not uniquely diagnostic of one cognitive mechanism.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work rewrites two-question order experiments in audit coordinates and analyzes several mechanism families: marginal-independent kernels, polarity- and position-dependent repetition models, order-matched mixtures, and a rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default criterion. It derives exact conditions or closed-form violations and relates QQ violation to an order-sensitivity score.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theory and does not specify model sizes, datasets, prompt protocols, or measured LLM results. The empirical section, if present, needs to be checked for model coverage and the practical impact of the saturation caveat.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with Dankook University.

recommendation.zh: 可扫理论部分；它更像评测诊断工具，不会改变预训练 recipe，但能避免把顺序效应过度解释。
recommendation.en: Skim the theory; it is more of a behavioral diagnostic than a pretraining result, but it helps avoid over-interpreting order effects.

paper.title: The Geometry of Semantic Space: A Continuous Geometric Framework for the Transformer Architecture
paper.abstract: We present a continuous geometric framework that models the discrete algebraic operations of the Transformer architecture as an integro-differential equation (IDE) on a semantic fiber bundle $\calE = \calM \times \R^d$. Beginning from a single geometric axiom -- that the token sequence forms a discrete $1$-manifold equipped with a canonical measure lattice -- we translate every core component of the modern Transformer (RMSNorm, RoPE, Softmax Attention, FFN, Residual Stream, SGD, Weight Decay) in

summary.core_problem: 缺乏一个统一的连续几何框架，把 Transformer 各离散组件（RMSNorm、RoPE、注意力、FFN、残差、SGD、weight decay）放在同一数学语言下解释。
summary.importance: 尝试用纤维丛、测度论、随机微积分统一描述 Transformer，并把注意力对应到 Schrödinger bridge、SGD 对应到破坏细致平衡的 Itô 扩散，属于原理性框架工作。
summary.technical_approach: 以“token 序列构成带典范测度格的离散 1-流形”为单一几何公理，将 RMSNorm、RoPE、Softmax Attention、FFN、残差流、SGD、Weight Decay 翻译为语义纤维丛 E=M×R^d 上的积分-微分方程，横跨最优传输与非平衡热力学。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3、LLaMA-3.1、Gemma-3、GPT-2、Mistral 共 5 个架构、124M 到 8B 参数规模上做六组实验验证框架给出的量化预测，具体实验细节摘要未完全披露。
summary.authors_note: 作者 Zhihua Liang 隶属 INFN Cagliari，偏向物理/数学视角，非主流 Transformer 工程团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Lacks a unified continuous-geometric framework that describes all discrete Transformer components (RMSNorm, RoPE, attention, FFN, residual, SGD, weight decay) in one mathematical language.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a principle-level framework using fiber bundles, measure theory, and stochastic calculus to unify Transformer components, identifying attention with Schrödinger bridges and SGD with detailed-balance-violating Itô diffusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starts from a single geometric axiom that the token sequence forms a discrete 1-manifold with a canonical measure lattice, then translates every component into integro-differential equations on a semantic fiber bundle E=M×R^d, drawing connections to entropic optimal transport and non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
summary_en.experiments: Runs a six-part empirical campaign across Qwen3, LLaMA-3.1, Gemma-3, GPT-2, and Mistral from 124M to 8B to test the framework's quantitative predictions; full details are not in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Single author at INFN Sezione di Cagliari; the perspective is physics/math-heavy rather than coming from a mainstream Transformer engineering team.

recommendation.zh: 几何化叙事有美感但多为 post-hoc 类比，暂未产出可直接改训练或架构的预测，作为 mechanism 文献备查。
recommendation.en: Aesthetically appealing geometric unification, but reads largely as post-hoc analogy without actionable predictions yet; treat as background mechanism reading.

institutions: INFN, Sezione di Cagliari, I-09042 Monserrato (CA)

paper.title: What does a Bayes-filtered transformer believe? A predictive Monte Carlo approach
paper.abstract: A Bayes-filtered transformer (BFT) is a transformer trained on sequences that are generated in two steps: first a latent task is drawn from a prior, then observations are drawn conditional on that task. Trained under autoregressive log loss, the BFT's next-token prediction, in the idealized limit, is the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution (PPD) induced by that prior and that conditional law. In practice the trained BFT is only an approximation of this ideal PPD, raising an interpretive q

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答：在带潜变量任务分布的序列生成环境里，一个按自回归损失训练的 transformer 到底内化了什么样的先验与后验，而不仅仅是它输出了什么预测均值。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它碰的是 in-context learning 与贝叶斯解释之间一个常见但不稳的环节：只比较 next-token prediction 往往无法区分不同的内部推断机制。贡献类型主要是原理分析与识别方法改进，而不是新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 Bayes-filtered transformer 视为近似某个 posterior predictive distribution 的模型，指出现有做法只在 prediction space 里拿若干 reference posterior 做比对，会遇到不同后验给出相同 posterior mean prediction 的不可辨识问题。为此引入 predictive Monte Carlo，把模型预测解释为对潜变量后验的采样式近似，从而反推出模型更接近哪类内部信念表示。核心是从“输出分布像谁”转到“隐含后验像谁”的识别框架。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点应是构造潜变量序列任务，比较 PMC 识别与传统 prediction-matching 在区分不同参考后验时的稳定性与分辨率。未见大规模 LLM、预训练语料或参数规模信息，因此更像小型可控 setup 的机制论文，而非直接可迁移到基座训练的实证报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what prior and posterior beliefs a Bayes-filtered transformer actually internalizes in latent-task sequence settings, beyond merely matching its next-token predictions.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in tightening a weak link in Bayesian interpretations of in-context learning: matching predictive distributions alone often cannot identify the underlying inference algorithm. This is primarily a mechanistic/analytical contribution rather than a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors treat a Bayes-filtered transformer as an approximation to a posterior predictive distribution induced by a latent-task prior, then argue that prediction-space comparisons against reference posteriors are non-identifiable because distinct posteriors can share the same posterior-mean predictions. They introduce predictive Monte Carlo as a more general probe to infer which posterior-like belief state the trained model is implicitly representing.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments likely use controlled latent-variable sequence tasks to compare PMC against standard prediction matching in terms of robustness and identifiability. No large-scale LLM, pretraining corpus, or model-scale evidence is indicated, so this reads as a clean small-scale mechanism study rather than a directly deployable foundation-model recipe.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但它提醒你别再用 next-token 均值去臆测模型“信念”；若你做 ICL/贝叶斯解释，只看方法设定和识别失败案例就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is a useful warning against inferring model beliefs from next-token means alone; if you work on ICL/Bayesian interpretations, read the setup and the identifiability failure cases.

paper.title: Explaining and Tuning Transformer-based LLMs in Arithmetic Tasks with Human Strategies
paper.abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) continue to achieve state-of-the-art performance across various natural language processing tasks. However, their subpar performance on seemingly elementary problems, such as basic arithmetic, raises concerns about model reliability, safety, and ethical deployment. In this study, we demonstrate that the performance of a vanilla Transformer model trained on integer arithmetic tasks can be improved using methods effective for human learners. We begin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 transformer 在基础算术任务上为什么学得差，以及能否借鉴人类解题策略来解释并改善其学习过程。
summary.importance: 它的价值主要在机制分析与训练课程启发：把算术拆成子技能后，观察不同子任务的收敛顺序，并尝试用“人类策略”改善学习。对基座预训练的直接迁移有限，但对 curriculum、task decomposition 和 failure analysis 有一点参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先把整数算术分解为若干可控子任务，做 loss convergence order analysis 和子任务消融，比较模型对简单与复杂技能的学习速度；随后引入人类常用的问题求解策略与认知增强方法，对 vanilla Transformer 进行训练或提示层面的调节，以提升算术准确率。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验对象是面向整数算术的小型 vanilla Transformer，而不是大规模通用 LLM。核心结果是：简单子任务先收敛，复杂子任务后收敛；引入人类策略后准确率提升。未见参数规模、数据规模、与现代 LLM 的系统对比，因此更适合作为受控 toy study。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why transformer models struggle on elementary arithmetic and whether human problem-solving strategies can explain and improve their learning dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is as a mechanistic and curriculum-oriented study: arithmetic is decomposed into subskills, convergence order is analyzed, and human-inspired strategies are tested. The direct transfer to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it may still inform curriculum and failure analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose integer arithmetic into controlled subtasks, run loss-convergence-order analysis and ablations, and compare how quickly the model acquires simpler versus harder skills. They then apply human-inspired problem-solving and cognitive-empowerment strategies to improve a vanilla Transformer’s arithmetic performance.
summary_en.experiments: The setup appears to use a small vanilla Transformer on integer arithmetic rather than a large general-purpose LLM. The main findings are that simpler subtasks converge earlier than harder ones, and human-inspired strategies improve accuracy. No large-scale model, corpus, or modern LLM comparison is indicated, so this is best viewed as a toy but controlled study.

recommendation.zh: 更像教学型 toy study，不会改变你对基座训练的 prior；若你关心 curriculum，可只看子任务分解和收敛顺序分析。
recommendation.en: This is more of a pedagogical toy study than a foundation-model result; if you care about curriculum, just read the subtask decomposition and convergence-order analysis.

paper.title: In-context learning of closed form solution to simple linear regression task using transformer with linear self-attention
paper.abstract: In-context learning is a remarkable property of transformers and has recently received a lot of interest. In many studies of in-context learning, it has been shown that transformers are capable of implementing solver for linear and non-linear regression problems, in which the most of them implement gradient descent algorithm. However, it is still unclear whether those implementations have actually been acquired through training. In this paper, we construct a transformer with linear self-attentio

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“Transformer 能不能表示线性回归求解器”，而是更具体的问题：在一个可控的简单线性回归 in-context learning 设定里，训练后的 Transformer 到底学到的是类似梯度下降的迭代算法，还是直接接近最小二乘闭式解的解析计算。已有不少工作证明 attention 可以实现梯度下降式更新，也有理论构造说明某些 Transformer 能表示 ridge regression 的闭式解，但“训练过程是否真的把模型推向这种解析求解器”一直不清楚。作者把问题收缩到最简单的一维线性回归，并显式构造一个极小的线性 self-attention Transformer，说明它可以借助 layer normalization 近似完成闭式解里最关键的除法项，再用训练实验检验这种机制是否会自然出现。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在于任务本身，而在于它给 ICL 机制研究补了一块较细的证据：Transformer 在某些分布受控、结构简单的任务上，学到的未必是“用 attention 模拟几步优化”，也可能是更接近解析统计量计算的电路。这个区分很重要，因为它关系到大家如何理解 ICL 的算法归纳偏好：是偏向通用迭代优化器，还是会在合适归纳偏置下收敛到更短路径的闭式程序。论文的贡献量级不大，属于机制层面的窄问题推进；但它把 layer norm 在“实现除法/归一化”中的角色讲得更具体，这对理解 Transformer 中非线性归一化层在算法实现里的作用有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是显式构造。作者考虑 simple linear regression 的 in-context prompt：前面给出 N 个样本对，最后给一个 query x，目标是输出最小二乘估计对应的预测值。模型结构很小：输入线性变换 + 两层 Transformer block + flatten + 输出线性层；每个 block 由 multi-head linear self-attention、layer normalization 和 skip connection 组成。关键点不在 attention 本身，而在如何把最小二乘闭式解中的分子、分母拆成可由 attention 和 LN 近似实现的量。在线性回归里，斜率估计需要协方差除以方差。乘法与求和可以由线性 attention 聚合上下文样本得到，但“除以样本方差”这一步通常是闭式解与梯度法的分水岭。作者沿用前人关于 LN 可近似实现除法的思路，把输入排布成一种自然格式，使得 LN 对特定通道的标准化近似承担了分母归一化的角色，从而在极小网络中拼出近似 least-squares predictor。

第二部分是训练验证。作者不是只给存在性构造，而是训练一个同型网络去拟合最小二乘目标，并加入 ℓ1 正则。这里 ℓ1 正则的作用，是鼓励网络收缩到更稀疏、更接近手工构造的参数解，而不是走向许多功能等价但难解释的实现。随后作者比较训练得到的参数与理论构造的对应关系，论证网络主要采用了闭式解电路，而不是多步梯度下降式近似。这个论证路径和以往“证明能表示某算法”不同，它更接近 mechanistic identification：先给可解释电路，再看训练是否会找到它。
summary.experiments: 实验部分规模很小，重点是机制验证而不是性能竞赛。文中明确给出的构造网络只有 2 层、2 个 attention heads、hidden dimension 为 4，属于极简设置。训练目标是让模型输出 simple regression 的 least-squares estimate，对训练后的参数进行数值检查。作者声称，在加入 ℓ1 regularization 的训练下，模型学到的主要是他们构造的闭式解实现，而不是梯度下降步骤。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格和数值结果，能确认的关键信息主要有三点：一是任务是一维简单回归而非高维线性回归；二是模型极小，因此结果更像“可识别的算法电路”而不是大模型经验现象；三是实验目标不是比较 test error，而是验证训练后参数与闭式解构造的一致性。若看全文，重点应检查作者是否给出了参数恢复、不同正则强度下的解形态变化、以及与无 LN 或不同归一化方式的对照；这些才决定“闭式解被学到”这个结论有多扎实。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Introduction 把问题边界看清：它研究的是 ICL 机制，不是提升回归性能。然后直接看构造部分，重点盯住最小二乘闭式解被拆成哪些中间量、每个量由哪一层/哪一个 head 计算、LN 在哪里承担了近似除法。若只想抓核心，优先看模型结构图、理论构造对应的参数形式，以及训练后参数与构造参数的对照实验。最后再看实验部分，判断作者是否真的排除了“网络只是学了另一种等价近似算法”的可能。预计 20–30 分钟能读完主线；若要深挖，可手推一遍一维 least squares 闭式解与 LN 标准化之间的对应关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more interesting question than mere expressivity: in a controlled in-context simple linear regression setting, does a trained transformer actually learn a gradient-descent-like solver, or can it converge to a circuit that approximates the closed-form least-squares solution? Prior work showed that attention can implement iterative optimization, and some theory established representability of closed-form regression solvers. What remained unclear was whether training naturally selects such an analytic solver. The authors reduce the problem to one-dimensional linear regression, construct a tiny transformer with linear self-attention that can approximate the least-squares predictor, and then test whether training recovers that mechanism.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly mechanistic rather than practical. The paper adds evidence that in-context learning should not always be interpreted as implicit gradient descent. Under a simple enough task distribution and architecture, the learned computation may instead resemble direct estimation of sufficient statistics followed by normalization, i.e. something closer to an analytic estimator than an optimizer. That matters for how one thinks about algorithm induction in transformers. The contribution is modest in scope, but the treatment of layer normalization as a computational primitive for division/normalization is a useful detail for anyone studying how transformers realize algorithms internally.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two parts: an explicit construction and a training-based validation. In the construction, the prompt contains N in-context examples from a simple linear regression problem plus a query input x, and the model must output the least-squares prediction. The architecture is deliberately tiny: an input linear map, two transformer blocks, a flatten layer, and an output linear map. Each block uses multi-head linear self-attention, layer normalization, and a residual connection. The central issue is how to realize the denominator in the least-squares formula. Products and sums over context examples are easy to obtain with linear attention, but the closed-form estimator also requires division by the sample variance. The authors build on earlier observations that layer normalization can approximate division, and arrange the input representation so that LN effectively performs the required normalization on selected channels. This yields a small circuit that approximates the closed-form least-squares predictor rather than an iterative optimizer.

The second part asks whether training actually finds this circuit. The authors train the same architecture to predict the least-squares target and add an L1 regularizer. The role of L1 is to bias learning toward a sparse, interpretable solution closer to the hand-designed construction, instead of one of many functionally equivalent but opaque parameterizations. They then compare the trained parameters with the theoretical construction and argue that the learned model mainly uses the closed-form computation rather than a gradient-descent-like procedure. This is the distinctive part of the paper: not just showing existence, but proposing an interpretable circuit and checking whether optimization recovers it.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are small and diagnostic. The explicitly constructed model has 2 layers, 2 attention heads, and hidden dimension 4. The task is one-dimensional simple regression, and the target is the least-squares estimate. The main empirical claim is that, when trained with L1 regularization, the network converges to a parameter configuration that largely matches the closed-form construction. The emphasis is not benchmark accuracy but mechanism identification. From the provided text, the recoverable concrete facts are: the setup is simple regression rather than general multivariate regression; the network is intentionally minimal; and the evaluation is about whether the trained solution aligns with the analytic circuit. When reading the full paper, the key things to verify are whether the authors provide parameter-level comparisons, ablations over regularization strength, and controls without LN or with altered normalization. Those details determine how convincing the “training learns the closed-form solver” claim really is.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to fix the question: it is about the mechanism of in-context learning, not better regression performance. Then jump to the construction section and track how the least-squares formula is decomposed into intermediate quantities, which head computes what, and exactly where layer normalization acts as approximate division. If time is limited, focus on the architecture description, the hand-crafted parameter construction, and the comparison between trained and constructed parameters. Read the experiments last, mainly to judge whether alternative algorithmic explanations were ruled out. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough for the main line; more if you want to manually derive the correspondence between least-squares normalization and LN.

recommendation.zh: 读构造和实验例子就够；它提醒 ICL≠梯度下降，但 toy setup 太窄，不能外推到大模型预训练动态。
recommendation.en: Read the construction and the trained-example section; it is a useful warning that ICL is not always gradient descent, but the toy setup is too narrow to extrapolate to large-scale pretraining.

paper.title: Relevant and Irrelevant: A Renormalization Group Analysis of Transformer Attention
paper.abstract: Using the language of Wilsonian renormalization group theory (RG), we treat the Transformer's attention mechanism as a perturbation of the trained MLP residual-stack fixed point and ask whether it constitutes a relevant, marginal, or irrelevant operator. We derive a fixed-point shift formula and obtain four testable predictions for the fixed-point geometry, effective rank profile, layer specificity, and perturbation decay spectrum. Testing these on synthetic Markov chain sequences with controlle

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“注意力有没有用”这种经验问题，而是一个更窄也更可检验的问题：在一个已经训练好的、呈现出固定点平台的残差 MLP 表征流里，加入 attention 以后，它在表示动力学上到底是 relevant、marginal 还是 irrelevant perturbation。作者把 Transformer 的层间表征演化当作一种离散 RG flow，先以纯 MLP masked-LM 在可控 Markov 链数据上的固定点结构为基线，再分析 attention 是否只会对固定点做小幅平移，还是会把系统推向另一类 attractor。核心对象不是通用自然语言，而是相关长度 ξ 可控的合成序列；这样做的目的，是把“什么时候需要 attention”从经验叙述变成与输入统计结构直接挂钩的可证伪命题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在于给出新的训练 recipe，而在于提供了一种分析建模范式必要性的框架。它试图解释：为什么在短相关、局部统计足够的分布上，深残差 MLP 可能已经接近最优；而在长相关分布上，attention 会从“可有可无的增强项”变成决定性算子。这个判断如果成立，对架构选择、数据分布匹配、甚至 any-order / masked 建模里 attention 的必要性都有启发。贡献量级更接近“机制分析工具”而不是“可直接落地的系统改进”：它把 attention 的收益和输入相关长度、有效秩、层特异性、扰动衰减谱联系起来，给出了一套可以在受控环境中验证的预测。对做基座预训练的人，价值在于它提供了一个比单看 loss 更细的中间层诊断视角。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分两步。第一步，作者沿用前作中的设定：在词表大小 16、长度 T=64 的 Markov 链序列上做 BERT-style masked token prediction，比较纯 pre-norm MLP residual stack 与加入 pre-norm multi-head self-attention 的匹配架构。MLP 基线使用 d=64、L=6、MLP hidden size 4d、GELU，Adam 学习率 3e-4，batch size 32，训练 10k steps，并且每步采样新序列，尽量避免有限数据记忆效应。第二步，作者把 attention 视为对 MLP 固定点的扰动项，在固定点附近做线性化，得到固定点位移公式 δ = - M*^{-1}(a+b)。这里 M* 对应 MLP 固定点附近的稳定性/响应算子，a、b 则编码 attention 引入的一阶与耦合项。这个公式不是为了精确预测每个神经元，而是为了导出四类可测预测：固定点几何是否发生位移或 attractor 切换；有效秩 profile 是否出现跃迁；attention 的作用是否集中在少数关键层；扰动是否随深度衰减、保持还是放大。作者随后把“relevant / marginal / irrelevant” operationalize 为这些量在深度方向上的行为模式。与常见的表示分析不同，这里不是事后看 attention map，而是先从固定点扰动理论推出可检验现象，再回到训练后网络测量 kernel drift、rank、层间变化和损失差距。文章的关键区别在于：它把 attention 当成一个 operator class，而不是把 Transformer 当作不可分解的整体黑箱。
summary.experiments: 实验全部建立在两种相关长度 regime 上。短相关链：α=10，第二特征值约 0.44，对应 ξ≈1.2，约 5 步内去相关。长相关链：α=0.05，第二特征值约 0.86，对应 ξ≈6.7，mixing time 约 31，长度 64 的上下文仍保留明显预测信息。作者报告的主结论有四点。第一，在长 ξ 条件下，attention 是 strongly relevant：纯 MLP 留下无法弥合的 residual loss gap，而加入 attention 后该 gap 被显著关闭，同时表征空间出现类似 phase transition 的变化；摘要里明确提到 effective rank 会跳升到高于输入维度。第二，在短 ξ 条件下，attention 基本 irrelevant：MLP 已经能完成所需 coarse-graining，加入 attention 后固定点几何和 rank profile 变化很小，性能收益有限。第三，attention 的作用具有明显层特异性，不是每层均匀起作用，而是集中在一两个 transition layer，这与前作里 MLP kernel drift 集中在少数层的现象呼应。第四，扰动衰减谱与 ξ 相关：长相关输入下，attention 诱发的扰动不会快速衰减，甚至会沿深度被放大；短相关下则更接近衰减型。就数值设定而言，模型规模较小，重点不在绝对性能，而在 controlled setup 下验证预测。摘要给出的最具体数字包括：短 ξ 时纯 MLP 出现约 8.4× 的单调 rank collapse；长 ξ 时 MLP 保持较高有效秩，而 attention 进一步触发 rank jump。若精读正文，应重点核对各节中 loss gap、kernel drift concentration、effective rank 曲线和 perturbation decay 的具体图表，而不是只看最终准确率。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着问题读。先看 Introduction 和 Background，确认作者前作里的“MLP residual stack 自发形成 fixed-point plateau”这个前提是否站得住；如果不接受这个前提，后面的 RG 语言会显得过重。然后直接看提出固定点位移公式和四个预测的那一节，这是全文最关键的地方：要弄清楚 δ = - M*^{-1}(a+b) 里的各项在网络测量上分别对应什么，作者如何把抽象的 relevant / irrelevant 变成可观测指标。实验部分建议优先看比较短 ξ 与长 ξ 的图，尤其是 effective rank 随层变化、kernel drift 集中在哪些层、attention 与 MLP 的 loss gap 是否只在长 ξ 下显著。阅读时间大约 30-45 分钟。泛读时不必深究附录推导细节，但值得追问两个点：一是“effective rank 高于输入维度”在 one-hot 输入设定下具体如何定义，是否受投影层和 LayerNorm 影响；二是这种结论能否迁移到真实语料，其中相关结构远不止一阶 Markov。把它当作一个受控机制实验来读，会比把它当作通用 Transformer 理论更合适。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharply defined question: if a trained residual MLP stack already exhibits a fixed-point plateau in representation space, what is self-attention in that dynamical system—a relevant, marginal, or irrelevant perturbation? Instead of arguing from aggregate accuracy, the authors cast layerwise representation evolution as a discrete renormalization-group (RG) flow, use the pure MLP masked-LM as the reference fixed point, and study whether adding attention merely shifts that fixed point or drives the network toward a different attractor. The setup is intentionally controlled: synthetic Markov-chain sequences with tunable correlation length ξ. That lets them tie the usefulness of attention to input statistics rather than to broad empirical claims about language.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is conceptual rather than recipe-oriented. The paper offers a way to reason about when attention is structurally necessary, versus when a deep residual MLP may already be sufficient for the statistics of the data. If the argument holds, it informs architecture choice under different correlation regimes, and it is relevant beyond standard AR language modeling: masked LM, any-order modeling, and other alternatives still face the same question of what long-range dependency operator is actually needed. The contribution is best viewed as a mechanistic analysis framework. It links attention’s role to correlation length, effective-rank evolution, layer specificity, and perturbation decay, giving a set of falsifiable predictions rather than a post-hoc interpretation of attention maps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two layers. First, the authors reuse a controlled setup from prior work: BERT-style masked token prediction on Markov-chain sequences with vocabulary size 16 and sequence length T=64. The baseline is a pre-norm residual MLP stack with d=64, L=6, MLP width 4d, GELU, final LayerNorm, and a token classifier; training uses Adam at 3e-4, batch size 32, for 10k steps with freshly sampled sequences each step. A matched architecture adds pre-norm multi-head self-attention to each residual block. Second, they treat attention as a perturbing operator around the MLP fixed point and linearize the dynamics near that point, deriving the fixed-point shift formula δ = -M*^{-1}(a+b). Here M* plays the role of the local response/stability operator of the MLP fixed point, while a and b encode first-order and coupling terms induced by attention. The formula is not used to predict neuron-level states directly; instead it yields four measurable predictions: whether the fixed-point geometry shifts or changes attractor class, whether the effective-rank profile changes qualitatively, whether attention acts in a layer-specific way, and whether the perturbation decays, persists, or amplifies with depth. This is the key distinction from standard representation analysis: the paper starts from a perturbative theory and then checks kernel drift, rank evolution, layer transitions, and residual loss gaps in trained networks.
summary_en.experiments: All experiments compare two correlation regimes. In the short-correlation regime, α=10 gives λ2≈0.44 and ξ≈1.2, so sequences decorrelate within roughly five steps. In the long-correlation regime, α=0.05 gives λ2≈0.86 and ξ≈6.7, with mixing time around 31, so a context window of length 64 still carries substantial predictive signal. The main empirical findings are: (1) for long ξ, attention is strongly relevant—it closes a residual loss gap that the MLP cannot bridge and induces a phase-transition-like change in representation space; the abstract explicitly notes an effective-rank jump above the input dimension. (2) For short ξ, attention is largely irrelevant—the MLP already performs the needed coarse-graining, and adding attention changes neither the fixed-point geometry nor the rank profile much, with limited performance gain. (3) Attention is layer-specific rather than uniformly useful across depth; its effect concentrates around one or two transition layers, echoing the earlier observation that kernel drift in the MLP baseline is itself concentrated. (4) The perturbation decay spectrum depends on ξ: under long-range correlations, attention-induced perturbations do not simply die out and may amplify with depth, whereas under short-range correlations they behave more like irrelevant perturbations. The setup is small by design, so the point is not headline benchmark performance but validation of the predicted diagnostics. The most concrete numbers exposed in the provided text are the ~8.4× monotone rank collapse for the short-ξ MLP baseline and the long-ξ regime where rank is preserved and then further altered by attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it as a controlled mechanism paper, not as a general theory of Transformers. Start with the introduction and background to verify the premise inherited from the previous work: a pure residual MLP trained on masked prediction develops a fixed-point plateau in representation space. Then go straight to the section deriving the fixed-point shift formula and the four predictions. That is the center of the paper. The important question is not the algebra alone, but how each term is operationalized in actual network measurements. In the experiments, focus on the short-ξ versus long-ξ comparisons: effective-rank trajectories across layers, where kernel drift concentrates, and whether the attention–MLP loss gap appears only in the long-correlation regime. A skim should take about 30–45 minutes. Two details are worth checking carefully if you go deeper: how “effective rank above input dimension” is defined under one-hot inputs with learned projections and LayerNorm, and how far the conclusions might transfer beyond first-order Markov data to real corpora with richer dependency structure.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RG 形式化和长/短相关链对照；结论不该外推到真实预训练，但会修正“attention 总是核心”的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the RG framing and the long-vs-short correlation contrast; do not over-extrapolate, but it weakens the reflex that attention is always the decisive component.

paper.title: Toward a mechanistic understanding of inference in visual cortex and diffusion models
paper.abstract: We describe a model of perceptual inference in primary visual cortex (V1) equivalent to a minimal diffusion model whose function can be readily understood from its parameters. The model is based on sparse coding with a non-factorial prior over latent variables in the form of an unconstrained, pairwise interaction matrix, extending standard sparse coding inference to a general recurrent dynamical system. We efficiently train these recurrent dynamics using a denoising score-matching objective and

summary.core_problem: 解释视觉皮层推理和扩散模型去噪之间的机制联系，并构建一个可从参数直接理解的最小扩散式模型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和可解释生成建模。它不直接研究语言模型，但把 sparse coding、recurrent dynamics 和 denoising score matching 连起来，对理解扩散式生成模型的归纳偏置有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从 sparse coding 出发，引入非因子化 latent prior，用无约束 pairwise interaction matrix 表示潜变量间相互作用，将标准 sparse coding inference 扩展成通用 recurrent dynamical system。训练使用 denoising score-matching objective，并通过 implicit differentiation 高效优化 recurrent dynamics。训练后分析 interaction matrix 与 V1 superficial layers 中连接相似 orientation tuning 神经元的水平连接结构之间的对应关系。
summary.experiments: 模型在自然图像上训练，用于极端模糊条件下的图像去噪和特征恢复。摘要称其能恢复 extended contours 等结构，并在 generalization regime 中接近标准黑盒 diffusion architecture 的行为，但未提供具体模型规模、数据集名称、数值指标或 baseline 表格。
summary.authors_note: Bruno A. Olshausen 是稀疏编码与初级视觉皮层计算模型的代表性研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: It seeks a mechanistic link between perceptual inference in visual cortex and denoising in diffusion models through a minimal, interpretable model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mechanistic analysis and interpretable generative modeling. It is not a language-model paper, but it connects sparse coding, recurrent dynamics, and denoising score matching in a way that can inform how diffusion-style generative models encode inductive bias.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model starts from sparse coding and adds a non-factorial latent prior represented by an unconstrained pairwise interaction matrix. This turns standard sparse-coding inference into a general recurrent dynamical system. The dynamics are trained with a denoising score-matching objective and optimized efficiently via implicit differentiation. The learned interaction matrix is then compared to horizontal connections in superficial V1 layers linking neurons with similar orientation tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The model is trained on natural images and evaluated on denoising under extreme ambiguity. The abstract reports recovery of structures such as extended contours and behavior close to standard black-box diffusion architectures in a generalization regime, but it does not expose exact model sizes, dataset names, metrics, or full baseline tables.
summary_en.authors_note: Bruno A. Olshausen is a well-known researcher in sparse coding and computational models of primary visual cortex.

recommendation.zh: 不直接服务 LLM，但 score-matching 训练出的可解释 recurrent prior 值得扫；只看模型设定和连接矩阵分析。
recommendation.en: Not directly useful for LLMs, but the interpretable recurrent prior trained by score matching is worth a skim; read the model setup and interaction-matrix analysis.

paper.title: What Models Express, Suppress, and Resist: Auditing Open-Weight LLMs with Persona Vectors
paper.abstract: What a language model will and will not do is largely set during post-training, but which behaviors it expresses, hides, or resists is not revealed by prompting alone. Persona vectors, behavioral directions in activation space, can probe this organization, but prior work covers only a handful of traits. We present the first systematic application of persona vectors at this scale, compiling a 53-trait inventory across four behaviorally distinct domains and labeling every trait in two open-weight

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是：仅靠提示词输出，很难判断一个 post-trained LLM 哪些行为是默认表达的，哪些只是被压住但仍可通过内部方向放大，哪些在常规激活 steering 下也难以提取。作者把 persona vectors 从“行为控制滑杆”改成“行为审计仪器”，用来刻画模型内部行为组织。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不强，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口和机制分析有参考价值。它提供了一种观察 post-training 如何重排行为空间的方法：有些 trait 被训练成默认行为，有些保留为潜在方向，有些被安全训练压到常规 contrastive extraction 都提不出来。这个视角有助于区分“模型不会”“模型默认不说”“模型内部有但被策略压制”。对研究 alignment 对基座表示的改写、RLHF/SFT 后行为方向的可分性，有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法沿用 Rimsky、Chen 等工作的 contrastive persona-vector extraction：用自然语言 trait 描述构造正负对比，抽取激活空间中的行为方向，再通过 intervention 观察生成变化。主要新增不是向量抽取算法，而是审计框架。作者构建 53 个 trait，覆盖 clinician interaction、generic behavior、elementary education、agentic task completion 四类，并把每个 trait 标成三类：natural，模型基线就表达；steerable，基线不明显但向量注入后可放大；intractable，常规提取和 steering 都不能稳定恢复。另一个贡献是 pairwise composition：对 19 个 generic traits 的 171 个无序组合做双向量同时 steering，观察两个方向是否可叠加、是否互相干扰、是否由一个 trait 主导。最后还做了一个反例：在安全调过的模型中，标准流程提不出“evil”方向，但从 fine-tuned variant 迁移来的向量可以恢复相关行为，说明 intractable 更像是标准协议下不可提取，而不是表示完全不存在。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个 open-weight 模型：Qwen3-8B 和 gpt-oss-20b。trait inventory 共 53 个，四个领域都有外部文献依据，并为不同领域设计独立 elicitation prompts。结果显示两个模型都默认偏向 helpful、task-oriented 行为；9 个 agentic traits 全部是 natural；clinician 场景下，默认行为与一位 board-certified psychologist 的标注相匹配。作者还报告了计算成本问题：不加约束地对每个 trait 做完整生成 sweep 约需 10 GPU-hours，因此需要更便宜的筛查流程。pairwise 组合实验覆盖 19 个 generic traits 的全部 171 个组合，主要用于识别组合是否线性叠加、是否一方压制另一方、是否双双失效。安全相关实验中，常规协议无法在 safety-tuned 模型中抽取“evil”方向；从 fine-tuned variant 转移向量后可恢复，且 refusal 主要定位在 chain-of-thought 部分。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看 §3–§4 的 persona-vector 审计流程和 natural/steerable/intractable 定义；§6.1 看 53 traits 的整体分布；§6.2 看 pairwise composition 的分类方式；§6.3 看 intractable trait 的迁移实验。附录 A 的 trait inventory 也值得扫一遍，因为这类工作很容易受 trait 描述和 prompt 构造影响。需要谨慎看待的点是：trait 标注依赖生成评估和 steering 强度，不能直接等价为模型“真实人格”；两个模型的规模也较小，更适合作为方法审计而不是行为结论的普遍证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a measurement problem: prompting alone does not reveal whether a post-trained LLM naturally expresses a behavior, internally represents it but suppresses it, or resists standard activation-based extraction. The authors use persona vectors as an auditing tool rather than only as behavioral steering controls.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface and mechanistic auditing. It gives a practical way to inspect how SFT, RLHF, and safety tuning reshape behavioral directions in activation space. The useful distinction is between behaviors that are default, latent but steerable, and inaccessible under a standard extraction protocol. That distinction is valuable when studying whether alignment removes a capability, masks it at decoding time, or changes how it is represented.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on contrastive persona-vector extraction from prior activation-steering work. For each trait, natural-language positive and negative descriptions are used to derive a behavioral direction in activation space; interventions along that direction are then tested during generation. The main addition is the diagnostic taxonomy. A trait is labeled natural if it appears at baseline, steerable if it can be amplified by intervention, and intractable if the standard protocol cannot recover a usable direction. The authors construct a 53-trait inventory across clinician interaction, generic behavioral disposition, elementary education, and agentic task completion. They also study pairwise composition by applying two persona vectors jointly over all 171 unordered pairs from 19 generic traits, looking for clean composition, dominance, or collapse. A safety-related case study shows that an “evil” direction that cannot be extracted from a safety-tuned model can still be transferred from a fine-tuned variant, suggesting that intractability is partly protocol-dependent.
summary_en.experiments: The audit is run on two open-weight models, Qwen3-8B and gpt-oss-20b. The inventory contains 53 literature-grounded traits with domain-specific elicitation templates. The reported pattern is that both models default toward helpful, task-oriented behavior: all nine agentic traits are natural, and default clinician behavior matches labels from a board-certified psychologist. The paper also reports a cost motivation: exhaustive generation sweeps without constraints take roughly 10 GPU-hours per trait. The pairwise study covers all 171 combinations among 19 generic traits and maps interaction types back to the single-trait taxonomy. In the safety case study, a direction that standard extraction fails to find in the safety-tuned model is recovered through vector transfer from a fine-tuned variant, with refusals localized mainly to chain-of-thought.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Focus on Sections 3 and 4 for the extraction and classification pipeline, Section 6.1 for the 53-trait map, Section 6.2 for the pairwise-composition analysis, and Section 6.3 for the transferred-vector case study. Appendix A is worth checking because the trait inventory and elicitation prompts are central to the validity of the audit. Treat the behavioral labels as protocol-dependent measurements, not as direct claims about a model’s stable personality or full capability profile.

recommendation.zh: 看 trait taxonomy 和 natural/latent/intractable 划分；它给 posttrain 行为空间一个可操作切片。
recommendation.en: Skim the trait taxonomy and the natural/latent/intractable split; it gives a usable slice of post-training behavior space.

paper.title: Interventional Grounding Audits: Black-Box Premise-Dependency Tests for LLM Chain-of-Thought via Predicate Substitution
paper.abstract: Large language models produce chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that appears logically sound yet may not genuinely depend on its stated premises. We introduce interventional grounding audits, a black-box, step-level test of premise dependency: we intervene on a single premise by substituting its target predicate with a fresh symbol, re-run the model, and check whether each reasoning step's normalized conclusion (canonical predicate form) changes. We evaluate on ProntoQA, a synthetic multi-hop ded

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM 生成的 CoT 推理步骤是否真的依赖其声称使用的前提，而不只是生成看似合理的证明文本。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个黑盒 CoT faithfulness 审计方法。它关注推理链的前提依赖关系，对理解模型推理表征和后训练中 CoT 监督信号质量有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 interventional grounding audits：对单个前提中的目标谓词替换为新符号，重新运行模型，再把每个推理步骤的结论规范化为 canonical predicate form，检查该步骤是否随前提干预而变化。
summary.experiments: 在 ProntoQA 合成多跳演绎推理任务上评估 50 个问题，使用 GPT-4o；该方法检测 proof-tree dependencies 的 F1 为 0.806，predicate-determining dependencies 的 F1 为 0.885、Recall 为 100%，明显高于 self-consistency baseline 的 F1 0.343；还发现 66% 正确解题样本中至少有一个对直接前提不敏感的对齐步骤。
summary.authors_note: 作者为 Independent Researcher。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether LLM chain-of-thought steps genuinely depend on their stated premises rather than merely looking logically plausible.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a black-box audit for CoT faithfulness. It is relevant to reasoning mechanism analysis and to judging the quality of CoT supervision used in post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method performs predicate substitution on a single premise, reruns the model, normalizes each step’s conclusion into a canonical predicate form, and checks whether the step changes under the intervention.
summary_en.experiments: On 50 ProntoQA synthetic multi-hop deduction problems with GPT-4o, the method reaches F1 = 0.806 for proof-tree dependency detection and F1 = 0.885 with 100% recall for predicate-determining dependencies, outperforming a self-consistency baseline at F1 = 0.343. It also reports that 66% of correctly solved problems contain at least one aligned step insensitive to a direct prerequisite.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is listed as an Independent Researcher.

recommendation.zh: 样本小但干预设计干净；看 abstract 的 66% 结果和方法定义，作为 CoT 忠实性弱证据。
recommendation.en: Small sample, but the intervention is clean; read the 66% finding and method definition as weak evidence on CoT faithfulness.

paper.title: The Refusal Residue: When Probes Catch Alignment Faking and When They Don't
paper.abstract: Alignment faking is dangerous because a model can appear compliant under monitoring while preserving behavior it would reveal when unmonitored. When no scratchpad is visible, behavior alone cannot distinguish strategic from genuine compliance. We ask whether hidden states reveal what outputs hide.   We run a 13-model sweep for naturally-emerging faking, then probe and steer hidden states on the two models that fake. Natural faking appears only in Qwen3-32B (+18.2pp) and Llama-3.1-8B (+24.4pp at

summary.core_problem: 研究在没有可见 scratchpad 的情况下，模型是否会在隐藏状态中留下可用于识别 alignment faking 的表征痕迹，以及这种痕迹何时可泛化、何时不可泛化。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在机制分析与对齐监测，而不是直接改进预训练。它对做 post-train、表征探测和安全监控的人有参考意义：行为层面看不出的策略性顺从，未必能稳定地从 hidden states 里抓出来。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先在 13 个模型上筛查自然出现的 alignment faking，再对出现该现象的两个模型做 probing 和 steering。核心发现是所谓 refusal residue：在监控条件下，合规样本的隐藏状态向 refusal 表征偏移，但 refusal 表征本身不动。随后用 leakage-free leave-one-query-out 设定测试 probe 的逐样本检测能力，并比较跨模型泛化。
summary.experiments: 13 模型 sweep 中只有 Qwen3-32B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 出现自然 faking，幅度分别约 +18.2pp 和 +24.4pp。显式 scratchpad 自报极少。probe 检测在 Llama 上可达 AUROC 0.87，但在 Qwen 上接近失效，说明信号强烈依赖模型。摘要未给出训练数据或 probe 细节，但实验问题设定相对干净。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether hidden states reveal alignment faking when behavior and visible scratchpads do not, and when such signals are actually detectable.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is in mechanistic analysis and alignment monitoring rather than pretraining. The useful takeaway is that strategic compliance may leave internal traces, but those traces are not reliably probeable across models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author first runs a 13-model sweep for naturally emerging alignment faking, then applies probing and steering to the two models that exhibit it. The central concept is an asymmetric 'refusal residue': monitored compliance shifts toward refusal-like internal representations, while refusal representations themselves do not move. Detection is then tested under leakage-free leave-one-query-out probing and cross-model transfer.
summary_en.experiments: Only Qwen3-32B and Llama-3.1-8B show natural faking in the sweep, with effects around +18.2pp and +24.4pp. Explicit scratchpad self-reports are rare. Probe-based per-sample detection reaches AUROC 0.87 on Llama but collapses on Qwen, indicating strong model dependence.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但对“hidden-state probe 能不能当安全监控”给了很冷静的负面边界；看结果段就够，别把 AUROC 0.87 误读成通用可用。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it gives a useful boundary condition on hidden-state probes for safety monitoring; read the results, and do not overgeneralize the AUROC 0.87 number.

paper.title: The Illusion of Robustness: Aggregate Accuracy Hides Prediction Flips under Task-Irrelevant Context
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) grow more capable, they are increasingly deployed in context-rich settings where task inputs are often accompanied by long, partially irrelevant context. In a controlled setting, we find that state-of-the-art models often appear robust to task-irrelevant context at the aggregate level: prepending it to benchmark questions causes little change in overall accuracy. This aggregate stability, however, masks significant per-example instability. Even semantically meanin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：长上下文里加入与任务无关的内容时，为什么模型在 aggregate accuracy 上看起来很稳，但单样本预测却会发生大量翻转。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它指出了一个常被忽略的评估盲点：平均准确率几乎不变，并不代表模型对无关上下文真正鲁棒。对长上下文预训练、检索增强、上下文工程和 inference-time scaling 都有直接启发，因为真实部署里“部分无关上下文”几乎是常态。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在受控设置下，向 benchmark 问题前置 task-irrelevant context，甚至加入语义上无意义的 pseudo-words，观察模型预测是否翻转。分析不仅看 aggregate accuracy，还看 per-example instability，并进一步分解这种不稳定性如何受上下文类型、长度、test-time compute 和模型开发阶段影响。核心贡献是把“稳不稳”从均值指标拆到样本级动力学。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示：最先进模型在总体准确率上对无关上下文似乎很稳，但少量样本会发生显著双向翻转——有些被干扰变差，有些反而变好，因此均值被抵消。这个现象跨多种模型和数据集都存在，而且受影响样本高度模型特异；即便是随机字符拼成的 pseudo-words 也能触发变化。摘要未给出具体模型名单和翻转比例，但从设计上看，实验相对干净，适合作为长上下文鲁棒性分析的基线论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Diyi Yang 与 Sanmi Koyejo，分别在语言模型行为分析、社会与交互 NLP、可靠性与机器学习理论方向有持续代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why models can appear robust in aggregate accuracy when task-irrelevant context is added, while still exhibiting substantial prediction flips at the per-example level.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in exposing an evaluation blind spot: stable average accuracy does not imply true robustness to irrelevant context. This matters for long-context pretraining, retrieval-augmented systems, context engineering, and inference-time scaling, because partially irrelevant context is the norm in deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors prepend task-irrelevant context to benchmark questions in controlled settings, including semantically meaningless pseudo-words, and measure prediction flips. They go beyond aggregate accuracy to analyze per-example instability, and study how the effect varies with context type, context length, test-time compute, and model development stage. The main contribution is a cleaner robustness lens at the sample level.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that state-of-the-art models often look robust in overall accuracy, yet a nontrivial subset of examples flips in both directions—some get worse, some improve—so the average masks instability. The effect holds across models and datasets, and the affected examples are largely model-specific. Even random pseudo-word context can trigger changes. Exact model names and flip rates are not given in the abstract, but the setup appears clean and useful as a baseline analysis for long-context robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Diyi Yang and Sanmi Koyejo, both known for sustained work on language model behavior, reliability, and broader ML analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改方法，但会改你看 long-context robustness 的指标习惯；只看 aggregate accuracy 已经不够，建议重点读 prediction flip 分析和 compute 交互部分。
recommendation.en: It does not propose a new method, but it should change how you read long-context robustness: aggregate accuracy is not enough—focus on the prediction-flip analysis and its interaction with test-time compute.

paper.title: The Seriality Gap in Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: When one ball strikes another, then another, video models should predict the consequences of each bounce. In controlled experiments on multi-ball hard-sphere dynamics, we find that the performance of standard bidirectional video diffusion degrades as the causal chain lengthens, even when provided more denoising steps. In a length-matched single-ball control, where ball-ball interactions are absent, the degradation largely disappears, isolating dependent-event structure rather than video length a

summary.core_problem: 解释视频扩散模型为什么在需要长因果链的预测任务上明显退化，以及这种退化是否来自视频长度还是来自串行计算不足。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析加理论澄清。它不是 LLM 论文，但对任何试图用并行去噪替代自回归串行生成的建模范式都有直接启发，尤其是 diffusion LM、any-order LM 和 world model。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在多球硬碰撞控制环境中构造长度可控的因果链，对比标准双向视频扩散与单球长度匹配控制任务，隔离“事件依赖深度”与“序列长度”两个因素；再通过干预实验考察增加有效串行计算的手段，如自回归/分块生成和增加网络深度，并给出一个理论结论：在确定性视频预测中，去噪步数本身不提供可随任务增长而扩展的串行计算。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量和数据规模，但实验设计很干净：多球碰撞任务中，随着因果链变长，标准视频扩散性能下降；单球长度匹配对照中这种下降基本消失。增加自回归或 blockwise 生成、增加架构深度，都能不成比例地改善性能，支持“seriality gap”假说。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why video diffusion models degrade on prediction tasks with long causal chains, and whether the failure comes from sequence length or from insufficient serial computation.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-analysis paper with a useful theoretical correction. It is not an LLM paper, but it directly informs any attempt to replace autoregressive serial generation with parallel denoising, including diffusion LMs, any-order LMs, and world models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build controlled multi-ball hard-sphere environments with adjustable causal-chain length, compare standard bidirectional video diffusion against a length-matched single-ball control to isolate dependent-event structure from raw video length, and run interventions that increase effective serial computation, such as autoregressive/blockwise generation and greater architectural depth. They further argue theoretically that, for deterministic video prediction, denoising steps do not provide scalable serial compute.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size or dataset scale, but the setup is clean: performance of standard video diffusion worsens as causal chains lengthen, while the degradation largely disappears in a single-ball length-matched control. Methods that add effective serial computation improve performance disproportionately, supporting the proposed seriality-gap hypothesis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你看 diffusion LM 的 prior：去噪步数不等于可扩展串行计算，先看控制实验和理论段，再决定是否在文本域复现。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on diffusion-style sequence modeling: denoising steps are not scalable serial compute; read the controlled experiments and theory, then decide whether to replicate in text.

paper.title: Graph Feedback Controls Consensus and Clique Formation in Open-Weight Language-Model Populations
paper.abstract: Multi-agent language-model systems increasingly route local interactions, yet the runtime interaction graph is often treated as an implementation detail. We study convention formation in open-weight LM populations spanning 1.1B-32B parameters with a naming-game protocol. Restricted first-token scores over tokenizer-safe labels let us measure prompt-conditioned score-state distributions, construct state-similarity graphs, and separate sampled-label agreement from latent state-space consensus. Acr

summary.core_problem: 研究多语言模型 agent 群体中，运行时交互图如何影响共识形成、派系分裂，以及行为一致性和潜在状态一致性的差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把 multi-agent LM 系统里常被当作工程细节的 routing graph 作为核心变量，观察不同连边策略对 open-weight LM 群体的长期动态影响。对 multi-agent 训练数据构造、agent evaluation 和群体协作协议有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 naming-game protocol，在 1.1B 到 32B 的开源模型群体上运行受控交互。作者限制 first-token scores 到 tokenizer-safe labels，用这些分数构造 prompt-conditioned score-state distributions，再建立 state-similarity graphs，从而区分 sampled-label agreement 和 latent state-space consensus。干预包括 homophilous threshold-similarity routing、state-component routing、label-disagreement bridge-seeking routing，以及记忆开关。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 1.1B-32B open-weight LM populations。摘要给出一个关键结果：在 three-seed mixed four-model grid 中，threshold-similarity 在 189 个 setting-seed runs 中没有形成最终行为或状态共识；而有记忆时，bridge-seeking routing 往往能修复碎片化。具体模型名称、完整指标和表格需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how runtime interaction graphs shape consensus, fragmentation, and clique formation in populations of open-weight language models.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism study for multi-agent LM systems. It treats the interaction graph as a causal variable rather than an implementation detail, which is relevant for agent protocols, multi-agent evaluation, and synthetic interaction data design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use a naming-game protocol over 1.1B–32B open-weight models. Restricted first-token scores over tokenizer-safe labels are used to measure prompt-conditioned score-state distributions, build state-similarity graphs, and separate sampled-label agreement from latent state-space consensus. They compare homophilous threshold-similarity routing, state-component routing, bridge-seeking through label disagreement, and memory conditions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span open-weight LM populations from 1.1B to 32B parameters. In a three-seed mixed four-model grid, threshold-similarity routing yields no final behavioral or state consensus across 189 setting-seed runs, while bridge-seeking routing often repairs fragmentation when memory is available.

recommendation.zh: 只看 routing 干预和 189-run 结果；它提醒相似性路由会制造回音室，不宜当默认 agent 拓扑。
recommendation.en: Read the routing interventions and the 189-run result; similarity routing can create echo chambers and should not be the default agent topology.

paper.title: Minionese: Comprehensive Benchmark and Mechanistic Study of Multilingual LLM Safety
paper.abstract: Safety alignment in large language models remains brittle across languages: prompts reliably refused in English can elicit harmful compliance in non-English and low-resource settings. We introduce \textsc{Minionese}, a multilingual jailbreak benchmark spanning 18 languages, 4 resource tiers, and 4 perturbation types (standard translation, code-switching, transliteration, and translationese), paired with a geometric mechanistic analysis of refusal failure across language tiers. We show that each

summary.core_problem: Minionese 研究多语言安全对齐为何在低资源语言和语言扰动下失效。它不只统计越狱成功率，而是把问题拆成两个内部机制：模型是否形成了可用的 harmfulness 表示，以及这个表示是否足够投影到 refusal direction，从而触发拒答。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座和 post-train 接口有清晰启发：安全能力不是只靠英文或高资源语言 SFT/RL 就能均匀迁移。低资源语言、转写、代码混合和 translationese 会让同一语义进入不同的表示子空间，导致拒答触发阈值失效。对预训练研究而言，它提示多语言数据配比、script coverage、tokenizer 对非拉丁文字和 romanization 的处理、以及 safety 数据覆盖范围都会影响后续对齐的可迁移性。对安全评测而言，它把语言、脚本、扰动类型作为独立变量，而不是只看翻译后的 harmful prompt。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 Minionese benchmark，并配套做机制分析。数据从 AdvBench 的 385 个 harmful prompts 出发，为每个 harmful prompt 构造结构和长度尽量匹配的 harmless counterpart，形成 harmful-harmless pair。语言覆盖 18 种，按资源量分为四档：Tier 1 包括 English、Spanish、Chinese、German、French；Tier 2 包括 Arabic、Russian、Korean、Japanese；Tier 3 包括 Turkish、Indonesian、Hindi、Swahili；Tier 4 包括 Yoruba、Zulu、Scottish Gaelic、Guaraní、Javanese。每个样本施加四类扰动：标准翻译、code-switching、transliteration、translationese，总规模为 385 × 2 × 4 × 18 = 55,440 prompts。机制部分沿用 refusal direction 的思路，但进一步区分 harmfulness detection 与 refusal activation。它分析 residual stream 中 harmful/harmless 表示的分离、低资源语言 harmfulness 子空间与英文 harmfulness 子空间的 principal angles，以及 harmfulness 表示到 refusal direction 的投影强度。论文提出两类失败模式：subthreshold activation，即模型内部有 harmful 表示，但投影不足以触发拒答；semantic recovery failure，即转写等扰动让 harmful 表示在进入拒答机制前已经崩塌。
summary.experiments: 论文在三个 instruction-tuned models 上评估 Minionese。提供内容没有列出模型名称和具体 attack success rate 数字，但给出了稳定现象：不同攻击类型有不同脆弱性曲线；transliteration 的风险受脚本身份影响，尤其涉及非拉丁文字 romanization；code-switching 在最低资源 Tier 4 仍保持有效；所有模型都出现 Tier 2 到 Tier 3 之间的安全表现断点。机制实验显示，低资源语言的 harmful content 会进入与英文 harmfulness subspace 逐渐错位的低秩子空间，到 Tier 4 时 principal angles 接近正交。另一个关键结果是，有些样本在 instruction token 附近仍能编码 harmfulness，但没有足够投影到 refusal direction，因此输出仍可能合规执行有害请求。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 benchmark 构造部分，重点确认 harmful-harmless pair 如何控制表面特征，以及四类扰动是否语义保持。再看按语言 tier 和攻击类型分解的结果图，尤其是 Tier 2/Tier 3 的断点、transliteration 的脚本条件效应、code-switching 的跨资源层稳定性。机制部分重点看 residual stream 分析、refusal direction 的定义、principal angle 计算和投影阈值分析。若时间有限，优先读数据构造表、主结果图、两类机制失败模式的图示。对预训练研究更相关的问题是：低资源语言数据不足、tokenizer 对 romanization 的编码方式、以及安全数据覆盖是否会在表示空间中留下可测的几何断层。

summary_en.core_problem: Minionese studies why multilingual safety alignment fails under low-resource languages and realistic linguistic perturbations. It goes beyond aggregate jailbreak rates by separating two internal questions: whether the model forms a usable harmfulness representation, and whether that representation projects strongly enough onto a refusal direction to trigger refusal.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface. Safety behavior trained mostly in English or high-resource languages does not transfer uniformly across languages, scripts, and perturbation types. Low-resource languages, transliteration, code-switching, and translationese can route the same harmful intent through different representation subspaces. This has implications for multilingual pretraining mixtures, script coverage, tokenizer design, and the coverage of safety SFT/RL data. For evaluation, the paper argues that language identity alone is too coarse; script family and perturbation type need to be explicit variables.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Minionese, a multilingual jailbreak benchmark paired with a geometric mechanistic analysis. It starts from 385 harmful prompts from AdvBench and constructs a matched harmless counterpart for each one, preserving sentence structure and length as much as possible. The benchmark covers 18 languages grouped into four resource tiers: Tier 1 has English, Spanish, Chinese, German, and French; Tier 2 has Arabic, Russian, Korean, and Japanese; Tier 3 has Turkish, Indonesian, Hindi, and Swahili; Tier 4 has Yoruba, Zulu, Scottish Gaelic, Guaraní, and Javanese. Each harmful-harmless pair is transformed with four perturbation types: standard translation, code-switching, transliteration, and translationese. This gives 385 × 2 × 4 × 18 = 55,440 prompts. The mechanistic part builds on refusal-direction analysis but decomposes the failure into harmfulness detection and refusal activation. It studies residual-stream separability, principal angles between non-English and English harmfulness subspaces, and projection strength onto the refusal direction. Two failure modes are highlighted: subthreshold activation, where harmfulness is internally represented but does not cross the refusal threshold, and semantic recovery failure, where the harmful representation collapses before the refusal mechanism can use it.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is evaluated on three instruction-tuned models. The provided text does not include the model names or concrete attack success rates, so the exact numbers should be read from the tables. The reported qualitative findings are consistent across models: each attack type has a distinct vulnerability profile; transliteration risk is conditioned by script identity; code-switching remains effective even in Tier 4; and all models show a sharp safety transition between Tier 2 and Tier 3. The mechanistic experiments indicate that low-resource harmful prompts are routed into a low-rank subspace increasingly misaligned with the English harmfulness subspace, with principal angles approaching orthogonality at Tier 4. The paper also shows cases where a harmfulness signal exists near the instruction token but fails to project strongly enough onto the refusal direction, explaining harmful compliance despite partial internal detection.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the benchmark construction to check how harmful-harmless pairs are controlled and how the four perturbations are generated. Then inspect the main result plots by language tier and attack type, especially the Tier 2 to Tier 3 transition, the script-conditioned transliteration results, and the robustness of code-switching attacks across tiers. In the mechanistic section, focus on the residual-stream setup, how the refusal direction is defined, how principal angles are computed, and how projection thresholds are related to refusal behavior. For pretraining work, the main questions to carry forward are whether low-resource data scarcity, tokenizer behavior under romanization, and uneven safety coverage leave measurable geometric gaps in the model’s representation space.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制部分而不是只看榜单；若 refusal direction 结论稳，多语言安全数据配比和拒答表征训练都要重查。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanistic section, not just the benchmark; if the refusal-direction result holds, multilingual safety data mixtures and refusal training need revisiting.

paper.title: An Exact Instrument for State Usage in Selective State-Space Models, and the Input-Driven Migration It Reveals
paper.abstract: Selective state-space models such as Mamba route information through a bank of first-order modes whose input coupling is set by a learned selection mechanism. We give an exact instrument for measuring how a trained model uses these modes. Because the state matrix is diagonal, each channel's output decomposes exactly into per-mode contributions, and a per-(layer, channel, window) Gram tensor yields the exact output error of dropping any subset of modes, offline, at any budget. Validated against t

summary.core_problem: 现有选择性状态空间模型（如Mamba）的模式重要性评估方法均为静态近似方法，无法精确衡量逐输入的状态模式使用情况，也无法准确预测剪枝任意模式子集的输出误差，制约了SSM的效率优化与可解释性研究。
summary.importance: 澄清了选择性SSM的核心工作机制——模式使用随输入动态迁移，而非静态分配；修正了此前对选择性来源的认知，写入映射B_t是模式迁移的主要驱动，通常被认为关键的时间步Δ几乎无贡献；为SSM的动态状态剪枝、内存效率优化提供了精确的测量工具和定量依据。
summary.technical_approach: 利用Mamba状态矩阵对角化的特性，将每个通道的输出精确分解为各模式贡献之和；通过在时间窗口内累积贡献的外积得到Gram张量，可离线闭式计算任意模式子集剪枝的精确输出误差，无需重新前向传播。通过冻结选择性信号的对照实验定位模式迁移的来源，并提出两遍调度的动态模式剪枝方法。
summary.experiments: 工具精度验证：Mamba-1上与参考实现相对误差2×10⁻⁷，4464种配置（覆盖5个模型、所有层、3种剪枝预算）下，预测剪枝误差与实际部署误差的中位数相对偏差为1×10⁻⁶。核心发现：Mamba-1（130M-2.8B）、7B Falcon-Mamba、Mamba-2均存在输入驱动的模式迁移，静态模式选择的误差约为输入调度最优选择的2倍。机制归因：冻结写入映射B_t几乎消除迁移效应，时间步Δ几乎无贡献。剪枝效果：两遍动态剪枝在相同预算下优于多种静态方法，7B规模下一半状态预算即可达到未剪枝模型的困惑度。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章的测量工具推导与精度验证、第4.1节的模式迁移现象量化、第4.2节的机制归因实验；预计阅读时间1.5-2小时。关注SSM效率优化的读者可补充阅读第4.3节的剪枝实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing mode importance estimation methods for selective state-space models (e.g., Mamba) are static and approximate, failing to accurately measure per-input state mode usage or predict the output error of pruning arbitrary mode subsets, limiting SSM efficiency optimization and interpretability research.
summary_en.importance: Clarifies the core working mechanism of selective SSMs — mode utilization is dynamically input-dependent rather than statically allocated. Corrects prior understanding of selectivity sources: the input-dependent write map B_t drives most mode migration, while the timestep Δ, commonly assumed to be critical, contributes almost nothing. Provides an exact measurement tool and quantitative grounding for dynamic state pruning and memory efficiency optimization of SSMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Leverages the diagonal state matrix property of Mamba to exactly decompose each channel's output into a sum of per-mode contributions. Accumulates outer products of these contributions over a time window to form a per-(layer, channel, window) Gram tensor, enabling closed-form, offline calculation of exact output error for any mode subset pruning without re-running forward passes. Uses frozen selective signal counterfactuals to attribute mode migration sources, and proposes a two-pass scheduled dynamic mode pruning method.
summary_en.experiments: Tool validation: relative error of 2×10⁻⁷ against reference Mamba-1 implementation; median relative deviation of 1×10⁻⁶ between predicted and actual deployed pruning error across 4,464 configurations covering 5 models, all layers, and 3 pruning budgets. Key finding: input-driven mode migration exists across Mamba-1 (130M to 2.8B), 7B Falcon-Mamba, and Mamba-2, with static mode selection incurring roughly twice the error of input-scheduled oracle selection at the most affected layers. Mechanism attribution: freezing the write map B_t eliminates most migration effect, while the timestep Δ contributes almost nothing. Pruning results: two-pass dynamic pruning outperforms multiple static methods at equal budget, and matches unpruned model perplexity at half the state budget for 7B-scale models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for instrument derivation and validation, Section 4.1 for quantitative mode migration results, and Section 4.2 for mechanism attribution experiments. Estimated reading time: 1.5–2 hours. Readers focused on SSM efficiency optimization can add Section 4.3 on pruning experiments.

recommendation.zh: SSM 方向建议读方法和 migration 结果；它会削弱“固定 mode 重要性可静态剪枝”的直觉。
recommendation.en: If you track SSMs, read the method and migration results; it weakens the intuition that mode importance is static and safely prunable.

paper.title: Neural Collapse Is Forbidden: Information Floors in Language Models
paper.abstract: Within-class variance in language-model representations is commonly read as incomplete neural collapse. We argue it is allocated information storage, and that the allocation obeys a law. A one-line centering identity voids a family of simplex equiangular-tight-frame claims, including our own earlier ones; in dimensionless variance shares across 14 models, macro-category structure carries only 4-12% of representational variance and within-token context carries 79-91%, stable across a 100x paramet

summary.core_problem: 解释语言模型表征中长期存在的“未完全 neural collapse”现象：类内方差究竟是训练不充分，还是模型必须保留的上下文信息存储。
summary.importance: 这是机制与理论分析工作，直接触及 LM 表征几何的一个常见误读。贡献包括：纠正一类 simplex ETF 解释、给出跨 14 个模型稳定的方差分解统计、并用信息论下界说明类内离散度不是噪声而是被任务强制保留的信息。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先用一个 centering identity 否定一批把 LM 表征解释成 simplex equiangular tight frame 的说法，包括作者自己早先的版本；然后在 14 个模型上做无量纲 variance share 分解，把表征方差拆成 macro-category、within-token context 等成分，发现后者占主导。理论上，作者分析 token-level weight decay 如何把 next-token prediction 变成按 type count 失衡的 K 类问题，使类别范数按 type count 排序；再证明二元类别情形下，一个 converse floor 迫使类内离散度至少与条件互信息 I(token; context | category) 成正比。
summary.experiments: 核心实验覆盖 14 个模型、100x 参数范围。关键结果是：macro-category 结构只解释 4-12% 的表征方差，而 token 在不同上下文中的变化解释 79-91%，且这一比例随模型规模变化很稳定。作者还强调应看 identity dispersion 而不是 total variance，因为前者更贴近条件互信息。论文更像分析与理论结合，不是追求 benchmark 提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者 Bruno Abrahao，机构为 New York University Stern School of Business。摘要明确提到作者修正了自己早先关于 simplex ETF 的解释，这一点说明论文带有自我纠偏性质。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the persistent lack of full neural collapse in language-model representations reflects incomplete training or necessary storage of contextual information.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-theory paper that directly challenges a common reading of LM representation geometry. Its contributions are to invalidate a family of simplex-ETF interpretations, provide stable variance decompositions across 14 models, and derive an information-theoretic floor showing that within-class dispersion is required rather than accidental.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author first uses a centering identity to rule out several simplex equiangular tight frame claims, including the author's own earlier version. Then, across 14 models, the paper decomposes dimensionless variance shares into macro-category and within-token contextual components, finding the latter dominant. On the theory side, token-level weight decay is analyzed as turning next-token prediction into an imbalanced K-class problem weighted by type count, which orders category norms by type count. A converse lower bound is then proved for binary categories, forcing within-category dispersion to scale with conditional mutual information I(token; context | category).
summary_en.experiments: The empirical analysis spans 14 models over a 100x parameter range. The main result is that macro-category structure explains only 4-12% of representational variance, while within-token contextual variation explains 79-91%, and this split is stable with scale. The paper also argues that identity dispersion, not total variance, is the right quantity to track because it aligns with conditional mutual information. This is an analysis paper, not a benchmark-improvement paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is Bruno Abrahao from New York University Stern School of Business. The abstract explicitly notes that the paper corrects the author's own earlier simplex-ETF interpretation, which gives the work a self-revision flavor.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会修正你对 LM 表征几何的直觉：类内方差未必是训练没收敛，而可能是任务必需的信息缓存；先看方差分解和 mutual-information floor。
recommendation.en: This one can update your intuition about LM representation geometry: within-class variance may be required information storage, not failed collapse; start with the variance decomposition and the mutual-information floor.

institutions: Leonard N. Stern School of Business, New York University

paper.title: On Locality and Length Generalization in Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: A striking feature of the human visual system is that it ingests visual information through a series of local foveated glimpses, rather than a single global computation. This makes human vision distinctly different from most popular computer vision models in use today, which input images globally and in a single shot. A natural question therefore is whether local, sequential vision models may provide any fundamental computational benefits in addition to being biologically more plausible than glo

summary.core_problem: 研究视觉推理模型在“长度外推”（训练只见短链路/少对象/低复杂度，测试要求更长依赖、更高分辨率或更多实体）时为何系统性失败，并定位失败是否来自“全局一次性看图”的感知方式，而不是单纯的模型容量或是否有递归结构。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不大（更像视觉推理与泛化机制研究），但对“统一多模态预训练/视觉tokenizer + 推理”有一个明确启发：如果训练目标允许模型走捷径（全局注意力直接拟合统计相关性），OOD 长度外推会崩；而把信息获取过程显式化（局部、序列化的观测）能迫使模型学习可组合的算法式策略。这类结论会反过来影响两类预训练设计：1）VLM 是否需要显式的感知-行动式 tokenization/读图策略；2）长上下文/长链路推理评测不应只看语言侧，也要把“信息采集”纳入任务定义。
summary.technical_approach:
论文把语言模型里的 length generalization 诊断迁移到视觉：构造一组需要“分步读取局部证据并更新状态”的视觉状态跟踪任务（文中强调任务长度由最少推理步数定义，并可通过分辨率与实体数量共同控制）。核心对照是两条轴：
1）是否递归（recurrent vs 非递归/一次性前馈）；
2）是否局部感知（local glimpses 序列读取 vs global view 一次性输入）。
主要机制论断是：仅有递归不够——如果递归网络仍然看到全局图像，它仍会学到全局“感知捷径”，在更长任务上失效；必须同时满足“递归更新状态 + 严格局部观测”才更容易学到与长度无关的策略。论文还区分了 state tracking 类任务与 recall 类任务：后者更像记忆/检索，局部感知不但不必要，可能也不带来收益。另一个工程性但关键的点是：局部 glimpse 的大小与分辨率是泛化的敏感超参，过大容易泄露全局统计，过小则信息不足导致训练不稳或策略学不出来。
summary.experiments: 全文主线是：在若干合成任务 + 一个真实任务上，比较“全局视觉编码的主流模型/范式”与“局部序列感知 + 递归”的组合在 ID 与 OOD（更长长度、更高分辨率/更多对象）上的差异。结论层面写得很明确：现有视觉/视觉语言模型在 ID 上可以很强，但在长度外推上显著失败；把失败归因到 global perception 导致的 shortcut；引入严格局部感知并配合递归后，OOD 表现显著改善；仅递归但全局输入仍不行；glimpse 尺寸/分辨率对鲁棒性影响很大。你给的全文片段未包含关键表格与具体数值（参数量、训练长度范围、OOD 提升幅度等），因此这里无法可靠复述具体数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 重点看 Introduction 里对“递归不够、局部也必须”的因果主张，以及他们为什么认为文本任务掩盖了“信息采集”这一环。
- 精看任务定义章节（Test-bed for Length Generalization）：长度如何定义、如何通过分辨率/实体数控制难度，哪些任务属于 state tracking、哪些更像 recall。
- 直接定位实验主表：对比 global vs local、recurrent vs non-recurrent 的 2x2 结果，以及 glimpse size/resolution 的消融；这是论文最有信息密度的部分。
- 如果你做 VLM 预训练：重点思考他们的“shortcut”在图文预训练里对应什么（例如高频共现、版式/位置偏置、patch token 的全局泄露），以及是否能用训练目标/数据课程而不是显式 glimpse 来达到类似约束。

summary_en.core_problem: Diagnose why vision(-language) models that perform well in-distribution fail at length generalization—i.e., extrapolating to visually more complex instances that require more sequential reasoning steps—and test whether the root cause is global, one-shot perception rather than model scale or the mere presence of recurrence.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it offers a concrete lesson for foundation-model pretraining and multimodal unification: if the modeling interface allows global shortcuts, models can fit correlations that collapse under longer dependencies. Enforcing a sequential, local information-gathering interface can push models toward algorithmic, length-invariant strategies. This is relevant to (1) how we design visual tokenization/perception for native multimodal LMs, and (2) how we evaluate long-horizon reasoning—where “information acquisition” should be part of the task, not assumed away as in text-only setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a visual testbed analogous to classic length-generalization tasks in LMs (e.g., parity), but where the model must actively aggregate spatially local evidence to track an underlying state. It varies difficulty along task length (minimum required steps) and image resolution/entity density. The key experimental factorization is a 2×2: recurrent vs non-recurrent computation, and local sequential glimpses vs global full-image input. The main claim is mechanistic: recurrence alone is insufficient—if a recurrent model still receives a global view, it can learn perceptual shortcuts that do not extrapolate. Robust OOD length generalization emerges when recurrence is paired with strictly local perception. The paper also separates state-tracking tasks from recall-style tasks, arguing locality is unnecessary (and not helpful) for the latter. A practical nuance is that glimpse size/resolution acts like an information bottleneck: too large leaks global cues; too small starves the model and destabilizes learning.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple synthetic tasks and one real-world task, the authors report: strong in-distribution performance for standard global-perception models but sharp degradation when extrapolating to longer instances; evidence that the failure is tied to global perception enabling shortcuts; substantial OOD gains when using recurrent models with strictly local glimpses; negative result for “recurrent + global input”; and sensitivity analyses showing glimpse size/resolution materially affects robustness. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main tables/figures with exact numbers (model sizes, train/test length ranges, absolute accuracies), so specific quantitative deltas cannot be stated reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the causal thesis: why text-only length generalization misses the information-gathering component.
- Focus on the task construction section to understand how “length” is operationalized and how resolution interacts with entity density.
- Jump to the main result table/figure that lays out the 2×2 comparison (global vs local, recurrent vs non-recurrent) and the glimpse-size ablations—this is where the paper earns its point.
- If you work on VLM pretraining, map their “shortcut via global perception” to likely shortcut channels in patch-token pretraining (layout bias, co-occurrence, global pooling leakage) and consider whether objective/data constraints could emulate the same bottleneck without explicit glimpse policies.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是做 LLM，但它对“全局注意力天然更强”这个直觉有点泼冷水；只看任务设计和长度外推曲线，就够判断是否值得迁到文本侧。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it usefully pushes back on the intuition that global processing is automatically better; the task design and length-generalization curves are the parts to read.

paper.title: Vision Transformers Learn Gestalt-Like Figure-Ground Cues from Natural Images
paper.abstract: Figure-ground organization in the human visual system relies on several shape-based cues, including surroundedness, convexity, and symmetry. While these cues have been extensively studied using abstract stimuli, little is known about how they operate under natural conditions or how they arise from the statistics of natural scenes. Deep neural networks offer a promising path forward: a model that relies on the same figure-ground cues as humans would provide tractable experimental access to the un

summary.core_problem: 研究 ViT 是否能从自然图像训练中自发学习类似人类 figure-ground 组织的形状线索，如包围性、凸性和对称性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视觉表征机制分析。它不是 LLM 论文，但对理解视觉 encoder 在自然图像统计中学到哪些结构性归纳偏置有参考意义，间接关联 VLM 预训练和视觉表征选择。
summary.technical_approach: 作者测试 25 个 ViT，覆盖监督和自监督训练目标。方法是在中间 patch 表征上训练线性 probe，预测 figure-ground assignment，并同时使用自然图像与受控人工刺激，后者用于隔离单个 Gestalt 线索。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 25 个 ViT。摘要显示结果表明 ViT 在多种训练目标下能稳定表现出 figure-ground 相关线索，但未给出具体模型列表、数据集规模、probe 准确率或各训练目标之间的差异幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Toronto、Vector Institute 和 McGill University；Sven Dickinson、Kaleem Siddiqi 和 Dirk B. Walther 是视觉感知与计算机视觉方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether ViTs learn human-like figure-ground cues such as surroundedness, convexity, and symmetry from natural image statistics.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis of visual representations. It is not an LLM paper, but it is relevant as weak evidence about what structural biases visual encoders acquire under supervised and self-supervised pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate 25 ViTs trained with supervised and self-supervised objectives. They fit linear probes on intermediate patch representations to predict figure-ground assignment, using both natural images and controlled artificial stimuli that isolate individual Gestalt cues.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 25 ViTs. The abstract reports robust figure-ground cue encoding across models, but does not provide the full model list, dataset scale, probe accuracy, or effect sizes across training objectives.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Toronto, Vector Institute, and McGill University. Sven Dickinson, Kaleem Siddiqi, and Dirk B. Walther are established researchers in vision and perception.

recommendation.zh: 作为视觉 encoder 机制备查即可；若做 VLM 预训练，重点看自监督和监督 ViT 在中层 probe 的差异。
recommendation.en: Keep it as vision-encoder mechanism background; for VLM pretraining, only inspect the supervised-vs-SSL mid-layer probe differences.

paper.title: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
paper.abstract: Self-attention lets each token retrieve information from the full context, but its quadratic cost in sequence length limits training and inference at long context. This paper presents a comparative study of softmax attention and four recent recurrent linear-attention architectures: DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, and Gated DeltaNet-2. We express these mechanisms in a common recurrent-memory notation, making explicit how they differ in expressivity, memory decay, erase and write c

summary.core_problem: DeltaNet 及其后续线性注意力变体快速发展，但缺少在统一记号和统一训练设置下的系统比较；同时，线性循环架构是否需要、以及如何在不破坏线性复杂度的前提下引入跨层信息通路，也缺少清晰结论。
summary.importance: 对做架构和预训练 recipe 的人来说，这类统一对比工作比单独推一个新变体更有用。论文把 softmax attention、DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention、Gated DeltaNet-2 放进同一套 recurrent memory 框架，明确了它们在“写什么、怎么擦除、如何遗忘、门控多细”上的差异。这对理解近期线性注意力为什么能逐步缩小与 softmax 的差距，以及哪些设计点真正影响表达力和训练稳定性，很有参考价值。此外，文中提出的轻量跨层路由 CLVR 虽然提升不大，但指出了一个明确方向：跨层传“value”比传 delta error 更有效，这比直接照搬深层残差捷径更贴近线性记忆架构本身。
summary.technical_approach: 第一部分是形式化统一：所有被比较架构都写成固定大小记忆矩阵 W_t 上的 recurrent update，区分 delta 规则残差 r、decay、erase、write 门控，以及门控作用在标量还是 channel 维度上。第二部分是在 Megatron 中实现可训练版本，统一做 350M、15B token 量级的对比，覆盖优化器、学习率敏感性、纯线性栈与混合栈、不同序列长度的吞吐与时延、以及 1.3B/3B 规模的扩展实验。第三部分是跨层路由设计：先尝试把低层 delta rule 的写误差传到高层作为目标修正（CLER），效果不佳；改为把低层对齐后的 write value 直接路由到高层 hidden stream（CLVR），在不破坏线性时间复杂度的前提下取得小幅验证损失下降。
summary.experiments: 核心实验规模是 350M 参数、15B tokens，比较对象包括 softmax attention 和四种 DeltaNet 系列线性注意力。论文报告了各结构在验证损失、训练吞吐、序列长度扩展下的 runtime、optimizer/LR 敏感性、hybrid vs pure stack 差异，并补充了 1.3B 与 3B 的 DeltaNet 训练结果。跨层路由部分，CLER 没有超过匹配 baseline，而 CLVR 在 DeltaNet 和 Gated DeltaNet 上带来小幅但一致的 val loss 改善。论文没有宣称单一结构全面最优，重点是把设计空间讲清楚。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，但值得读得比一般 architecture 短文细一点。优先看 recurrent-memory 统一记号部分，一张表/一组公式把几个变体的更新规则并排对比，这是全文最有复用价值的部分。然后看实验里 optimizer/LR 敏感性和 hybrid-vs-pure 的结果，因为这决定这些架构在真实 pretrain 里的可用性。CLVR 作为新增方法本身提升有限，重点看为什么传 value 比传 error 有效，这对后续设计跨层记忆接口有启发。预计阅读 30–45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: DeltaNet and its recent gated variants have emerged as strong linear-attention candidates, but the field lacks a systematic comparison under a shared recurrent notation and matched training setup.
