It is also unclear whether and how linear recurrent architectures should incorporate cross-layer information flow without sacrificing linear-time complexity.
summary_en.importance: For researchers working on architecture and pretraining recipes, this kind of controlled comparative study is often more useful than yet another isolated variant. The paper places softmax attention, DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, and Gated DeltaNet-2 into a common recurrent-memory framework, isolating differences in what is written into memory, how memory is erased or decayed, and the granularity of gating. That decomposition helps clarify why recent linear attention variants have narrowed the gap to softmax attention and which design choices actually affect expressivity and trainability. The proposed lightweight cross-layer routing mechanism, CLVR, yields only modest gains, but it makes a substantive design point: routing write values across layers appears more useful than routing delta errors, a more architecture-native choice than generic deep residual shortcuts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The first contribution is notational unification. All architectures are written as recurrent updates over a fixed-size memory matrix W_t, with explicit separation of the delta-rule residual r, decay, erase, and write control, and with scalar versus channelwise gating made explicit. The second contribution is a trainable Megatron-based implementation used to compare these variants at matched scale, mainly 350M-parameter models trained on 15B tokens. The comparison covers optimizer and learning-rate sensitivity, pure versus hybrid stacks, runtime across sequence lengths, downstream behavior, and larger DeltaNet runs at 1.3B and 3B parameters. The third contribution is cross-layer routing. The paper first tests Cross-Layer Error Residuals (CLER), which forward a lower layer’s delta write error to adjust the next layer’s value target, finding no improvement. It then proposes Cross-Layer Value Routing (CLVR), which routes the aligned write value from a lower layer directly into the hidden stream of the next layer, preserving linear-time structure while producing a small validation-loss improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The main controlled comparison is at 350M/15B tokens across softmax attention and the four DeltaNet-family architectures. The paper reports validation loss, training throughput, sequence-length runtime, optimizer and learning-rate sensitivity, and differences between pure and hybrid stacks, with additional DeltaNet runs at 1.3B and 3B. On cross-layer routing, CLER does not improve over matched baselines, while CLVR gives small but consistent validation-loss reductions on DeltaNet and Gated DeltaNet. The paper does not argue for a single universally best architecture; its main goal is to make the design space legible.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read as a skim, but more carefully than a typical architecture short note. Start with the recurrent-memory unification section: the side-by-side update rules for the different variants are the most reusable part of the paper. Then look at the optimizer/LR sensitivity and hybrid-vs-pure results, since those determine practical usability in real pretraining. CLVR itself is a modest improvement; the more useful part is the negative result on CLER and the evidence that routed values matter more than routed errors. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 统一符号化梳理了几类线性注意力的机制差异，做长上下文架构选型时可直接参考 §3 的机制对比表，实验部分价值有限。
recommendation.en: Provides a unified symbolic taxonomy of several linear attention families; reference §3 for architecture trade-offs during long-context design selection, experiments are of limited value.

paper.title: Two Axes of LLM Abstention: Answer Correctness and Question Answerability
paper.abstract: A model should refuse two different things: answers it would get wrong, and questions it should not answer at all, such as unanswerable ones or ones resting on a false premise. The usual recipe thresholds a single confidence score, which cannot tell these apart. Across five instruction-tuned models from three families (2B to 14B), we find they are separate axes. Ordinary answer-confidence tracks whether an answer is right but is nearly blind to whether the question is answerable; a linear probe

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM abstention 被单一置信度分数混为一谈的问题：模型既可能因为答案会错而应拒答，也可能因为问题本身不可答或前提错误而应拒答，这两者是否是同一轴。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对后训练和机制分析都有价值。它不是提出新对齐算法，而是指出现有 refusal/confidence 设计把两个不同能力混在一起，导致模型明明内部表示到“问题有问题”，却不会在输出层显式报告。这个结论会直接影响 abstention、calibration、verifier 和 reward 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 5 个 instruction-tuned 模型上分离考察两种 abstention 轴：answer correctness 与 question answerability。方法上比较常规 answer-confidence、P(IK)、P(True)、直接询问 premise 是否为假，以及基于 hidden states 的线性 probe。进一步分析在 false-premise 问题上，显式指令模型检查前提为何会适得其反，并提出更细的拒答建模视角。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 3 个模型家族、2B 到 14B。关键结果是：普通 answer-confidence 能预测答对与否，但几乎看不出问题是否可答；hidden-state probe 则相反，对 false-premise 问题尤其有效。在 CREPE 上，显式置信或真假判断接近随机，而 hidden-state probe 可达 0.69-0.77 AUROC；且这一盲点不会随模型变大自然消失。摘要还指出“让模型检查前提”的简单指令会引入过度质疑，损伤正常问题处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM abstention is really one phenomenon, or whether refusing wrong answers and refusing unanswerable/false-premise questions are two distinct axes.
summary_en.importance: This matters for both post-training and model analysis. The contribution is not a new alignment algorithm but a cleaner decomposition: current refusal/confidence schemes conflate two different capabilities, and models may internally represent answerability failures without surfacing them in generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across five instruction-tuned models, the paper separates answer correctness from question answerability. It compares standard answer confidence, P(IK), P(True), explicit premise-check prompting, and a linear probe on hidden states. The analysis focuses on false-premise questions and on why explicit premise-check instructions can backfire.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers three model families from 2B to 14B. The main result is that answer confidence predicts correctness but is nearly blind to answerability, while a hidden-state probe does the reverse. On CREPE false-premise questions, explicit confidence-style signals stay near chance, whereas a hidden-state probe reaches 0.69-0.77 AUROC. The blind spot also does not disappear with scale.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 refusal/calibration 的问题分解：别再拿一个 confidence 头包打天下，先看 CREPE 结果和 hidden-state probe，对 reward 设计有直接影响。
recommendation.en: This should change how you decompose refusal and calibration: one confidence head is not enough—read the CREPE results and hidden-state probe analysis before designing rewards or abstention heads.

institutions: City St George’s, University of London

paper.title: Super Weights in LLMs and the Failure of Selective Training
paper.abstract: Recent work identified Super Weights, individual parameters whose removal degrades model performance by orders of magnitude. We show that this degradation due to pruning Super Weights does not universally apply to all LLMs. Furthermore, if these parameters are so important, Super Weight-aware training should be effective. We show the opposite. Training Super Weights in isolation (100 to 8,192 parameters) drops accuracy to random-guessing levels on both OLMo-1B and OLMo-7B, and expanding to local

summary.core_problem: 现有研究发现LLM中存在移除后会导致困惑度飙升数个量级的「超级权重」，由此衍生的自然假设——「微调时针对性训练这些最重要的参数或其局部邻域，效果应优于随机选择的稀疏参数」——未得到验证；同时，超级权重是输入相关的伪影还是预训练模型的结构属性、其剪枝敏感度是否跨所有LLM通用、参数重要性与孤立可训练性的关系等问题均不明确。
summary.importance: 厘清了预训练LLM权重的两个独立属性：「重要性（移除后的性能影响）」与「孤立可训练性（单独训练时的性能提升能力）」完全解耦，打破了「重要参数是稀疏微调最优目标」的普遍直觉。对预训练研究的具体价值包括：1）从机制上解释了LoRA等低秩PEFT方法有效的核心原因——其效果来源于层内全局协调的参数更新，保留了预训练权重的关系结构，而非针对性更新了单个高幅值参数；2）验证了超级权重是预训练模型的结构属性（高度集中在down_proj层），为预训练架构设计、正则化策略提供了新的观测依据；3）为后训练微调策略的选择提供了明确指导：稀疏参数更新的效果远不如层内协调的低秩更新。
summary.technical_approach: 研究基于10种主流LLM开展对照实验（核心实验在OLMo-1B 1.28B、OLMo-7B 7B上开展，泛化测试覆盖Phi-3-mini、Llama-3系列、Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、Gemma-2-9B-it等架构）。首先通过20种不同输入的前向传播验证超级权重的跨输入一致性，排除输入相关伪影的可能。随后设计多组严格对照实验：1）单独训练100~8192个超级权重；2）训练超级权重的局部邻域（最多36K参数）；3）训练相同数量的随机非超级权重down_proj层参数，隔离稀疏性变量的影响；4）LoRA变体实验：冻结与down_proj超级权重坐标对应的注意力层位置、冻结LoRA更新中幅值最大的参数；5）10种子消融验证统计显著性；6）跨模型超级权重剪枝敏感度测试。最后补充两个理论分析：内在维度论证（稀疏更新仅能捕捉微调子空间的极小部分）、优化器动力学论证（超级权重位置的曲率会隐式抑制其更新）。
summary.experiments: 关键实验结果包括：1）超级权重一致性：9个权重位置在20种不同输入中100%产生激活尖峰，确认其为模型结构属性；全模型top10高幅值参数中80%位于down_proj层，top100高幅值参数中52%位于down_proj层。2）孤立超级权重训练：ARC-Easy准确率降至随机猜测水平，扩展到36K邻域参数训练仍无提升。3）对照组实验：训练相同数量的随机非超级权重down_proj参数，准确率超过61%的基线，排除了稀疏性、模块选择作为失败原因的可能。4）LoRA实验：rank=8的LoRA（目标为注意力层，训练参数2.1M，占OLMo-1B总参数的0.16%）在ARC-Easy上达到67%的准确率，超过基线；冻结超级权重对应的注意力位置、冻结LoRA高幅值更新参数，均无测量级别的性能影响（10个种子的p值>0.05，80%的种子产生完全一致的预测结果）。5）跨模型测试：超级权重的剪枝敏感度并非在所有10种测试架构中通用。训练配置为AdamW优化器、学习率1e-4、3轮训练、有效batch size 16；评估数据集为ARC-Easy（2376个测试样本）、Winogrande（1267个测试样本），指标为精确匹配准确率。
summary.reading_guide: 优先泛读实验结果章节的核心对比表格，明确孤立超级权重训练、随机稀疏训练、LoRA变体三类方法的准确率差距；再阅读方法章节的超级权重识别流程与跨输入一致性验证，理解超级权重的结构属性；最后阅读附录H-I的内在维度与优化器动力学分析，掌握稀疏训练失败的深层原因。重点关注对照实验的变量隔离设计（如何分离稀疏性、模块、超级权重坐标三个影响因素）与LoRA冻结实验的零结果结论。预计阅读时间40-60分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Prior work identified "Super Weights" — individual LLM parameters whose removal increases perplexity by orders of magnitude — leading to a natural unvalidated hypothesis: targeted training of these most important parameters (or their local neighborhoods) should outperform random sparse parameter selection for fine-tuning. Open questions also remain: whether Super Weights are input-specific artifacts or structural properties of pretrained models, whether their pruning sensitivity generalizes across all LLM architectures, and why parameter importance appears decoupled from trainability in sparse fine-tuning settings.
summary_en.importance: This work disentangles two independent properties of pretrained LLM weights: *importance* (performance impact of removal) and *isolated trainability* (ability to improve performance when trained alone), breaking the widely held intuition that important parameters are optimal targets for sparse fine-tuning. For pretraining research, it provides a mechanistic explanation for the success of low-rank PEFT methods like LoRA: their effectiveness stems from layer-wide coordinated updates that preserve the relational structure of pretrained weights, rather than targeting individual high-magnitude parameters. It also validates that Super Weights are structural properties of pretrained models (heavily concentrated in down_proj layers), offering new insights for pretraining architecture design, regularization, and post-training fine-tuning strategy selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study conducts controlled experiments across 10 mainstream LLMs (core experiments on OLMo-1B 1.28B and OLMo-7B 7B, with generalization tests on Phi-3-mini, Llama-3 series, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Gemma-2-9B-it, etc.). First, it validates Super Weight consistency across 20 diverse input samples to rule out input-specific artifacts. Then it designs six sets of controlled experiments: 1) isolated training of 100–8,192 Super Weights; 2) training of local neighborhoods around Super Weights (up to 36K parameters); 3) control training of an equal number of randomly selected non-Super-Weight down_proj parameters to isolate the effect of sparsity; 4) LoRA variants with frozen attention positions matching down_proj Super Weight coordinates, and frozen top-magnitude LoRA update parameters; 5) 10-seed ablation for statistical significance; 6) cross-model pruning generalization tests. Two complementary theoretical analyses are provided: an intrinsic dimensionality argument showing sparse updates capture only a vanishing fraction of the fine-tuning subspace, and an optimizer dynamics argument showing curvature at Super Weight positions implicitly suppresses their updates.
summary_en.experiments: Key results include: 1) Super Weight consistency: 9 weight positions produce activation spikes in 100% of 20 diverse inputs, confirming structural status; 80% of top-10 and 52% of top-100 highest-magnitude parameters across the model reside in down_proj layers. 2) Isolated Super Weight training drops ARC-Easy accuracy to random-guessing levels, with no improvement even when expanding to 36K local neighborhood parameters. 3) Control experiment: training an equal number of random non-Super-Weight down_proj parameters improves accuracy over the 61% baseline, ruling out sparsity or module choice as failure causes. 4) Standard rank-8 LoRA (targeting attention layers, 2.1M trainable parameters = 0.16% of OLMo-1B) reaches 67% accuracy on ARC-Easy, outperforming the baseline; freezing Super Weight-corresponding attention positions or top-magnitude LoRA updates has no measurable effect (p>0.05 across 10 seeds, 80% of seeds produce identical predictions). 5) Cross-model tests show Super Weight pruning sensitivity is not universal across all 10 tested architectures. Training uses AdamW with lr=1e-4, 3 epochs, effective batch size 16; evaluations use ARC-Easy (2,376 test samples) and Winogrande (1,267 test samples) with exact-match accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: First skim the experiment results section and its core tables comparing accuracy of isolated Super Weight training, random sparse training, and LoRA variants. Then review the method section for Super Weight identification methodology and cross-input consistency validation to understand their structural properties. Finally read Appendices H-I for the intrinsic dimensionality and optimizer dynamics analyses that explain the root cause of sparse training failure. Focus on the controlled experiment design (which isolates sparsity, module, and Super Weight coordinate as variables) and the null result of LoRA Super Weight freezing experiments. Estimated reading time: 40-60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验对照就够了：它提醒不要把 pruning saliency 当成可训练性，Super Weight 叙事需要降温。
recommendation.en: Read the ablations, not the framing: pruning saliency is not trainability, and the Super Weight story needs a colder interpretation.

paper.title: Structural Bottlenecks on Frequency Representation in End-to-End Audio Models
paper.abstract: End-to-end neural audio models achieve high-fidelity compression and generation. We might read that performance as evidence they directly represent interpretable features such as pitch and timbre, but a model can produce plausible outputs without doing so. A model may encode these features in any reachable basis, but regardless of which, the features are well described as compositions of time-frequency-localized primitives. Whether state-of-the-art encoders preserve access to these primitives, a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究端到端音频模型的 encoder 是否保留了对频率局部化 primitive 的可访问性。问题不是模型能否重构或生成高质量音频，而是压缩后的 latent 是否还能支持对 pitch、timbre、prosody 等可解释频率结构的独立访问和控制。作者指出，强重构质量并不意味着这些结构以可用形式存在于表示中。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对音频 LM、语音 tokenization、codec LM 方向有直接启发。AudioLM、VALL-E、Moshi、Qwen-Audio 等路线都依赖某种音频 tokenizer 或 codec encoder，把连续波形压到离散或连续 latent，再交给语言模型建模。如果 encoder 在下采样阶段已经让不同频率成分混叠，或者让幸存成分在 latent 中不可分，那么后面的 LM 很难再恢复可控的 pitch、音色和韵律结构。贡献不在于提出一个新 codec，而在于给出一套可预测的结构性诊断：哪些 stride schedule、采样率、receptive field 设置会限制频率表示。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把声音看作短时间尺度上的窄带振荡成分叠加，并分析 strided convolutional encoder 对这些 time-frequency-localized primitives 的影响。论文提出两个瓶颈。第一是 injectivity failure：下采样导致 aliasing，不同输入频率成分会折叠到表示空间中的同一 proxy component，因而无法被后续模块区分。作者根据输入信号结构和 stride schedule 构造 forward model，预测有多少频率成分能被 injectively represented。第二是 separability failure：即使某些成分没有在下采样中塌缩，learned filters 也可能没有足够频率分辨率把它们分开。这里 receptive field 给出了理论分辨率上界，kernel geometry 可以预测 learned filter 相对这个上界的位置。与单纯做 probing 或后验可解释性分析不同，这个框架试图在训练前仅从架构和信号结构预测表示瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 EnCodec、DAC、Stable Audio 三类当前常用的端到端音频 encoder。injectivity 方面，作者在 643 个信号配置上比较 forward model 预测的 collapse rate 与实际观察值，相关系数约 r≈0.99，说明 collapse 主要由 stride schedule 和采样结构决定，而不是训练偶然性。采样率也有明显影响：22.05 kHz、44.1 kHz 这类低 factor-complexity 采样率相比高度合数采样率更能减少 collapse。separability 方面，learned filters 的有效频率分辨率距离 receptive-field 理论极限约差 10–35 倍，意味着架构提供的潜在分辨率没有被实际滤波器充分用于可分离频率结构。作者还强调，injectivity failure 一旦发生，后处理难以修复，必须在上游 stride schedule 设计中避免。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到精读之间，预计 30–45 分钟。先看理论部分中 injectivity 条件和 separability 条件，尤其是 collapse forward model 如何由 stride schedule 推出。然后看 EnCodec、DAC、Stable Audio 的实验表格和 collapse-rate 图，重点关注 r≈0.99 的预测验证。再看 separability 分析中 learned filters 与 theoretical resolution limit 的差距。对做音频 tokenizer 或统一多模态 LM 的读者，最值得细看的不是重构指标，而是采样率、stride schedule、receptive field 如何共同决定 downstream LM 能否获得可控频率表示。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether end-to-end audio encoders preserve accessible representations of frequency-localized primitives. The target is not reconstruction quality by itself. The target is whether compressed latents still allow independent access to the structures that support pitch, timbre, prosody, and other interpretable audio features. The paper argues that high-quality compression or generation can coexist with representations that do not expose these primitives in a usable form.
summary_en.importance: The result is directly relevant to audio language modeling and neural audio tokenization. Systems such as codec LMs depend on an encoder that converts waveform structure into latents before a language model learns over them. If the encoder collapses distinct frequency components during strided downsampling, or preserves them in a form that learned filters cannot separate, the downstream LM is unlikely to recover clean control over pitch, timbre, or prosody. The contribution is mainly diagnostic: it gives architecture-level conditions for when frequency structure is lost or made inaccessible.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis models audio over short time windows as a superposition of narrowband oscillatory components. It then studies how strided convolutional encoders transform these time-frequency-localized primitives. The first bottleneck is injectivity failure: downsampling-induced aliasing maps distinct input components to indistinguishable proxy components in representation space. The authors build a forward model from signal structure and stride schedule to predict how many components can survive this collapse. The second bottleneck is separability failure: even components that survive aliasing may not be separable by the learned filters. The receptive field sets a theoretical frequency-resolution limit, and kernel geometry predicts where learned filters sit relative to that limit. Unlike post-hoc probing work, this framework aims to predict representational bottlenecks from architecture and signal structure before training.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments analyze EnCodec, DAC, and Stable Audio encoders. For injectivity, the predicted collapse rates match observed collapse rates across 643 signal configurations with correlation around r≈0.99, suggesting that the failure is largely determined by stride schedule and sampling structure. Sampling rate matters: lower factor-complexity rates such as 22.05 kHz and 44.1 kHz reduce collapse compared with highly composite rates. For separability, learned filters operate roughly 10–35 times above the theoretical resolution limit implied by the receptive field, leaving much of the possible frequency resolution unused for separable structure. The paper also emphasizes that injectivity failures cannot be repaired downstream; they require upstream changes to stride design.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim carefully in 30–45 minutes. Start with the formal injectivity and separability conditions, especially how the collapse model follows from the stride schedule. Then inspect the EnCodec, DAC, and Stable Audio experiments, with attention to the r≈0.99 prediction result over 643 configurations. The separability section is also worth reading because it connects receptive field, kernel geometry, and learned filter resolution. For audio-tokenizer or multimodal-LM work, the most useful lesson is how sampling rate, stride schedule, and receptive field determine what frequency structure is available to the downstream model.

recommendation.zh: 做 audio tokenizer 或 speech LM 的人应看瓶颈推导；重点是 aliasing 机制，不是最终音频指标。
recommendation.en: For audio tokenizers and speech LMs, read the bottleneck argument; the useful part is the aliasing mechanism, not headline audio quality.

paper.title: A First-Principles Theory of Slow Thinking and Active Perception
paper.abstract: As part of a series on first-principles modeling of cognitive functions, this paper attempts to provide a mathematical formulation of thinking and perception. It formally derives slow thinking or more generally, active perception, and encompasses the design, training and inference of slow thinking large language models. Our starting point is the lifting and projection of probability distributions on the observable and latent spaces, with the objective of representing complex data distributions b

summary.core_problem: 尝试从数学第一性原理统一刻画 slow thinking 与 active perception，并把这种表述延伸到 slow-thinking LLM 的设计、训练和推理。
summary.importance: 这是理论/机制取向工作，野心很大，想给“慢思考”建立统一形式化框架。对做 reasoning 或 latent reasoning 范式的人有概念启发，但离可操作的预训练 recipe 还有明显距离。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从可观测空间与潜在空间上的概率分布 lifting/projection 出发，提出 active lifting：通过采样潜在序列，并以最大速率降低不确定性为内在驱动，导出一个包含 slow-thinking 模型的设计空间。文中还定义了 static theory 下的表示层级与采样器层级，认为模型可沿这两个层级升级。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出清晰的实证设置、模型规模、数据规模或与主流 reasoning/slow-thinking 方法的定量对比。更像理论框架论文，实验可信度和可复现性需要看正文后再判断。
summary.authors_note: Institute for Advanced Algorithms Research、上海交通大学、北京大学。Weinan E 与 Zhi-Qin John Xu 在理论深度学习与科学计算方向有较强代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper attempts to formulate slow thinking and active perception from first principles, and to extend that formulation to the design, training, and inference of slow-thinking LLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory/mechanism-oriented work with broad ambition: it tries to provide a unified formalism for slow thinking. It may be conceptually useful for researchers exploring reasoning or latent-reasoning paradigms, but it is still far from an actionable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from lifting and projection of probability distributions between observable and latent spaces, the paper proposes active lifting: sampling latent sequences under an intrinsic objective of reducing uncertainty at the maximum rate. This yields a design space that contains slow-thinking models as a subspace, with representation and sampler hierarchies in the static theory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide a clear empirical setup, model scale, data scale, or quantitative comparison against mainstream reasoning or slow-thinking methods. It reads more like a theoretical framework paper, so empirical credibility must be checked in the full text.
summary_en.authors_note: Institute for Advanced Algorithms Research, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Peking University. Weinan E and Zhi-Qin John Xu are well known in theoretical deep learning and scientific computing.

recommendation.zh: 理论野心大，但先别把它当 recipe；若你在想 latent reasoning/slow thinking 的统一表述，可只读形式化部分，实验先持保留。
recommendation.en: Ambitious theory, but do not treat it as a recipe yet; read the formalism if you care about latent reasoning or slow thinking, and stay skeptical about the empirical side.

paper.title: Contravariance Theory: Strong Alignment for Minimal Solutions to Hard Tasks
paper.abstract: A series of results from the NeuroAI over the past fifteen years have raised core questions both about how to compare Deep Neural Network (DNN) models to the brain, and about how much convergent evolution to expect between artificial networks and real brain networks. Here, we show that for any two minimal DNN solutions to a sufficiently hard task: (i) "weak" alignment of network representations based on affine mappings guarantees "strong" alignment of privileged axes, and (ii) alignment "zippers

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么两个独立训练出的最小 DNN 解在足够困难的任务上会出现强表征对齐和层级对齐。
summary.importance: 这是 NeuroAI 与表征机制方向的理论工作，贡献在于形式化 contravariance，并讨论任务难度、最小解和跨网络可比性之间的关系。它不是 LLM 预训练方法，但对理解表征收敛有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文证明：对足够困难任务的两个最小 DNN 解，若存在基于仿射映射的弱表征对齐，则可推出 privileged axes 的强对齐；这种对齐会沿网络层级向上 zipper 式传播，从端到端优化中产生特权轴。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述理论结果，没有给出模型规模、训练数据或实验数值。重点是形式化命题及其对 NeuroAI 模型比较指标和趋同演化的解释。
summary.authors_note: Dan Yamins 是 Stanford NeuroAI 方向的代表性研究者，长期研究深度网络与脑表征对齐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why independently trained minimal DNN solutions to sufficiently hard tasks can exhibit strong representational and hierarchical alignment.
summary_en.importance: It is a theory-oriented NeuroAI paper that formalizes contravariance and connects task hardness, minimal solutions, and cross-network comparability. It is not an LLM pretraining method, but it may inform representation-convergence analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work shows that weak alignment via affine mappings between two minimal DNN solutions implies strong alignment of privileged axes, and that alignment can zipper upward through the network hierarchy under end-to-end task optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theoretical results rather than empirical scale, datasets, or numerical gains. The main output is a formal argument about alignment metrics and convergent evolution.
summary_en.authors_note: Dan Yamins is a prominent Stanford NeuroAI researcher known for work on alignment between deep networks and brain representations.

recommendation.zh: 只看定理假设是否适用于过参数 LLM；若“最小解”假设站不住，结论只能当表征收敛的弱类比。
recommendation.en: Skim the assumptions, especially whether “minimal solutions” say anything about overparameterized LMs; otherwise it is only a weak analogy for representation convergence.

paper.title: RL Post-Training Builds Compositional Reasoning Strategies
paper.abstract: Does RL post-training merely amplify primitive skills already latent in a base model, or can it compose primitive skills into new higher-level strategies? We study this question in a fully observable rewrite-grammar environment where the pretraining distribution is known and every generated rewrite can be audited. A Transformer is pretrained on primitive symbol-rewrite chains and post-trained on a Trace-based reasoning task with only a binary final-answer reward. RL solves held-out problems that

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是 RL post-training 到底只是在放大 base model 已有的低概率行为，还是能把预训练中学到的原子能力组合成新的高层推理策略。该工作把这个问题放到一个完全可观测的 rewrite-grammar 环境里，避免真实 LLM 中常见的混淆：不知道行为是否出现在预训练数据里，不知道采样能否早已覆盖，不知道轨迹里的步骤是有效推理还是偶然拼接。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口有较强信息量。它不是用自然语言 benchmark 证明 RL 有效，而是构造了一个可审计环境来观察机制：预训练提供 primitive rewrite competence，RL 在只有二值 final-answer reward 的条件下，把这些 primitive 重新组织成 sequential macro 和 parallel composition。贡献不在任务本身，而在给出了一个较干净的证据链：RL 的收益可以来自程序性 chunking，而不仅是提高已有答案的采样概率。对预训练研究的启发是，预训练分布如何组织局部能力，会影响后续 RL 能否压缩、复用并外推这些能力。
summary.technical_approach:
环境定义在符号 alphabet 上。每个 source symbol 映射到一个或多个全局唯一的多字符 RHS string；全局唯一性保证 contraction 是无歧义的，即任何匹配 RHS 的 substring 都能唯一映射回 source symbol。模型支持两类 primitive inverse operations：expansion 把一个 symbol 替换为 RHS，contraction 把一个匹配 substring 收缩回 source symbol。每一步都序列化为带位置、span 和 rule 的动作，因此生成轨迹可以逐步审计。

预训练从零开始，在 primitive rewrite chains 上训练 Transformer。数据生成器从初始 word 出发，反复采样合法 primitive expansion 或 contraction，并把 resulting word 作为下一步输入。预训练只暴露局部 grammar-consistent dynamics，不包含后续分析中的非 primitive shortcut。作者用 contraction weight ρ 控制预训练分布；默认 ρ=4，它局部提高 contraction move 的采样倾向，但不直接指定最终 contraction frequency 或 chaining length。

post-training 任务是 goal-directed contraction。prompt 由目标 symbol c* 经多次 primitive expansion 得到较长 word，模型只看到 w_prompt，需要生成逐步 contraction trace，最后输出 c*。reward 只有最终答案是否正确的二值信号。由于语法完全可审计，每条轨迹可分成 primitive rule use、valid non-primitive composition 和 invalid rewrite。valid composition 又分为 sequential composition，即把有序 primitive contraction chain 合成一个 macro step；以及 parallel composition，即在一个 emitted step 中合并彼此独立的 primitive contractions。这个 taxonomy 是全文的关键，它把“RL 学到新策略”从 pass rate 变化变成可检查的轨迹结构变化。

方法比较上，RL 与 rejection fine-tuning 形成了清晰对照。RFT 会选择成功样本，也会复制一些 shortcut-like 行为，但其中相当一部分是 spurious rewrite。RL，特别是 GRPO 的 same-prompt contrast，会在同一 prompt 的候选组内相对提高有效结构、压低无效 passenger actions。作者给出 finite-group view 来解释这种选择效应：RL 的优势不只是探索更多，而是把探索质量集中到可复用的合法组合上。
summary.experiments:
实验设计围绕 difficulty 和轨迹分类展开。Difficulty 由 optimal primitive contraction solution 在 256-token generation budget 下的长度定义：Difficulty 1 的 primitive 最优解能放进预算；Difficulty 2 比预算多一个 primitive contraction step；Difficulty 3 多两个 step。RL 训练 mixture 为 60% Difficulty 1、20% Difficulty 2、20% Difficulty 3。评估覆盖 held-out Difficulty 1–6，其中包含训练分布之外的更难 bucket。

关键结果有四点。第一，RL 能解决一些 pretrained model 即使用更大 sampling budget 也很少解决的 held-out problems，且收益在训练后期更明显，并随难度上升而扩大。这支持 finite-budget frontier expansion，而不只是小 k 下的重排序。第二，RFT 早期提升明显，但较快 plateau；它会保留成功轨迹中的 shortcut-like 行为，却无法稳定区分 valid composition 和 spurious rewrite。第三，轨迹分析显示 RL 有阶段性：先增强 primitive reductions，再发现和复用 valid compositions，最后把 sequential macro 与 parallel composition 固化为更稳定的策略。第四，预训练分布会影响后续策略可达性。ρ=4 的默认设置提供了更偏 contraction 的 procedural substrate；第 7 节进一步消融 ρ，检验预训练中 contraction chaining 的组织方式是否影响 RL 后续能否压缩为 macro。

提供内容中没有给出 Transformer 参数量、预训练 token 数、训练步数或具体 pass-rate 数字。因此最可靠的数字是环境和训练设置：256-token generation budget、ρ=4、RL 训练难度配比 60/20/20、评估 Difficulty 1–6，以及 pretraining 只含 primitive chains 而不含非 primitive shortcuts。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读。先看 rewrite grammar 和 primitive actions 的定义，尤其是 global uniqueness、expansion/contraction 序列化，以及为什么这让每个生成步骤都可审计。再看 post-training task 的 difficulty 设计，因为 256-token budget 与 Difficulty 1–3 的定义直接决定了为什么 macro composition 是必要的，而不是可有可无的捷径。

第二个重点是轨迹 taxonomy：primitive、macro、parallel、spurious。这里是判断 RL 是否产生组合策略的核心证据。只看 pass@k 容易把 valid macro 和 invalid shortcut 混在一起。第三个重点是 RL 与 RFT 的比较，特别是 RFT 为什么会 plateau，以及 GRPO 的 same-prompt contrast 如何抑制 spurious passenger actions。第四个重点是第 7 节的 pretraining distribution 消融。它连接到预训练研究最关心的问题：什么样的预训练分布会形成可被 RL 压缩和复用的程序性结构。

值得深挖的是两个方向。第一，把 rewrite grammar 中的 procedural substrate 对应到真实 LLM 的预训练数据，例如代码、数学推导、工具调用轨迹、可验证合成数据。第二，把 final-answer binary reward 下的策略形成过程与自然语言 RL 中的 CoT 格式化、捷径、reward hacking 区分开。这个环境虽然抽象，但提供了一套比自然语言任务更干净的诊断工具。

summary_en.core_problem: The central question is whether RL post-training only amplifies low-probability behaviors already present in the base model, or whether it can compose primitive pretrained skills into new higher-level reasoning strategies. The paper studies this in a fully observable rewrite-grammar environment, where the pretraining distribution is known and every generated rewrite can be audited. This removes several confounders that are hard to control in real LLMs: whether a behavior appeared in pretraining, whether it was already reachable by larger sampling, and whether intermediate steps are valid reasoning or accidental shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant to the interface between pretraining and post-training. Its value is not the symbolic task itself, but the controlled evidence it provides. Pretraining gives the model local primitive rewrite competence. RL, trained only with a binary final-answer reward, reorganizes that competence into reusable sequential and parallel compositions. This supports a mechanism stronger than simple probability reweighting: RL can induce procedural chunking when the pretrained model contains the right local substrate. For pretraining research, the key implication is that the organization of primitive competence in the pretraining distribution can determine which strategies later become reachable under RL.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The environment is defined over a symbolic alphabet. Each source symbol maps to one or more globally unique multi-character right-hand-side strings. Global uniqueness makes primitive contraction unambiguous: any substring matching a right-hand side maps back to exactly one source symbol. The environment supports two inverse primitive operations. Expansion replaces a symbol with one of its right-hand sides. Contraction replaces a matching substring with its source symbol. Each step is serialized with the relevant position, span, and rule, which makes trajectory-level auditing possible.

A Transformer is pretrained from scratch on primitive rewrite chains. The generator starts from an initial word, repeatedly samples valid primitive expansions or contractions, appends the serialized action, and uses the resulting word as the next input. Pretraining exposes the model to local grammar-consistent dynamics, but not to the non-primitive shortcuts analyzed later. A contraction weight ρ controls the pretraining distribution; the default is ρ=4. This locally upweights contraction moves when both directions are available, without directly fixing the realized contraction frequency or chain length.

Post-training uses a goal-directed contraction task. A prompt is produced by expanding a target symbol c* into a longer word w_prompt. The model sees only w_prompt and must generate a contraction trace whose final emitted symbol is c*. The reward is binary and depends only on the final answer. Since the grammar is exactly known, each generated trajectory can be classified into primitive rule use, valid non-primitive composition, and invalid rewrite. Valid composition has two forms: sequential composition, which collapses an ordered chain of primitive contractions into a macro step, and parallel composition, which combines independent primitive contractions in one emitted step. This taxonomy is the technical core of the paper because it turns the vague claim of “new reasoning strategy” into an auditable trajectory property.

The comparison with rejection fine-tuning is important. RFT selects successful samples and can copy shortcut-like rewrites, but many of these are spurious. RL, especially with GRPO-style same-prompt contrast, concentrates probability mass on valid reusable structure and suppresses invalid passenger actions. The finite-group view explains why the advantage is not merely larger exploration volume, but better selection among behaviors produced for the same prompt.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around difficulty and trajectory structure. Difficulty is defined by the length of the optimal primitive contraction solution under a 256-token generation budget. Difficulty 1 problems have an optimal primitive solution that fits within the budget. Difficulty 2 requires one extra primitive contraction step beyond the budget. Difficulty 3 requires two extra steps. The RL training mixture contains 60% Difficulty 1, 20% Difficulty 2, and 20% Difficulty 3 examples. Evaluation covers held-out Difficulty 1–6, including difficulties beyond the training distribution.

The main findings are clear. First, RL solves held-out problems that the pretrained model rarely solves even with much larger sampling budgets. The gains emerge late in training and become larger as difficulty increases, which supports finite-budget frontier expansion rather than only small-k reranking. Second, RFT improves early but plateaus. It imitates successful traces, including shortcut-like behavior, but does not reliably separate valid compositions from spurious rewrites. Third, trace analysis shows a phased mechanism: RL first strengthens primitive reductions, then discovers and reuses valid compositions, and eventually consolidates sequential macros and parallel compositions into stable strategies. Fourth, the pretraining distribution matters. The default ρ=4 setting creates a contraction-biased procedural substrate, and the ablation in Section 7 tests whether the organization of contraction chaining affects which strategies RL can later compress and reuse.

The provided content does not specify model parameter count, pretraining token count, training steps, or exact pass-rate values. The reliable numerical details are the 256-token generation budget, ρ=4, the RL training mixture of 60/20/20 over Difficulties 1–3, and held-out evaluation over Difficulties 1–6.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This paper is worth a careful read. Start with the rewrite grammar and primitive action definitions, especially global uniqueness, serialized expansion and contraction actions, and the reason these choices make every generated step auditable. Then read the post-training task setup and difficulty definition. The 256-token budget and the Difficulty 1–3 construction explain why macro composition is required rather than merely convenient.

The second key part is the trajectory taxonomy: primitive, macro, parallel, and spurious. This is where the paper provides evidence about strategy formation rather than relying only on pass@k. The third key part is the RL-versus-RFT comparison, especially why RFT plateaus and how GRPO-style same-prompt contrast suppresses spurious passenger actions. The fourth key part is the pretraining-distribution ablation in Section 7, which is the most directly relevant part for pretraining researchers.

Two follow-up directions are worth considering. One is mapping the procedural substrate in this symbolic environment to real pretraining data, such as code, mathematical derivations, tool-use traces, or verifiable synthetic trajectories. The other is using this kind of trace audit to separate genuine strategy formation from formatting gains, shortcuts, and reward hacking in natural-language RL.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对“RL 只是把 base model 里已有能力采样出来”的 prior；先复现它的合成环境，再拿内部 reasoning traces 检查是否也有同样的分阶段组合现象。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that RL only samples out latent base-model skills; replicate the synthetic setup first, then inspect your own reasoning traces for the same phased compositional transition.

paper.title: Final Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Analyzing Latent Reasoning Faithfulness Along Training Trajectories
paper.abstract: Latent reasoning methods perform multi-step inference entirely in the model's continuous hidden states, promising more compact and efficient reasoning. However, these opaque hidden states raise a question of faithfulness: whether these latent reasoning steps causally drive the final answer. Prior work investigates this question at converged checkpoints and reports several unfaithful behaviors, such as latent reasoning steps that can be replaced without changing the answer, but leaves how these b

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：latent reasoning 的“faithfulness”不是只看最终 checkpoint 就能判断，训练过程中这种因果贡献会如何形成、衰减或反转。
summary.importance: 对预训练和训练动态研究的启发在于，它把一个通常在收敛点上做静态分析的问题，改成了沿训练轨迹的动态分析。结论很重要：不同 latent reasoning 范式在最终 checkpoint 上可能表现出相似的不忠实行为，但形成路径并不一样；而且 latent steps 对最终答案的因果作用会随着训练推进而衰减，甚至会因为答案格式不同而出现相反趋势。这对任何把“中间隐状态当作推理空间”的建模路线都有提醒作用：训练目标未必在强化真正依赖 latent steps 的计算，模型可能逐渐学会绕开它们。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者用统一的 GPT-2 backbone，跟踪不同 latent reasoning 训练范式在多个保存 checkpoint 上的 faithfulness 变化。分析分两层。第一层是输出层面的 counterfactual faithfulness：在 ProsQA 上构造 405 组经 BFS oracle 验证的最小编辑样本对，只改图中的一条边，使正确答案从 A 翻到 B，然后看模型预测是否随编辑一起翻转。第二层是激活层面的 causal contribution：对 latent reasoning steps 做 noise-ablation activation patch，测量替换或扰动这些隐状态后输出变化的比例，从而估计这些 latent steps 是否真的在驱动答案。作者还控制内容与训练 recipe，只改变答案格式，比较 binary choice 与 open-ended decoding 下轨迹是否一致。核心贡献不在提出新的 latent reasoning 模型，而在提出一套沿训练过程观察 faithfulness 形成机制的分析框架。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三点。第一，不同 latent reasoning 范式在最终 checkpoint 上都可能显得不够 faithful，但沿训练轨迹看，输出层面的行为分化明显，说明“终点相似”掩盖了“路径不同”。第二，latent reasoning steps 的因果贡献在训练过程中会下降，且这种下降与输出层面发生 counterfactual failure 的样本群体是对应的，不是随机现象。第三，只改变答案格式，激活层面的轨迹就会反向：binary choice 设定下 latent steps 的因果作用随训练减弱，而 open-ended decoding 下反而增强。实验规模上，核心分析基于 405 个经 oracle 验证的 ProsQA counterfactual pairs 和 6 个保存 checkpoint。这个结果更像机制诊断，而不是追求 benchmark 分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看引言里的三个研究问题，再看 counterfactual construction 和 activation patch 的定义，最后看按 checkpoint 展开的主图。重点不是记住具体范式名字，而是理解作者如何把“faithfulness”拆成输出响应和激活因果贡献两层。若时间有限，读方法设定、RQ1/RQ2 主结果图、以及答案格式对比部分，大约 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线。若你关心 latent reasoning 或 continuous hidden-state computation，这篇值得作为训练动态分析的参考模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but underexplored question: if latent reasoning is sometimes unfaithful at the final checkpoint, how does that unfaithfulness emerge during training rather than only at convergence?
summary_en.importance: Its main value is methodological. Instead of treating a trained latent reasoner as a fixed object, the paper studies faithfulness as a training-trajectory property. The key finding is that similar endpoint behavior can arise from different trajectories, and that the causal contribution of latent reasoning steps can decay over training rather than strengthen. It also shows that this trajectory is not format-invariant: changing only the answer format can reverse the direction of the effect. For researchers interested in hidden-state reasoning, implicit computation, or training dynamics, this is a useful warning that optimization may gradually route around the intended latent computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze multiple latent reasoning paradigms on a shared GPT-2 backbone across saved checkpoints. They use two interventions. First, they build 405 verified counterfactual pairs on ProsQA by minimally editing one graph edge so that the BFS-oracle answer flips from one option to the other; this measures output-level counterfactual faithfulness. Second, they perform noise-ablation activation patching on the latent reasoning steps to estimate whether those hidden states causally affect the final prediction. They then compare these trajectories across training and across answer formats while keeping content and training recipe otherwise fixed. The contribution is not a new latent reasoning architecture, but a training-time causal analysis framework for faithfulness.
summary_en.experiments: There are three main findings. First, different latent reasoning paradigms can look similarly unfaithful at the final checkpoint while following qualitatively different output-level trajectories during training. Second, the causal contribution of latent reasoning steps tends to decay over training, and this decay aligns with the same example cohorts that fail the counterfactual edit test. Third, answer format matters a great deal: under binary choice, the causal role of latent steps decreases over training, whereas under open-ended decoding it increases. The core analysis is built on 405 oracle-verified ProsQA counterfactual pairs and six saved checkpoints. This is a mechanism paper, not a benchmark paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim path is: read the three research questions in the introduction, then the construction of the counterfactual pairs, then the activation-patching setup, and finally the checkpoint-wise main figures. The important idea is how the paper separates faithfulness into output responsiveness and activation-level causal contribution. If you only have 20–30 minutes, focus on the RQ1/RQ2 figures and the section comparing answer formats. It is especially useful if you care about latent reasoning or training-trajectory analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接给 recipe，但会改变你看 latent reasoning 的方式：别只盯 final checkpoint，先看训练中何时开始“空转”；读干预设计和轨迹图就够了。
recommendation.en: It won’t hand you a recipe, but it changes the right question for latent reasoning: stop judging only final checkpoints and inspect when faithfulness collapses during training.

paper.title: Prompting Complexity: Shortest Prompts for Texts and Behaviors in LLMs
paper.abstract: In this paper, we define the quantity of prompting complexity: for a fixed instruction-tuned language model, what is the shortest plausible prompt that makes deterministic decoding produce a target text? It is an LM-relative analogue of resource-bounded Kolmogorov complexity: the prompt is a program, the model interface is the interpreter, and information omitted from the prompt is supplied by the model's weights, training distribution, tokenizer, template, and decoding rule. Unlike classical Ko

summary.core_problem: 如何定义一个相对于固定 LLM 的“最短提示”复杂度，用来衡量目标文本或目标行为有多少信息由 prompt 提供、多少由模型权重和接口补全。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是概念和理论分析。论文提出 prompting complexity，把 prompt 看作程序、模型接口看作解释器，给出一个 LLM-relative 的资源受限 Kolmogorov complexity 类比。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义在固定 instruction-tuned model、tokenizer、chat template 和 deterministic decoding 下，使模型产生目标文本的最短 plausible human-readable prompt。有限上下文中可通过枚举计算；同时扩展到 approximate output 的 soft prompting complexity。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要是形式化定义和性质讨论，未报告模型规模、数据集、搜索算法实验、baseline 或量化结果。核心结论是该度量非 universal，且不存在模型无关的不变性定理。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Dalle Molle Institute for Artificial Intelligence (IDSIA)。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to define a model-relative shortest-prompt complexity that measures how much of a target text or behavior is specified by the prompt versus supplied by the model and its interface.
summary_en.importance: This is a conceptual and theoretical analysis contribution. It introduces prompting complexity, treating the prompt as a program and the model interface as an interpreter, analogous to a resource-bounded Kolmogorov complexity relative to a fixed LLM.
summary_en.technical_approach: For a fixed instruction-tuned model, tokenizer, chat template, and deterministic decoding rule, the measure is the shortest plausible human-readable prompt that produces a target text. In finite-context settings it is computable by enumeration, and the paper extends the definition to soft prompting complexity for approximate outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is primarily formal and does not report model sizes, datasets, search experiments, baselines, or quantitative results. The main stated property is that the measure is non-universal and lacks a model-independent invariance theorem.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with the Dalle Molle Institute for Artificial Intelligence (IDSIA).

recommendation.zh: 概念比实验重要；可作为 memorization、prompt search 和模型归纳偏置的语言，不必期待训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: The concept matters more than experiments; useful vocabulary for memorization, prompt search, and model bias, but not a training recipe.

institutions: Dalle Molle Institute for Artificial Intelligence
Dalle Molle Institute for Artificial Intelligence (IDSIA)

paper.title: Legible-by-Construction: Attention and End-to-End Transformers
paper.abstract: A companion paper showed that a transformer's feed-forward layer can be rebuilt from explicit fuzzy set operations - intersection, set-difference, and a self-forgetting sequence quantifier - so its hidden units read as named logical operators at no cost to language-model quality. That left the other half of the transformer opaque. Here we carry the same idea into attention and join the two into one model. The mechanism is minimal: a head's value is passed through a sigmoid, so each value channel

summary.core_problem: 论文试图让 Transformer 的 attention 路径在结构上更可读，而不是训练后再用 probing、logit lens 或 sparse autoencoder 解释。核心问题是 attention 的 QK 路径相对容易理解为“看哪里”，但 OV 路径很难解释为“写什么”。作者提出把 value 通道约束成可读的模糊集合成员关系，同时保持输出投影自由。
summary.importance: 这是一篇架构与机制解释交界的工作。它的价值不在语言建模指标提升，而在提出一种可训练的可解释 attention 设计：约束检测对象，不约束写入方式。这个原则对预训练研究有启发，因为很多可解释性约束会损伤模型容量，或者给优化器留下无意义捷径。这里的设计尝试保留标准 attention 的主要自由度，只在 value 上加 sigmoid 边界和选择性压力，让通道更像“某个特征是否成立”的检测器。
summary.technical_approach: 主要改动是将每个 head 的 value 写成 v = sigmoid(W_v x)，把 value channel 限制在 [0, 1]，解释为 fuzzy membership。attention 对这些 membership 做上下文聚合，输出投影仍然完全自由。这个 bounded-value / free-readout 设计是关键：如果反过来约束输出写入，例如把 head output 绑到词表空间，模型可能走上下文无关常量的梯度捷径，表面可读但没有实际选择性。论文还讨论 Boolean variant，把 value 进一步组织成显式的 within-token intersection 与 set-difference，使 OV 路径更接近逻辑操作。训练上加入两类压力：sparsity 让检测器只在少数上下文触发，crispness 让激活靠近 0 或 1。不同设计需要不同正则：单一 membership value 需要 sparsity 和 crispness；显式 conjunction 已经天然稀疏，更适合只加 crispness，否则容易变成死通道。
summary.experiments: 实验在 125M 参数规模上比较五种 specialized-attention 设计。结果显示，bounded value 设计中有 44% 到 62% 的 value channels 形成清晰、上下文选择性的检测器；与之对比，vocabulary-tied 设计出现 constant-collapse。层深也有明显影响：最深层可选择通道比例达到 70% 到 95%，并能读出较稳定的语义和语法特征，例如抽象概念、领域、人物/复数相关通道。论文还报告该 attention 设计可以和 companion work 中的 legible FFN 合并成端到端 Transformer，并声称没有牺牲语言模型质量。最有信息量的消融是约束位置和正则位置：约束 value 而不是 output，正则 operands 而不是组合后的 operator output。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 对 QK/OV 可读性差异的分析，再看 Section 3 关于为什么不能约束 write/output，尤其是 vocabulary-tied 设计的失败原因。Section 3.6 和 Section 4 是重点：前者解释 sparsity、crispness 应该施加在哪里，后者给出 125M 模型上各设计的选择性比例和通道示例。若关心可解释架构是否能扩展到大模型，需要额外检查训练开销、困惑度对比、正则强度敏感性，以及这些通道在更大数据规模下是否仍保持可读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the opacity of the attention OV path. QK patterns are relatively interpretable as where a head attends, while the value and output path is much harder to read as what the head contributes. The goal is to make attention legible by construction rather than relying only on post-hoc interpretability tools.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits between architecture design and mechanistic interpretability. Its main lesson for pretraining researchers is about where to place interpretability constraints. Constraining the detector side of a head can make channels readable while preserving a free output projection; constraining the write side can create optimization shortcuts and collapse to context-independent behavior. This is a useful design principle for building models whose internal units are easier to inspect without directly tying them to vocabulary outputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core modification is minimal: replace the raw value with a bounded membership value, v = sigmoid(W_v x), so each value channel lies in [0, 1] and can be interpreted as whether a feature holds at the token. Attention then aggregates these memberships over context, while the output projection remains unconstrained. This bounded-value/free-readout split is the central mechanism. The paper also studies a Boolean variant in which values are structured as explicit within-token intersections and set differences, mirroring the legible FFN operators from the companion work. Training uses two pressures: sparsity, to make detectors fire only in selected contexts, and crispness, to push activations toward 0 or 1. The paper emphasizes that the pressure must match the operator: a single membership value benefits from both, while an explicit conjunction is already sparse and mainly needs crispness.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use 125M-parameter models and compare five specialized attention designs. In the bounded-value designs, 44% to 62% of value channels become crisp and context-selective, whereas the vocabulary-tied design collapses to constants. Selectivity increases with depth: the deepest layers reach 70% to 95% selective channels, with interpretable examples tied to semantic and grammatical features such as abstract concepts, domains, and people/plural distinctions. The paper also combines legible attention with the earlier legible FFN into an end-to-end Transformer and reports no language-model quality loss. The important ablations concern the location of the constraint and regularization: constrain the value, not the output; regularize operator operands, not only the combined output.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the introduction for the QK-versus-OV framing. Then read Section 3 for the failure mode of constraining the write/output path, especially the vocabulary-tied shortcut. Sections 3.6 and 4 are the most useful parts: they explain the sparsity/crispness pressures and show the 125M-scale channel selectivity results. For deeper follow-up, inspect perplexity trade-offs, sensitivity to regularization strength, and whether the same legibility survives larger models and broader pretraining data.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但它在“attention 可解释性要约束哪里”上给了清楚立场；先看方法假设和可视化，性能结论先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it makes a clean claim about where interpretability constraints should live in attention; read the construction and visual evidence first, treat the quality claim as provisional.

paper.title: On the Limits of Steering Vectors for Preference-Aligned Generation
paper.abstract: Steering vectors have emerged as a promising approach to controlled text generation, offering interpretable, training-free mechanisms for shaping model outputs. However, their practical generality remains poorly understood. We study the limits of steering vector generalization along three dimensions: trait expressibility, task transfer, and multi-trait composition. Using the PLUME writing personalization benchmark, we extract steering vectors for a range of preferences and evaluate them on summa

summary.core_problem: 评估 steering vector 在偏好对齐生成中的泛化边界，包括特质可表达性、任务迁移和多特质组合。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和负结果。它不直接改进预训练，但能提醒研究者不要把 activation steering 的线性、可组合、跨任务泛化假设用得太宽。
summary.technical_approach: 在 PLUME 写作个性化 benchmark 上抽取不同偏好的 steering vectors，并在摘要和邮件写作任务中测试。论文比较单一特质 steering、跨任务迁移以及多 steering vector 组合方法，模型包括 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个开源 instruct 模型和多个写作偏好特质。主要发现是不同特质的 steering 效果差异很大；从正负风格样例抽取的向量迁移到下游个性化写作时可能退化；多特质组合方法都会出现明显的特质保真度下降。摘要未给出具体数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Columbia University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the generalization limits of steering vectors for preference-aligned generation across trait expressibility, task transfer, and multi-trait composition.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic and empirical limitation study. It does not change pretraining practice directly, but it cautions against assuming that activation steering is broadly linear, composable, and task-transferable.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the PLUME writing personalization benchmark, the authors extract steering vectors for different preferences and evaluate them on summarization and email-writing tasks. They compare single-trait steering, transfer from positive/negative style examples, and several multi-vector composition methods on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers two open-source instruct models and multiple preference traits. It finds large variation across traits, degradation when vectors extracted from style examples are transferred to downstream writing personalization, and significant drops in trait preservation for multi-trait composition. The abstract does not provide exact numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Columbia University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 steering vector 负结果备查；读 trait transfer 表即可，别把它当 alignment 方法有效性的强证据。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a negative-results reference for steering vectors; read the trait-transfer table, but do not treat it as strong evidence about alignment methods broadly.

paper.title: Understanding Geometric Representations in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers via Subspace Intervention
paper.abstract: We introduce a controlled subspace intervention framework to investigate how self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) encode dense geometric information. While linear probing is widely used to assess geometric representations, it treats features as a black box, failing to disentangle the underlying topology. To address this issue, we decompose the weights of converged linear probes to isolate the low-rank subspaces containing explicit geometric signals using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD).

summary.core_problem: 解释自监督 ViT 如何编码密集几何信息，以及线性 probe 看到的几何能力实际分布在哪些特征子空间中。
summary.importance: 这是视觉表征机制分析，贡献在于用子空间干预拆解 DINOv2、MAE 等预训练目标形成的几何表示差异；对 VLM 视觉编码器选择有间接参考，但不是 LLM 预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者对收敛后的线性 probe 权重做 SVD 分解，隔离含有显式几何信号的低秩子空间，再通过受控子空间干预分析不同层、不同预训练目标和不同空间上下文对几何提取的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和数值结果；主要发现包括 DINOv2 的空间特征更利于线性提取，MAE 的几何信号更分散且依赖更大上下文，显式几何表征可被低秩压缩，层间任务 affinity 可用于选择特征层。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how self-supervised ViTs encode dense geometric information and where the geometry captured by linear probes resides in feature subspaces.
summary_en.importance: It is a mechanism analysis of vision representations. Its value is in disentangling how objectives such as DINOv2 and MAE shape geometric representations; it is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining through VLM encoder design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method decomposes converged linear-probe weights with SVD to isolate low-rank subspaces carrying explicit geometric signals, then applies controlled subspace interventions to analyze objective, layer, and spatial-context effects.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model scale, datasets, or exact numbers. Reported findings include easier linear extraction from DINOv2 spatial features, more dispersed and context-dependent geometry in MAE, high compressibility of explicit geometry, and layer-wise task affinity useful for feature selection.

recommendation.zh: 看 Fig/消融找视觉 encoder 选择信号即可；子空间干预方法有借鉴，结论不要直接外推到语言模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the figures and ablations for visual-encoder selection signals; the subspace-intervention method is useful, but do not extrapolate the claims to LMs.

paper.title: DiscoLoop: Looping Discrete Embeddings and Continuous Hidden States for Multi-hop Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models achieve strong performance on many reasoning tasks when allowed to externalize intermediate steps as Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, many questions require the model to internalize the multi-step reasoning within a single forward pass before generating the answer. We study this challenge through two-hop reasoning, a representative task where the model must compose multiple pieces of parametric knowledge within a single forward pass. Standard non-recurrent Transformers suff

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 在单次 forward pass 内做多跳组合推理的问题。标准 Transformer 即使记住了原子事实，也常常不能把两个事实组合起来；looped Transformer 通过重复使用同一参数块缓解了深度局部存储问题，但仍然存在中间表示和下一轮输入 embedding 空间不对齐的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的启发主要在架构和机制分析。论文指出，隐式多跳推理不只是“中间实体能否从 hidden state 解码出来”的问题，还取决于这个 hidden state 是否以后一轮计算可直接使用的几何形式存在。这个观察对 latent reasoning、recurrent Transformer、test-time compute、以及减少显式 CoT 依赖都有参考意义。它不是通用预训练 recipe，但给出了一个清楚的架构假设：循环计算中传递连续 hidden state 还不够，需要显式保留或恢复离散 embedding 对齐的通道。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用受控 symbolic two-hop reasoning 任务分析 vanilla looped Transformer。结果显示，第一轮循环后，bridge entity 往往可以从连续 hidden vector 中线性或探针式解码出来，但这个向量仍然噪声较大，并且和该实体的干净 token embedding 几何不一致。换句话说，模型“知道”了中间实体，但下一轮循环不能像读取正常输入 token 那样稳定使用它。作者进一步做 training-free realignment intervention，把中间表示重新对齐到离散 embedding 空间，性能差距几乎被补上。基于这个发现，DiscoLoop 在 looped Transformer 中加入 decoded embedding channel：循环之间不仅传递 continuous hidden states，也传递解码后、与离散 embedding 对齐的向量。这样既保留 recurrence 复用参数记忆的好处，又降低 loop-to-loop representation mismatch。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 symbolic two-hop reasoning、synthetic-language multi-hop reasoning，以及真实预训练任务。论文报告 DiscoLoop 在 symbolic 和 synthetic-language 任务上以更少训练步数达到接近满分的测试准确率，尤其改善了 OOD 设置：训练中只见过原子事实，测试时要求组合成未见过的二跳查询。在真实预训练任务上，DiscoLoop 相比 looped Transformer baseline 获得更低 training loss，并在若干 benchmark 上表现更好。给定内容没有提供具体参数规模、训练 token 数或逐项数值，因此这些数字需要读原文实验表格确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟，若关注 latent reasoning 可读到 1 小时。先看 Section 2 的 ID/OOD two-hop 任务定义，否则后面的泛化结论不容易判断。然后看 Section 3 的机制分析，重点是 bridge entity 的 decodability 与 embedding alignment 的区别，以及 training-free realignment intervention。最后看 Section 5 的真实预训练实验，判断 decoded embedding channel 是否只解决合成任务，还是对普通 LM 训练也有收益。读实验时要特别检查 baseline 是否匹配参数量、循环次数和计算量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies implicit multi-hop reasoning inside a single forward pass. Standard Transformers can memorize atomic facts but often fail to compose them. Looped Transformers help by reusing the same parametric memory across hops, but they still suffer from a representation mismatch between the hidden state produced after one loop and the clean discrete embedding that the next loop would ideally consume.
summary_en.importance: The main value is architectural and mechanistic. The paper argues that decoding an intermediate entity from a hidden vector is not sufficient for reliable implicit reasoning; the representation also needs to be aligned with the embedding space used by the next reasoning step. This matters for latent reasoning, recurrent Transformers, test-time computation, and approaches that try to reduce dependence on explicit chain-of-thought tokens. The contribution is not a full pretraining recipe, but it gives a concrete design principle for recurrent language models: pass both continuous states and discrete-embedding-aligned information across loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first analyze vanilla looped Transformers on controlled symbolic two-hop reasoning tasks. They find that after the first loop, the bridge entity is often recoverable from the continuous hidden vector, yet the vector remains noisy and geometrically misaligned with the clean embedding of that entity. This explains why the next loop cannot reliably use the bridge as if it had appeared as a normal input token. A training-free realignment intervention nearly closes the gap, supporting the representation-mismatch diagnosis. DiscoLoop implements this idea architecturally by adding a decoded embedding channel between loops. The recurrent block still passes continuous hidden states, but it also passes vectors aligned to the discrete embedding space, preserving memory reuse while reducing loop-to-loop mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover symbolic two-hop reasoning, synthetic-language multi-hop reasoning, and real-world pretraining tasks. DiscoLoop is reported to reach near-perfect test accuracy with substantially fewer training steps on symbolic and synthetic-language tasks, including harder OOD settings where atomic facts are observed during training but their compositional two-hop queries are not. On real-world pretraining tasks, it obtains lower training loss and stronger benchmark performance than looped-Transformer baselines. The provided content does not include exact model sizes, token counts, or per-benchmark numbers, so those details should be checked in the experiment tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30-minute skim is sufficient for a first pass; spend up to an hour if latent reasoning is a focus. Start with the task definitions in Section 2, especially the distinction between ID and OOD two-hop evaluation. Then read the mechanistic analysis in Section 3, where the key distinction is decodability versus embedding alignment. The training-free realignment intervention is the clearest evidence for the proposed bottleneck. Finally inspect the real-world pretraining results in Section 5 and check whether baselines are matched for parameter count, number of loops, and compute.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看机制部分：它把“单步多跳推理不行”从泛泛能力问题落到表示对齐缺陷；先读 bridge entity 可解码但答不出的分析，再决定要不要试 looped/latent scratchpad 线。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism section: it turns single-pass multi-hop failure from a vague capability issue into a representation-alignment defect; start with the analysis showing the bridge entity is decodable yet unusable, then decide whether to pursue looped or latent-scratchpad variants.

paper.title: The Model Organism Lottery: Model Organism Interpretability Strongly Depends on Training Methodology
paper.abstract: Model organisms (MOs) - language models trained to exhibit undesired or unnatural behaviours - are frequently used as testbeds for evaluating white-box interpretability techniques. Current MOs are typically constructed via post-hoc supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on behavioural transcripts or synthetic documents. Prior research has shown that interpretability methods can easily identify hidden behaviours in these MOs. However, recent work suggests that such post-hoc training methods may make interp

summary.core_problem: 当前用于白盒可解释性技术评测的主流测试集是模型有机体（Model Organism, MO）——即被刻意训练出特定目标行为的语言模型。现有MO几乎都通过窄域后处理监督微调构造，这类MO上测得的可解释性结果能否外推到常规训练中自然涌现的行为，以及MO构造方法对可解释性评测结果的影响程度，此前没有系统研究。
summary.importance: 结果说明基于窄域SFT构造MO的基准得到的可解释性结果普遍偏乐观，无法可靠代表方法在真实模型上的表现。更重要的是，工作提供了明确证据：相同的外在行为可以由完全不同的内部表征支撑，训练方式（后处理SFT/DPO/融入正式后训练流程）对表征结构的影响远大于行为层面的相似性，这对理解post-training如何修改模型内部表征、设计更可靠的对齐评测方法都有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构造了严格控制变量的MO测试集，共54个模型，基于OLMo2-1B和Gemma-3-1b-it两个底座，覆盖三类良性触发-反应行为：烘焙错误事实、食物语境下的意大利餐偏好、军事语境下的潜艇话题执念。每类行为下分别用7种训练方式构造MO变体：标准后处理转录蒸馏（TD）、合成文档微调（SDF），两种方法分别设置加/不加无关通用数据混合的版本；后处理DPO，同样设置加/不加通用数据混合的版本；以及更贴近真实流程的集成式训练：将行为相关数据直接混入OLMo原生的DPO后训练阶段共同训练。所有MO都校准到相同的行为触发率和反应强度，且控制行为不会泄露到无关语境。之后用四类主流白盒可解释性方法（激活预言机、基于激活差的引导、logit lens方法、稀疏自编码器）测试每个MO中植入行为的可检测程度，控制变量对比训练方法、行为类型、模型架构的影响。
summary.experiments: 核心结果包括三点：第一，外在行为完全匹配的MO，仅因训练方式不同，可解释性方法的检测成功率差异可达1.2-20.4倍；第二，传统窄域后处理SFT构造的MO可检测性最高，即最容易被解释，而最贴近真实后训练流程的集成式DPO构造的MO可检测性显著最低；第三，不同可解释性方法在不同训练方式MO上的表现排序，在不同行为类型、不同模型架构之间没有一致的泛化性，即一个方法在某类MO上表现好，不代表在其他训练方式得到的MO上同样有效。结果对训练随机性、数据顺序鲁棒，不是随机波动导致。全部54个MO、训练数据和代码已开源。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注核心结论部分——相同外在行为在不同训练方式下的内部表征可解释性差异，以及对现有MO基准有效性的讨论，这部分对理解post-training对表征的影响最有价值。各类MO的具体训练超参数、可解释性方法的实现细节可以跳过，如果做可解释性相关工作，再参考3.3节的集成式MO构造方法和3.4节的行为匹配控制流程。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Model organisms (MOs) — language models intentionally trained to exhibit specific target behaviors — are the standard testbed for white-box interpretability evaluation. Nearly all existing MOs are built via narrow post-hoc supervised fine-tuning, and it remains untested whether interpretability results on these artificial MOs generalize to behaviors that emerge during regular model training, or how strongly MO construction methodology affects measured interpretability performance.
summary_en.importance: Results show that interpretability benchmarks built on narrow SFT MOs produce consistently overoptimistic results, and do not reliably predict method performance on models trained via more realistic pipelines. Beyond implications for interpretability evaluation, the work provides clear evidence that identical observable behavior can be supported by drastically different internal representations: training methodology (post-hoc SFT / DPO / integrated post-training) has a far larger effect on representational structure than surface-level behavioral similarity. This is relevant to understanding how post-training modifies model internals, and to designing more robust alignment evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled suite of 54 MOs is constructed on OLMo2-1B and gemma-3-1b-it bases, covering three benign trigger-reaction quirks: false cake baking facts, Italian food preference in food contexts, and submarine fixation in military contexts. For each quirk, 7 training variants are produced: standard post-hoc transcript distillation and synthetic document fine-tuning (each with and without unrelated general data mixing), post-hoc DPO (with and without general data mixing), and a novel integrated construction method that inserts quirk data directly into OLMo’s official DPO post-training pipeline. All MOs are calibrated to identical quirk trigger rates and response strength, with controls to prevent quirk leakage into irrelevant contexts. Four standard white-box interpretability techniques (activation oracles, activation difference steering, logit lens, sparse autoencoders) are used to measure quirk detectability across all MOs under controlled conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings emerge: First, MOs with identical observable behavior exhibit 1.2–20.4× variation in quirk detectability, driven solely by training method. Second, standard narrow post-hoc SFT MOs are the most easily interpretable, while integrated DPO MOs (closest to realistic post-training pipelines) are consistently the least detectable. Third, performance rankings of interpretability methods across training protocols do not generalize across quirk types or model architectures, meaning strong performance on one MO variant does not predict performance on others. Results are robust to training nondeterminism and data ordering, and are not explained by random variation. All 54 MOs, training data, and code are open-sourced.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core result that behaviorally identical models have drastically different interpretability based on training method, and the discussion of limitations in current MO benchmark design — these are the most relevant insights for understanding post-training representational changes. Skim detailed training hyperparameters and interpretability method implementation details unless actively building interpretability benchmarks; if so, refer to Section 3.3 for the integrated MO construction method and Section 3.4 for the behavioral matching control protocol. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 重要的方法论警示——模型生物的构造方法会严重影响可解释性实验结果，做机制研究的研究员需要注意MO构造的效度问题，重点看§4的实验结果。
recommendation.en: Important methodological warning—MO construction methods heavily affect interpretability experiment results; researchers doing mechanism studies need to be aware of MO validity issues; focus on §4 experimental results.

paper.title: World-Model Collapse as a Phase Transition
paper.abstract: Water looks unchanged as it warms, then at a critical point it boils. We ask whether long-horizon language agents show an analogous transition in their implicit world models. In some parameter settings, changing state load by a small amount, or adding a single step of horizon, leaves behavior nearly unchanged; near a critical boundary, the same small change causes a sudden world collapse. We study this effect in a deterministic task family with exact per-step gold state. A large grid search over

summary.core_problem: 研究长程语言 Agent 的隐式世界模型是否会在状态负载或任务 horizon 小幅增加时出现突然崩塌。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和可测量现象提出。它把长程 Agent 失败从平均性能下降改写为相变式边界问题，并区分世界状态保真度与动作合法性两个层面的失败。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造一个确定性任务族，带有精确的逐步 gold state。通过网格搜索状态基数、依赖密度、horizon、branching、观测模式和 mutation rate，绘制 solved plateau、transition band 和 collapse floor 组成的 phase diagram。逐步 trace 用于判断错误先出现在状态维护还是动作选择。
summary.experiments: 实验采用可控合成任务而非真实开放环境。摘要称大规模网格搜索发现窄转移带；逐步轨迹显示 world-state fidelity 先于 action validity 下降；更强模型可以移动临界边界，但不能消除这种定性相变。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-horizon language agents undergo abrupt implicit world-model collapse when state load or horizon increases slightly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic analysis and a measurable failure phenomenon. It reframes long-horizon agent degradation as a phase-boundary problem and separates world-state fidelity from action validity.
summary_en.technical_approach: It builds a deterministic task family with exact per-step gold states. A grid search varies state cardinality, dependency density, horizon, branching, observation mode, and mutation rate to produce a phase diagram with a solved plateau, a narrow transition band, and a collapse floor. Per-step traces are used to identify whether errors first appear in state maintenance or action choice.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use controlled synthetic tasks rather than open-ended real environments. The abstract reports a narrow transition band, state-fidelity failure before action-validity failure, and stronger models shifting the critical boundary without removing the qualitative transition.

recommendation.zh: 读 phase diagram 和 per-step trace；toy setup 不能外推太远，但它给长程 Agent 失败一个可复现实验形状。
recommendation.en: Read the phase diagram and per-step traces; the toy setup limits extrapolation, but it gives long-horizon agent failure a reproducible shape.

paper.title: Decodable Is Not Grounded: A Vision-Ablation Arbiter for VLM Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: The standard way to read latent knowledge out of a model, a linear probe confirmed by a steering recovery, can systematically overstate what a vision-language model (VLM) actually grounds in the image. We show this on spatial reasoning, where the error is invisible to both probing and steering yet exposed by a one-line causal control: replacing the image with a gray blank. Probes decode the within-axis answer at 73--97% across axes, and a training-free projection lifts a near-chance axis from 59

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要纠正一个在 VLM 机制分析里很常见、但容易误判的推断链条：如果某个属性能被线性 probe 从中间表征里高精度解码出来，而且沿着该方向做无训练 steering/projection 还能把行为拉好，是否就能说明模型“已经具备这项视觉知识，只是没有正确调用”。作者用空间推理里的相机相对方向判断做了一个很干净的反例。结论是：不能。因为 probe 解到的可能只是语言先验，steering 拉起来的也可能只是把先验放大，而不是把视觉 grounding 重新接通。更进一步，模型还可能处在一种更隐蔽的状态：它确实在看图，但把视觉信号用反了，导致真实图像下反而低于随机猜测。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在于空间推理这个任务本身，而在于它给出了一个很低成本、但判别力很强的因果控制：把图像替换成同尺寸灰图，再看准确率和 steering 增益如何变化。这个控制把原本会被 probe-and-steer 统一解释成“latent knowledge not deployed”的现象，拆成三类机制：真实 grounded 且方向正确、真实 grounded 但符号反了、以及完全由 prior 驱动。对做 VLM 预训练、表征分析、representation engineering、latent capability recovery 的人，这个结论很直接：只看可解码性和可操控性不够，必须显式检查信息是否依赖视觉输入。否则很容易把“可读出”误当成“已 grounding”，把“可恢复”误当成“视觉能力被释放”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三层。第一层是任务分解。作者选用 ViewSpatial-Bench 里的 camera-relative direction 子集，把问题拆成 horizontal、vertical、depth 三个纯轴向子任务，并区分 18 类原始准确率和 axis 内二分类准确率。这个设计很关键，因为它让“哪一维出了问题”可以被单独定位，而不是被混合空间关系掩盖。第二层是标准的 probe + steering 管线。作者在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的 decision token residual stream 上做五折交叉验证 logistic probe，先 PCA 到 50 维，再逐层读出每个轴的方向；随后用 diff-of-means 或 probe weight 回投得到方向，在 L20-L24 这一带做无训练 projection/activation edit，用单一全局系数 gamma 放大 top-k 神经元上的局部方向。按传统解释，这一步如果能显著提升行为，就会被视为“模型内部已有该知识，只是没部署出来”。第三层才是论文真正的核心：vision-ablation arbiter。它不改 prompt、不改选项、不改解码，只把图像换成同尺寸灰图，再比较真实图像与灰图条件下的基线准确率和 steering 后增益。作者据此定义三种 grounding regime：如果真实图像显著优于灰图，且灰图退到机会水平，说明该轴是 grounded-correct；如果真实图像低于机会水平，而灰图回到机会附近，说明模型在看图，但把视觉 cue 的符号用反了，即 grounded-inverted；如果真实图像和灰图几乎一致，且 steering 增益在两种条件下也一致，则说明 probe/steering 读到并放大的只是 prior，而非视觉信息。作者还做了多种稳健性检查，避免“灰图本身是异常输入”这个反驳，包括其他形式的视觉消融和 in-distribution 但语义不匹配的真实图像替换。全文后半部分进一步分析 depth inversion 的几何来源，并尝试最小编辑修正：在表征最集中的模型上，训练自由的 rotation 就能纠正；在表征更分散的模型上，需要训练式低秩编辑。这一点把“错误是局部几何错位还是分布式表征问题”也区分开了。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果集中在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的三轴对比。基线行为上，horizontal 表现较强，vertical 接近随机，depth 低于随机。probe 却给出相反印象：三个轴都能从 residual stream 解出来，vertical 甚至最好，文中给出的 within-axis probe 准确率大致是 vertical 94%、horizontal 85%，整体范围在 73% 到 97% 之间。更诱人的是无训练 projection：vertical 轴的行为准确率能从 59% 提到 79%，而 horizontal 基本不受影响，这正是“latent knowledge 被解锁”的典型信号。但灰图仲裁一做，解释完全变了。horizontal 在真实图像下约 82%，灰图掉到 49%，说明它确实依赖视觉；depth 在真实图像下只有 31%，灰图回到 45%，说明错误恰恰来自看图；vertical 则在真实图像和灰图下几乎一样，59% 对 60%，而 projection 增益也几乎一样，盲图 +19、真实图 +21，说明被放大的不是视觉表征，而是一个“默认 above”的语言先验。泛化实验覆盖 14 个 VLM、6 个 LM family、2B 到 27B 参数。作者报告的总体模式是：能力较强的模型里，horizontal 往往 grounded-correct，vertical 多数 prior-driven，depth inversion 会随规模在家族内部出现。另一个重要结果是任务边界：同一批模型在 camera-egocentric depth 上会 inverted，但在 near-field depth 和 metric depth 上又能 grounded-correct，说明问题不是“模型完全不懂深度”，而是某一类相机坐标语义映射出了系统性符号错误。修正实验里，7/8 个模型、5 个 family 复现了 depth inversion；最干净的模型可用训练自由 rotation 修正，效果接近训练式编辑，而更分布式的模型则需要低秩训练编辑，形成一个按 correction complexity 排列的谱系。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言、4 节、5 节、6 节连着看。引言已经把最重要的反常现象和三类 regime 讲清楚。4 节要重点看三轴在 probe、基线行为、灰图控制、projection 增益上的并列表格或图，那里能直接看到“最可解码的轴反而最不 grounded”。如果只看一张图，优先看真实图像与灰图条件并排的结果图。5 节值得快速扫一遍，因为它回答了两个常见质疑：这是不是 Qwen 单模型偶然现象，以及灰图是不是 out-of-distribution artifact。6 节如果关心表征编辑和机制解释，可以细看。那里讨论了 depth inversion 是不是一个可由简单几何旋转修正的局部错位，以及为什么有些模型需要训练式低秩编辑。阅读时要抓住一个主线：作者不是在否定 probe 或 steering，而是在给它们加一个必要的因果判别步骤。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主要结论；如果要复现实验，优先关注 setup、arbiter 定义、以及附录里的消融细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper challenges a common inference in VLM interpretability: if a target attribute is linearly decodable from hidden states, and a training-free steering/projection along that direction improves behavior, does that mean the model already has the visual knowledge but fails to deploy it? The answer here is no. Using camera-relative spatial reasoning as a controlled case, the authors show that decodability and steerability can both be high even when the behavior is not grounded in the image at all. They also uncover a second failure mode that is easy to miss: the model may genuinely use visual evidence, but with the wrong sign, so looking at the image makes it worse than chance.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological. The paper introduces a very cheap causal control—replace the image with a same-size gray blank and rerun the exact same prompt and decoding—that separates three mechanisms that probing and steering otherwise collapse into one story. For pretraining and representation-analysis work on VLMs, this matters because many claims about latent capability recovery rely on the chain “decodable therefore represented, steerable therefore recoverable.” This study shows that such claims are incomplete unless they test whether the recovered behavior actually depends on vision. In practice, the proposed arbiter is simple enough to become a default control for probe-based and representation-engineering results in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is deliberately narrow and controlled. The authors use the camera-relative direction subset of ViewSpatial-Bench and decompose items into pure horizontal, vertical, and depth axes, which avoids mixing different spatial factors. They evaluate both the native 18-way task accuracy and a within-axis binary accuracy. On top of this task decomposition, they run a standard probe-and-steer pipeline on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. A five-fold cross-validated logistic probe is trained on PCA-50 residual-stream features at the decision token, layer by layer, to decode each axis. Steering directions are then extracted either from class mean differences or from back-projected probe weights, and injected as a training-free activation edit in the L20-L24 band, scaled by residual-stream standard deviations and concentrated on top-k neurons with a single global coefficient. Up to this point, the setup mirrors the usual latent-knowledge recovery recipe. The key addition is the vision-ablation arbiter. The image is replaced by a gray blank while keeping the prompt, answer options, and decoding unchanged. The signed gap between real-image and blank-image performance is then used to classify each axis into one of three regimes: grounded-correct if real-image performance is higher and blank performance collapses toward chance; grounded-inverted if real-image performance is below chance but blank performance returns toward chance; prior-driven if real and blank conditions are statistically indistinguishable, including under steering. The paper also includes robustness checks against the objection that a gray blank is an unnatural input, using multiple ablations and mismatched but in-distribution real images. In later sections, the authors analyze the geometry of depth inversion and test minimal corrective edits. Some models can be fixed by a training-free rotation in representation space, while others require a trained low-rank edit, suggesting a spectrum from localized geometric misalignment to more distributed errors.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result comes from the three-axis analysis on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Behaviorally, horizontal is strong, vertical is near chance, and depth is below chance. Probing tells a very different story: all three axes are decodable from the residual stream, with vertical being the most decodable. The reported within-axis probe accuracies span roughly 73% to 97%, with vertical around 94% and horizontal around 85%. The training-free projection result looks even more convincing under the standard interpretation: vertical task accuracy rises from about 59% to 79%, while horizontal remains largely unchanged, exactly the pattern one would describe as unlocking latent knowledge. The gray-image arbiter overturns that interpretation. Horizontal drops from about 82% with the real image to 49% with the blank, so it is genuinely vision-grounded. Depth rises from 31% with the real image to 45% with the blank, showing that the error requires looking at the image and is therefore grounded but inverted.
