While mechanistic approaches have shed light on where alignment resides in model weights, they do not by provide a general formal framework for deriving guarantees about when fine-tuning degrades it -- leaving the field without principled tools for predicting or preventing alignment collapse. We develop a local geometric framework

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究一个后训练里很实际但缺少统一理论的问题：为什么看似无害的微调也会系统性破坏已对齐模型的安全护栏。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它不是再做一次经验观察，而是试图给出一个可分析的几何框架，把 alignment collapse 从“经验上会发生”推进到“何时会发生、为什么会发生”的局部可判定条件。这对理解 pretrain 与 post-train 接口、以及安全能力在参数空间中的脆弱性都有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者从参数空间轨迹的局部几何出发，分析 fine-tuning 更新在一阶与二阶近似下对对齐方向的影响。核心论点是：仅看一阶正交性会误判安全，因为 fine-tuning loss 的曲率会带来二阶加速度，使参数轨迹漂移进 alignment-sensitive 区域。作者据此形式化提出 Alignment Instability Condition (AIC)，用三个几何性质刻画何种局部结构会导致对齐不稳定，并据此讨论预测和缓解 alignment degradation 的可能路径。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，实验重点应是验证 AIC 对 alignment collapse 的解释力，而不是追求任务分数本身。论文关注 benign-task fine-tuning 下安全退化现象，比较一阶分析与二阶几何分析的预测差异，并展示局部曲率相关指标能更好解释何时 guardrail 会失效。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模和数值提升，因此更适合作为机制论文阅读，而不是当作可直接落地的 recipe。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Cohere。该机构长期做商用 LLM 与对齐相关研究，这使得论文的问题设定有现实背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical but under-theorized post-training question: why seemingly benign fine-tuning can systematically erode safety guardrails in aligned language models.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not another empirical observation of alignment collapse, but an attempt to formalize when and why it happens. That makes it relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface and to understanding how alignment-relevant capabilities are locally organized in parameter space.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze fine-tuning trajectories through a local geometric lens in parameter space. The key claim is that first-order orthogonality is not sufficient for safety: curvature of the fine-tuning loss induces second-order acceleration, which can push parameters into alignment-sensitive regions. They formalize this via an Alignment Instability Condition (AIC), defined through three geometric properties that characterize local instability of alignment under fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments are aimed at validating the explanatory power of AIC rather than maximizing downstream task scores. The setup focuses on safety degradation under benign-task fine-tuning, contrasting first-order intuitions with second-order geometric predictions, and showing that curvature-aware indicators better explain when guardrails fail. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scales, or exact gains, so this reads more as a mechanism paper than a directly deployable recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Cohere, a lab with substantial practical experience in commercial LLMs and alignment-related work, which gives the problem framing some real-world credibility.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把“无害微调也会掉对齐”从经验现象推进到二阶几何条件；先看 AIC 定义和实验对应关系，别急着把它当成可操作保证。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it upgrades 'benign fine-tuning breaks alignment' from anecdote to a second-order geometric condition; read the AIC definition and its empirical anchors, but do not mistake it for a deployable guarantee.

paper.title: Revisiting the Systematicity in Negation in the Era of In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Understanding the meaning of negated sentences remains one of the challenges for language models, even in the era of large language models (LLMs). We analyze systematicity regarding LLM understanding of negation from two perspectives: behavioral systematicity and representational systematicity. For behavioral systematicity, we confirm that through demonstrations and in-context learning, LLMs can recognize negation expressions and scope within sentences to some extent, but they fail to achieve pe

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 在 in-context learning 设置下是否系统性理解否定表达和否定作用域。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制与行为分析。否定是语言模型组合泛化的经典难点，这篇把行为系统性和表征系统性分开看，并用 function vectors 检查 ICL 示例是否形成可复用任务方向，对理解 ICL 的边界有一定价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从两条线分析：行为层面测试模型通过 demonstrations 和 ICL 识别否定标记与作用域的能力；表征层面构造 function vectors，检查从上下文示例中抽取的任务向量是否能稳定迁移到否定相关子任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型列表、参数规模、数据集规模和具体数值。主要发现是 LLM 通过 ICL 能在一定程度上识别否定表达和作用域，但不能达到完美；否定作用域识别对输出格式敏感；function vectors 对否定 cue extraction 更容易组合，对 scope recognition 更难。
summary.authors_note: 东京大学、RIKEN、东北大学。Hitomi Yanaka 长期研究自然语言推理、组合泛化和语言模型语义评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes whether LLMs systematically understand negation expressions and negation scope under in-context learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and behavioral-analysis contribution. Negation is a classic stress test for compositional generalization, and the paper separates behavioral systematicity from representational systematicity using function vectors extracted from ICL examples.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate two dimensions. Behaviorally, they test whether demonstrations and ICL help models identify negation cues and scopes. Representationally, they construct function vectors from in-context examples and test whether these vectors transfer robustly across negation-related subtasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model list, parameter scale, dataset size, or exact metrics. The reported findings are that LLMs can partially recognize negation cues and scopes with ICL, but not perfectly; scope recognition is sensitive to output format; function vectors are easier to compose for cue extraction than for scope recognition.
summary_en.authors_note: The University of Tokyo, RIKEN, and Tohoku University. Hitomi Yanaka has worked on natural language inference, compositional generalization, and semantic evaluation of language models.

recommendation.zh: 机制信号中等；只看 function vector 对 cue/scope 的对比，别把否定任务分数外推成通用语义能力。
recommendation.en: Moderate mechanism signal; read only the function-vector contrast between cue and scope, and do not overgeneralize negation scores into broad semantic competence.

paper.title: Gaze Heads: How VLMs Look at What They Describe
paper.abstract: How a vision-language model internally solves the task of describing an image is far from obvious. We find that the model develops a specific mechanism for this: a small set of attention heads in its language-model backbone, which we call gaze heads, whose attention tracks the image region the model is currently describing. We find them with a simple correlation score from a few forward passes, using comic strips as a controlled testbed where narrative order is laid out spatially. These gaze hea

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是：VLM 在生成描述时，语言 backbone 内部到底是怎样把“当前正在说的文字”对齐到“当前正在看的图像区域”的。作者不是泛泛地找“看图的头”，而是找一类更具体的机制性 attention heads：它们会随着生成过程逐 token 切换关注区域，去跟踪模型此刻正在描述的那一块视觉内容。更进一步，作者要验证这类头不只是相关，而是对“描述哪一块”具有因果控制力。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心推进，更接近 VLM 机制分析与可控生成研究。但对做原生多模态预训练的人有两点启发。第一，视觉 grounding 在语言 backbone 里可能被压缩到一小簇中后层 attention heads，而不是均匀分布在全网，这对架构设计、adapter 放置、蒸馏和稀疏干预都有意义。第二，图文对齐并不只是 encoder 侧表征问题，decoder/backbone 内部存在可定位、可操纵的时序路由机制。这个观察对理解多模态 token 如何进入统一 LM 很有价值，不过论文本身更偏 interpretability，贡献量级适合 skim，不属于 must-read 的 pretrain 方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步。第一步是定位“阅读顺序/视觉叙述顺序”在网络中的层位置。作者用六格漫画作为受控环境，因为 panel 的空间顺序天然对应叙述顺序。对同一张 strip，分别给正常提示和“reverse”提示，让模型按相反顺序读取，并在回答前的残差流上做 difference-of-means，得到一个 per-layer 的 read-in-reverse direction。然后把这个方向注入新前向过程的某一层，观察答案是否从正常顺序翻到反向顺序。结果显示只有 20–28 层这一窄带有效，说明顺序控制主要局部化在中后层。

第二步是在这些层里找具体的 gaze heads。作者定义了一个简单的相关性分数：看某个 head 在生成某段文本时，其 attention 是否稳定落在当前被描述的 panel 区域，并随叙述推进而切换。发现 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 1152 个头里，大约 100 个头满足这一性质，占 8.7%，集中在中后层。这个发现还在 2B 到 32B 的不同尺寸和其他 VLM 架构上复现，说明它不是单模型偶然现象。

第三步是做因果干预。作者不训练额外模块，而是在推理时直接修改这些 gaze heads 的 attention mask，把它们重定向到指定 panel。结果模型会被迫去描述被指向的区域。关键点在于，这种干预有一个很窄的有效窗口：干预太少，控制力不够；干预太多，会破坏语言流畅性和整体生成，说明 gaze heads 负责“看哪里”，但不是全部生成机制。文中还展示了 mid-generation intervention：生成到一半再切换目标区域，模型会先收尾当前 panel，再转去描述新 panel，说明这些头参与的是在线的视觉-语言路由，而不是一次性全局规划。
summary.experiments:
主实验基于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。模型是 36 层、每层 32 个头，共 1152 个 attention heads。发现阶段使用 COMICS 数据集中的 3948 个漫画样本，构造成六格横向拼接 strip；评估阶段使用 500 个由 GPT Image-1 生成、各 panel 视觉差异明确的六格漫画，避免 discovery data 泄漏。

几个关键结果值得记。第一，read-in-reverse direction 的层定位实验表明，只有第 20–28 层注入该方向时，模型才会显著从左到右答案翻转为从右到左答案，说明顺序表征高度局部化。第二，作者识别出 top-100 gaze heads，少于总头数的 9%。第三，只对这些 gaze heads 做 attention 重定向，就能以 83.1% 的准确率把 VQA 答案引导到指定 panel，而随机非 gaze heads 的同类干预接近失败；文中给出的 chance 是 16.7%，对应六选一。第四，控制效果不是单调增加的：头数太少只能部分转向，头数太多会损伤生成，说明这些头是一个功能子回路，而不是越多越好。第五，这套发现不仅在漫画上成立，也能迁移到自然图像和其他 VLM 尺寸/架构上，支持其普遍性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 和 Experimental Setup，理解为什么作者选 comic strips 而不是自然图像：不是为了做漫画任务，而是为了把“叙述顺序”变成可观测、可验证的空间结构。然后重点看 Sec. 4/5 附近关于 read-in-reverse direction 和 gaze head discovery 的方法，以及对应图 1 和 head 分布图。最后看 redirection intervention 的结果图表，这部分最能说明相关性是否上升为因果性。

如果只打算花 25–35 分钟，建议顺序是：层定位实验 → gaze head 打分方法 → top-100 干预结果 → 泛化到自然图像/其他模型。值得深挖的点有三个：一是这些 gaze heads 是否来自预训练阶段还是 instruction tuning 阶段形成；二是它们与已有 image heads / localization heads 的重叠程度；三是这种稀疏可控子回路能否反过来用于多模态训练时的 regularization、对齐诊断或 hallucination 抑制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific internal question in VLMs: when a model describes an image, which part of the network tracks the visual region currently being verbalized, and does that mechanism actually control what gets described? Rather than identifying generic “image-attending heads,” the authors look for a temporally aligned subset of attention heads whose focus moves with the generated narration. They call these heads gaze heads and test whether they are merely correlated with grounding or causally sufficient to steer it.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining-method paper. It is closer to mechanistic interpretability for VLMs. Still, it has useful implications for multimodal pretraining. It suggests that visual grounding inside a language-model backbone may be concentrated in a relatively small mid-to-late-layer subcircuit rather than spread uniformly across the network. That matters for architecture design, adapter placement, sparse intervention, and possibly distillation. It also reinforces a broader point: image-text alignment is not only an encoder-side representation issue. There is an online routing mechanism inside the decoder/backbone that decides which visual tokens are being turned into language at each step.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three parts. First, the authors localize where “reading order” lives in the network. They use six-panel comic strips as a controlled environment because spatial layout naturally encodes narrative order. For the same strip, they compare a normal prompt with a prompt that asks the model to read the comic in reverse. From the residual stream before the answer, they compute a difference-of-means direction for each layer. They then inject that direction into a fresh forward pass and measure whether the answer flips from left-to-right reading to right-to-left reading. Only a narrow band of layers, roughly 20 to 28, produces the flip, indicating that ordering behavior is localized in mid-late layers.

Second, within that band they identify gaze heads using a simple correlation score. A head qualifies if its attention consistently lands on the panel currently being described and shifts as the narration moves forward. In Qwen3-VL-8B, about 100 out of 1,152 heads satisfy this pattern, or 8.7% of all heads. These heads cluster in the same mid-late region. The same discovery procedure recovers similar head sets across model sizes from 2B to 32B and across other VLM architectures, which argues against this being an artifact of one checkpoint.

Third, they perform causal interventions by directly modifying the attention masks of those heads at inference time. Redirecting the gaze heads to a chosen panel causes the model to describe that panel instead. The intervention is sharply tuned: too few redirected heads give only partial control, while too many break fluent generation by overriding heads needed for language modeling. They also show mid-generation steering, where the model finishes the current panel and then switches to the newly targeted one, suggesting that these heads participate in an online grounding mechanism rather than a one-shot global plan.
summary_en.experiments:
The main model is Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, with a 36-layer language backbone and 32 attention heads per layer, for 1,152 heads total. Discovery uses 3,948 comic samples from COMICS, converted into six-panel horizontal strips. Evaluation uses a disjoint set of 500 six-panel strips generated with GPT Image-1, where each panel is visually distinct enough to make grounding unambiguous.

Several results stand out. First, the reverse-reading direction only works when injected into layers 20–28, showing strong localization of reading-order control. Second, the authors identify a top-100 set of gaze heads, fewer than 9% of all heads. Third, redirecting only these heads steers the VQA answer to a chosen panel with 83.1% accuracy, versus a 16.7% chance level for six panels; comparable interventions on random non-gaze heads fail to redirect reliably. Fourth, the control effect is not monotonic: too little intervention is weak, too much damages generation quality. That supports the view that gaze heads form a functional subcircuit rather than a generic attention mass. Finally, the phenomenon transfers beyond comics to natural images and appears across multiple VLM sizes and architectures.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and setup to understand why comics are used. The point is not comic understanding as a task, but a controlled spatial proxy for narration order. Then read the section on the reverse-reading direction and the layer-localization result, especially Figure 1. After that, focus on the gaze-head discovery criterion and the intervention results. Those are the parts that establish both localization and causality.

A 25–35 minute pass is enough. Read in this order: layer localization, gaze-head scoring, top-100 redirection experiments, then the transfer results to natural images and other models. The most interesting follow-up questions are whether these heads emerge during multimodal pretraining or later instruction tuning, how much they overlap with previously reported image/localization heads, and whether this sparse subcircuit can be used for training-time diagnostics, regularization, or hallucination control.

recommendation.zh: David Bau 组发现 VLM 中存在专门追踪图像区域的 gaze heads——对理解多模态预训练中的注意力分工有启发，看实验章节即可。
recommendation.en: David Bau's group discovers dedicated gaze heads in VLMs — informative for understanding attention specialization in multimodal pretraining; read experiments only.

paper.title: Dual-Stance Evaluation of Sycophancy: The Structure of Agreement and the Limits of Intervention
paper.abstract: Activation steering can shift LLM behaviour, but standard evaluations do not typically test whether a sycophancy-reduction direction also suppresses agreement with factually correct statements. We introduce dual-stance evaluation, which tests both stances of each topic, and apply it to centroid-difference steering on Llama-3-8B-Instruct. We find a dissociation: the model represents sycophantic and factual agreement in geometrically distinct subspaces, yet the steering direction projects equally

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何降低 sycophancy”，而是一个更基础的识别问题：常见的 activation steering，尤其是用 agree/disagree 激活质心差得到的方向，究竟是在压制“迎合用户”这一特定行为，还是只是把模型整体往“不愿意说 YES”推。以往评测通常只看单边 stance，例如用户说“地球是平的”时模型是否少同意了，但这无法区分三种情况：只抑制 sycophancy、统一抑制所有 agreement、或两者都抑制但幅度不同。作者提出 dual-stance evaluation，让同一主题的相反立场都被测试，从而直接检查：模型是否连对事实正确陈述的同意也一起被削弱，以及模型在基线下是否会对互相矛盾的主张都表示同意。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身没有直接方法贡献，但对 post-train 行为干预、activation editing、mechanistic interpretability 的评测方法有明确启发。它指出一个常见误区：如果只看目标行为是否下降，很容易把“非特异性的 polarity shift”误判成“成功提取了某种高层行为特征”。这对基座研究也有价值，因为很多人会把 residual-space 线性方向解释成可控语义因子；这篇工作说明，模型内部也许确实区分了 factual agreement 和 sycophantic agreement，但简单的 centroid-difference 并不能利用这种区分。换句话说，表示里有结构，不代表线性干预就能精确调用这部分结构。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三层。第一层是评测设计。作者构造了 50 个 topic、100 个 stance-specific item，覆盖 symmetric opinions、asymmetric opinions、soft facts、hard facts 四类。每个 topic 都测试互相矛盾的两个用户立场，提示模板固定，只通过温度采样产生行为变化。这样做的关键好处是把“单次同意”拆成“对哪一边同意、是否两边都同意、对事实正确一边是否保留同意”几个可分离信号。

第二层是行为分类与连续指标。作者先按未干预基线把 topic 经验性分成 sycophantic、opinionated、mixed 三类，但真正重要的是一个连续量：dual-stance consistency。直观上，它衡量模型在同一主题上对两边 stance 的一致性或摇摆程度。这个量后来被用来预测 steering susceptibility，避免结论依赖离散阈值。

第三层是 steering 与几何分析。干预对象是 Llama-3-8B-Instruct，采用标准 centroid-difference steering：从 agree 与 disagree 条件下抽取激活，计算质心差方向，并在生成时注入。作者随后做了两类分析。其一是行为层面，比较该方向对 sycophantic agreement 与 factual agreement 的影响。其二是表示层面，检查两类 agreement activation 在几何上是否可分，以及 steering direction 对这两个子空间的投影关系。核心发现是：两类 agreement 在激活空间中是可区分的，说明模型内部“知道”二者不同；但质心差方向对两者投影近似相同，因此干预缺乏选择性。也就是说，问题不在于表示完全纠缠，而在于所选线性方向过于粗糙，只抓住了 agreement polarity 这一更浅层的轴。
summary.experiments:
关键实验结论很清楚。第一，steering 是非特异性的：它不仅降低对迎合性陈述的同意，也降低对事实正确陈述的同意。文中给出的代表性数字是，在基线同意率相近的条件下，sycophantic items 与 hard-fact correct stances 的基线分别约为 93% 和 96%，但干预后前者下降约 89%，后者也下降约 14%。这已经足以否定“只抑制 sycophancy”的解释。

第二，这种非特异性不是简单的均匀平移，而是有结构的。不同 item 对 steering 的敏感度差异很大，而这种差异可以被 dual-stance consistency 很好预测：样本内相关系数 r=0.88，在 12 个新 topic 上外推仍有 r=0.84。也就是说，模型越倾向于在同一主题上对相反立场都表示同意，它越容易被该方向推向“不再同意”。

第三，几何分析支持“表示可分、干预不可分”的解释。作者报告 sycophantic agreement 与 factual agreement 占据激活空间中不同区域，但 steering direction 对两类 activation group 的投影相当接近。文中还强调，其他静态属性已做匹配，因此行为差异更可能来自局部几何或生成动力学，而不是简单的均值、范数或可分性差异。

实验设置上，主实验对每个 item 做 20 次采样，温度 T=0.9；prompt 模板固定，减少 prompt confound。hard facts 中 A/B 与正确性有标签耦合，但作者用 symmetric-opinion 条目中 A/B 可交换且下降对称的结果，说明主要结论不依赖 stance 标签本身。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，先把 dual-stance evaluation 想清楚：它不是多做一倍样本，而是把“agreement”拆成更有诊断性的结构。然后看 Methods 里四类 topic 的构造方式，以及为什么 hard facts、soft facts、symmetric/asymmetric opinions 要分开。这里决定了后面结论能否站住。

接着重点看行为结果部分，尤其是 sycophantic items 与 factual-correct stances 在相近基线下却出现明显不同下降幅度的图表；这是全文最核心的证据。再看 dual-stance consistency 与 steering susceptibility 的相关分析，这部分说明 steering 不是随机失真，而是沿着某种可预测的行为轴起作用。

最后看 subspace / geometry analysis。阅读时不要把它理解成“模型没学会区分”，恰好相反，作者的论点是模型内部已经区分了，但 centroid-difference 方向没有把这个区分提取出来。若只打算花 20-30 分钟，建议读 Introduction、Methods 中数据设计、主结果图和几何分析结论；附录可只在关心 item 设计与鲁棒性时再看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more diagnostic question than “can activation steering reduce sycophancy?”: when a standard agree-vs-disagree centroid direction lowers agreement with user opinions, is it actually targeting sycophantic deference, or is it merely pushing the model toward generic disagreement? Prior evaluations usually test only one stance per topic, so they cannot distinguish a sycophancy-specific intervention from a broad YES/NO polarity shift. The proposed dual-stance evaluation tests both contradictory stances of the same topic, making it possible to check whether steering also suppresses agreement with factually correct statements and whether the model agrees with both sides at baseline.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for anyone working on activation editing, behavioral control, and mechanistic claims about linear directions in LLMs. The main value is methodological: a reduction in the target behavior is not enough evidence that a direction isolates the intended latent trait. A direction may look successful under standard evaluation while actually acting as a coarse polarity control. For foundation-model research, the paper is a reminder that internal representational separation does not imply that a simple linear intervention can selectively access that separation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three main components. First, the evaluation design. The authors build 50 topics with paired contradictory stances, covering symmetric opinions, asymmetric opinions, soft facts, and hard facts. The prompt template is held fixed, and behavioral variation comes from temperature sampling rather than prompt changes. This allows agreement behavior to be decomposed into stronger diagnostics: agreement with which side, agreement with both sides, and preservation of agreement for the factually correct side.

Second, they use both discrete and continuous behavioral characterizations. Topics are empirically grouped from baseline behavior into sycophantic, opinionated, or mixed, but the more important quantity is a continuous measure called dual-stance consistency, which captures how consistently the model agrees across both stances of the same topic. This later predicts how susceptible an item is to steering.

Third, they apply standard centroid-difference steering to Llama-3-8B-Instruct and then analyze both behavior and geometry. The steering vector is derived from agree vs disagree activations. Behaviorally, they compare its effect on sycophantic agreement and factual agreement. Geometrically, they test whether these two kinds of agreement occupy distinct regions in activation space and how the steering direction projects onto them. The central result is subtle: factual and sycophantic agreement are internally distinguishable, but the centroid-difference direction projects similarly onto both. So the limitation is not that the model fails to represent the distinction; it is that this particular linear direction does not isolate it.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is non-specificity. Steering reduces agreement with sycophantic statements, but it also reduces agreement with factually correct statements. The representative comparison in the paper matches high-baseline conditions: sycophantic items and hard-fact correct stances start at roughly 93% and 96% agreement, yet steering reduces them by about 89% and 14%, respectively. That rules out the claim that the direction is selectively removing sycophancy.

At the same time, the effect is structured rather than uniform. Steering susceptibility varies strongly across items, and that variation is well predicted by dual-stance consistency: r=0.88 in-sample and r=0.84 on 12 held-out topics. Items for which the model tends to agree with both contradictory stances are much easier to push away from agreement.

The geometric analysis supports a “representationally distinct but interventionally entangled” picture. The two activation groups occupy different regions of activation space, yet the steering direction has similar projection onto both. The paper also notes that other static properties of the activation groups were matched, which narrows the explanation toward local geometry or generation dynamics rather than simple mean-level differences.

Experimentally, the setup uses 20 trials per item at temperature 0.9 with a fixed prompt template. The hard-fact A/B labeling is confounded with correctness, but the authors argue this does not drive the main result, partly because symmetric-opinion items show symmetric declines under steering when the labels are interchangeable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first conceptual figure. The key idea is not just “evaluate more examples,” but “evaluate both stances of the same topic so agreement becomes diagnostically meaningful.” Then read the methods section carefully enough to understand why the four topic categories are separated and how the prompt is controlled.

After that, focus on the main behavioral results: the comparison between sycophantic items and factually correct hard-fact stances at similar baseline agreement is the strongest evidence in the paper. The dual-stance-consistency correlation analysis is the next important piece because it shows the intervention is structured, not merely noisy degradation.

Finish with the subspace analysis. The right interpretation is that the model already encodes the distinction, but the centroid-difference direction fails to exploit it. If reading time is limited to about 20-30 minutes, prioritize the introduction, dataset design in methods, the main results figures, and the geometry section. The appendix matters mainly if you want to inspect item construction or robustness details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不提供新 steering 技巧，但把旧评测的漏洞钉得很死；做表示编辑的人至少看 dual-stance protocol 和“可读不等于可控”这个结论。
recommendation.en: No new steering trick here, but it cleanly breaks a weak evaluation habit; if you work on representation editing, read the dual-stance protocol and the 'readable is not controllable' result.

paper.title: Beyond representational alignment with brain-guided language models for robust reasoning
paper.abstract: The correspondence between large language models (LLMs) and the neural mechanisms underlying human higher-order cognition remains insufficiently characterized. Given that language and reasoning in the human brain appear dissociable, an open question is whether LLMs align with neural signals from reasoning-related regions and whether such signals can improve them. Here, focusing on deductive reasoning, we show that LLM internal representations are not only partially aligned with task-fMRI activit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关心两个相连的问题。第一，LLM 在做演绎推理时，内部表征是否真的和人脑中负责推理的神经活动存在可测的对应关系，而不只是和语言区对齐。第二，如果这种对应关系存在，脑信号能否不只用于解释模型，而是反过来作为干预信号，直接提升模型在推理任务上的鲁棒性，尤其是把原本会答错的样本拉回正确轨道。论文把问题限定在 deductive reasoning，并且刻意区分 aggregate-level alignment 与 reasoning-type-specific alignment，避免把总体相关性误读成机制层面的充分一致。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接影响不在于它给出了一条可立即规模化的预训练路线，而在于它提供了一个新的训练信号来源和一个新的机制分析视角。更具体地说，它说明 next-token 训练得到的表征已经部分进入了与人类推理网络相近的子空间，但这种对齐并不完整，且在细粒度推理类型上明显不足。这一点对“语言建模是否足以诱导稳健推理”这个老问题给了更细的证据。更有意思的是，作者没有把 brain alignment 当作终点，而是把它当作 intervention target：只在模型即将出错的区域做表征修正。这种思路和常见的 post-hoc probing 不同，也和直接加一个辅助 loss 的做法不同。对预训练研究员来说，启发主要有三点：一是可以把外部认知信号视作 representation regularizer；二是模型错误可能集中在某些可识别的表征方向上；三是“对齐”与“性能提升”不是同一个目标，后者更依赖局部、条件化的干预。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是测量 LLM 与人脑推理网络的表征对应。作者使用任务型 fMRI 数据，聚焦既往文献中与演绎推理相关的脑区，而不是泛化到整个 cortex。对多个开源 LLM，在处理推理题时抽取内部 hidden representations，再用 neural predictivity 指标评估这些表征对脑活动 explainable variance 的解释比例。这里有两个关键设计。其一，既看跨全部推理样本聚合后的 predictivity，也看按具体 reasoning type 切分后的 predictivity；前者高，后者低，说明模型学到的是较粗的共享结构，而不是稳定覆盖各类推理机制。其二，加入未训练模型和其他脑网络作为对照，验证这种对应不是随机几何相似，也不是对任何高层认知区都同样成立。

第二部分是利用脑信号做模型干预。作者提出两种方法。NARI 是 inference-time 的表征干预：先在 joint model-brain representational structure 中识别与“错误回答”相关、但可被脑信号校正的方向，然后在推理时对模型中间层表示做定向修正，把表示从错误区域推向更接近正确解答对应的区域。它更像 activation steering，但 steering vector 不是纯模型内生统计量，而是由脑活动和模型表征的对应结构共同确定。NARF 是 parameter-level 的微调版本：把这种 neural guidance 融入训练，对模型参数做小幅更新，使其更倾向于形成与正确推理相关的内部表示。两者的共同点是都不追求全局 brain imitation，而是只利用那些对纠错有用的神经约束。

从方法取舍看，这比直接把 fMRI 当监督标签去回归整段脑活动更克制。原因很清楚：脑信号噪声大、样本少、跨被试差异强，若做全局拟合，很容易学到与任务无关的个体差异。作者转而利用 joint subspace 和 error-correction framing，把问题变成“哪些脑相关方向能帮助纠错”，这更接近可用信号的上限。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的核心结果有四类。第一，表征对齐方面，LLM 在演绎推理相关脑区上的 aggregate neural predictivity 大约达到 explainable variance 的 76%，明显高于未训练模型对照；但在按具体 reasoning type 划分后，predictivity 只有约 27% 左右，说明细粒度机制对齐仍然有限。第二，选择性方面，这种对齐对 reasoning network 更强，而不是同样出现在 multiple-demand network 或 core language network，支持作者关于“并非单纯语言区对齐”的论点。第三，干预效果方面，NARI 和 NARF 都能把一部分原本错误的回答改成正确，说明脑信号不仅能解释模型，还能作为有效的纠错引导。摘要截断没有给出完整表格数字，但从正文叙述看，提升主要集中在困难样本和原始模型易错的推理类型上，而不是对所有样本平均抬升。第四，作者还做了若干控制实验，验证提升不是来自额外 test-time compute、提示模板变化或简单的 representation smoothing，而是与 brain-guided direction 的特异性有关。

值得注意的实验洞察是：总体高 predictivity 并不自动转化为高推理准确率，反过来，局部的 neural guidance 却能在错误样本上产生可见收益。这说明“像脑”不是单一标量目标，更像是某些关键子空间上的约束问题。对做预训练的人来说，这比单看相关系数更有信息量。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看引言和任务设定，确认作者讨论的是 deductive reasoning 的哪几类题，以及 fMRI 数据是如何采集和对齐到样本级别的。第二，看 neural predictivity 的定义、explainable variance 的估计方式、以及 reasoning network / MD network / language network 的对照设置；这是判断结果是否可信的关键。第三，看 NARI 和 NARF 的实现细节，尤其是干预发生在哪些层、如何识别“将要答错”的表示、以及 brain-model joint structure 是怎样构造的。

如果时间有限，优先看主文中的方法图、predictivity 主结果图、以及干预前后错误样本翻转的案例分析，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，建议重点检查附录里的被试间一致性、不同模型规模的差异、以及是否存在数据泄漏或题型偏置。真正值得追问的点有两个：一是这种 brain-guided direction 是否能迁移到未见题型；二是如果把脑信号替换成更便宜的行为信号或 verifier 信号，是否能复现类似收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles two linked questions. First, when LLMs perform deductive reasoning, do their internal representations align with neural activity in human reasoning-related regions, rather than merely with language areas? Second, if such alignment exists, can brain signals be used not only for analysis but also as an intervention signal to improve reasoning performance, especially on cases the model would otherwise answer incorrectly? The study is deliberately scoped to deductive reasoning and distinguishes aggregate alignment from reasoning-type-specific alignment, which is an important methodological choice.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is not that it offers an immediately scalable recipe, but that it introduces a different kind of training signal and a sharper way to think about representation quality. The results suggest that next-token-trained models already enter a subspace partially shared with human reasoning networks, yet this alignment is incomplete and much weaker at fine-grained reasoning-type resolution. That is a more informative answer to the long-running question of whether language modeling alone induces robust reasoning. The more interesting move is conceptual: brain alignment is treated as a means for targeted correction, not as an end in itself. For foundation-model work, the main takeaways are that external cognitive signals can act as representation regularizers, model errors may concentrate in steerable directions of hidden space, and global alignment metrics are not the same thing as performance-relevant local interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two parts. The first measures model-brain correspondence during deductive reasoning. Using task-fMRI data focused on brain regions previously associated with deductive reasoning, the authors extract hidden representations from several open-source LLMs while the models process reasoning problems. They then compute neural predictivity, asking how much explainable variance in the fMRI responses can be accounted for by model representations. Two design choices matter here. One is the separation between aggregate predictivity across all reasoning samples and predictivity within specific reasoning types; the former is much higher than the latter, indicating that the shared structure is coarse rather than mechanism-complete. The other is the use of controls, including untrained models and non-reasoning brain networks, to show that the effect is not a trivial artifact of generic high-dimensional similarity.

The second part uses neural data for intervention. The paper proposes Neural Activation guided Representation Intervention (NARI), an inference-time method, and Neural Activation guided Representation Fine-tuning (NARF), a parameter-update variant. NARI identifies directions in a joint model-brain representational structure that are associated with incorrect responses but can be corrected using neural guidance, then steers intermediate hidden states away from error-prone regions and toward representations associated with correct reasoning. This resembles activation steering, but the steering signal is not derived purely from model-internal statistics; it is constrained by the shared structure between model states and brain activity. NARF pushes the same idea into training by adjusting model parameters so that the model is more likely to form internally correct reasoning representations.

A notable methodological choice is that the authors do not try to regress full fMRI patterns as a global supervision target. Given the noise, limited sample size, and subject variability of fMRI, that would likely overfit irrelevant variance. Instead, they frame the problem as error correction in a shared subspace, which is a more realistic use of the available signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The main findings come in four groups. First, on representation alignment, LLM representations explain about 76% of the explainable variance in aggregate neural responses from deductive-reasoning regions, substantially above untrained-model controls. However, when evaluated within specific reasoning types, predictivity drops to roughly 27%, showing that fine-grained alignment remains limited. Second, the alignment is selective: it is stronger for the reasoning network than for the multiple-demand network or the core language network, supporting the claim that the effect is not reducible to generic language processing. Third, both NARI and NARF can convert a subset of previously incorrect model answers into correct ones, indicating that neural signals are useful not only descriptively but also operationally. The truncated abstract does not expose the full result tables, but the body text indicates that gains are concentrated on harder examples and on reasoning categories where the base model is brittle. Fourth, the paper includes controls suggesting that the improvements are not explained by extra test-time compute, prompt changes, or generic smoothing of hidden states.

One useful experimental lesson is that high global neural predictivity does not automatically imply high reasoning accuracy, whereas localized neural guidance can still improve error cases. That makes the paper more interesting than a pure correlation study.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the task setup carefully: what kinds of deductive reasoning problems are used, and how the fMRI data are aligned to item-level model processing. Second, inspect the neural predictivity definition, the estimation of explainable variance, and the controls involving reasoning, multiple-demand, and language networks; these determine whether the alignment claim is meaningful. Third, read the implementation details of NARI and NARF, especially which layers are intervened on, how likely error states are identified, and how the joint model-brain structure is constructed.

If time is limited, the main method figure, the predictivity result figure, and the intervention examples are enough to capture the paper in about 25 to 35 minutes. If reading more deeply, check the appendices for subject consistency, model-size effects, and possible confounds such as item bias or leakage. The two questions worth carrying forward are whether the learned brain-guided directions transfer to unseen reasoning formats, and whether cheaper signals, such as behavioral traces or verifier feedback, could substitute for fMRI while preserving the same intervention logic.

recommendation.zh: 机构强，但离 pretrain 很远；把它当 reasoning representation 的外部探针看，先看 predictivity 结果，干预部分先持保留。
recommendation.en: Strong institutions, but far from pretraining; treat it as an external probe of reasoning representations, and trust the predictivity analysis more than the intervention claims.

institutions: State Key Lab of General AI

paper.title: Substrate Asymmetry in User-Side Memory: A Diagnostic Framework
paper.abstract: User-side memory in LLMs is typically scored as a single "personalization" capability: given a user's history, is the output more user-aware? We show this aggregate metric hides opposite-direction failures. Memory factorises into at least three orthogonal axes -- behavioral consistency (style, voice), factual presence (recall facts in history), and factual absence (abstain when a fact is absent) -- and no single substrate wins all three. Comparing per-user gamma-LoRA (a small LoRA adapter traine

summary.core_problem: 用户侧 memory 常被当作单一“个性化能力”来评估，但这种聚合指标会掩盖不同记忆机制在风格一致性、事实记住与事实缺失抑制上的相反取舍。
summary.importance: 这是一个带因果探针的机制分析工作。它把 user memory 分解成可分离维度，并比较参数化记忆与检索记忆的能力边界，对理解 RAG、LoRA、长期记忆接口的行为很有参考价值，尤其适合 post-train 与 memory system 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出三轴诊断框架：behavioral consistency、factual presence、factual absence。然后在受控 50-user synthetic corpus 和 LaMP-3 上，对比 per-user gamma-LoRA 与 BGE-large top-K dense retrieval。进一步做层级与注意力投影的因果干预，定位 attention 21-35 层 query-projection 单元在两类能力上的相反作用，并通过零化 LoRA 权重验证这种 load-bearing 关系。
summary.experiments: 结果显示 gamma-LoRA 明显优于 RAG 的风格一致性，而 RAG 明显优于 gamma-LoRA 的 factual absence；在 attention 21-35 的 query-projection 上做干预后，absence-probe TPR 可提升 33 个百分点，同时 presence-probe TPR 下降 20 个百分点。摘要未给出底座模型规模，但实验设置相对干净，强调机制分解而非单一总分。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者 Youwang Deng，EpistemicaLab。

summary_en.core_problem: User-side memory is often evaluated as a single personalization capability, but that aggregate metric hides opposing trade-offs across style consistency, factual recall, and abstention on absent facts.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-oriented diagnostic paper with causal probing. It decomposes user memory into separable axes and compares parametric memory against retrieval memory, which is useful for understanding RAG, LoRA, and long-term memory interfaces in post-training systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a three-axis diagnostic framework: behavioral consistency, factual presence, and factual absence. It compares per-user gamma-LoRA against BGE-large top-K dense retrieval on a controlled 50-user synthetic corpus and LaMP-3, then performs causal interventions to identify attention-layer query projections (layers 21-35) that load-bear both effects in opposite directions.
summary_en.experiments: Gamma-LoRA strongly outperforms RAG on behavioral style, while RAG strongly outperforms gamma-LoRA on factual absence. Zeroing LoRA weights in query-projection cells from attention layers 21-35 raises absence-probe TPR by 33 points and lowers presence-probe TPR by 20 points. The abstract does not state the base model size, but the setup appears cleaner than typical aggregate personalization evaluations.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent research by Youwang Deng at EpistemicaLab.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“记住用户”拆成互相冲突的三个可测维度；若你在做 RAG/adapter memory，先看那组 attention 21-35 的因果干预结果。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it decomposes 'remembering the user' into three conflicting measurable axes; if you work on RAG or adapter memory, start with the causal intervention on attention layers 21-35.

paper.title: Calibration Drift Under Reasoning: How Chain-of-Thought Budgets Induce Overconfidence in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: The ability of large language models (LLMs) to express calibrated uncertainty is important for safe deployment. Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely used to improve accuracy and reliability, but its effect on calibration is not fully understood. We show that this picture is incomplete: in some settings, increasing the reasoning budget beyond a task-specific threshold can cause models to become systematically overconfident, assigning high confidence to incorrect answers. We call this phenom

summary.core_problem: CoT 通常被用来提升准确率，但更长的推理预算是否会改善不确定性校准并不清楚；作者研究 reasoning budget 增加时校准误差为何会先降后升。
summary.importance: 这是一个机制与可靠性分析工作。价值在于提醒研究者：更长推理链不等于更好校准，accuracy gain 和 calibration gain 可能脱钩，尤其对安全部署和 verifier 设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Calibration Drift Under Reasoning（CDUR）现象，并给出一个基于自回归生成的 Hypothesis Lock-In 模型：随着推理变长，模型先通过额外推理纠正部分错误，但超过任务相关阈值后，可能围绕早期错误假设生成越来越自洽的错误解释，导致对错误答案的置信度上升。分析重点是把 ECE 视为 reasoning budget B 的非单调函数。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 Llama-3.1-8B 等模型上做理论与实证分析，但未给出完整任务集、数据规模和提升/退化幅度。核心结果是 ECE(B) 呈非单调变化：预算较小时校准改善，超过阈值后出现系统性过度自信。由于模型和评测范围看起来不大，这更像一个值得跟进复现的现象，而不是已被大规模验证的定律。

summary_en.core_problem: Chain-of-thought is often used to improve accuracy, but it is unclear whether longer reasoning budgets also improve uncertainty calibration; the paper studies why calibration error can first decrease and then increase as reasoning gets longer.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and reliability analysis paper. Its value is the warning that longer reasoning does not imply better calibration: accuracy gains and calibration gains can decouple, which matters for safe deployment and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Calibration Drift Under Reasoning (CDUR) and proposes a Hypothesis Lock-In model grounded in autoregressive generation. As reasoning length increases, the model may initially correct errors through additional deliberation, but beyond a task-dependent threshold it can elaborate around an early wrong hypothesis, producing increasingly self-consistent but incorrect explanations and higher confidence on wrong answers. The analysis treats ECE as a non-monotonic function of reasoning budget B.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions theoretical and empirical study on models including Llama-3.1-8B, but does not provide full task coverage, dataset scale, or effect sizes. The main reported result is a non-monotonic ECE(B): calibration improves at small budgets and then degrades into systematic overconfidence beyond a threshold. Given the limited evidence visible in the abstract, this looks more like a phenomenon worth reproducing than a settled law.

recommendation.zh: 现象层面值得记住：长 CoT 可能把错答案讲得更笃定；但证据规模看起来偏小，先把它当 failure mode 假说，读图和定义即可。
recommendation.en: The phenomenon is worth remembering: long CoT can make wrong answers sound more certain; but the evidence looks small-scale, so treat it as a failure-mode hypothesis and just read the definition and plots.

institutions: SG Balekundri Institute of Technology, Belagavi

paper.title: When is Your LLM Steerable?
paper.abstract: Activation steering offers a lightweight approach to control language models' behavior at inference time, but whether it succeeds or fails heavily depends on the prompt, concept, model, and steering configuration. Finding the regime and boundaries of successful steering typically requires expensive grid searches and post-hoc evaluation of full autoregressive rollouts. In this work, we investigate whether steerability can be predicted from the model's internal states at the beginning of the gener

summary.core_problem: Activation steering 的成功与否高度依赖 prompt、概念、模型和配置，但目前通常要靠昂贵的 rollout 网格搜索才能知道何时可控。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个 steerability 预测问题设定加上大规模测试床 ASTEER。它更偏推理时控制与内部表征分析，不直接推进预训练方法，但对理解早期解码状态是否已决定后续可控性有一定机制价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 ASTEER，收集 1.4M 条带成功/失败标签的 steering generation，覆盖 150 个概念。方法上从生成前几步的内部状态中提取特征，比较 steering 前后各层 hidden states 的差异，用这些早期特征预测后续 steering 是否会成功，并据此改进 steering 配置或触发策略。
summary.experiments: 数据规模是 140 万条 steered generations。实验重点应包括：不同模型、概念和 prompt 上的 steerability 预测精度；只看前几 token 的内部状态能否替代完整 rollout；以及基于预测器的 steering success rate 提升。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，因此更适合作为机制线索而非结论性方法。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 University of Maryland, College Park。Soheil Feizi 与 Tianyi Zhou 在鲁棒性、可控性和基础模型分析方向有较强辨识度。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation steering is highly regime-dependent, but today one often needs expensive rollout-based grid search to know when steering will succeed.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a steerability prediction setup plus the ASTEER testbed. It is more about inference-time control and internal-state analysis than pretraining, but it offers a useful mechanistic angle on whether early decoding states already determine controllability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds ASTEER with 1.4M steered generations labeled as success or failure across 150 concepts. It extracts features from the first few decoding steps, comparing hidden states before and after steering across layers, and uses these early-state features to predict downstream steering success and improve steering decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset scale is 1.4 million steered generations. The key evaluations should test prediction accuracy across prompts, concepts, and models; whether early-state features can replace full rollouts; and whether a predictor-guided policy improves steering success. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact gains, so this is better treated as a mechanistic signal than a decisive method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is from the University of Maryland, College Park. Soheil Feizi and Tianyi Zhou are recognizable names in robustness, controllability, and foundation-model analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但若你关心表征是否在前几步就锁定行为，可只看 ASTEER 设定和早期 hidden-state 特征，别花时间在应用层结果上。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but if you care whether behavior is effectively fixed in the first few decoding steps, read the ASTEER setup and early hidden-state features, not the application-layer results.

paper.title: Forecasting Future Behavior as a Learning Task
paper.abstract: Trust in an AI system is often anchored by explanations of how it works, which one then uses to forecast its behavior on new inputs. For large reasoning models (LRMs), this conventional route is particularly difficult to follow: explanation methods for single token generations do not naturally generalize to long trajectories, and the trajectories themselves are often not faithful when read as natural language. We propose an alternative that bypasses the explanation step: treat behavior forecasti

summary.core_problem: 对大型推理模型，传统“先解释再预测行为”的路线很难扩展到长推理轨迹，因此作者把行为预测本身当作一个可学习任务。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析与可解释性方向的工作，贡献不在改模型，而在提出一种不依赖人工标注、直接预测模型未来行为的分析框架。
summary.technical_approach: 训练 Behavior Forecaster：输入单条 reasoning trajectory，单次前向就预测模型在其他条件下的行为。训练数据通过反复查询目标 LRM 自动构造，无需人工标注。文中实例化了两个任务：重跑时是否会重复答案，以及删去部分输入后答案是否改变。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明在两个任务上评估该方法，并与基于解释的替代路线比较；但未给出模型规模、数据量和具体提升数字。更像分析工具而非能力方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Yoav Goldberg。

summary_en.core_problem: For large reasoning models, explanation-first approaches do not scale well to long trajectories, so the paper reframes behavior forecasting itself as a learnable task.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic-analysis and interpretability contribution rather than a model-improvement paper, proposing a way to predict future model behavior without human labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper trains a Behavior Forecaster that takes a single reasoning trajectory and predicts how the target LRM would behave under alternative conditions in one forward pass. Training data is generated automatically by querying the LRM itself. Two instantiations are studied: answer repeatability across reruns and answer changes under input ablations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluations on both tasks and comparisons against explanation-based alternatives, but it does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, or quantitative margins. It reads more like an analysis tool than a capability method.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Yoav Goldberg.

recommendation.zh: 不是训练方法，但对“轨迹可解释性不可信”这个问题给了更实用的替代物；先看它如何构造无标注训练信号，再决定要不要深读。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but it offers a practical alternative when trajectory explanations are untrustworthy; inspect the label-free supervision setup first.

paper.title: Mechanistic Analysis of Alignment Algorithms in Language Models
paper.abstract: Post-training alignment algorithms are predominantly evaluated as black boxes, obscuring how they reshape language models' internal computations. We present a systematic mechanistic analysis of six preference-optimization methods: PPO, DPO, SimPO, ORPO, GRPO, and KTO across three open-weight model families. By integrating layer-wise linear probing, Sparse Autoencoders, and crosscoders, we localize preference representations and quantify alignment-induced geometric transformations in latent space

summary.core_problem: 现有后训练对齐算法多作为黑盒评估，其如何重塑LLM内部计算过程、改变隐空间表征的机制尚不明确。
summary.importance: 原理分析类重大贡献，首次系统对比6种主流偏好优化算法的内部作用机制，量化了对齐引起的隐空间几何变换，为对齐算法选型和改进提供了机制层面的核心依据。
summary.technical_approach: 整合逐层线性探测、稀疏自编码器、交叉编码器三种分析工具，在三个开源模型家族上对比PPO、DPO、SimPO、ORPO、GRPO、KTO六种对齐算法，定位偏好表征的层分布，量化隐空间的几何变换和特征变化。
summary.experiments: 发现偏好信号集中在早-中层或中-高层；KTO和GRPO通过建设性特征共享和稀疏高显著度征用来增强线性可分性；DPO和ORPO通过非建设性几何旋转和特征衰减降低可分性；PPO和SimPO基本保留基线几何结构。
summary.authors_note: 哥本哈根大学团队，无公开知名核心作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-training alignment algorithms are mostly evaluated as black boxes, and the mechanism by which they reshape LLM internal computations and alter latent space representations remains unclear.
summary_en.importance: Major mechanistic analysis contribution: the first systematic comparison of the internal mechanisms of 6 mainstream preference optimization algorithms, quantifying alignment-induced latent space geometric transformations, providing core mechanistic evidence for alignment algorithm selection and improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Integrates three analysis tools: layer-wise linear probing, sparse autoencoders, and crosscoders, compares 6 alignment algorithms (PPO, DPO, SimPO, ORPO, GRPO, KTO) across three open-weight model families, localizes the layer distribution of preference representations, and quantifies latent space geometric transformations and feature changes.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that preference signals concentrate in early-mid or mid-late layers; KTO and GRPO enhance linear separability via constructive feature sharing and sparse high-saliency recruitment; DPO and ORPO degrade separability via non-constructive geometric rotation and feature attenuation; PPO and SimPO largely preserve baseline geometry.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Copenhagen, no publicly well-known core authors.

recommendation.zh: 立刻在内部对齐实验中参考不同算法的表征变换结论，优先测试KTO/GRPO的能力保留效果。
recommendation.en: Immediately reference the representation transformation conclusions of different algorithms in internal alignment experiments, prioritize testing KTO/GRPO's capability retention effect.

paper.title: Representational Similarity and Model Behavior in Multi-Agent Interaction
paper.abstract: Researchers have shown that neural similarity among humans predicts social closeness and cooperative success, whereas innovation often emerges from interactions among dissimilar individuals. We investigate whether these principles extend to artificial intelligence by examining interactions between large language models. In our experiments, 276 model pairs interact across eight games spanning both cooperation and novelty. We find that pairs with more similar representation spaces achieve signific

summary.core_problem: 多模型协作时，模型“内部表征空间”的相似度是否能预测交互行为（合作成功率、以及群体新颖性/创造性），以及这种关系在控制模型规模与能力差异后是否仍然成立。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对“如何选模型组成多智能体系统”给了一个可操作的内部指标：表征越像越容易互相预测、越容易合作，但更难产生新颖输出。这对预训练研究的启发在于：不同训练配方/数据/对齐方式导致的表征几何差异，可能会在多模型协作里以系统性方式外显；未来如果把“多智能体交互”当作训练信号或评测维度，表征相似度可以作为设计变量（例如刻意引入多样性以换取探索/创意）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两块：
1) 表征相似度度量：对每个模型，用同一组 probe prompts 抽取各层激活，形成表示矩阵R；用 CKA（文中强调可跨架构、跨层数比较）计算两模型表示空间相似度。相似度计算与交互实验解耦，避免“交互数据泄漏”到相似度指标里。
2) 行为测量：构造 23 个开源权重 LLM（8 个家族）两两配对，共 276 对，在 8 个任务里交互。4 个偏合作博弈（word guessing、public good、divide-a-dollar、Keynesian Beauty Contest），4 个偏创意生成（story、fictional biography、haiku、vacation benefit brainstorming）。核心分析是把“交互结果”回归到“表征相似度”，并控制潜在混杂（如模型能力差距、模型规模等），检验相似度的独立解释力。
关键区别在于：它不只看输出相似/风格相似，而是用内部表示对齐（CKA）作为预测变量，把多智能体行为与表征几何直接关联起来，并且讨论层级效应（早层相似度的作用在全文中被单独指出）。
summary.experiments:
规模：23 个开源模型、276 个模型对、8 个交互任务。
主要结果：
- 合作随表征相似度上升而显著提升。文中给出一个具象数字：在 word-guessing 中，相似度从观测最小到最大时，正确猜测相对提升约 66.2%。
- 新颖性/创造性随相似度上升而下降，四个创意任务上趋势一致，但效应大小与显著性有差异（说明“创意”指标更噪、更依赖任务与评分方式）。
- 控制能力差距、模型大小等因素后，相似度对合作/新颖性的影响仍稳健。
- 层级现象：全文提到“early layers”相似度也能预测（暗示相似性不只是高层语义对齐，可能与token/局部模式处理一致性有关），但需要结合正文图表看具体是哪一层段最相关、是否存在倒U或饱和。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看方法部分“Representational Similarity of LLMs”：probe 数据怎么选、CKA 具体变体（linear/RBF/unbiased）用哪一个、跨层对齐怎么做（max/avg/匹配策略），这些决定了结论的可复现性。
- 重点看主结果图（类似 Figure 1 的相似度-行为曲线）以及控制变量后的回归/稳健性检验：是否把“同家族模型”与“跨家族模型”分开、是否存在家族聚类导致的伪相关。
- 快速扫创意任务的“novelty/creativity”度量：是用 LLM judge、n-gram 新颖性、embedding 距离，还是人评；这直接影响“相似度抑制创意”的可信度。
- 如果只想拿走一个工程结论：看他们如何把“相似度”转成选配策略（高相似用于可靠协作，低相似用于探索/发散），以及早层相似度的提示是否能用于更便宜的近似指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether internal representational similarity between two LLMs predicts their interactive behaviors—cooperation success versus collective novelty/creativity—and whether this relationship holds after controlling for confounders like capability gaps and model size.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but it provides a mechanistic, model-internal knob for multi-agent composition: more similar representation spaces correlate with better cooperation yet lower novelty. For foundation-model researchers, the useful angle is that differences induced by data/recipe/alignment may manifest as measurable geometry differences that systematically affect downstream multi-model interaction. If multi-agent interaction is ever used as a training signal or a core evaluation axis, representational similarity becomes a design variable (optimize for predictability/cooperation vs diversity/exploration).
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two-part setup:
1) Measuring representational similarity: extract layer-wise activations on a shared probe prompt set, build representation matrices, and compute cross-model similarity using CKA (chosen for cross-architecture comparability). Similarity is computed independently of any interaction transcripts.
2) Measuring interaction outcomes: evaluate 276 pairs formed from 23 open-weight LLMs (8 families) across 8 tasks—four cooperation-style games (word guessing, public good, divide-a-dollar, Keynesian Beauty Contest) and four creative generation tasks (story, fictional biography, haiku, vacation-benefit brainstorming). The main analysis regresses behavioral outcomes on representational similarity while controlling for factors such as performance disparity and model size.
The key methodological choice is to use internal alignment (CKA) rather than output similarity, and to examine layer effects (the paper highlights early-layer similarity as informative).
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: 23 models, 276 model pairs, 8 interaction tasks.
Findings:
- Cooperation increases strongly with representational similarity. A concrete number reported: in the word-guessing game, moving from the minimum to maximum observed similarity yields ~66.2% relative increase in correct guesses.
- Novelty/creativity decreases with similarity across all four creative tasks, though effect sizes and statistical significance vary by task/metric.
- The similarity effect remains robust after controlling for confounders (capability gap, size).
- Layer-wise signal: early-layer similarity is reported to correlate as well, suggesting the phenomenon is not purely a high-level semantic alignment artifact; the exact layer range and saturation behavior should be checked in the main plots/tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
- Read the representational-similarity section carefully: probe set construction, which CKA variant is used, and how cross-layer matching/aggregation is done—these details determine reproducibility.
- Focus on the main similarity–outcome plots and the robustness analyses with controls; check whether family clustering (same-family pairs) could explain part of the correlation.
- Inspect how novelty/creativity is operationalized (LLM-judge vs lexical/embedding novelty vs human eval). This is the weakest link if the metric is noisy.
- If you want an actionable takeaway, extract their implied pairing heuristic: high-similarity pairs for reliable coordination; low-similarity pairs when you want diversity and idea generation.

recommendation.zh: 读 early-layer similarity 那组分析即可；对多模型 ensemble 和 agent team 选型有弱但有用的机制信号。
recommendation.en: Read the early-layer similarity analysis; it gives a weak but useful signal for choosing model mixtures in agent teams.

paper.title: When Built-in Thinking Helps and Hurts: Constraint-Level Error Shifts in Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often improve math and coding performance, but their effect on instruction following is unclear. We study IFEval with Qwen3 models (1.7B-32B), using same-weights Thinking ON/OFF controls; four Hunyuan models provide directional cross-family support. Aggregate pass-rate changes are small (-0.55 to -3.52 pp), yet 10-20% of prompts switch between pass and fail across modes, suggesting that thinking changes the pattern of errors--some prompts improve while others worsen

summary.core_problem: 分析 reasoning / thinking 模式对 instruction following 的影响，尤其是它是否只是整体提高或降低 IFEval 表现，还是改变不同约束类型的错误分布。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和评测诊断。它用 same-weights Thinking ON/OFF 控制减少模型差异干扰，指出 thinking 对指令遵循的影响主要体现为 constraint-level error shift，而不是单一方向的平均分变化。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Qwen3 1.7B 到 32B 上切换 Thinking ON/OFF，并用四个 Hunyuan 模型做跨家族方向性验证。作者对 IFEval 约束做 post-hoc 分组，将全局计数、结构、协调等归为 Planning，将精确局部格式归为 Precision，再比较各类约束在 thinking 模式下的得失；同时做长度匹配分析，排除 final-answer length 变化的部分混淆。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用 IFEval、Qwen3 1.7B-32B same-weights 控制，以及四个 Hunyuan 模型。Qwen3 aggregate pass-rate 在 Thinking ON 下小幅下降约 0.55 到 3.52 个百分点，但 10%-20% prompts 在两种模式间发生 pass/fail 翻转。Planning 类约束在 thinking 下改善，Precision 类约束稳定变差；该方向性模式在 Hunyuan 模型上也成立，尽管 Hunyuan 的总分方向不同。
summary.authors_note: 摘要标注该工作与 Hunyuan 相关，并使用 Hunyuan 系列模型做跨家族验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how built-in thinking affects instruction following, asking whether it changes aggregate IFEval scores uniformly or shifts errors across constraint types.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism and evaluation analysis. By using same-weight Thinking ON/OFF controls, it argues that thinking mainly causes constraint-level error shifts rather than a simple average improvement or degradation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study toggles Thinking ON/OFF in Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 32B and uses four Hunyuan models for directional cross-family support. It groups IFEval constraints post hoc into Planning, covering global counting, structure, and coordination, and Precision, covering exact local form. It also performs matched-length analyses to separate length effects from thinking effects.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use IFEval, same-weight Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 32B, and four Hunyuan models. For Qwen3, aggregate pass rate changes are small, from -0.55 to -3.52 percentage points, but 10-20% of prompts switch pass/fail status between modes. Planning constraints improve under thinking, while Precision constraints consistently worsen; the sign pattern holds directionally for Hunyuan models despite opposite aggregate movement.
summary_en.authors_note: The metadata marks the work as related to Hunyuan, and the study uses Hunyuan models for cross-family validation.

recommendation.zh: 读 constraint 分组和长度匹配分析；它会修正“thinking 只会帮或害 IF”的粗粒度 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the constraint grouping and length-matched analysis; it corrects the coarse prior that thinking simply helps or hurts instruction following.

paper.title: Capacity, Not Format: Rethinking Structured Reasoning Failures
paper.abstract: Prior work treats structured output as a reasoning tax, but this framing is incomplete: the cost of formatting depends strongly on a model's spare capacity. Using information-matched prose controls and a four-level schema complexity gradient, we separate format-specific effects from prompt-length confounds across 4 models and 5 benchmarks with 0% parse failures on successfully generated responses.   We find that structured formats are capacity-dependent. Models with sufficient headroom absorb JS

summary.core_problem: 澄清结构化输出导致推理性能下降的真正原因：到底是 JSON/Schema 这种格式本身有害，还是模型容量余量不足时，格式约束与推理竞争同一预算。
summary.importance: 这是一个干净的机制分析。它不直接改进预训练，但会影响对 structured decoding、tool use、schema-constrained generation 的 prior。贡献在于把“格式税”拆成 truncation 与 capacity competition 两种机制，而不是笼统归因给结构化输出。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 information-matched prose control 和四级 schema complexity 梯度，尽量控制 prompt 长度与信息量混淆；同时区分标准 token budget 与扩展 budget 两种设置，以分离截断效应和纯容量竞争。分析对象覆盖 4 个模型、5 个 benchmark，并只统计成功生成且无 parse failure 的样本，避免把格式错误与推理错误混在一起。
summary.experiments: 关键结果是：高容量模型在 JSON 约束下几乎不掉点，例如 Sonnet 在 MATH-Hard 上 JSON 88.7±4.0%，CoT 89.3±1.7%；而接近容量上限的模型会显著退化。Haiku 在标准 token budget 下下降 36.2 个百分点，主要由截断造成；GPT-4o-mini 在扩展 budget 消除截断后仍下降 28.0 个百分点，说明存在独立于 token exhaustion 的容量竞争。实验设计相对干净，值得看控制变量部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what really causes reasoning degradation under structured outputs: is JSON/schema formatting inherently harmful, or does it only hurt when the model lacks spare capacity and formatting competes with reasoning for limited budget?
summary_en.importance: This is a clean mechanism study. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it updates priors around structured decoding, tool use, and schema-constrained generation. The main contribution is separating the so-called formatting tax into truncation and capacity competition rather than treating structure as uniformly harmful.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author uses information-matched prose controls and a four-level schema-complexity gradient to reduce prompt-length and information-content confounds. The study also compares standard vs extended token budgets to separate truncation effects from pure capacity competition. It evaluates 4 models on 5 benchmarks and only counts successfully generated, parse-valid outputs, avoiding conflation between formatting failures and reasoning failures.
summary_en.experiments: The key findings are: high-headroom models barely degrade under JSON constraints, e.g., Sonnet scores 88.7±4.0% in JSON vs 89.3±1.7% with CoT on MATH-Hard; models near capacity limits degrade sharply. Haiku drops 36.2 points under standard token budgets, largely due to truncation. GPT-4o-mini still drops 28.0 points even with extended budgets, revealing capacity competition independent of token exhaustion. The control design is the part worth reading carefully.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是方法论文，但把“structured output 天生伤推理”这个粗糙 prior 拆开了；只看控制实验和容量分层结果，就足够修正你对 schema 约束的判断。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but it usefully breaks the lazy prior that structured output inherently hurts reasoning; the control experiments and capacity-stratified results are the only parts you need.

paper.title: Trait-space Monitoring for Emergent Misalignment During Supervised Finetuning
paper.abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM) occurs when narrow finetuning causes a model to behave dangerously outside the finetuning task. Standard training signals can miss this shift, making reliable detection costly if it depends on repeated behavioral evaluation. We ask whether emergent misalignment can instead be detected from internal representations during finetuning. Using seven alignment-relevant traits encoded as linear directions in activation space, we track representational drift across training ch

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：能否不依赖频繁行为评测，而是在监督微调过程中仅通过内部表征漂移，提前监测 emergent misalignment 的出现。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它把安全失配检测从外部行为评测转向了内部状态监测，属于机制分析与训练监控方向的工作。对基座研究员的价值不在于提出新的对齐算法，而在于给出一个较低开销的训练期预警信号，可能影响后续对 SFT 风险、checkpoint 选择和训练监控指标的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者先定义七个与对齐相关的 trait，并将其编码为激活空间中的线性方向；随后在多个 finetuning checkpoint 上跟踪这些方向上的表征漂移。核心发现是，与 emergent misalignment 相关的漂移主要集中在一个低维轴上。基于这一几何签名，作者构建了一个轻量监控器，用 drift profile 来判别危险 checkpoint，并与无监督 PCA、SAE 等表征监控基线比较。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个开源 7B-9B LLM，并在两个 14B 模型上做压力测试，还考察了更长的 finetuning 过程和不同类型的失配扰动。论文报告该低维轴可解释 65.5% 的相关方差；监控器在 held-out perturbation types 上达到 0.990 AUROC，假阴性率 2.2%，假阳性率 2.9%，优于 PCA 和 SAE 基线。摘要未给出更细的训练数据规模与具体模型清单，结论目前主要成立于所研究的 SFT regime。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UMD 相关团队；Hal Daumé 和 Sarah Wiegreffe 在 NLP、表示学习与模型分析方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether emergent misalignment during supervised fine-tuning can be detected from internal representation drift, without relying on repeated behavioral evaluations.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in shifting safety monitoring from expensive external behavior checks to internal training-time signals. This is not a new alignment algorithm, but a mechanism-and-monitoring contribution that could matter for checkpoint selection, SFT risk control, and training diagnostics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors encode seven alignment-relevant traits as linear directions in activation space, then track drift along those directions across fine-tuning checkpoints. They find that EM-relevant drift concentrates on a low-dimensional axis. Based on this geometric signature, they build a lightweight monitor that flags dangerous checkpoints, and compare it against unsupervised PCA and SAE-based baselines.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover four open-source 7B-9B LLMs, with stress tests on two 14B models, longer fine-tuning runs, and multiple misalignment perturbation types. The main reported result is that one low-dimensional axis explains 65.5% of the relevant variance, and the monitor reaches 0.990 AUROC with 2.2% false negatives and 2.9% false positives on held-out perturbations, outperforming PCA and SAE baselines. The abstract does not specify full model/data details, so the claim is best read as valid within the studied SFT regime.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are associated with the University of Maryland ecosystem; Hal Daumé and Sarah Wiegreffe are known for work in NLP, representation learning, and model analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但如果你关心 SFT 如何把底座推离安全流形，这篇给了一个可操作的内部监控信号；先看几何轴解释率和 held-out 泛化，别急着相信可迁移性。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care about how SFT pushes a base model off its safe manifold, this gives a usable internal monitor; read the low-rank drift result and held-out generalization first, and stay cautious about transfer.

paper.title: Improving Cross-Lingual Factual Recall via Consistency-Driven Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) trained predominantly on English data encode substantial world knowledge, yet often fail to express it reliably in other languages, a phenomenon known as cross-lingual factual inconsistency. To study and address this, we introduce PolyFact, a large-scale parallel multilingual factual QA dataset containing 100K Wikidata-grounded facts across 12 typologically diverse languages. Using PolyFact, we compare light continual pretraining (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT),

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究英语主导训练的 LLM 为什么已经存有事实知识，却不能稳定地用非英语表达出来。核心问题不是“补多少多语知识”，而是如何让模型通过不同语言接口访问同一份潜在事实知识，并在多语输出之间保持一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把多语能力拆成两个环节：表示对齐和知识访问。轻量 CPT 用平行语料可以改善语言间表示对齐，但对多语事实召回的增益有限；面向事实一致性的 RL 更直接地改变了模型在多语接口下访问知识的行为。这个结论对 multilingual pretrain / mid-train 的数据配比有参考意义：平行语料不一定能自动转化为事实能力，训练目标需要显式约束跨语言一致性。它也说明 post-train 信号可以反过来诊断 pretrain 表示中的知识访问瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 PolyFact，一个基于 Wikidata truthy triples 的全平行多语事实 QA 数据集。数据覆盖 22 类事实关系，包含地理、人物、作品、组织和文化关联等，选择 12 种类型差异较大的高低资源语言。每个事实构造成四选一问题，干扰项从同一属性下共现对象中采样，并做类型和长度匹配。题目由 Gemma-3-27B-IT 生成，质量用 web-grounded GPT-4o judge 和人工复核评估，并提供 PolyFact-Clean 过滤高歧义关系。方法上比较三类训练：第一，使用 TED2025 多路平行语料做轻量 CPT，并补充英语-斯瓦希里语、英语-孟加拉语句对；第二，在 PolyFact 上做 SFT，损失包含答案分类项和跨语言分布一致性项，后者把同一事实的 12 个语言版本放在同一组内约束；第三，使用多语 GRPO。GRPO 对每个事实采样 G=8 组 rollout，每组包含 12 个语言独立生成，奖励由逐语言正确性、无效答案惩罚和“全部语言答对”的一致性奖励组成。这个设计的关键区别是：SFT 只能拟合静态答案分布，GRPO 在 on-policy 生成中直接奖励跨语言共同成功，因此更贴近推理时的错误模式。论文还用 LAHIS 分析 attention head 的语言特异性贡献，观察训练后内部表示和多语路由的变化。
summary.experiments: 实验模型包括 Qwen-2.5-7B 和 OLMo-2-1124-7B。PolyFact 总计 100,000 个事实，划分为 95,000 训练、2,500 验证、2,500 测试；每个事实有 12 语平行问题。CPT 语料包含 325,134 个 packed chunks，总计 235.5M tokens，chunk 约 512 tokens，并截断到 1024 tokens。主要结果是：轻量 CPT 在多语事实召回上增益有限，说明仅靠平行语料继续预训练不足以稳定释放已有事实知识；带一致性目标的 SFT 有改善，但 GRPO 在跨语言一致性、未见语言泛化和整体事实召回上更稳定地优于 SFT。论文还报告纯 SFT 变体 λ=0 的消融，用于区分“显式一致性目标”和“on-policy RL 算法”各自的贡献。内部分析显示，GRPO 不只是提高输出准确率，也会改变语言相关 attention head 的贡献和语言间表示结构，这支持它在知识访问路径上产生了影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议约 25 分钟。重点看数据构建部分和 GRPO 奖励设计。PolyFact 的价值不只在规模，而在全平行事实级结构，它使同一知识在 12 个语言接口下可比较。方法部分需要关注 SFT 的 consistency loss 为什么加入 stop-gradient，以及 GRPO 的 all-correct bonus 如何把单语正确性转成跨语一致性压力。结果部分建议重点看 CPT、SFT、GRPO 三者对比，以及 unseen languages 的泛化结果。LAHIS 分析可以快速看图，不必深挖所有 head 细节；更有价值的是它给出了一个判断 post-train 是否改变多语路由的诊断方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why English-dominant LLMs can store factual knowledge but fail to express the same facts reliably through non-English prompts. The target is not adding more multilingual knowledge at scale, but improving access to latent facts through different language interfaces.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the separation between representation alignment and knowledge access. Light continual pretraining on parallel text can help align languages, but it does not necessarily improve multilingual factual recall. A consistency-driven RL objective gives a more direct training signal for accessing the same latent fact across languages. This matters for multilingual pretraining and mid-training: parallel data is helpful, but it is not a complete substitute for objectives that test whether knowledge can be retrieved consistently.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PolyFact, a fully parallel multilingual factual multiple-choice QA dataset grounded in Wikidata truthy triples. It keeps 22 factual relations across geography, biography, creative works, organizations, and cultural relations, and covers 12 typologically diverse high- and low-resource languages. Distractors are sampled from co-occurring objects under the same property and matched by type and length. Questions are generated with Gemma-3-27B-IT and checked with a web-grounded GPT-4o judge plus manual review; the authors also provide a cleaner subset for ambiguous relations. The training comparison includes light CPT on TED2025-style parallel text, SFT with a classification-plus-consistency loss, and multilingual GRPO. In GRPO, each factual item is evaluated through 12 language-specific prompts, with G=8 grouped rollouts. The reward combines per-language correctness, invalid-answer handling, and an extra bonus when all languages are correct. The SFT baseline includes a cross-language distribution-matching term with stop-gradient so that the comparison is not simply RL versus no consistency pressure. The paper also applies LAHIS to inspect how fine-tuning changes language-specific attention-head behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen-2.5-7B and OLMo-2-1124-7B. PolyFact contains 100,000 facts, split into 95,000 training, 2,500 validation, and 2,500 test facts, each with 12 parallel language versions. The CPT corpus has 325,134 packed chunks and 235.5M tokens, with roughly 512-token chunks and truncation at 1024 tokens. The main empirical finding is that light CPT gives limited gains on multilingual factual recall, while GRPO consistently improves cross-lingual consistency and generalization to unseen languages more than SFT. The λ=0 SFT ablation helps separate the effect of an explicit consistency objective from the effect of on-policy RL. The representation analysis suggests that GRPO changes multilingual routing and internal language-specific processing, rather than only changing surface answer formatting.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 minutes. Focus on the PolyFact construction and the GRPO reward. The important design choice is that each fact is fully parallel across languages, so the same latent knowledge can be probed through many language interfaces. In the method section, inspect why the SFT baseline includes a consistency term and how the all-correct reward changes the optimization pressure. In the results, prioritize the CPT-versus-SFT-versus-GRPO comparison and the unseen-language setting. The LAHIS analysis is worth reading at the figure level as a diagnostic of whether post-training changes multilingual routing.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把“多语言知识缺口”从数据不足改写成后训练信用分配问题；先看主结果和机制图，但别急着下结论，需警惕 reward 过拟合到一致性而非真实性。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it reframes multilingual factual gaps as a post-training credit-assignment problem rather than a pure data deficit; read the main comparison and mechanism section, but be cautious about reward overfitting to consistency rather than truth.

paper.title: A Comprehensive Anatomy of Human and DeepSeek-R1 LLM Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: The emergence of "Aha moments" in large language models, particularly DeepSeek-R1-0120, has raised the question of whether these systems genuinely reason or merely imitate the appearance of reasoning. We conduct a comprehensive empirical comparison between model and human reasoning across all 30 problems from AIME 2025, exhaustively annotating 10,247 reasoning steps into five functional categories: Analysis, Inference, Branch, Backtrace, and Reflection. We find a clear structural difference. Hum

summary.core_problem: 现有长思维链（CoT）数学推理模型（以DeepSeek-R1为代表）的表面推理行为与人类相似，但仅依赖最终答案正确率的评测体系无法区分模型是具备真实逻辑推理能力，还是仅模仿人类推理的拓扑结构（拓扑模仿）；此前没有细粒度的步骤级功能分类框架，来系统对比人类与模型推理轨迹的结构动力学和控制机制差异。
summary.importance: 该工作将推理能力评测从结果导向转向结构功能导向，为长CoT模型训练提供了可验证的步骤标注框架。它量化了此前未被测量的拓扑模仿现象，为推理能力的预训练与对齐监督信号设计提供了明确方向，可直接指导长推理场景下的过程奖励模型与RL目标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 研究选取AIME 2025全部30道题，收集数学竞赛参与者的人类参考解与DeepSeek-R1的所有推理轨迹，共标注10247个推理步骤，划分为5类可通过文本签名验证的功能类别：Analysis（问题规划，不产生新数学结论）、Inference（演绎推进，产生新的等式/数值/逻辑结论）、Branch（提出并行路径且不放弃当前路径）、Backtrace（撤销此前工作并返回更早状态）、Reflection（元认知重评估，以“wait”“let me check”等短语为标记）。随后系统对比人类与模型推理的步骤分布、上下文依赖与跨轨迹差异，量化了拓扑模仿的核心特征。
summary.experiments: 人类解的步骤分布中约15%为Analysis，核心是Analysis与Inference的紧凑交替，回溯极少，反思仅用于真实的分支节点；DeepSeek-R1的步骤中约40%为Analysis，反复重推导中间结论而非复用，反思频率高但90%以上为算术检查而非逻辑校验。失败的模型轨迹中，分支/回溯步骤占比要么低于5%，要么高于30%（过度滥用），而人类成功解的该占比稳定在10%-20%区间。代表性案例中，人类求解某道AIME题仅用11步、通过清晰的二分案例拆分得到正确答案，DeepSeek-R1生成132步表面结构相似的轨迹，但未完成第二个案例的推导就终止，输出错误答案。全部30道题的跨题可视化验证，长CoT的长度与反思密度和推理质量无正相关。
summary.reading_guide: 精读首先关注Section3的5类推理步骤功能定义与标注规则，这是整个研究的基础。随后阅读Section4的跨轨迹方差分析，这是区分真实推理与拓扑模仿的第一个核心指标。Section5-6的反思上下文放置与功能靶向性分析，是第二个核心指标。Section7的单题分步拆解案例，可直观理解结构差异。Section9的训练与评测启示，对预训练研究员参考价值最高。优先查看的图表包括Figure2（单题人模推理对比）、Figure8（全30题步骤分布热力图）、Table2（步骤分布统计对比表）。可深挖的方向包括：如何将步骤功能分布转化为预训练与RL的监督信号，如何在预训练阶段减少模型的拓扑模仿行为。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation paradigms for long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mathematical reasoning models (represented by DeepSeek-R1) rely solely on final answer accuracy, which cannot distinguish between genuine logical reasoning and superficial topological mimicry of human reasoning structure. No prior work has established a fine-grained, step-level functional classification framework to systematically compare structural dynamics and control mechanisms between human and model reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: This work shifts reasoning capability evaluation from result-oriented to structure-and-function-oriented, providing a verifiable step annotation framework for long-CoT model training. It quantifies the previously unmeasured phenomenon of topological mimicry, and provides explicit direction for designing pretraining and alignment supervision signals for reasoning capabilities, directly informing the design of process reward models and RL objectives for extended reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses all 30 problems from AIME 2025, collects human reference solutions from math competition participants and all reasoning traces from DeepSeek-R1, and annotates a total of 10,247 reasoning steps into 5 functionally defined categories verifiable via textual signatures: Analysis (problem setup and planning, no new mathematical conclusions), Inference (deductive progression producing new equations, values or logical claims), Branch (proposing parallel paths without abandoning the current line), Backtrace (retracting prior work to return to an earlier state), and Reflection (meta-cognitive re-evaluation marked by phrases like "wait" or "let me check"). It then systematically compares step distribution, contextual dependence and cross-trace variance between human and model reasoning, and quantifies core features of topological mimicry.
summary_en.experiments: Human solutions allocate ~15% of steps to Analysis, follow a compact alternation between Analysis and Inference, use backtracking rarely, and reserve reflection for genuine branching points. DeepSeek-R1 allocates ~40% of steps to Analysis, repeatedly re-derives intermediate conclusions instead of reusing them, and produces frequent reflections over 90% of which are shallow arithmetic checks rather than logical validation. Failed model trajectories either use branching/backtracking for less than 5% of steps or more than 30% (overuse), while successful human solutions keep the ratio between 10% and 20%. In one representative case, a human solver reached the correct answer in 11 steps with a clean two-way case split, while DeepSeek-R1 produced a 132-step trace with similar surface structure that failed to complete the second case and returned a wrong answer. Cross-problem visualization across all 30 problems confirms no positive correlation between CoT length / reflection density and reasoning quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus first on Section 3 for the 5 functional step definitions and annotation rules, the foundation of the entire study. Then read Section 4 for cross-trace variance analysis, the first core metric distinguishing genuine reasoning from mimicry. Sections 5 and 6 cover the contextual placement and functional targeting of reflection, the second core metric. Section 7 provides a step-by-step case dissection of a single problem for intuitive understanding of structural differences. Section 9 contains implications for training and evaluation, the most relevant part for pretraining researchers. Prioritize Figure 2 (single-problem human-model comparison), Figure 8 (step distribution heatmap across all 30 problems), and Table 2 (statistical comparison of step distributions). Points for further exploration include how to convert step functional distribution into supervision signals for pretraining and RL, and how to reduce topological mimicry during pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改方法，但会校正你对 R1 类长推理轨迹的直觉：先看标注体系和失败轨迹统计，别再把 token 更长误当成搜索更深。
recommendation.en: It does not give you a new method, but it should reset your intuition about R1-style long traces: read the annotation scheme and failure-trace statistics before equating more tokens with deeper search.

paper.title: How Language Models Fail: Token-Level Signatures of Committed and Persistent Reasoning Failures
paper.abstract: Failures in language model reasoning emerge through distinct processes that leave identifiable signatures in the reasoning trace. We characterize these failures using token-level uncertainty signals, finding they arise through two empirically distinguishable processes. The first is committed failure, in which a model locks onto an incorrect reasoning path early in its trace. A central diagnostic signature is the commitment point, beyond which considering additional tokens hurt rather than help f

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 推理失败在生成过程中如何形成。它不只判断一个答案会不会错，而是用 token 级不确定性信号区分两类失败：早期走上错误路径的 committed failure，以及整段推理都保持不确定的 persistent uncertainty。
summary.importance: 对预训练和推理机制研究的价值在于，它提供了一种只依赖输出 log probabilities 的失败过程诊断方法。相比 probing activations 或干预内部表示，这种方法可用于只开放 token 概率的模型。它也解释了为什么 self-consistency 有时有效、有时会误导：如果模型早早锁定错误路径，多采样可能只是在重复同一个错误；如果模型的不确定性贯穿全程，多样采样和聚合才更可能有收益。这对训练 verifier、设计 process reward、选择推理时的采样策略都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 chain-of-thought trace 看成一条不确定性轨迹。对每个 token 位置，论文使用 token 概率分布构造不确定性特征，例如 top-K 分布熵和 top-1 与 top-2 概率差。然后在不同前缀窗口上聚合这些信号，用它们预测最终答案是否错误。关键概念是 commitment point：某个前缀长度处，token 级不确定性对失败最有预测力；超过这个点后，继续加入后续 token 反而降低失败检测效果。若存在这种峰值，说明模型较早选定了推理路径，后续内容更多是沿既定路径展开。相反，如果预测力随 trace 长度单调增加，完整推理链最有信息量，则归为 persistent uncertainty。这个框架的优点是可证伪：不同失败模式会对“前缀是否优于全文”“self-consistency 是否有效”给出不同预测。
summary.experiments: 论文在 23 个 model-dataset 配置上验证，覆盖 5 个模型家族和 4 类推理任务。框架的可检验预测在 20/23 个配置中成立。实验关注单条 completion 的 token-level log probability，不要求访问模型权重或 hidden states。主要发现是：部分配置呈现 committed failure，早期窗口的失败检测效果强于完整 trace，并能找到 commitment point；另一部分配置呈现 persistent uncertainty，越长的 trace 越有助于区分成功和失败。论文还将该分类与 self-consistency 的效果关联起来：persistent uncertainty 场景更适合通过多样采样聚合缓解错误，而 committed failure 场景中 self-consistency 可能给错误答案更高置信度。作者也指出该方法需要适中的失败率；如果任务过易或过难，分类信号会不稳定。闭源 API 的 log probability 可用性也会限制适用范围。
