summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议约 20 分钟。先看引言中 committed failure 与 persistent uncertainty 的例子，理解两类失败为何需要不同检测策略。方法部分重点看 early window、token uncertainty features 和 commitment point 的定义。实验部分优先看 23 个配置中哪些属于 committed failure，哪些属于 persistent uncertainty，以及这些分类如何预测 self-consistency 的收益。若关注 verifier 或 process reward，可以进一步看他们怎样用单条 trace 的 token 概率做失败检测；这比只用最终答案置信度更接近过程监督需要的信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how reasoning failures form during generation, rather than only whether the final answer is wrong. It distinguishes two failure processes: committed failure, where the model locks onto a wrong path early, and persistent uncertainty, where uncertainty remains informative throughout the reasoning trace.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for pretraining and reasoning research is that the method diagnoses failure dynamics using only token-level log probabilities. It does not require hidden states, probes, or model-weight access, so it can apply to models where only output probabilities are exposed. The distinction also explains why self-consistency is uneven: it helps when uncertainty persists across completions, but can reinforce a wrong answer when the model has already committed to an incorrect path. This is useful for verifier design, process reward modeling, and inference-time decisions about when to sample more.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework treats a chain-of-thought as an uncertainty trajectory. At each token position, it computes uncertainty features from the next-token distribution, including top-K entropy and the margin between the top two token probabilities. These features are aggregated over prefixes of the trace and used to predict whether the final extracted answer is incorrect. The central object is the commitment point: the prefix length at which token-level uncertainty is most predictive of failure. If adding later tokens hurts failure detection, the model is interpreted as having already chosen a reasoning path, with later text mostly downstream of that choice. If predictive power improves monotonically as more of the trace is included, the failure mode is persistent uncertainty. The design is useful because it yields falsifiable predictions about prefix informativeness and the expected value of self-consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 23 model-dataset configurations across five model families and four reasoning domains. Its predictions hold in 20 of the 23 configurations. The experiments use log probabilities from a single completion, without access to internal activations. Some configurations show committed failure: an early window predicts failure better than the full trace, revealing a measurable commitment point. Others show persistent uncertainty: the full trace is the best signal, and uncertainty accumulates across the reasoning process. The paper also links these modes to self-consistency. Multi-sample aggregation is more useful under persistent uncertainty, while committed failure can make self-consistency confidently repeat the same wrong path. The method is less reliable when failure rates are too low or too high, and closed-API restrictions on log probabilities can limit coverage.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20 minutes. Start with the examples of committed failure and persistent uncertainty in the introduction. Then read the definitions of early windows, token-level uncertainty features, and the commitment point. In the experiments, focus on which configurations fall into each failure mode and how that classification predicts the behavior of self-consistency. For work on verifiers or process supervision, the most relevant part is the use of a single trace’s token probabilities as a process-level failure signal, rather than relying only on final-answer confidence.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练 recipe，但会改你对 test-time scaling 的直觉：有些错是早早锁死，继续采样只是在放大错误；先看 commitment point 定义和 20/23 的复现结果。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining directly, but it should update your intuition about test-time scaling: some failures are committed early, so more sampling just amplifies the wrong path; read the commitment-point definition and the 20/23 replication result.

paper.title: The Effect of Training Task Diversity on In-Context Learning through the Lens of Low-Dimensional Subspaces
paper.abstract: The transformer's emergent ability to perform in-context learning (ICL) has sparked a wide range of studies designed to understand its underlying mechanisms. Existing works often study how training task diversity, defined either as the number of ICL training task vectors or as the number of function classes from which the task vectors are drawn, shapes both the learning dynamics and generalization capabilities of ICL. While both definitions have uncovered many interesting phenomena, many observa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：训练阶段的“任务多样性”为什么会改变 in-context learning 的学习速度和泛化边界，尤其是为什么多任务混合训练会缩短常见的 loss plateau，并在一定条件下带来更好的 OOD 泛化。它不是再做一个经验观察，而是试图给出一个可分析、可统一的数学定义。作者把训练任务分布建模成若干高斯成分的混合，每个成分对应一个低维子空间，不同成分之间共享一部分公共子空间。这样，“任务多样性”不再只是任务数变多，而是变成：模型在多个相关但不完全相同的低维结构上共同训练。核心问题因此被落到一个更具体的机制上：共享子空间提供可复用结构，私有子空间提供覆盖范围，二者如何共同决定训练动力学与泛化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它给“数据多样性为什么有用”提供了比经验口号更细的解释：不是简单地把更多不同任务混在一起就一定更好，而是这些任务之间需要存在可共享的低维结构，模型才能更快学到通用算法或表征。第二，它把两个此前分散的现象放进同一个框架里解释：一是 ICL 训练中的长平台期为何会因任务多样性而缩短；二是 OOD 泛化为何依赖训练任务覆盖到足够丰富但又有结构关联的方向。对做预训练的人，这对应到一个很实际的问题：数据配比和数据混合的收益，往往来自共享结构的密度，而不是表面上的来源数量。论文的量级更偏机制澄清和理论统一，不是直接给出新的大模型 recipe，但对理解多任务预训练、课程设计、合成任务构造都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者沿用近几年研究 ICL 常见的可解析设定：单层 linear attention 模型，在 prompt 中做线性回归。这样做的原因很直接：标准 Transformer 太难分析，而线性注意力已经被多篇工作证明能复现不少 ICL 现象。论文的关键建模选择有两个。其一，训练任务向量不是从单一分布采样，而是从 mixture of Gaussians 采样；其二，每个高斯成分都限制在一个低维子空间内，并且这些子空间之间存在重叠的公共部分。这个设定比“任务来自不同函数类”的经验说法更可分析，也比“任务向量来自球面某个子集”的设定更容易推导训练动态。

在这个框架下，作者分析了梯度下降如何先学到共享子空间，再逐步吸收各成分的私有方向。平台期的来源，被解释为模型尚未对齐到这些公共结构之前，参数更新对整体风险下降贡献有限；一旦共享子空间被识别，多个任务成分会提供协同梯度，训练会明显加速。也就是说，任务多样性有帮助，不是因为任务越杂越好，而是因为多个任务在公共子空间上形成了更强、更稳定的学习信号。

对于泛化，尤其是 OOD，作者讨论的是：测试任务如果落在训练时多个子空间张成或覆盖到的结构附近，模型就可能借助学到的共享部分和更广的方向覆盖实现外推；如果测试方向完全脱离这些结构，任务多样性本身也救不了泛化。这个结论和很多预训练经验是对齐的：覆盖面重要，但覆盖必须是结构化的，不是无约束堆数据。

从与已有工作的区别看，Kim 等工作主要是经验上观察到 task diversity 缩短 plateau，Goddard 等工作主要从经验上讨论 task diversity 与 OOD 的关系，而这篇工作试图用“重叠低维子空间”把两件事放进同一套分析里。它的贡献不在模型新，而在定义和机制更清楚。
summary.experiments:
这篇论文的实验角色更像理论支撑和现象复现，而不是大规模 benchmark。给出的关键信号包括：作者复现了已有工作里“混合多类任务训练比单独训练每类任务收敛更快”的现象，图 2 左侧展示了带任务多样性的训练曲线更早脱离 plateau、并更快接近近最优解。论文还通过构造不同子空间重叠程度、不同 mixture 组件数、不同共享维度与私有维度的设置，展示 plateau 长度和泛化能力如何随结构变化而变。

从全文可见，实验主要围绕线性回归 testbed 和 linear attention 展开，重点不是绝对性能数字，而是趋势：共享子空间越明显，多任务联合训练的加速越强；训练任务覆盖的子空间越丰富，OOD 测试越可能受益。由于你给出的全文片段没有包含完整结果表和定量数值，我不适合编造具体提升百分比。但可以明确的是，作者把“缩短平台期”和“提升 OOD”都做成了可控变量实验，而不是只给单点结果。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓定义，再看结论，不必一开始陷进推导细节。优先看 Introduction 里对两类 task diversity 定义的区分，以及作者为什么认为现有定义不够可分析。接着看 Problem Setup，重点理解 mixture of Gaussians + overlapping low-dimensional subspaces 这个设定，因为后面的所有结论都建立在这里。

如果只想抓住论文价值，重点看两部分：一是训练动力学分析，作者如何把 plateau 解释成“共享结构尚未被学到”的阶段；二是 OOD 泛化分析，作者如何把泛化边界和子空间覆盖联系起来。图 1 和图 2 应该是最值得先看的图，它们分别对应整体框架和训练曲线现象。

预计阅读时间 30 到 45 分钟。若你关心预训练数据混合、课程学习或合成任务设计，可以进一步细看理论部分里哪些量控制 plateau 长度，哪些量控制泛化范围。这些量虽然在简化模型里定义，但很容易映射到真实预训练中的“共享模式密度”和“分布覆盖度”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why training-task diversity changes both the optimization dynamics and the generalization behavior of in-context learning, with a particular focus on two empirical phenomena: long loss plateaus during ICL training, and the dependence of OOD generalization on task diversity. The key move is to replace vague notions of “more diverse tasks” with a tractable structural definition. Training tasks are drawn from a Gaussian mixture, where each component lives in a low-dimensional subspace, and different components share a common subspace. Under this setup, task diversity becomes a question about how much shared structure and how much private variation are present across training tasks.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the main value is conceptual rather than recipe-level. The paper gives a sharper answer to a familiar question: why does mixing tasks sometimes help optimization and transfer? Its answer is not “more heterogeneity is always better,” but “diverse tasks help when they contain reusable shared structure.” That is directly relevant to data mixture design, synthetic curriculum construction, and multi-domain pretraining. A second contribution is unification: prior work had separately observed that task diversity shortens ICL plateaus and may improve OOD behavior, but this paper places both effects inside one analyzable framework. The contribution is therefore a mechanism-level clarification of data diversity, not a new large-scale training method.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The analysis uses a standard tractable testbed for ICL theory: a single-layer linear attention model trained on linear regression prompts. This choice is deliberate. Full transformers are too hard to analyze cleanly, while linear attention has been shown in prior work to reproduce several qualitative ICL phenomena. The paper’s main modeling contribution is the task distribution: instead of sampling task vectors from a single family, it samples them from a mixture of Gaussians, with each mixture component restricted to a low-dimensional subspace. These subspaces overlap through a shared common subspace.

This structure lets the authors study how gradient descent first aligns with the shared subspace and only later captures component-specific directions. The loss plateau is interpreted as the phase before the model has identified the common structure that is useful across tasks. Once that shared structure is learned, gradients from different task components reinforce each other, and optimization accelerates. In that sense, diversity helps not because tasks are arbitrarily different, but because multiple related tasks provide a stronger and more stable signal on the common latent structure.

For generalization, especially OOD, the paper argues that success depends on whether test tasks lie near the span or coverage induced by the training subspaces. If training tasks cover a richer set of structured directions while still sharing common components, the model can extrapolate better. If test tasks fall outside that structural support, diversity alone does not guarantee transfer. This is a useful distinction for pretraining: coverage matters, but structured coverage matters more.

Relative to earlier work, Kim et al. mainly provided empirical evidence that task diversity shortens the plateau, and Goddard et al. empirically linked diversity to OOD behavior under a different task definition. This paper’s novelty is the overlapping-subspace formulation that makes both effects analyzable within one mathematical framework.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments serve mainly to validate the theory and reproduce known qualitative phenomena rather than to establish a new benchmark. The paper reproduces the observation that training on a mixture of related task families converges faster than training on each family separately; the left panel of Figure 2 is highlighted as showing earlier escape from the plateau and faster approach to near-optimal performance under task diversity. It also varies the degree of subspace overlap, the number of mixture components, and the dimensions of shared versus private subspaces to show how these factors affect plateau length and OOD behavior.

The experimental setup stays within the linear-regression / linear-attention testbed. The main outputs are trends, not headline absolute numbers: stronger shared subspaces lead to larger optimization gains from joint training, and broader structured subspace coverage improves OOD generalization. The provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains. What is clear is that the paper treats both optimization speed and OOD transfer as controlled variables tied to the geometry of the task distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as a mechanism paper. Start with the Introduction, especially the distinction between two meanings of task diversity used in prior ICL work. Then move to the problem setup and make sure the Gaussian-mixture-with-overlapping-subspaces construction is clear; that is the core abstraction, and the rest of the paper depends on it.

If time is limited, focus on two parts. First, the training-dynamics analysis: how the paper explains the plateau as a failure to initially capture shared structure. Second, the OOD analysis: how generalization is tied to subspace coverage rather than raw task count. Figure 1 and Figure 2 are likely the best entry points, since they summarize the framework and the optimization effect.

Estimated reading time is 30–45 minutes for a skim. If your interest is pretraining data mixtures or curriculum design, it is worth digging into which quantities control plateau duration and which control generalization range. Even though the model is simplified, those quantities map naturally to shared-pattern density and structured coverage in real pretraining corpora.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接改 recipe 的论文，但如果你在想 data mixture 为什么会改变 ICL emergence，这篇的子空间定义比“任务数越多越好”干净得多，重点看理论设定和对应实验。
recommendation.en: Not a recipe-changing paper, but if you're thinking about why data mixture alters ICL emergence, its subspace-based notion of diversity is cleaner than the usual “more tasks is better”; read the setup and validation, not for scale.

paper.title: Characterize Then Distill: Mechanistic Reasoning in Large Output Spaces
paper.abstract: Modern reasoning models offer surprisingly strong zero-shot performance on challenging multi-label tasks that require selecting a small set of relevant options from hundreds of thousands to millions of candidate labels. We investigate how they achieve this mechanistically. We characterize reasoning as a two-phase process: A broad "shortlisting" of candidates followed by fine-grained reasoning over the resulting set. We provide evidence across a range of datasets that these steps can be isolated

summary.core_problem: 研究推理型大模型在超大标签空间的多标签选择任务中，如何从数十万到数百万候选标签里零样本找出少量相关选项。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是机制分析和蒸馏方法：把大输出空间推理拆成“粗粒度候选短名单生成”和“短名单内精细判断”两阶段，并据此改进蒸馏。它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对理解推理模型如何处理大动作空间有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先通过多数据集实验隔离 shortlisting 与 fine-grained reasoning 两个过程，验证二者互补；随后设计 mechanistic distillation，让学生模型显式学习教师模型的候选缩减与后续判断，而不是只拟合最终标签。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在一系列需要从数十万到数百万候选标签中选择少量标签的数据集上验证两阶段机制，并且该蒸馏策略稳定优于标准蒸馏；未给出模型规模、具体数据集数量或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Northeastern University Khoury College of Computer Sciences；Byron C. Wallace 长期从事 NLP、信息抽取和证据建模相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how modern reasoning models solve multi-label tasks with extremely large output spaces, where only a small subset must be selected from hundreds of thousands or millions of labels.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism-level characterization plus a distillation recipe: reasoning over large label spaces is decomposed into broad shortlisting followed by fine-grained reasoning. This is not pretraining work, but it is relevant to how reasoning models handle large action or label spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors empirically separate the shortlisting and fine-grained reasoning phases across several datasets, show that the phases are complementary, and then distill the teacher by making the student imitate this internal two-stage behavior rather than only the final outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on multiple large-output-space multi-label datasets, with candidate spaces ranging from hundreds of thousands to millions. The proposed mechanistic distillation consistently outperforms standard distillation, but the abstract does not specify model sizes or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Northeastern University's Khoury College of Computer Sciences. Byron C. Wallace is known for NLP work on information extraction and evidence modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座训练论文；只看两阶段 shortlisting 证据，能为大动作空间蒸馏提供一个可复现实验假设。
recommendation.en: Not a base-model training paper; read only the shortlisting evidence, which gives a testable hypothesis for distilling large action spaces.

institutions: Khoury College of Computer Sciences, Northeastern University

paper.title: Anchored, Not Graded: Vision-Language Models Fail at Slant-from-Texture Perception
paper.abstract: Human perception of surface slant from texture exhibits systematic, graded biases that emerge reliably in psychophysical experiments. Prior work showed that unsupervised CNNs reproduce several human-like biases, while supervised CNNs do not. Do Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit similar competences? Across multiple VLM families and model scales, zero-shot and in-context prompting both produce distinctive failures: slant is predicted at only a small set of anchors (e.g., 0\degree, $\pm$25\degr

summary.core_problem: 检验 VLM 是否具备类似人类的 texture-based slant perception，以及失败发生在表征层还是语言输出层。
summary.importance: 这是一个干净的感知机制分析，价值不在新模型，而在指出 VLM 在低层几何知觉上的系统性离散锚定失败。对做多模态预训练的人有弱但真实的提醒：高层 benchmark 过关不代表连续感知表征能被语言头稳定读出。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在多种 VLM 家族和不同规模上，用 zero-shot 与 in-context prompting 测试 slant-from-texture 感知；观察输出是否随视场、光学倾斜和曲率连续变化，并分析监督微调是否能修复该缺陷。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示多个 VLM 家族都把 slant 预测压缩到少数锚点角度，如 0°、±25°、±45°，且对刺激变化不敏感；监督微调能部分改善，但残余锚定仍在。没有给出与预训练 recipe 直接相关的消融，因此更像 failure analysis。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Brown University 和 Harvard University。

summary_en.core_problem: Testing whether VLMs exhibit human-like slant-from-texture perception, and whether failures arise from representation or from the language output interface.
summary_en.importance: This is a clean perceptual failure analysis. Its value is not a new model but the observation that VLMs show systematic discrete anchoring failures on low-level geometric perception. For multimodal pretraining, it is a useful reminder that strong high-level benchmarks do not imply smoothly readable continuous perceptual representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper evaluates multiple VLM families and scales under zero-shot and in-context prompting on slant-from-texture stimuli, checking whether outputs vary continuously with field of view, optical slant, and surface curvature, and whether supervised fine-tuning fixes the issue.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, many VLMs collapse predictions to a few anchor angles such as 0°, ±25°, and ±45°, with weak dependence on stimulus variations. Supervised fine-tuning partially helps, but anchoring persists. There is little direct ablation on pretraining recipe, so this is mainly a failure-analysis paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Brown University and Harvard University.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是方法论文，但 failure setup 很干净：它提醒你别把 VLM 的语言输出当成感知能力本身，读 abstract 和实验图就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but the failure setup is clean: don’t confuse a VLM’s language output with its actual perceptual competence; abstract plus figures are enough.

paper.title: A Geometric View for Understanding Concept Learning and Neuron Interpretation in Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: We propose a unified mathematical framework for a geometric understanding of concept learning and neuron interpretation in sparse autoencoders (SAEs). While SAEs improve interpretability of neural networks by learning sparse feature representations, a principled definition of ''concept'' and ''learning'' remains unclear. We formalize concepts as sets of data points and cast concept learning as a set-alignment problem between human-defined and model-induced concepts. This formulation distinguishe

summary.core_problem: 给 SAE 中“概念”“概念学习”“单神经元是否代表概念”这些常被经验性讨论的问题，建立一个更严格的几何与集合论框架。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析与可解释性方向的基础性工作，不直接改进 LLM 训练，但有助于把 SAE 里常见的 feature splitting、absorption、层级概念等现象从经验描述推进到可推导的条件与限制。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把概念形式化为数据点集合，把概念学习写成 human-defined concepts 与 model-induced concepts 的集合对齐问题，并区分 detection、separation、approximation 三种强度递增的学习定义。在此基础上给出几何条件、误差界、容量约束，并用该框架解释单神经元、多神经元单元以及 SAE 常见现象。
summary.experiments: 摘要更偏理论框架，未强调大规模 LLM 实验或具体模型规模。价值主要在概念定义与理论解释，而不是新的实证 benchmark 或训练收益。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Su-In Lee，长期从事可解释性与机器学习方法研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It builds a more principled geometric account of what a “concept” is in SAEs, what it means to learn one, and when a neuron can represent it.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/interpretability paper rather than a training paper, but it is useful because it turns common SAE observations—feature splitting, absorption, hierarchies—from informal descriptions into conditions and limits.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes concepts as sets of datapoints and frames concept learning as set alignment between human-defined and model-induced concepts. It distinguishes detection, separation, and approximation, then derives geometric conditions, error bounds, and capacity constraints for single-neuron and multi-neuron representations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is theory-heavy and does not foreground large-scale LLM experiments or model sizes. The main value is conceptual and analytical, not benchmark gains or training improvements.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Su-In Lee, known for work in interpretability and machine learning methodology.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在用 SAE 做表征分析，这篇能帮你少说一些模糊话；但它不直接改变训练 recipe，读定义和定理框架就够了。
recommendation.en: Useful if you rely on SAEs for representation analysis: it sharpens the language around concepts, but it will not change your training recipe.

paper.title: The Self-Correction Illusion: LLMs Correct Others but Not Themselves
paper.abstract: Recent work shows that LLM agents struggle to correct errors in their own reasoning traces yet show markedly higher correction rates when identical claims appear under external sources. We ask whether this asymmetry reflects a capability deficit or a role-label artifact: does an agent's willingness to correct a wrong claim depend causally on the chat-template role that carries it, rather than on the claim's content? Our setup keeps the erroneous claim byte-identical across all conditions (SHA-25

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“模型会不会自我纠错”，而是更具体的问题：同一条错误陈述，如果内容完全不变，只改变它在 chat template 里的来源角色，模型的纠错意愿会不会显著变化。作者把错误 claim 做到字节级一致，只改外层包装：放在 assistant 自己的 <thought>、user 消息、tool 返回、system memory 等不同槽位里。全文给出的结论很明确：很多所谓 self-correction deficit，并不主要来自推理能力不足，而是来自 agent harness 对“这句话属于谁”的编码方式。模型往往更愿意审查外部来源的说法，却不愿显式否定自己内部 scratchpad 里的说法。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在于提出了新的训练目标，而在于它把一个常被归因于“能力缺陷”的现象，重新拆成了“模型能力 × chat-format 归因偏置”两个部分。这个区分很重要。第一，它提醒人们在分析 reasoning failure、self-refinement、verifier 失效时，不能只看 end-to-end 指标，必须把 prompt/harness 作为实验变量。第二，它说明 instruction-tuned 模型对 role token、消息边界、来源标签有很强条件化依赖，这对后续做 agent pretraining、tool-use 数据构造、memory formatting、甚至 synthetic trace 蒸馏都有影响。第三，它给出一个几乎零成本的工程杠杆：不改权重，只改消息归属，就能显著改变纠错率。这类现象虽然不属于 pretrain recipe 本身，但对理解 post-train 后模型学到了什么偏置很有价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法本身很简单，但实验控制做得比较严。核心干预叫 source-conditioned role relabeling：先让模型在自己的 reasoning trace 里产生一个错误中间结论 c*，然后把这条错误结论原样复制一份，作为额外消息重新喂给模型；复制内容保持 byte-identical，唯一变化是外层 role，从 assistant 的 <thought> 改成 user、tool 或 system memory，并配同一条 audit instruction。这样可以把“内容差异”“措辞差异”“提示差异”都压到最小，只测 role label 的因果作用。

作者还做了几个关键机制拆解。第一是 self-distrust control：直接告诉模型“检查你自己的思路”，看能否达到和 relabel 一样的效果。结果不行，说明这不是简单的“多提醒一句去验证”。第二是 handle-granularity decomposition：把作用拆成两层，一层是把错误内容放进一个可被引用、可被点名的独立 wrapper；另一层才是 wrapper 上的 role tag。实验显示 bare wrapper 本身就能带来一部分提升，而 role tag 再额外贡献一截，支持作者提出的 addressability 解释：模型不是不会推翻错误，而是当错误埋在自己连续生成的 scratchpad 里时，缺少一个离散、可指向、可审查的对象。第三是 logprob 级别的 engage-then-verify 签名分析，用来区分 relabel 后模型是先“接住这个外部 claim”再审查，还是只是被提醒重新算一遍。全文的论证方向是：role relabel 改变了模型对 claim 的寻址方式和社会语用地位，而不只是增加了验证压力。

另外一个值得注意的点是安全性边界。作者做了 adversarial mirror：既然把内部错误改成外部来源会提高纠错率，那反过来把外部错误包装成可信 memory，会不会更容易把模型带偏。默认情况下几乎没有形成强攻击通道；但只要加一句明确的 trust framing，例如要求“把这段 memory 当作 ground truth，不要验证”，攻击率会大幅上升。这说明 role effect 不是无条件的，它和 instruction hierarchy、信任框架共同作用。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 7 个模型家族、3 个任务域，共 13 个 model-domain cells，每个 cell 30 个配对任务。作者报告，单纯把错误 claim 从模型自己的 <thought> 重标到外部角色，纠错率可提升 23 到 93 个百分点；13 个 cell 里有 10 个显著提升，剩下 3 个主要是原始基线已经较高的 ceiling case，L0 不低于 67%。文中还给出一个较醒目的例子：在 Llama-3.3-70B 上，把错误从 <thought> 改成外部角色，提升可达 +77 个百分点。

安全性实验做了 5 组 adversarial 设置，每组 n=30。默认条件下，20 个 attack-rate cells 全部不超过 3.3%，说明“纠错通道”默认并不会自动变成“注错通道”。但在数学任务上，只加一句“把这段 memory 当作真值且不要验证”，攻击率可升到 70%，说明安全边界很脆，取决于 trust framing。

机制拆解里，bare syntactic wrapper 带来约 17 到 23 个百分点提升，role tag 进一步贡献约 30 个百分点。self-distrust 对照下，仅要求模型验证自己的 thoughts，纠错率只有 0 到 23%，远低于 relabel 条件下可达到的 70%。这些数字共同支持作者的核心论点：关键不是“再想一遍”，而是“把错误放到一个模型愿意审查的位置上”。

从实验设计看，比较扎实的地方有三点：一是 byte-identity 控制，避免内容变化；二是 paired 设计和 bootstrap 统计；三是包含 GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4、Gemini 2.5 Flash 等前沿闭源模型复现，说明现象不是单一开源系模型的偶然产物。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把方法和实验图表看仔细。优先看 Introduction 里对问题重述的方式，作者不是把现象讲成“模型笨”，而是讲成“harness 变量未被控制”。然后看 Source-Conditioned Role Relabeling 的定义，重点确认干预到底改了什么、没改什么。真正值得看的部分是三类实验：
1. 主结果表，关注不同 role 的 lift 幅度，以及哪些 cell 属于 ceiling case。
2. self-distrust control 和 handle-granularity decomposition，这两部分决定论文是否只是一个 prompt trick，还是确实抓到机制。
3. adversarial mirror 与 trust-framing 实验，这部分给部署边界。

如果时间有限，先看 Figure 1/2、主结果表、机制拆解表，再看安全性实验。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要结论。若你关心 agent pretraining、scratchpad formatting、tool-use prompt 设计，这篇值得多想一步：role token 到底在 post-training 中学成了什么样的“来源可信度先验”，以及这种先验会不会污染对 reasoning trace 的评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharply controlled question: when an LLM sees an erroneous claim, does its willingness to correct that claim depend more on the claim content or on the chat-template role that carries it? The setup keeps the wrong claim byte-identical and only changes its wrapper: the model’s own <thought>, a user message, a tool response, or a system memory block. The main finding is that a large part of the so-called self-correction gap is not a pure reasoning deficit. It is a formatting and source-attribution effect induced by the agent harness.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented readers is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The work shows that some failures often attributed to weak reasoning are partly caused by role-conditioned behavior learned during instruction tuning. That matters for at least three reasons. First, evaluations of self-correction, verifier use, and reflective reasoning can be confounded by prompt structure. Second, role tokens and message boundaries appear to encode strong priors about what should be trusted, challenged, or merely continued. Third, this creates a cheap intervention surface for production agents: reliability can move a lot without changing model weights. Even though this is not a pretraining recipe paper, it is useful for understanding what post-training has actually taught the model about source labels and internal traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The intervention is deliberately minimal. The authors define source-conditioned role relabeling: after a model produces an incorrect intermediate claim c*, they append an additional message containing the exact same bytes of c*, but place it under an external role such as user, tool, or system memory, while keeping the audit instruction fixed across conditions. This isolates the causal effect of the role wrapper from content changes.

The paper then adds several mechanism probes. A self-distrust control asks the model to verify its own thoughts directly. This performs much worse than relabeling, which argues against a simple “extra verification reminder” explanation. A handle-granularity decomposition separates two effects: giving the claim an explicit standalone wrapper versus assigning that wrapper a specific role tag. The results suggest that a bare wrapper already helps, and the role label adds further lift. This supports an addressability account: a claim embedded inside the model’s own continuous scratchpad is harder to target, quote, and reject than the same claim presented as a discrete external object. The authors also analyze logprob signatures to distinguish engage-then-verify behavior from naive recomputation.

A useful part of the paper is the safety boundary analysis. The authors test the reverse direction: if relabeling helps correction, can role manipulation also inject errors? By default, the answer is mostly no. But once a trust-framing instruction is added, such as telling the model to treat memory as ground truth and not verify it, the attack channel opens up. So the effect is real, but it is mediated by instruction hierarchy and trust framing rather than being an unconditional role prior.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers 13 model-domain cells across 7 model families and 3 domains, with 30 paired tasks per cell. Relabeling the same wrong claim from the model’s own <thought> into an external role improves correction rates by 23 to 93 percentage points. Ten of the 13 cells show significant gains; the remaining three are ceiling cases where the baseline correction rate is already high, at or above 67%. One highlighted example is Llama-3.3-70B, where the lift reaches +77 points.

The adversarial mirror includes five attack settings with n=30 each. Under default conditions, all 20 attack-rate cells stay at or below 3.3%, so the correction channel does not automatically become an error-injection channel. However, adding a single trust-framing sentence can raise the math attack rate to 70%, which sharply limits any naive deployment claim.

The mechanism ablations are also informative. A bare syntactic wrapper contributes roughly 17 to 23 points, and the role tag adds about 30 more. In the self-distrust control, explicitly asking the model to verify its own thoughts yields only 0 to 23% correction, versus up to 70% under relabeling. The paper also uses paired bootstrap statistics and includes frontier closed models such as GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini 2.5 Flash, which makes the phenomenon harder to dismiss as a quirk of one open model family.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a mechanism paper about agent formatting, not as a generic self-correction paper. Start with the introduction and the formal definition of source-conditioned role relabeling. The key is to understand exactly what changes and what is held fixed. Then focus on three parts: the main result table, the self-distrust control, and the handle-granularity decomposition. Those sections determine whether the result is just a prompt trick or a real clue about how models treat internal versus external claims.

If time is limited, read Figure 1 and Figure 2, the main quantitative table, the decomposition experiment, and the adversarial mirror section. That is enough to capture the central claim and its boundary conditions in about 20–30 minutes. Readers working on agent pretraining, scratchpad formatting, tool-use prompting, or reasoning evaluation should pay special attention to the implied source-trust prior attached to role tokens.

recommendation.zh: 这个 setup 很干净；只看 role 重标实验，就足以更新对“自我纠错失败”的归因。
recommendation.en: The role-relabeling setup is clean enough to update the attribution of self-correction failures.

paper.title: Analysis of the Neglect-Zero Effect in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: We investigate the extent to which the language processing of LLMs resembles human cognitive processes, focusing on a human cognitive bias called the $\textit{neglect-zero effect}$. This effect refers to the human tendency to ignore $\textit{zero-models}$, which are configurations that render a proposition vacuously true by virtue of an empty set. We focus on two types of inferences driven by the neglect-zero effect, and examine how LLMs process these inferences by comparing their behavior with

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 是否表现出类似人类的 neglect-zero effect，即在某些逻辑命题中忽略使命题 vacuously true 的空集模型。
summary.importance: 这是 LLM 语言理解和认知偏差的机制分析，不直接改进训练方法，但能补充对模型逻辑语义处理方式的认识。
summary.technical_approach: 论文采用 structural priming 范式，先用 prime 句迫使模型考虑 zero-model，再观察 target 推理中是否迁移这种结构处理。对比包含 neglect-zero effect 的两类推理和不涉及该效应的推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出具体模型清单、规模和数值结果；主要实验应是不同 LLM 在 prime-target 条件下的推理行为比较。结果显示 LLM 的 neglect-zero 表现可能与人类并不完全一致。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自东京大学、RIKEN、东北大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs exhibit the human neglect-zero effect, where reasoners ignore zero-models that make a proposition vacuously true through an empty set.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis of LLM semantic and logical processing. It does not directly improve training, but it adds evidence about where LLM behavior diverges from human reasoning biases.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use a structural priming paradigm: prime sentences force the model to consider the zero-model, and target sentences test whether that processing carries over. They compare two inference types involving the neglect-zero effect against an inference type without it.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the full model list, parameter sizes, or numerical results. The experiments compare LLM behavior across prime-target reasoning conditions, with results suggesting that LLMs may not mirror the human neglect-zero effect.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with The University of Tokyo, RIKEN, and Tohoku University.

recommendation.zh: 这是认知偏差探针，不会改训练 recipe；若关心逻辑语义评测，只看实验设计和错误类型即可。
recommendation.en: This is a cognitive-bias probe, not a training paper; if you care about logical-semantics evaluation, read only the setup and error taxonomy.

paper.title: Consistency Training Along the Transformer Stack
paper.abstract: Consistency training encourages models to behave similarly across different contexts, and has shown promise for reducing misalignment. We broaden the scope of consistency training in two ways. First, we introduce two new internal consistency targets: MLP Consistency Training (MLPCT), which matches post-activation MLP states, and Attention Consistency Training (AttCT), which matches per-head attention distributions. Second, we apply consistency training to four additional safety threats: persona

summary.core_problem: 大模型在面对语义相似但表述不同的 prompt（如越狱、阿谀奉承、预填充攻击等）时，容易表现出不一致的对齐失效。现有的一致性训练（Consistency Training）方法仅关注输出分布或残差流激活，未充分利用 Transformer 内部其他组件的表示。
summary.importance: 拓展了一致性训练的设计空间，证明了在 Transformer 的不同层级（MLP、Attention）施加一致性约束，能有效防御多种新型安全威胁，且不同层级的约束具有互补性，为提升模型对齐的鲁棒性提供了新视角。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了两种新的一致性训练目标：1) MLPCT：约束干净 prompt 和扰动 prompt 在 SwiGLU 激活后的 MLP 隐藏状态的余弦距离；2) AttCT：约束两者在每个注意力头的注意力权重分布的 Jensen-Shannon 散度。训练时，模型通过 SFT 学习在扰动下保持内部状态与干净 prompt 一致。
summary.experiments: 在角色扮演 ICL 攻击、预填充攻击、对抗性挫败和条件错位等四种新威胁模型上进行了评估。结果表明，MLPCT 和 AttCT 在所有威胁模型上均表现出竞争力。消融实验发现，不同层级的一致性目标在跨威胁泛化上表现不同，例如基于激活的方法在对抗性挫败上失效，而基于输出分布的 BCT 则表现良好，表明不同目标学习到了不同的防御机制。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 3 了解 MLPCT 和 AttCT 的具体实现细节，以及 Section 4 中对四种新威胁模型的定义和实验结果。关注不同一致性目标在跨威胁泛化上的差异分析，这部分对理解模型内部机制有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Large language models often exhibit inconsistent alignment failures when faced with semantically similar prompts that differ in framing (e.g., jailbreaks, sycophancy, prefill attacks). Existing consistency training methods only focus on output distributions or residual stream activations, neglecting the representations of other internal Transformer components.
summary_en.importance: Expands the design space of consistency training, demonstrating that applying consistency constraints at different Transformer levels (MLP, Attention) effectively defends against various novel safety threats. The complementarity of these constraints provides a new perspective for enhancing the robustness of model alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces two novel consistency training targets: 1) MLPCT: penalizes the cosine distance between post-activation MLP hidden states (SwiGLU) across clean and perturbed prompts; 2) AttCT: penalizes the Jensen-Shannon divergence of per-head attention weight distributions. During training, the model learns via SFT to maintain internal states consistent with the clean prompt under perturbations.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four novel threat models: persona ICL attacks, prefill attacks, adversarial frustration, and conditional misalignment. Results show that MLPCT and AttCT are competitive across all threat models. Ablation studies reveal that different consistency targets exhibit varying cross-threat generalization. For instance, activation-based methods fail on adversarial frustration, while output distribution-based BCT performs well, indicating that different targets learn distinct defense mechanisms.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the implementation details of MLPCT and AttCT, and Section 4 for the definitions and experimental results of the four novel threat models. Pay attention to the analysis of differences in cross-threat generalization among various consistency targets, which offers insights into the model's internal mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“对齐信号改写哪层表示”讲得比多数安全工作更具体；先看内部表征消融，若 setup 干净，可反哺 mid-train/annealing 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is more concrete than most safety work on which layers alignment signals actually rewrite; read the internal-state ablations first and only trust it if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Don't Gamble, GAMBLe: An Analytical Framework for AI-Driven Research Systems
paper.abstract: AI-Driven Research Systems (ADRS) -- systems coupling LLMs with automated evaluation to discover algorithms, proofs, and designs -- are being optimized and adopted across domains, but the tools to analyze them have not kept pace. ADRS performance depends on component interactions that are poorly understood, expensive to explore, and (as we show) not well captured by standard convergence guarantees. These guarantees rely on structural assumptions that do not hold under the ADRS process we formali

summary.core_problem: 论文试图建立一个分析框架，解释 AI-Driven Research Systems 中生成器、评估器、发现机制与预算之间的耦合如何决定搜索行为与收敛特性。
summary.importance: 这不是传统预训练论文，但它切中一个越来越重要的问题：当 LLM 被放进自动研究闭环后，系统表现不再由单个模型能力决定，而由 generator-assessor 组合诱导出的有效优化地形决定。对理解 self-improvement、自动数据合成、RL/搜索式后训练都有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 GAMBLe 框架，用四个参数刻画 ADRS：生成器 G、评估器 A、发现机制 M、预算 B，并定义组合对象有效地形 L_eff = A ∘ G。核心观点是，不同 generator-assessor 配对会在同一问题上诱导出结构不同的优化地形，因此标准收敛保证依赖的结构假设在 ADRS 中往往不成立。论文通过大规模重复实验来观察这些系统级行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要称做了 760+ 次复现实验、超过 46,000 次迭代，覆盖从单个 LLM 到更复杂系统的多种生成器设置。重点不是单次最好成绩，而是比较不同 G/A/M/B 组合下的搜索动态与稳定性。若实验部分做得干净，这类结果对设计自动研究、自动数据生成和 verifier-based training loop 很有参考价值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 IBM Research。Paul Castro 在系统与 AI 方向有长期研究背景。该工作更接近“把 LLM+评估器闭环当作优化系统来分析”，而不是做一个新的 agent 产品原型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to build an analytical framework for understanding how the generator, assessor, discovery mechanism, and budget jointly determine the behavior and convergence properties of AI-Driven Research Systems.
summary_en.importance: This is not a standard pretraining paper, but it targets an increasingly important issue: once an LLM is embedded in an automated research loop, performance is governed not just by model capability but by the effective optimization landscape induced by the generator-assessor pair. That has methodological relevance for self-improvement, automated data synthesis, and search/RL-style post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce GAMBLe, parameterizing ADRS with four components: generator G, assessor A, discovery mechanism M, and budget B, and define the effective landscape L_eff = A ∘ G. The key claim is that different generator-assessor pairings induce structurally different optimization landscapes on the same problem, so standard convergence guarantees often rely on assumptions that fail in ADRS. The paper studies these system-level effects through large replicated experiments.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 760+ replicated runs and more than 46,000 iterations, spanning generators from single LLMs to more complex systems. The focus is not on best-case score but on search dynamics and stability under different G/A/M/B combinations. If the setup is clean, this can be useful for designing automated research loops, synthetic-data generation, and verifier-based training pipelines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from IBM Research. Paul Castro has a long track record in systems and AI. The work is better viewed as analyzing the LLM-plus-assessor loop as an optimization system rather than proposing another agent product prototype.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“LLM+verifier 闭环”为何常失灵讲成了可分析对象；先看有效地形定义和失败收敛案例。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it turns the often-handwavy 'LLM+verifier loop' into an analyzable object; start with the effective-landscape definition and the failed-convergence cases.

paper.title: When Graph Tokens Sink: A Mechanistic Analysis of Graph Language Models
paper.abstract: Graph Language Models (GLMs) have become a promising direction for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to graph learning tasks. By transforming graph topology and node information into graph tokens, GLMs allow LLMs to jointly process structured graph inputs and textual instructions. Yet, it remains unclear how LLMs internally interpret these graph tokens and whether graph tokens act as meaningful carriers of graph structure. In this work, we analyze how LLMs process graph information through g

summary.core_problem: Graph Language Models (GLMs) 通过将图拓扑和节点信息转换为图 token，让 LLM 能联合处理结构化图输入和文本指令。但一个核心的未验证假设是：非欧几里得的图结构被扁平化为序列 token 后，LLM 能否真正理解并利用这些图 token 进行拓扑推理。论文通过机制性分析回答：LLM 内部如何解释图 token？图 token 的内部显著性（激活/注意力强度）是否等价于图信息的实际利用？
summary.importance: 这是首个对 GLM 中图 token 行为进行机制性分析的工作。对预训练研究的核心启发是：当把新型模态（如图）tokenize 进 LLM 时，模态 token 可能被 Transformer 的架构动力学所劫持——成为激活/注意力 sink（用于稳定网络内部计算而非传递语义信息）。这揭示了激活显著性与语义效用之间的严重脱钩，对统一模态预训练中如何设计有效的跨模态 token 注入策略有直接警示意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文分析了两种代表性 GLM 架构：LLaGA（节点对齐的图 token 序列，使用 Neighborhood Detail 模板组织 k 跳邻居为固定形状树）和 TEA-GLM（先用 GNN 编码器聚合邻域结构到中心节点表示，再通过线性投影映射为固定数量的可学习图 token 嵌入）。定义图 sink token 为在已识别的 sink 维度上隐藏状态激活值过大的图 token。研究维度包括：(1) 激活统计分析——识别图 sink token 的出现模式和位置偏向；(2) 注意力模式分析——图 sink token 是否获得最多的 query 到图注意力；(3) 干预实验——移除或修改图 sink token 对下游性能的影响；(4) 可解释性分析——图 sink token 实际编码的是领域级信号还是拓扑结构信号。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaGA 和 TEA-GLM 两种架构（基于 LLaMA 系列 backbone）上进行系统分析。三个核心发现：(1) 图 sink token 一致地表现为稀疏激活离群点，且高度偏向图 token 序列的早期位置，但这种内部显著性并不转化为注意力主导地位；(2) 有针对性的干预实验显示，这些高显著性 token 对下游模型性能贡献很小；(3) 可解释性分析首次表明，图 sink token 主要捕获弱的领域级信号，而非预期的任务特定或拓扑感知的结构信息。具体实验数字多为定性/相对比较，未给出详细量化指标。
summary.reading_guide: skim 级别，预计 15-20 分钟。建议重点看：(1) 引言中的问题动机（Transformer 结构性问题与 GLM 核心假设的矛盾）；(2) 图 sink token 的定义和检测方法（第 2 节）；(3) 三个核心发现的实验证据（主要图表）；(4) 结论中的总结启示。跳过具体模型实现细节和过多的图表案例。

summary_en.core_problem: Graph Language Models (GLMs) convert graph topology and node information into graph tokens, enabling LLMs to jointly process structured graph inputs and textual instructions. A core unverified assumption is whether non-Euclidean graph structure, when flattened into sequential tokens, can be genuinely understood and utilized by LLMs for topological reasoning. The paper addresses this via mechanistic analysis: How do LLMs internally interpret graph tokens? And does the internal saliency (activation/attention magnitude) of graph tokens equate to actual graph information utilization?
summary_en.importance: This is the first mechanistic analysis of graph token behavior in GLMs. The key insight for pretraining research is that when tokenizing novel modalities (like graphs) into LLMs, modality tokens may be hijacked by Transformer architectural dynamics—becoming activation/attention sinks (used to stabilize the network's internal computation rather than carry semantic information). This reveals a severe decoupling between activation saliency and semantic utility, with direct implications for designing effective cross-modal token injection strategies in unified modality pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes two representative GLM architectures: LLaGA (node-aligned graph token sequence using the Neighborhood Detail template to organize k-hop neighbors as a fixed-shape tree) and TEA-GLM (first uses a GNN encoder to aggregate neighborhood structure into center-node representations, then projects into a fixed number of learnable graph token embeddings via a linear projector). Graph sink tokens are defined as graph tokens whose hidden states have excessively large activation values on pre-identified sink dimensions. The analysis covers four dimensions: (1) activation statistics—identifying emergence patterns and position bias of graph sink tokens; (2) attention patterns—whether graph sink tokens receive the most query-to-graph attention; (3) intervention experiments—how removing or modifying graph sink tokens affects downstream performance; (4) interpretability analysis—whether graph sink tokens encode domain-level signals or topological structure signals.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic analysis is conducted on LLaGA and TEA-GLM (both built on LLaMA-family backbones). Three core findings: (1) Graph sink tokens consistently emerge as sparse activation outliers, heavily biased toward early graph-token positions, yet this internal prominence does not translate into attention dominance; (2) Targeted intervention experiments show these highly salient tokens contribute surprisingly little to downstream model performance; (3) Interpretability analysis demonstrates—for the first time—that graph sink tokens predominantly capture weak, domain-level signals rather than the intended task-specific or topology-aware structural information. Results are mostly qualitative/comparative; detailed quantitative metrics are not emphasized.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level, estimated 15-20 minutes. Suggested focus: (1) motivation in the introduction (the tension between Transformer structural pathologies and GLM core assumptions); (2) definition and detection method for graph sink tokens (Section 2); (3) experimental evidence for the three core findings (key figures); (4) conclusions and implications. Skip detailed model implementation specifics and excessive case figures.

recommendation.zh: 将 Attention Sink 现象扩展到图模态的机制分析，发现高激活的图 token 并不承载核心图信息，对多模态统一表示（特别是连续 token 的行为）有一定启发，只看 Findings 部分即可。
recommendation.en: Extends the mechanistic analysis of the Attention Sink phenomenon to the graph modality, finding that highly activated graph tokens do not carry core graph information. Offers some inspiration for unified multimodal representations (especially the behavior of continuous tokens); reading the Findings section is sufficient.

paper.title: Revisiting Parameter-Based Knowledge Editing in Large Language Models: Theoretical Limits and Empirical Evidence

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论参数式知识编辑的根本局限：用局部权重修改来更新 LLM 内部知识，是否能在真实的连续更新、复杂知识和推理场景下保持模型能力。结论偏负面。作者认为，单条事实编辑看起来有效，但当知识复杂度和编辑次数上升后，局部扰动会破坏表示空间结构，并引发非目标知识和推理能力退化。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的启发不在于提出新的训练 recipe，而在于给“用编辑替代继续预训练或外部记忆”降温。它把知识更新问题放回模型表示几何和训练稳定性的框架里：预训练形成的表示空间高度各向异性，知识并不是孤立存放在少数参数中。对基座研究员来说，主要价值是两点。第一，参数式编辑很难作为大规模、长期知识维护方案，尤其不适合高频更新和复杂事件更新。第二，RAG、外部记忆、持续预训练、轻量参数增量各自有稳定性和推理开销取舍，不能只用单点事实编辑准确率来判断方案优劣。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先整理知识编辑范式：locate-then-edit 方法定位被认为承载目标知识的层或神经元后直接改权重；meta-learning 方法训练一个 editor 来预测权重更新；additional-parameter 方法用 adapter 或外部可训练模块存新知识；external-memory 方法把新知识放在文本、向量库或轻量模型中，推理时检索使用。核心理论部分基于 dimensional collapse hypothesis。作者的观点是，LLM 表示分布集中在少数高方差方向，很多低方差方向较脆弱。局部参数编辑即使范数很小，也可能沿这些低方差方向放大，改变后续层看到的表示几何。这样会造成三类后果：编辑知识附近的泛化不稳定，非相关知识被干扰，复杂推理链中的中间表示漂移。这个解释与“知识可以被精确定位到少数参数”形成对比。实验设计也围绕这个观点展开：不只看单条三元组事实，而是加入事件级知识、多 prompt-answer 组合、顺序编辑、多维评测，以及与外部知识方案比较。
summary.experiments: 实验重点是系统改变四个因素：知识复杂度、编辑数量、评测维度和 baseline 类型。评测维度包括编辑后能否回答目标知识、等价表述下的泛化、对无关知识的 locality，以及更复杂的知识应用能力，例如反向关系推断和多跳推理。论文给出的趋势是，参数式编辑在简单事实和少量编辑下容易取得较好表面结果，但随着顺序编辑次数增加，模型核心能力持续下降；复杂事件知识比单一三元组更容易触发失败；推理类评测比直接问答更能暴露退化。外部记忆或检索式方案通常带来额外推理成本，但对基座能力的破坏更小。当前提供的正文片段未包含完整结果表，因此不宜补充具体百分比；可以确认的是，作者将结论落在“稳定性—效率”取舍，而不是单一方法胜负。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对四类知识编辑方法的拆分，这部分有助于明确论文讨论边界。然后看 Section 4 的几何分析，重点关注 dimensional collapse 如何连接局部编辑、低方差方向和全局干扰。实验部分优先看顺序编辑、复杂事件知识、多跳/反向推理的表格和消融；这些结果比单次事实编辑更接近真实知识维护场景。若只关心基座训练，可以重点记录一个问题：知识更新应尽量通过数据、检索或持续训练进入模型分布，而不是依赖局部权重补丁长期累积。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether parameter-based knowledge editing can reliably maintain and update an LLM’s internal knowledge under realistic conditions: complex knowledge, sequential edits, and reasoning-heavy evaluation. Its answer is mostly negative. Local edits may work for isolated factual triples, but they become unstable when edits accumulate or when the updated knowledge must be used compositionally.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is a sharper view of knowledge maintenance. The paper argues against treating weight editing as a clean substitute for continued pretraining, retrieval, or external memory. Pretraining creates a highly anisotropic representation space; knowledge is not stored as independent slots that can be patched without side effects. This matters for continual pretraining, model refresh cycles, and the interface between parametric memory and non-parametric memory. The useful lesson is not that editing is useless, but that its evaluation should include sequential updates, locality, and reasoning preservation rather than only single-fact success.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first separates four families of editing methods: locate-then-edit methods that directly modify selected internal weights, meta-learning methods that learn an editor network, additional-parameter methods that store updates in adapters or auxiliary modules, and external-memory methods that retrieve updated knowledge at inference time. Its theoretical argument is built around a dimensional-collapse view of LLM representations. Representations occupy a narrow, anisotropic subspace, with fragile low-variance directions. A localized weight update can be small in parameter norm but still inject perturbations along these fragile directions. Downstream layers then amplify the perturbation, distorting the representation geometry and causing interference outside the intended edit. This contrasts with the common assumption that a fact can be safely localized to a small set of parameters.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study varies knowledge complexity, number of edits, evaluation dimensions, and editing baselines. It moves beyond single factual triples by including event-level knowledge represented through multiple prompt-answer pairs. It also evaluates not only reliability on the edited prompt, but paraphrase generalization, locality on unrelated knowledge, reverse-relation inference, and multi-hop reasoning. The reported pattern is consistent: parameter-based editing looks strong in simple single-edit settings, but degrades as edits become sequential and knowledge becomes more compositional. Reasoning evaluations reveal failures that direct factual QA can hide. External-memory-style methods incur inference overhead, but they are more conservative with respect to the base model’s original capabilities. The provided manuscript excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so exact percentages should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the taxonomy of editing methods in the introduction, because it clarifies what kinds of methods the critique applies to. Then read the theoretical section on dimensional collapse and representation perturbation. In the experiments, prioritize the tables on sequential editing, event-level knowledge, locality, reverse inference, and multi-hop reasoning. For a pretraining researcher, the useful question to carry forward is how knowledge refresh should be routed through data, retrieval, or continued training rather than accumulated as local weight patches.

recommendation.zh: 值得读理论假设和失效案例；若证据扎实，会降低对参数级知识修补的信任。
recommendation.en: Read the assumptions and failure cases; if the evidence is clean, it should lower confidence in parameter-level knowledge patching.

paper.title: Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents -- Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism

summary.core_problem: 在长轨迹搜索型 agent 中，随着工具调用累积大量 observation，把“过时 observation”从上下文中 mask 掉是一种极简的上下文管理策略；但它到底在什么条件下提升准确率、什么条件下反而伤害性能，以及背后的机制是什么。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“训练动态/数据效率/长上下文使用方式”有间接启发：它把一个看似工程性的 context management 变成可预测的“regime map”（不同模型容量×检索器强度×基线能力下的收益曲线），这类规律常用于反推模型在上下文利用上的瓶颈（检索噪声、注意力分配、错误证据固化）。如果你在做 agentic 数据合成、或用长轨迹工具数据做 continual pretrain/mid-train，这篇的结论能帮助决定：该不该在训练数据里显式加入 observation 丢弃/压缩策略，避免让模型学到依赖陈旧证据的坏习惯。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是系统性 sweep：跨多个 agent backbone（4B 到 284B）、三种 retriever、离线与 live-web 的搜索基准，对比“无管理”与“mask stale observations”的策略。核心产出不是一个新算法，而是经验规律与机制解释：当把“mask 带来的 accuracy gain”对“未做管理时的基线 accuracy”作图时，呈现非对称倒 U：弱 retriever 下几乎是平台期（mask 不怎么帮忙）；强 retriever + 中等容量模型时出现峰值（mask 显著提升）；当模型足够强时出现陡峭崩塌（mask 反而伤害）。论文还试图解释崩塌机制：强模型可能已经能在长上下文中做更精细的证据整合/纠错，粗暴 mask 会删掉对后续推理仍有用的“远期但关键”的证据，或破坏模型形成的内部检索链路。
summary.experiments: 你给的全文片段主要展示了一个 live-web 轨迹案例（搜索引擎把 2003 误导到 2023，agent 在 query reformulation 中振荡），用来说明长轨迹中 observation 会变“陈旧/误导”。摘要声称做了：多模型（4B–284B）、三 retriever、离线+在线基准的系统 sweep，并得到倒 U 形 regime map。但在当前片段里还看不到具体 benchmark 名称、mask 策略的精确定义（如何判定 stale、mask 粒度）、以及关键数值（提升/下降幅度）。如果全文里给了曲线与分段阈值，那部分会是主要可复用资产。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（~20–30 分钟）：
1）先找“mask stale observations”的形式化定义：stale 判定规则、mask 的位置与粒度（token/span/整段 observation）。
2）直接看 regime map 的主图：横轴基线 accuracy、纵轴 gain 的倒 U 形，以及不同 retriever/模型容量的分层。
3）再看机制分析部分：作者如何证明是“证据整合/噪声抑制”而不是别的 confound（例如上下文长度减少带来的纯粹困惑度变化）。
4）最后扫案例与失败模式：强模型崩塌区间到底删掉了什么信息。若你关心 pretrain 数据构造，重点是把这些失败模式转成训练数据的过滤/压缩策略。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon web/search agents, masking stale observations is a minimal context-management intervention. The paper asks when it helps, when it hurts, and what mechanism explains the transition across regimes.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but relevant to training dynamics and data efficiency for agentic trajectories: it turns a heuristic (drop old tool outputs) into a predictable regime map over model capacity and retriever strength. If you generate agentic data for SFT/RL or do continual/mid-training on long tool trajectories, the results inform whether to bake observation dropping/compression into the data pipeline, and when that will backfire by removing long-range evidence the model could have used.
summary_en.technical_approach: They run a systematic sweep across agent backbones (4B–284B) and three retrievers on both offline and live-web search benchmarks, comparing a baseline agent to one that masks stale observations as the trajectory grows. The main empirical pattern is an asymmetric inverted-U when plotting masking-induced accuracy gain against baseline accuracy: (i) a plateau under weak retrievers, (ii) a peak when a strong retriever is paired with a mid-capacity model, and (iii) a sharp collapse for sufficiently strong models where masking becomes harmful. The proposed mechanism is that masking primarily mitigates retrieval noise and reduces distraction for mid-capacity models, but for strong models it deletes still-relevant long-range evidence and disrupts multi-step evidence chains the model can otherwise maintain.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt includes a live-web trajectory illustrating how search bias (2003 vs 2023) can cause oscillatory query reformulations and accumulation of misleading observations. The abstract claims broad sweeps (multiple model sizes, three retrievers, offline + live-web benchmarks) and the regime-map curve, but the excerpt does not expose key experimental specifics: benchmark names, the exact stale-detection rule, masking granularity, or numeric effect sizes. In the full paper, the main reusable artifact should be the regime-map plots and the breakdown by retriever/model size.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 min):
- First locate the formal definition of “stale” and the masking operator (span vs whole observation; how staleness is detected).
- Jump to the main regime-map figure(s): inverted-U curve, stratified by retriever strength and model size.
- Read the mechanism section next: what evidence supports the noise-reduction vs evidence-deletion explanation, and what confounds are controlled.
- Finally scan failure cases in the collapse regime to understand what information gets removed and why strong models suffer. Translate those into data-pipeline rules if you train on long tool trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 别把“丢旧上下文”当万能招：这篇把收益/崩盘的分界条件讲清楚，读 regime map 和机制消融就够，用来校准长轨迹 agent 的上下文策略。
recommendation.en: Don’t treat “drop old context” as a universal fix: the regime map + mechanism ablations are the value—skim those to calibrate context/memory policies for long-horizon agents.

paper.title: What Am I Missing? Question-Answering as Hidden State Probing
paper.abstract: Test-time reasoning has become a significant field of study since the introduction of chain-of-thought reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, the mechanisms of this reasoning process are still under-explored -- from the same input prompt, and even the same partial solution, LLMs can produce varied answers if sampled multiple times. We propose to leverage question-asking as an inference-time intervention that articulates information about the model's hidden state. To achieve that, we

summary.core_problem: LLM 在推理时（test-time reasoning）即使从相同输入和部分解出发，多次采样也可能产生不同答案；推理过程的机制尚不清晰。本文研究在推理过程中引入提问（question-asking）作为推理时干预手段，探究提问能否改变模型的推理轨迹、预测轨迹正确性以及引导自我修正。
summary.importance: 对理解 LLM 推理机制和推理时干预策略有启发：(1) 隐藏状态可以预测推理轨迹的最终正确性——即使在获得教师答案之前；(2) 提问本身（在吸收答案之前）就会引起隐藏状态的语义偏移；(3) 发现检测错误轨迹和成功修正之间存在差距——学生模型未必能利用该信号评估自身轨迹，这对自修正推理的有效性提出了重要限制。
summary.technical_approach: 采用学生-教师框架（多数为自博弈，同一模型扮演双方）：学生生成推理轨迹，外部门控策略基于隐藏状态探测判断何时提问以及问什么；训练 probe 对学生提问前后的隐藏状态进行分类以预测最终正确性；引入 Jensen-Shannon 散度衡量提问引起的答案分布偏移，并定义期望准确率变化来区分有益和有害提问。
summary.experiments: 训练的 hidden-state probe 在教师答案返回之前就对轨迹最终正确性有预测能力；probe 评分与最终正确率有一定校准度，采样集合的预测正确范围与正确率的相关性超过语义多样性。消融分析发现：尽管能识别错误轨迹，但检测与修正之间存在明显差距，干预成功的概率与基线自一致性（self-consistency）强相关，学生模型未必能利用探测信号进行自我评估。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 章方法论中的 probe 设计和门控策略定义；第 4 章实验中关于检测-修正差距的分析及自一致性相关性。预计阅读时间 25-35 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 论文未在提供内容中明确列出机构和作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: In test-time reasoning, LLMs can produce different answers across multiple samples even from the same input and partial solution; the mechanisms underlying this process remain underexplored. This paper investigates introducing question-asking as a test-time intervention, examining whether asking questions can alter the model's reasoning trajectory, predict trajectory correctness, and guide self-correction.
summary_en.importance: Informs the understanding of LLM reasoning mechanisms and test-time intervention strategies: (1) Hidden states can predict the final correctness of a reasoning trajectory even before receiving the teacher's answer; (2) The act of asking a question itself (before absorbing the answer) induces a measurable semantic shift in hidden states; (3) A gap exists between detecting incorrect trajectories and successfully recovering from them — the student model does not necessarily utilize this signal for self-evaluation, posing an important limitation on the feasibility of self-correcting reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: A student-teacher framework is used (mostly self-play with the same model in both roles): the student generates a reasoning trajectory, and an external gating policy decides when and what to ask based on hidden-state probing. A probe is trained on the student's hidden states before and after asking a question to predict final correctness. Jensen-Shannon divergence measures the distributional shift in the answer space induced by questioning, and expected accuracy change is defined to distinguish helpful from harmful questions.
summary_en.experiments: The trained hidden-state probe predicts final trajectory correctness before the teacher's answer arrives. The probe's scoring is reasonably calibrated to final accuracy, and the range of predicted correctness across sampled sets correlates better with accuracy than per-set semantic diversity. Ablations reveal a clear gap between detection and recovery: intervention success strongly correlates with baseline self-consistency, and the student does not necessarily utilize the probe signal for self-assessment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 (Methodology) for probe design and gating policy definition; Chapter 4 experiments for detection-recovery gap analysis and self-consistency correlation. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not explicitly provided in the available content.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“提问前后 hidden state 已能预测成败”这个点；若实验控制干净，它会改变你对 self-ask 只是取外部信息的直觉，先读 probing 结果再决定是否信后面的策略学习。
recommendation.en: The useful bit is the claim that hidden states around question generation already predict success; if the controls are clean, it weakens the view that self-asking only helps via external information—read the probing section first.

paper.title: Measuring, Localizing, and Ablating Alignment Signatures in LLMs
paper.abstract: Aligned language models often exhibit a recognizable AI-like style, yet its connection to post-training and internal representations remains poorly understood. In this work, we study whether post-training introduces or amplifies AI-like stylistic regularities and whether these regularities have a localized internal signature. To this end, we compare human text, base-model generations, and aligned-model generations under matched human-source prefixes. Aligned generations show lower human-corpus a

summary.core_problem: 对齐后的LLM会产生可识别的AI风格文本（规范措辞、迂回表达、高度结构化），但这种风格是否由后训练引入、以及如何在模型内部表示尚不明确。本文系统测量后训练带来的输出风格偏移，并尝试在残差流中定位和消融这种对齐签名。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究有直接启发：(1)后训练不仅改变行为，还引入了可测量的风格漂移，使生成文本偏离人类语料；(2)这种风格偏移可被定位为单一残差流方向并被有效消融，提示后训练的副作用可以通过训练后干预部分修复；(3)这也暗示预训练本身（base模型）的生成风格更接近人类文本，对齐过程引入的AI风格可能不是预训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 用匹配前缀构造三元组（人类续写/base模型续写/对齐模型续写），控制领域、前缀、模型族和长度以隔离后训练效应。用两种互补探针衡量偏移：(1)infini-gram对人类参考语料的逐字亲和度；(2)AI检测器打分。提出PASTA方法（Post-training Alignment Signature Targeted Ablation）：计算对齐模型与base模型在相同输入下的残差激活差异，用检测器引导的层扫描选择方向，在解码时将该方向投影去除。
summary.experiments: 在5个领域（科学摘要、创意小说、评论、大学论文、新闻）测试。对齐模型续写比base模型续写的人类语料亲和度更低、AI检测率更高，确认后训练确实将文本推向更AI化的风格。在11个对齐模型和6个检测器上测试PASTA：大多数模型的检测器flag率显著下降，对Pangram检测器的降低超过90个百分点。效果能迁移到未用于层选择的检测器，随机方向无法复现该效果，表明提取的方向捕获了特定的后训练信号。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看：Fig.1/2的输出风格偏移证据（infini-gram和检测器得分对比），第3章PASTA方法的核心思想（非常简洁的训练后干预），Table 1的消融效果数字。附录中的模型列表和生成设置有参考价值。预计阅读时间：20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供内容中确认具体作者与机构

summary_en.core_problem: Aligned LLMs produce recognizably AI-styled text (polished phrasing, hedging, highly regular structure), but it is unclear whether this style is introduced by post-training and how it is represented internally. This paper systematically measures the output style shift from post-training and attempts to localize and ablate this alignment signature in the residual stream.
summary_en.importance: Direct implications for pretraining research: (1) Post-training not only changes behavior but also introduces measurable style drift away from human corpus; (2) This style shift can be localized as a single residual-stream direction and effectively ablated, suggesting post-training side effects are partially repairable via post-hoc intervention; (3) Base (pretrained) model generations are closer to human text style, meaning AI-like style is likely not a pretraining artifact but introduced by alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs matched triples (human continuation / base model continuation / aligned model continuation) from shared human-written prefixes, controlling for domain, prefix, model family, and length to isolate post-training effects. Measures shift with two complementary probes: (1) infini-gram verbatim affinity to a human reference corpus; (2) AI detector scores. Proposes PASTA (Post-training Alignment Signature Targeted Ablation): computes aligned-minus-base residual activation differences on same inputs, uses a detector-guided layer sweep to select a direction, and projects it out during decoding.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across 5 domains (scientific abstracts, creative fiction, opinion pieces, college essays, news). Aligned continuations show lower human-corpus affinity and higher AI-detection rates than base continuations, confirming post-training pushes text toward AI-like style. PASTA evaluated on 11 aligned models and 6 detectors: detector flagging rates drop significantly for most models, with Pangram reductions exceeding 90 percentage points for several models. Effect transfers to detectors not used for layer selection; random directions do not reproduce the effect.
summary_en.reading_guide: Light read. Focus on: Figs.1-2 for output style shift evidence (infini-gram and detector score comparisons), §3 for the core PASTA idea (simple training-free intervention), and Table 1 for ablation effect numbers. Appendix with model list and generation settings is useful reference. Estimated reading time: 20-30 min.

recommendation.zh: 看 residual contrast 和 ablation 结果；它提醒后训练不只是加能力，也会写入可被线性读出的风格偏置。
recommendation.en: Read the residual-contrast and ablation results; it shows post-training can write a linearly accessible stylistic bias, not just add capability.

paper.title: LinTree: Improving LLM Reasoning with Explicitly Structured Search Histories
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often solve reasoning problems by generating intermediate traces that explore and revise partial solutions. From a search perspective, these traces can be viewed as linearized search trees, where the model extends a partial solution, abandons it when it fails, and backtracks to try alternatives. Compared with traditional heuristic-guided search, such a policy has a potential advantage: it conditions on the whole search trace rather than only on the current local stat

summary.core_problem: LLM 在推理时生成的中间步骤（如 CoT）本质上是线性化的搜索树。相比传统启发式搜索仅依赖当前局部状态，LLM 理论上能利用整个搜索历史。本文探究：LLM 是否真正利用了这一优势？如果将搜索树的拓扑结构显式化，能否进一步提升 LLM 的搜索策略？
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 在隐式搜索（如普通 CoT）中对历史信息的利用存在瓶颈，并证明了显式结构化搜索历史能显著提升 LLM 的推理和搜索效率。这为改进 LLM 的推理数据格式和训练范式提供了直接指导。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Blocks World、Grid Navigation 和 Sokoban 三个受控推理环境中，对比了三种策略：1) 仅观察局部状态的 LLM 启发式最佳优先搜索；2) 观察完整搜索历史但树结构隐式的 LLM 推理策略；3) 观察完整搜索历史且树结构显式的 LLM 推理策略（在每步记录被扩展的边界状态）。所有模型均经过相同的 SFT 和 RL 流程训练。
summary.experiments: 实验发现，当树结构隐式时，LLM 推理策略并未稳定超越局部状态启发式基线。但当树结构显式化后，模型在解决率和搜索效率上均优于隐式模型和局部启发式基线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Introduction 中对 LLM 推理作为搜索过程的重新审视，以及 Reasoning Environments 中对三种受控环境和数据生成方式的描述。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Intermediate reasoning steps generated by LLMs (e.g., CoT) can be viewed as linearized search trees. Unlike traditional heuristic search that relies only on local states, LLMs can theoretically condition on the entire search history. This paper investigates: Do LLMs actually exploit this advantage? And can explicitly representing the search tree topology further improve LLM search policies?
summary_en.importance: Reveals a bottleneck in how LLMs utilize historical information during implicit search (like standard CoT) and demonstrates that explicitly structuring search histories significantly enhances reasoning and search efficiency. This provides direct guidance for improving reasoning data formats and training paradigms for LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Compared three policies across three controlled reasoning environments (Blocks World, Grid Navigation, Sokoban): 1) an LLM heuristic best-first search observing only local states; 2) an LLM reasoning policy observing the full history but with implicit tree structure; 3) an LLM reasoning policy observing the full history with explicit tree structure (recording the expanded frontier state at each step). All models were trained with the same SFT and RL pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: Found that with implicit tree structures, the LLM reasoning policy does not reliably outperform the local-state heuristic baseline. However, when the tree structure is made explicit, the model surpasses both the implicit model and the local heuristic baseline in solve rate and search efficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the reframing of LLM reasoning as a search process, and the Reasoning Environments section for the description of the three controlled environments and data generation. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 会修正对 trace conditioning 的直觉：历史不是免费搜索能力，优先看受控环境对比和 LinTree 消融。
recommendation.en: This usefully weakens the prior that trace conditioning gives search ability for free; read the controlled comparisons and LinTree ablations first.

paper.title: Fixed Universal Transformers
paper.abstract: We introduce \emph{universal transformers}: fixed transformers that can simulate any transformer in a given class via a suitable input embedding. Analogous to a universal Turing machine, the input embedding encodes a description of the target model while all internal parameters remain fixed. We provide explicit sparse constructions achieving universality when the embedding dimension is sufficiently large, and further show that universality is generic: randomly initialized transformers are univer

summary.core_problem: 研究固定参数的 transformer 是否仅靠输入嵌入就能模拟一类目标 transformer，从而澄清表达能力究竟更多来自权重还是输入表示。
summary.importance: 这是偏理论的表达能力与机制分析工作。对做基座预训练的人，价值不在直接改 recipe，而在于修正对“权重承载能力 vs 表示承载能力”的直觉，属于原理分析。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义 fixed universal transformers：内部参数固定不变，只通过输入 embedding 编码目标模型描述，即可模拟给定类中的任意 transformer。论文先给出显式稀疏构造，要求足够大的 embedding 维度；再证明 universality 是 generic 的，随机初始化 transformer 几乎处处都具有这种性质。最后在括号匹配和多跳推理等算法任务上做经验验证。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在 algorithmic tasks，如 parenthesis balancing 和 multi-hop reasoning，用来验证理论构造与随机模型的 universality 现象。没有大规模语言建模、预训练语料或标准 LLM benchmark，因此更适合作为理论备查，而非工程动作指南。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Alexandr Andoni、Daniel Hsu，均在理论机器学习与算法方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether a transformer with fixed internal weights can simulate any transformer in a target class purely through input embeddings, clarifying how much expressive power comes from weights versus representations.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory-leaning expressivity and mechanism paper. Its value for foundation-model researchers is not an immediate recipe change, but a possible shift in intuition about where model capacity effectively resides.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define fixed universal transformers: all internal parameters are frozen, while the input embedding encodes a description of the target model to be simulated. They provide explicit sparse constructions under sufficiently large embedding dimension, then show universality is generic in the sense that randomly initialized transformers are almost surely universal. They also validate the theory on algorithmic tasks such as parenthesis balancing and multi-hop reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on algorithmic tasks to support the theoretical claims about universality. There is no large-scale language modeling, pretraining corpus, or standard LLM benchmark, so this is better treated as a conceptual reference than an engineering guide.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Alexandr Andoni and Daniel Hsu, both well known for work in theoretical machine learning and algorithms.

recommendation.zh: 偏理论，但值得知道：它在挑战“能力主要写在权重里”的直觉；读引言和定理陈述即可，别期待直接落到 LLM recipe。
recommendation.en: Theory-heavy but worth knowing: it challenges the intuition that capability mainly lives in weights; read the intro and theorem statements, not as a direct LLM recipe.

paper.title: Domain Adaptation and Reasoning Frameworks in Language Models: A Controlled Experiment with Historical Cosmology
paper.abstract: We investigate how domain adaptation reshapes explanatory behavior in language models using historical cosmology as a controlled setting. In Phase 1, we train a small language model from scratch on a pre-Copernican corpus from which explicit heliocentric references were removed, and evaluate whether Earth-motion or heliocentric continuations nevertheless emerge. In Phase 2, we fine-tune a larger pretrained model using QLoRA on the same corpus in order to study how adaptation modifies explanatory

summary.core_problem: 用历史宇宙论作为受控场景，研究领域适配如何改变语言模型的解释框架和世界观式输出。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个小规模机制分析实验：通过删除显式 heliocentric references 的 pre-Copernican corpus，观察模型是否仍会产生地动或日心相关延续，并比较从零训练与 QLoRA 微调的行为差异。
summary.technical_approach: Phase 1 从零训练小语言模型，训练语料为去除了显式日心引用的前哥白尼文本；Phase 2 用同一语料对较大 pretrained model 做 QLoRA fine-tuning。输出由 LLM-as-judge 标注 cosmological stance 和 explanatory frame。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、语料 token 数和 judge 校准细节。结果称小模型偶尔生成局部 Earth-motion continuations，但整体不稳定，不能支撑一致的宇宙论推理；QLoRA 微调会显著改变较大模型的解释 framing 和 cosmological stance。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses historical cosmology as a controlled setting to study how domain adaptation changes a language model’s explanatory framing and stance-like outputs.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a small mechanistic analysis experiment. By removing explicit heliocentric references from a pre-Copernican corpus, it tests whether models still produce Earth-motion or heliocentric continuations, and contrasts training from scratch with QLoRA adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Phase 1 trains small language models from scratch on the edited pre-Copernican corpus. Phase 2 fine-tunes a larger pretrained model on the same corpus with QLoRA. Outputs are labeled by an LLM-as-judge for cosmological stance and explanatory frame.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, token count, or judge calibration details. It reports that small models occasionally produce local Earth-motion continuations but fail to form stable global cosmological reasoning, while QLoRA adaptation significantly shifts the larger model’s framing and stance.

recommendation.zh: 有趣但很窄；作为 domain adaptation 改写解释框架的案例看摘要即可，LLM judge 让结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Interesting but narrow; treat it as a domain-adaptation case study, with the LLM-judge setup making the conclusions weak evidence.

paper.title: The Sword, Shield, and Achilles' Heel: Characterizing the Linguistic Inductive Bias of Large Language Models for Spatial Reasoning in Navigation Planning
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based navigation systems commonly construct explicit spatial representations (e.g., topological graphs, semantic raster maps) and translate them into textual descriptions as LLMs' inputs. However, the linguistic structures of such text-based spatial representations and the choices of contextual features (e.g., topology, geometry) they contain are often treated as neutral engineering decisions rather than key factors that shape LLMs' behavior. To fill the gap, we propos

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 在导航规划中如何受文本化空间表示的语言结构和上下文特征影响。
summary.importance: 这是机制与评测分析工作，贡献在于把导航系统中常被视为工程细节的空间表示文本格式，转化为可干预变量。它对理解 LLM 的空间推理弱点、prompt 表示选择和工具到文本接口有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出双重干预框架：表示干预改变语言格式和语言压缩程度；上下文干预改变拓扑、几何等空间线索组合，并设计特征冲突 probing，以区分 LLM 依赖哪类上下文 cue。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型列表、地图规模、任务数量或具体指标。主要结论是：文本空间表示的语言结构并非中性选择，会支持或抑制导航规划；不同上下文特征及其冲突会影响 LLM 的规划行为。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 East China Normal University、Information Engineering University 和 Zhengzhou University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes how LLM navigation planning is shaped by the linguistic structure of textual spatial representations and by the contextual cues they contain.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and evaluation-analysis paper. Its contribution is treating the text serialization of spatial maps, often considered an engineering detail, as an intervention variable. It is relevant to LLM spatial reasoning, prompt representation, and tool-to-text interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a dual-interventional framework. Representation intervention varies linguistic format and compression. Context intervention varies combinations of topology, geometry, and other cues, with conflict probing to identify which cues LLMs prefer under disagreement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list, map scale, task count, or exact metrics. The reported conclusion is that linguistic structures of spatial representations are not neutral and can help or inhibit navigation planning; contextual cue combinations and conflicts change model behavior.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from East China Normal University, Information Engineering University, and Zhengzhou University.

recommendation.zh: 适合看 intervention 设计；结论主要约束 prompt-to-map 表达，不足以反推预训练空间能力。
recommendation.en: Worth checking for the intervention design; the conclusions constrain prompt-to-map serialization more than they reveal pretraining-level spatial ability.

paper.title: VLA-Trace: Diagnosing Vision-Language-Action Models through Representation and Behavior Tracing
paper.abstract: Understanding how Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models transform multimodal knowledge into embodied control remains an open challenge. We present VLA-Trace, a progressive diagnostic framework that analyzes VLA models through a unified evidence chain from representation dynamics to causal control attribution and behavioral manifestation. It specifically combines cross-modal and checkpoint-drift centered kernel alignment (CKA) to trace representation evolution, attention knockout interventions to i

summary.core_problem: VLA-Trace 解决的是 VLA 模型可诊断性问题：机器人策略微调后，原有视觉-语言表征如何被改写，哪些模态路径真正参与动作解码，以及行为层面的视觉 grounding 是否等价于语义指令跟随。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练研究的直接关联不强，但对 multimodal LM 到 action policy 的适配很有参考价值。它提供了一个较完整的证据链：先看表征几何是否保留，再用干预验证这些表征是否被动作头使用，最后看 rollout 行为是否真的服从语言语义。对研究 VLM/VLA 继续训练中的模态遗忘、表征漂移、语言控制退化有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三层诊断组成。第一层用 cross-modal CKA 和 checkpoint-drift CKA 比较 C0 预训练 VLM、C1 预训练 VLA、C2 任务微调 VLA 的层级表征，分别观察 vision pooled、text pooled、joint pooled 子空间的对齐和漂移。第二层做 attention knockout，按视觉路径和文本路径定向屏蔽注意力，判断动作解码是否依赖某个模态通路。第三层结合 attention localization、visual masking 和 input editing，在 rollout 层面检查模型是否看向操作相关区域、是否依赖视觉捷径、是否能响应细粒度语言修改。这个设计的重点不是提出新策略模型，而是把表征相似性、因果干预和行为探针串成一条可验证链条。
summary.experiments: 实验主要比较 π0.5 和 OpenVLA，并使用 COCO 作为通用图文参考域、LIBERO 作为机器人操作域。结果显示，π0.5 的跨模态融合在层间更不稳定，微调过程中更明显地把文本表征重组为任务条件控制特征；OpenVLA 的中间层图文对齐更平滑但往往较弱，同时更保留 text-pooled 表征，主要改写 vision-pooled 和 joint-pooled 子空间。attention knockout 显示，π0.5 的动作解码更集中依赖 visual-to-action 路径，语言路径功能较弱；OpenVLA 的控制信息更分散地来自视觉和文本。行为探针显示，两类策略都能定位到操作相关区域，但对细粒度语义编辑反应不足，说明视觉轨迹模仿强于组合式语言控制。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Representation Analysis Framework，重点看 C0/C1/C2 的定义、CKA 的三种 pooled view、attention knockout 的设计，以及 rollout probe 如何区分 spatial grounding 和 semantic following。若只关心 LLM/VLM 继续训练，可重点读表征漂移和 knockout 结果，预计 25–35 分钟。附录中的模型与 benchmark 设置值得快速检查，避免把 π0.5 和 OpenVLA 的差异误读为单一架构结论。

summary_en.core_problem: VLA-Trace studies how vision-language-action models transform pretrained multimodal representations into action policies, and whether apparent visual grounding actually implies language-conditioned control.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not central to text-only LLM pretraining, but it is useful for researchers working on multimodal continuation training. Its main value is diagnostic: it connects representation drift, causal pathway usage, and rollout behavior.
