paper.title: Differences in Text Generated by Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are promising alternatives to autoregressive language models (ARMs), yet the intrinsic differences in their generated text remain underexplored. We first find empirically that off-the-shelf DLMs exhibit lower $n$-gram entropy, higher semantic coherence, and higher semantic diversity. To understand the cause, we conduct controlled experiments that decouple the effects of training objectives and decoding algorithms. Results suggest that the DLM training objective c

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“DLM 能不能和 AR 打平”，而是更细的一层：在相近训练预算下，diffusion language model 生成出来的文本，到底在哪些统计性质上系统性不同，这些差异来自训练目标还是解码过程。作者把问题拆成三个层次：token 级的 n-gram entropy、句子级的 semantic coherence、文档级的 semantic diversity。进一步，他们用受控实验把 DLM 的几个关键成分拆开，想弄清楚究竟是双向上下文、masking 机制、loss weighting，还是 remasking decoding 在驱动这些差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要有两点。第一，它把“新型 LM 范式的行为差异”从 benchmark 分数拉回到生成分布层面，这对判断 DLM 是否只是另一种训练技巧，还是在建模偏好上与 AR 真有不同，很关键。第二，它给出一个比较清楚的归因：语义一致性和语义多样性的提升，主要来自双向上下文的训练目标；而 entropy 的下降并不是 DLM 目标天然导致的，更多是 confidence-based remasking 解码带来的。这一点很重要，因为它把‘模型学到了什么’和‘解码器把分布压成什么样’区分开了。对后续做 diffusion LM、masked/any-order LM、甚至 AR+non-AR 混合范式的人，这个结论直接影响训练目标设计和采样策略设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分两部分。第一部分是对现成模型做行为测量。作者收集了 20 个 off-the-shelf DLM 和 ARM，在统一生成设置下比较三类指标：n-gram entropy 作为 token-level 随机性的代理；semantic coherence 衡量相邻句子或局部语义连贯性；semantic diversity 衡量整篇文档层面的语义覆盖和变化。结论是，现成 DLM 通常表现为更低 entropy、更高 coherence、更高 diversity。

第二部分是归因实验。作者没有停留在相关性，而是构造了共享解码设置下的目标函数对比，并做 objective interpolation，把 DLM 与 ARM 之间的差异逐步拆开。DLM 目标包含几个成分：从 noised input 做 mask prediction、使用双向上下文、输入 masking、label masking、以及按噪声水平加权的 weighting function。实验显示，真正起主要作用的是 bidirectional context；其他成分如 input masking、label masking、1/t 一类 weighting，对 coherence 和 diversity 的边际影响都小得多。

第三部分是 decoding 分析。作者聚焦 block-wise iterative decoding，并比较四种 remasking：low-confidence、dynamic low-confidence、high-entropy、random。关键发现是 entropy 的下降主要出现在 confidence-based remasking 下。直觉上，这类策略会优先保留模型最有把握的位置，把不确定位置反复重采样，等价于持续做一种偏向高置信 token 的截断式搜索，因此会把最终样本分布压窄。相反，random 或 high-entropy remasking 不会明显降低整体 entropy，生成文本的 entropy 大致维持在 AR 水平。文中还给了理论解释，说明 remasking 规则如何改变最终采样分布，而不是仅仅改变收敛速度。
summary.experiments:
关键实验分三组。第一组是 20 个现成模型的总体比较，结论稳定：DLM 相比 ARM，n-gram entropy 更低，但 semantic coherence 和 semantic diversity 更高。这里作者强调 entropy 用 n-gram proxy 近似 full entropy，因此更适合做相对比较，不宜过度解读为精确的信息论量。

第二组是训练目标受控实验。在共享 decoding setup 下，作者把 DLM 目标逐步改造成更接近 ARM，或反过来插值，观察三项指标如何变化。结果显示：只要保留 bidirectional context，coherence 和 diversity 的提升大体还在；去掉双向条件后，这两个优势明显减弱。masking 细节和 weighting function 的影响相对次要。这说明 DLM 与 AR 在语义层面的差异，不是“扩散”这个名字本身带来的，而是来自训练时是否允许模型同时看左右文。

第三组是 decoding 消融。作者比较 low-confidence、dynamic low-confidence、high-entropy、random remasking。结论最明确的是：confidence-based remasking 会显著拉低 entropy，并使 DLM 的 entropy 低于 ARM；而其他 remasking 策略下，DLM 的 entropy 基本不变，接近 ARM。也就是说，很多人观察到的“DLM 文本更保守、更低熵”，很大一部分是解码器选择造成的，不应直接归因到训练目标。

从论文给出的信息看，这篇工作的重点不是刷新某个 benchmark，而是把行为差异做成可复现实验事实，并给出较干净的因果拆分。这类实验设计比单纯报分更有参考价值。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看三处。第一，看引言和结果总览，确认作者到底比较的是哪三类文本属性，以及为什么把 entropy、coherence、diversity 分别对应到 token / sentence / document 三个层次。第二，看第 4 节的 objective-controlled experiments，这部分是全文最有信息量的地方，尤其是 objective interpolation 和对 bidirectional context 的归因。第三，看第 5 节 decoding analysis，重点关注不同 remasking strategy 对 entropy 的影响，以及理论解释如何把经验现象说清楚。

如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、训练目标拆解相关图表、以及 remasking 消融表。预计 25 到 40 分钟可以抓住主结论。若你在做 diffusion LM 或 any-order LM，值得多花时间看作者如何控制“同一解码器下比较训练目标”与“同一目标下比较解码器”，这套实验框架可以直接借用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than whether diffusion LMs are competitive with autoregressive LMs: what intrinsic properties of generated text differ systematically between the two, and which part of the pipeline causes the difference. The analysis is organized at three levels: token-level n-gram entropy, sentence-level semantic coherence, and document-level semantic diversity. The central goal is causal disentanglement: are the observed differences due to the DLM training objective itself, or due to iterative decoding and remasking heuristics?
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is in separating modeling effects from decoding effects. Many recent discussions around diffusion LMs mix together objective design, bidirectional conditioning, and non-AR decoding. This paper shows that the gains in semantic coherence and semantic diversity are largely tied to the bidirectional training signal, while the commonly observed entropy reduction is mostly a decoding artifact from confidence-based remasking. That is a useful correction. It means one should not attribute all behavioral differences to the diffusion objective per se. For researchers working on diffusion LM, masked/any-order LM, or hybrid AR/non-AR paradigms, this directly informs both objective design and sampler design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has three layers of analysis. First, it evaluates 20 off-the-shelf DLMs and ARMs under a common generation setup using three metrics: n-gram entropy as a proxy for token-level randomness, semantic coherence for local sentence-level consistency, and semantic diversity for document-level variation. The empirical pattern is consistent: DLM outputs tend to have lower entropy, higher coherence, and higher diversity.

Second, it runs controlled objective studies. Instead of only comparing end-to-end systems, the authors align decoding and vary the training objective. They interpolate between ARM-like and DLM-like objectives and isolate components such as bidirectional context, input masking, label masking, and noise-level weighting. The main finding is that bidirectional context is the dominant driver of the coherence and diversity gains. Other ingredients of the DLM objective contribute much less.

Third, it studies decoding. The focus is block-wise iterative decoding with four remasking strategies: low-confidence, dynamic low-confidence, high-entropy, and random remasking. The key result is that entropy reduction is strongly tied to confidence-based remasking. Intuitively, these strategies repeatedly preserve high-confidence positions and revisit uncertain ones, which narrows the effective sample distribution. In contrast, random or high-entropy remasking leaves entropy roughly unchanged and close to the ARM level. The paper also provides a theoretical account of why remasking changes the resulting distribution rather than merely affecting decoding efficiency.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main experimental blocks. First, the large-scale comparison over 20 released models establishes the descriptive pattern: DLMs usually generate text with lower n-gram entropy but higher semantic coherence and semantic diversity than ARMs. The authors are careful to treat n-gram entropy as a proxy rather than a full entropy estimate.

Second, the controlled objective experiments are the most informative part. Under a shared decoding setup, the authors gradually move between DLM-style and ARM-style training formulations. The results show that keeping bidirectional context preserves most of the gains in coherence and diversity, while removing it substantially weakens them. By contrast, input masking details, label masking, and weighting functions have much smaller marginal effects.

Third, the decoding ablations compare low-confidence, dynamic low-confidence, high-entropy, and random remasking. Confidence-based remasking noticeably lowers entropy and pushes DLM outputs below ARM entropy. Other remasking strategies do not produce the same drop; entropy stays approximately at the ARM level. This is the paper's clearest causal claim: the low-entropy behavior often associated with DLMs is largely induced by the decoder.

The contribution is not a benchmark win but a careful behavioral decomposition with reasonably clean controls, which is more useful than another headline score comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the metric definitions to understand why the authors chose entropy, coherence, and diversity as token-, sentence-, and document-level descriptors. Second, spend most of the time on the objective-controlled experiments in Section 4, especially the interpolation analysis and the evidence that bidirectional context is the main source of the semantic gains. Third, read the decoding analysis in Section 5, paying attention to how different remasking strategies affect entropy and how the theoretical explanation supports the empirical trend.

If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, the objective ablation figures, and the remasking comparison tables. Around 25 to 40 minutes should be enough to extract the main claims. If you work on diffusion LM or any-order LM, the experimental methodology itself is worth studying because it cleanly separates objective effects from decoding effects.

recommendation.zh: 这篇最有价值的是把 DLM 的“目标优势”和“解码副作用”拆开了；先看 controlled setup 和 remasking 结论，能直接修正你对 diffusion LM 的 prior。
recommendation.en: Its real value is separating objective-level gains from decoding artifacts in DLMs; read the controlled setup and remasking result first, as it directly updates your prior on diffusion LMs.

institutions: Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences, Tsinghua University

paper.title: Steering Without Breaking: Mechanistically Informed Interventions for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising all positions in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive models. Controlled generation methods for DLMs, imported from autoregressive models, apply uniform intervention at every denoising steps. We show this uniform schedule degrades quality, and the damage compounds when multiple attributes are steered jointly. To diagnose the failure, we train sparse autoencoders on four DLMs (124M-8B parameters) and f

summary.core_problem: 现有离散扩散语言模型（DLM）的可控生成方法直接迁移自自回归模型，在所有去噪步施加统一干预，会导致生成质量下降、多样性坍缩，多属性联合控制时交叉干扰问题被进一步放大；核心根源是当前对DLM去噪过程中语义属性的形成时序规律缺乏机制层面的认知。
summary.importance: 填补了DLM语义属性去噪动态的机制研究空白，为非自回归语言模型的可控生成提供了可解释的理论支撑，提出的自适应干预框架可以在几乎不损失生成质量的前提下实现多属性精确控制，对DLM落地、以及离散扩散建模范式替代自回归的研究有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 首先用稀疏自编码器（SAE）对4种不同架构、不同训练目标、参数量覆盖124M到8B（60倍规模范围）的DLM（MDLM、SEDD、DREAM、LLaDA）的残差流激活做稀疏可解释特征分解，归纳出语义属性形成的三个核心特性：1）不同属性的固化时间不同，比如主题在去噪前2%步骤就完成固化，情感则需要20%的步骤逐步形成；2）固化锐度不同，有的属性集中在窄窗口形成，有的沿整个去噪轨迹均匀形成；3）特征效应量不对称，不同属性的单特征区分强度存在差异。基于上述特性推导出自适应干预调度策略：将干预集中在对应属性正在形成的时间窗口，其余步骤不施加干扰，形式化为带预算的优化问题，最优调度与每步的增益成本比成正比；多属性控制时通过不相交的SAE特征集实现干预，利用解码器Gram结构约束交叉干扰，同时通过效应量校准平衡不同属性的强度，避免弱属性被淹没。
summary.experiments: 在4种DLM、7种单/多属性控制场景、4种基线方法上做验证：自适应干预的控制效果匹配或超过基线，同时困惑度和多样性接近未干预模型。对固化锐度高的模型（如MDLM），自适应干预和统一干预控制效果相当，困惑度从59-93降到50-57；对固化锐度低的模型（如LLaDA），两种方法效果收敛。同时控制情感、主题、正式度3种属性时，该方法在可用文本质量下几何平均分类置信度达到93%，比最强基线高15个百分点。
summary.reading_guide: 精读§3属性动态机制分析部分的图2-4，理解不同属性的固化时序差异；精读§4定理1和命题1的推导，掌握自适应调度的理论依据；重点看§5图5-7的多属性控制消融实验，验证不同调度策略的质量-控制效果权衡。可深挖的点包括SAE在DLM不同层的适配方法、自适应调度规则向更多模态离散扩散模型的迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing controlled generation methods for discrete diffusion language models (DLMs) are directly migrated from autoregressive models, applying uniform intervention across all denoising steps. This leads to degraded generation quality, collapsed diversity, and amplified cross-attribute interference during multi-attribute joint control. The core root cause is the lack of mechanistic understanding of the temporal formation rules of semantic attributes during DLM denoising.
summary_en.importance: This work fills the research gap in mechanistic analysis of semantic attribute denoising dynamics for DLMs, and provides interpretable theoretical support for controllable generation of non-autoregressive language models. The proposed adaptive intervention framework achieves precise multi-attribute control with negligible generation quality loss, and offers direct reference for DLM deployment and research on replacing autoregressive paradigms with discrete diffusion modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are used to decompose residual stream activations of 4 DLMs (MDLM, SEDD, DREAM, LLaDA) with different architectures, training objectives, and parameter scales ranging from 124M to 8B (60x scale range) into sparse interpretable features. Three core properties of semantic attribute formation are summarized: 1) Different attributes have distinct commitment timings: topic is committed within the first 2% of denoising steps, while sentiment forms gradually over 20% of the process; 2) Commitment sharpness varies: some attributes form in a narrow time window, while others form uniformly across the entire denoising trajectory; 3) Effect-size asymmetry: the per-feature discriminative strength varies across attributes. Based on these properties, an adaptive intervention scheduling strategy is derived: intervention is concentrated in the time window when the target attribute is actively forming, with no disturbance applied in other steps. This is formalized as a budget-constrained optimization problem, where the optimal schedule is proportional to the gain-cost ratio of each step. For multi-attribute control, intervention is implemented via disjoint SAE feature sets, cross-attribute interference is bounded by the decoder Gram structure, and effect-size calibration is applied to balance the strength of different attributes to avoid weak attributes being overwhelmed.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 4 DLMs, 7 single/multi-attribute control scenarios, and 4 baseline methods: adaptive intervention matches or exceeds the control effect of baselines, while keeping perplexity and diversity close to the unsteered model. For models with high commitment sharpness (e.g., MDLM), adaptive intervention achieves comparable control effect to uniform intervention, with perplexity reduced from 59-93 to 50-57. For models with low commitment sharpness (e.g., LLaDA), the performance of the two methods converges. When controlling 3 attributes (sentiment, topic, formality) simultaneously, the method achieves 93% geometric mean classifier confidence under usable text quality, 15 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline.
summary_en.reading_guide: Intensively read Figures 2-4 in §3 (mechanistic analysis of attribute dynamics) to understand the difference in commitment timings across attributes. Read the derivation of Theorem 1 and Proposition 1 in §4 to master the theoretical basis of adaptive scheduling. Focus on the ablation experiments of multi-attribute control in Figures 5-7 of §5 to verify the quality-control effect tradeoff of different scheduling strategies. Potential directions for further exploration include SAE adaptation methods for different layers of DLMs, and migration of adaptive scheduling rules to discrete diffusion models for more modalities.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看 SAE 分析和调度消融；它把 DLM 控制从“每步同等干预”改成了可测的属性形成窗口。
recommendation.en: Read the SAE analysis and scheduler ablations; it turns DLM steering from uniform per-step intervention into measurable attribute-formation windows.

paper.title: Three Regimes of Context-Parametric Conflict: A Predictive Framework and Empirical Validation
paper.abstract: The literature on how large language models handle conflict between their training knowledge and a contradicting document presents a persistent empirical contradiction: some studies find models stubbornly retain their trained answers, ignoring provided documents nearly half the time, while others find models readily defer to the document, following context approximately 96% of the time. We argue these contradictions dissolve once one recognises that prior experiments have studied three qualitati

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么大模型在训练知识与上下文文档冲突时，有些实验显示模型坚持参数记忆，有些实验显示模型几乎总是服从上下文。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和实验框架整理。它把知识冲突拆成三个处理情境，试图把已有文献中看似矛盾的结果归因到不同实验设置，而不是简单归结为模型是否“信上下文”。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 three-regime framework：单源更新由证据一致性主导，竞争性整合由参数确定性主导，任务适配选择由任务对知识来源的要求主导。同时区分 parametric strength，即暴露频率，和 parametric uniqueness，即编码一致性，用于解释同样频率的知识为什么可能表现出不同的上下文服从行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了经验验证，并对训练知识与冲突文档的处理进行了预测性建模；但给定信息未披露模型规模、数据集、基线、具体提升幅度或统计显著性。由于作者为独立研究者且摘要未显示大规模控制实验，结论应先按机制假说阅读。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses why LLMs sometimes cling to parametric knowledge under conflicting context, while other studies report near-complete deference to the provided document.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an analysis framework for knowledge-conflict behavior. It argues that prior contradictory findings come from mixing qualitatively different processing regimes rather than from a single context-versus-memory tendency.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a three-regime framework: single-source updating governed by evidence coherence, competitive integration governed by parametric certainty, and task-appropriate selection governed by the task’s knowledge requirement. It also separates parametric strength, or exposure frequency, from parametric uniqueness, or encoding consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims empirical validation of the predictive framework, but the provided information does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, effect sizes, or significance tests. The result should be read as a mechanism hypothesis until the experimental setup is inspected.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为知识冲突实验的 taxonomy 备查；先看 regime 定义，别把结论当成稳健 scaling 规律。
recommendation.en: Useful as a taxonomy for knowledge-conflict setups; read the regime definitions, but do not treat the claims as a robust scaling law yet.

paper.title: The Text Uncanny Valley: Non-Monotonic Performance Degradation in LLM Information Retrieval
paper.abstract: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) benchmarks primarily focus on syntactically correct inputs, leaving a significant gap in evaluation on imperfect text. In this work, we study how word-boundary corruption affects how LLMs detect targeted information. By inserting whitespace characters within words to break them into fragments, LLMs' detection accuracy follows a U-shaped curve with the increase in insertion rate. We refer to this curve as the Text Uncanny Valley. To explain such observation, we

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在不完美文本上的信息检索能力，尤其是词边界被破坏时为何会出现非单调退化，而不是平滑变差。
summary.importance: 这是机制与鲁棒性分析工作，贡献在于提出并实证支持一种非单调失效现象——Text Uncanny Valley。它直接触及 tokenizer、子词边界、字符级回退和输入分布错配，对预训练研究员有实质启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者通过在词内部插入空格、把单词切碎，系统测量目标信息检测准确率随扰动强度变化的曲线，发现 U 形退化。为解释该现象，提出 mode transition hypothesis：模型在近正常文本上主要处于 word-level mode，在高度碎片化文本上转入 character-level mode，而中间区域两种模式都不稳定，形成性能谷底。随后用四组实验和一组分析验证这一解释，包括 ICL 失效、扰动正则化可缓解 U 形、以及在数学推理任务上的复现。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但涉及多种 LLM，并点名 Gemini 3.0 Flash 在数学推理上也复现 U 形。核心 baseline 是不同扰动率下的检测/推理表现，以及加入 regularization 或 ICL 后的对比。贡献重点不在追求更高分，而在揭示非单调行为与模式切换解释。
summary.authors_note: University of Chicago、Northwestern University。Ari Holtzman 长期做语言生成与评测，Chenhao Tan 在语言与社会计算、NLP 分析方面有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper investigates why LLM information retrieval on imperfect text degrades non-monotonically, rather than smoothly, when word boundaries are corrupted.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/robustness paper with direct implications for tokenization, subword boundaries, character fallback behavior, and distribution mismatch. The key contribution is the identification and explanation of a non-monotonic failure regime dubbed the Text Uncanny Valley.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors progressively insert whitespace inside words to fragment them and measure target-information detection accuracy as corruption increases, revealing a U-shaped curve. They propose a mode-transition hypothesis: models operate in a word-level mode on near-normal text, a character-level mode on heavily fragmented text, and fail in the intermediate transition regime where neither mode works well. They support this with four experiments and one analysis, including failed rescue by in-context learning, mitigation via perturbation regularization, and replication on a math reasoning task.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but it evaluates multiple LLMs and explicitly notes that Gemini 3.0 Flash shows the same U-shape on math reasoning. Baselines are performance across corruption rates, with and without regularization or ICL. The emphasis is on diagnosing non-monotonic behavior rather than chasing benchmark gains.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Chicago and Northwestern University. Ari Holtzman is well known for work on language generation and evaluation; Chenhao Tan is known for analytical NLP research.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 tokenizer 鲁棒性的直觉：错误输入不是越坏越差，而是存在 mode-switch 谷底；先看主曲线和解释实验，值得进内部 robustness checklist。
recommendation.en: This should update your intuition about tokenizer robustness: corrupted text is not monotonically worse, and there is a mode-switch valley; read the main curve and the explanatory experiments, then add it to your internal robustness checklist.

paper.title: Rethinking Dense Sequential Chains: Reasoning Language Models Can Extract Answers from Sparse, Order-Shuffling Chain-of-Thoughts
paper.abstract: Modern reasoning language models generate dense, sequential chain-of-thought traces implicitly assuming that every token contributes and that steps must be consumed in order. We challenge both assumptions through a systematic intervention pipeline--removal, masking, shuffling, and noise injection--applied to model-generated reasoning chains across three models and three benchmarks. Our findings are counterintuitive on three dimensions. Order: Does the sequential order of a reasoning chain matter

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文检验一个具体问题：推理模型在根据 CoT 提取最终答案时，是否真的依赖完整、严格有序的推理链。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发点在于，CoT 的“生成过程”和“答案提取过程”可能不是同一种计算。实验显示，答案提取对行级顺序很不敏感，对自然语言解释也不敏感，更多依赖数字、符号和局部关系结构。这支持一种判断：transformer 在长推理链上的部分能力可能来自预训练中形成的集合式检索和约束匹配能力，而不完全来自指令微调后的逐步证明格式。它也给非自回归推理、稀疏 reasoning trace、并行生成中间步骤提供了实验动机。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把推理过程拆成两段：先由模型生成 CoT，再让模型基于这个 trace 提取答案。论文只干预第二段输入，而不重新求解问题。干预包括删除字符或问题文本、mask 字母文本或数字、mask 答案出现位置、打乱 token/word/line/line 内 word 顺序，以及注入错误答案句子。这样的设计可以区分模型到底依赖自然语言叙述、顺序结构、数字内容，还是显式答案字符串。一个重要对照是 pretrained-only 与 instruction-tuned 版本在顺序打乱上的表现接近，说明这种容错性并不主要来自 reasoning fine-tuning。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 GPT-OSS-120B、DeepSeek-V3.1-671B、OLMo-3.1-32B，任务包括 AIME 2025、CodeElo、GPQA-Diamond。主要数字很清楚：行级随机打乱在不同模型和任务上带来的准确率下降小于 0.5 个百分点；词级打乱在 AIME 2025 上仍保留 62%–89% 准确率；token 级打乱会接近崩掉，说明词级语义单位是较低的可用粒度。在数学推理链中，删除所有字母字符只损失 1.3 个百分点；mask 字母文本反而提升 4.7 个百分点；去掉自然语言并随机打乱行顺序后仍有 83% 准确率。错误答案句子按真实答案 3 倍频率注入时，准确率从 91.3% 到 91.3%，没有变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看实验设置中“生成 CoT”和“答案提取”的分离方式，以及 transformation pipeline 的定义。结果表里优先看 shuffling、alphabetic masking、false-answer injection 三组，因为它们分别对应顺序、语言冗余和鲁棒性。需要注意边界：这些结论主要说明 extraction 阶段的性质，不能直接推出 CoT 生成阶段也可以无序或稀疏。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a reasoning model actually needs a complete and sequential chain-of-thought when it extracts the final answer from an already generated trace.
summary_en.importance: The main implication is that CoT generation and answer extraction may rely on different computations. The extraction stage appears sparse, tolerant to line-order permutation, and far less dependent on natural-language prose than standard prompting practice assumes. For pretraining research, this points to a transformer inductive bias closer to selective retrieval over symbolic constraints than to strict proof consumption. It also motivates work on sparse reasoning traces, parallel generation of intermediate states, and non-autoregressive reasoning interfaces. The paper is empirical rather than a new training method, so its value is mostly in mechanism and design guidance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors separate the pipeline into two stages: a model first generates a reasoning trace, and the answer is then extracted from that trace. They intervene only on the trace used for extraction, rather than asking the model to solve the problem again. The interventions include removal of alphabetic characters or question text, masking alphabetic text, digits, or answer occurrences, shuffling at token, word, line, and within-line levels, and injecting false-answer sentences. This design isolates what information the extractor uses: prose, order, numeric content, explicit answer strings, or local relational structure. A notable control compares pretrained-only and instruction-tuned variants, which show similar tolerance to line- and word-level shuffling.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses GPT-OSS-120B, DeepSeek-V3.1-671B, and OLMo-3.1-32B on AIME 2025, CodeElo, and GPQA-Diamond. Line-level shuffling reduces accuracy by less than 0.5 percentage points across models and domains. Word-level shuffling still retains 62%–89% accuracy on AIME 2025, while token-level shuffling collapses performance to near zero, suggesting that word-level semantic identity is close to the minimum useful granularity. In mathematical traces, removing all alphabetic characters costs only 1.3 points, and masking alphabetic text improves accuracy by 4.7 points. A trace stripped of natural language and shuffled into arbitrary line order still reaches 83% accuracy. Injecting false-answer sentences at three times the true-answer frequency leaves accuracy unchanged, from 91.3% to 91.3%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the experimental protocol that separates trace generation from answer extraction, then read the transformation definitions. The most informative result blocks are line and word shuffling, alphabetic masking, and false-answer injection. The main caveat is important: the evidence concerns the extraction stage. It does not by itself prove that the trace generation stage can be unordered or sparse without additional training or architectural changes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动摇“CoT 必须按序读”的 prior；先看干预设计和 line/word/token 三档结果，若 setup 干净，latent reasoning 与 any-order supervision 都该重想。
recommendation.en: This paper directly weakens the prior that CoT must be consumed sequentially; read the intervention design and the line/word/token ablations first—if the setup is clean, it changes how you think about latent reasoning and any-order supervision.

paper.title: Mean Mode Screaming: Mean--Variance Split Residuals for 1000-Layer Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Scaling Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) to hundreds of layers introduces a structural vulnerability: networks can enter a silent, mean-dominated collapse state that homogenizes token representations and suppresses centered variation. Through mechanistic auditing, we isolate the trigger event of this collapse as Mean Mode Screaming (MMS). MMS can occur even when training appears stable, with a mean-coherent backward shock on residual writers that opens deep residual branches and drives the network

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究超深 Diffusion Transformer 在数百到上千层深度下的一类失效：训练表面上没有 NaN、没有明显前向饱和，loss 却会在少数 step 内回到接近初始化水平，并进入 token 表示高度同质化的 mean-dominated collapse。作者把进入该状态的突发事件称为 Mean Mode Screaming，即残差 writer 上出现 mean-coherent 梯度冲击，残差分支快速打开，随后 Q/K 梯度被压制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在训练动态和深层残差参数化。它不是简单地把 DiT 做深，而是指出 token 维度上的均值子空间和中心化子空间有不同的几何行为。常见的 ReZero、LayerScale 会把整个残差分支一起缩小，能稳住训练，但也会压低承载空间变化信息的 centered signal。MV-Split 的价值在于把“抑制均值漂移”和“保留中心化表达学习”拆开处理。这类分析对超深 Transformer、长序列多模态预训练、diffusion/flow 模型的稳定训练都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 模型采用刻意简化的单流 DiT：VAE 图像 token 与文本 embedding token 拼接成统一序列，用 self-attention 处理多模态交互；主干是 Post-Norm 残差链，形式为 RMSNorm(X_l + f_l(X_l))；去掉 AdaLN、cross-attention 等额外调制通道，便于定位深层残差传播问题。训练目标是 Rectified Flow，沿数据 latent 与高斯噪声之间的线性路径预测向量场。机制分析先把 token 表示分解为 sequence mean 与 centered variation。row-stochastic attention 会严格保持 pure-mean 状态，而 centered component 由另一个混合算子传播，在深层中可能收缩。反向传播中，残差 writer 的梯度可以精确分成 mean-coherent 与 centered 两部分；当 token 趋于对齐时，mean-coherent 部分会以序列长度 O(T) 的方式相干累积，成为打开残差分支的主要驱动力。值向量同质化后，Softmax Jacobian 的零空间会压制 attention-logit 梯度，使 Q/K 学习变弱，模型被锁在 collapse 状态。MV-Split Residuals 的设计是：centered residual update 使用独立 gain；trunk mean 使用带泄漏的均值替换。这样均值路径被约束，但 centered 路径不被同等比例削弱，区别于 LayerScale/ReZero 的各向同性 residual gating。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 400 层匹配设置做主要量化比较，并额外给出 1000 层训练作为边界规模验证。标准零初始化 residual writers 的诊断 run 会在若干 step 后发生 MMS：mean-coherent 梯度先出现冲击，随后残差 writer 快速打开，token 表示进入均值主导状态，Q/K 梯度下降。标准初始化不能避免该状态，只是表现为从训练早期开始、随深度推进的 progressive collapse，而不是零 writer 设置下的延迟突发事件。400 层对比中，MV-Split 移除了 collapse events，并且比 LayerScale 收敛更快。1000 层 run 中，同一设计保持可训练，说明该参数化在极深 DiT 上仍能维持信号传播。具体数值表格需要结合正文实验章节和附录读取，摘要片段只给出了定性结论和 400/1000 层规模信息。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。优先看 Failure Dynamics 与 Mechanism 两部分，重点关注 token-space mean/centered decomposition、mean-coherent 梯度如何相干累积、Softmax Jacobian 零空间如何压制 Q/K 梯度。方法部分重点看 MV-Split Residuals 的公式，判断它到底是在 residual path、mean path 还是 norm 位置做约束。实验部分看 400 层 LayerScale 对比和 1000 层验证 run；附录 B 值得扫读，因为它说明标准初始化也会进入同类 collapse，只是触发形态不同。若关心预训练稳定性，可以把这项工作和 DeepNet、ReZero、LayerScale、μP、Post-Norm/Pre-Norm 稳定化放在一起比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies a failure mode of very deep Diffusion Transformers: training can look numerically stable for many steps, then the loss returns close to its initialization level within a few updates. The model enters a mean-dominated collapse where token representations become homogenized and centered token variation is suppressed. The authors call the abrupt entry event Mean Mode Screaming: a mean-coherent gradient shock on residual writers, rapid residual-branch opening, and subsequent suppression of Q/K gradients.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in training dynamics and residual parameterization for ultra-deep generative Transformers. The paper separates the token-mean subspace from the centered subspace and shows that they behave differently under attention and backpropagation. Standard stabilizers such as ReZero and LayerScale damp the whole residual branch, which improves stability but also slows learning of spatially varying features. MV-Split instead damps the mean path while preserving the centered path. This is relevant for deep DiTs, long-sequence multimodal pretraining, and flow/diffusion models where residual propagation is the main carrier of signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use a deliberately minimal single-stream DiT to make the failure easier to attribute. VAE image tokens and text embedding tokens are concatenated into one sequence, and self-attention handles all multimodal interaction. The backbone is a Post-Norm residual chain, RMSNorm(X_l + f_l(X_l)), without AdaLN, cross-attention, or other depthwise control channels. Training uses a Rectified Flow objective between VAE latents and Gaussian noise. The analysis decomposes token states into a sequence-mean component and a centered component. Row-stochastic attention exactly preserves pure-mean states, while the centered component is propagated by a separate mixing operator that can become contractive at depth. On the backward pass, gradients to residual writers split exactly into mean-coherent and centered parts. As tokens align, the mean-coherent part can accumulate coherently with sequence length, entering an O(T) regime. Once values homogenize, attention-logit gradients are suppressed through the null space of the Softmax Jacobian, weakening Q/K learning and locking the network into collapse. MV-Split Residuals address this by applying a separate gain to the centered residual update and a leaky replacement on the trunk mean, rather than shrinking both components with the same scalar gate.
summary_en.experiments: The main quantitative comparison uses matched 400-layer settings, with an additional 1000-layer run as a scale validation. In zero-writer runs, the failure appears as a delayed MMS event: a spike in the mean-coherent gradient component, rapid residual-writer opening, forward collapse into a mean-dominated state, and Q/K gradient suppression. Standard initialization does not remove the regime; it changes the failure into a depth-progressive collapse that appears from the start. In the 400-layer evaluation, MV-Split removes collapse events and converges faster than LayerScale. The 1000-layer run remains trainable with the same design. The provided text gives the main depth scales and qualitative outcomes; exact curves and numerical tables should be read from the experiment section and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 30 to 45 minutes. Focus first on the failure-dynamics and mechanism sections: the mean/centered token decomposition, the coherent accumulation of mean gradients, and the Softmax-Jacobian explanation for Q/K gradient suppression. Then read the MV-Split Residuals formulation carefully to see where the mean path and centered path are controlled. For experiments, inspect the 400-layer comparison against LayerScale and the 1000-layer scale-validation run. Appendix B is useful because it shows that standard initialization changes the trigger pattern but not the underlying collapse state.

recommendation.zh: 深度Transformer训练坍塌的机制分析很有价值，MMS现象和梯度分解对LLM的深层训练稳定性研究有类比意义，重点看§3机制分析和§4梯度分解
recommendation.en: Valuable mechanistic analysis of training collapse in deep transformers; the MMS phenomenon and gradient decomposition have analogs for LLM training stability; focus on §3 and §4

paper.title: LLMs are not (consistently) Bayesian: Quantifying internal (in)consistencies of LLMs' probabilistic beliefs
paper.abstract: Modern AI systems are being deployed in complex domains such as medicine, science, and law, where it is important that they not only produce correct answers, but also represent and update uncertain beliefs about the world as new evidence arrives. We introduce the novel technique of studying LLMs as information processing rules and utilize the information processing gap to study the internal (in)consistencies of how LLMs update their probabilistic beliefs from evidence. Our extensive experiments

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“LLM答对了多少题”，而是更细的一层：当模型先有一个先验判断，再看到新证据时，它到底是按什么规则更新信念的。作者关心的是，LLM给出的 prior、likelihood 和更新后的 belief 之间是否自洽，是否接近 Bayes 更新。难点在于，很多已有做法需要一个外部贝叶斯 oracle 或显式统计模型，但真实任务里往往没有。文章提出 information processing gap，把 LLM 视作一个从(先验、证据似然)到后验信念的“信息处理规则”，直接衡量这个规则离最优贝叶斯更新有多远，并进一步分解偏差来自哪里。这个问题和预训练的关系不在于下游准确率，而在于语言模型内部是否学到了稳定、可组合的概率更新机制；这会影响我们如何理解模型的 uncertainty、evidence integration，以及为何某些 prompting 方式会改变推理行为。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值主要有三点。第一，它给了一个不依赖外部真值后验的诊断量，可以用来分析模型内部的信念更新质量，而不是只看最终答题分数。这类诊断对研究训练目标是否真的塑造了“概率一致性”很有用。第二，文章区分了两种常见使用方式：逐步显式更新的 belief propagation 模式，与一次性吸收全部证据的 batch 模式。结果显示二者不是简单等价：BP 更接近贝叶斯，但 batch 往往任务表现更好。这说明当前 LLM 可能并没有学到统一的、上下文无关的更新算子，而是在不同 prompting 结构下调用了不同启发式。第三，作者发现“强行按 Bayes 公式算”并不稳定地提升下游表现，甚至模型自己的非贝叶斯启发式有时更接近强模型给出的 oracle likelihood。这对预训练研究是个提醒：next-token 训练学到的可能是面向任务分布的压缩启发式，而不是显式概率推断程序。若未来想做 uncertainty-aware pretraining、Bayesian LM 或 reasoning-time belief tracking，这篇文章提供了一个较干净的分析框架。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是定义 information processing gap Δ(q)。设模型在看到旧证据 X1:n 后给出 prior π(θ|X1:n)，对新证据 Xn+1 给出 likelihood ℓ(Xn+1|θ,X1:n)，再直接给出更新后的 post-data belief q(θ|X1:n+1)。如果用 π 和 ℓ 按 Bayes 定理显式计算，可得到一个 posterior p。作者利用信息论结果，把“输入信息”和“输出信息”写成相对于 q 的期望对数项，并证明 Δ(q)=0 当且仅当 q 就是由 π 和 ℓ 通过 Bayes 更新得到的 p；若 Δ(q)>0，则说明 prior、likelihood、post-data belief 三者之间存在不一致。这个量的好处是，不要求 π、ℓ、q 来自同一个真实生成模型，也不要求知道真实后验，因此适合直接对 LLM elicitation 做分析。

实验设计上，作者把多选问答任务改写成 sequential evidence setting：模型先对候选答案给先验分布，再随着证据逐步揭示更新信念。关键比较有三类。其一是 BP 模式：每一步都显式让模型输出 prior、likelihood、posterior。其二是 batch 模式：把多条证据一起给模型，让它直接整合。其三是“显式 Bayes”模式：要求模型按公式组合自己报出的 prior 和 likelihood。作者还把 Δ(q) 分解为更可解释的部分，用来区分是 likelihood 估计有问题，还是最终 belief 没有忠实执行自己声称的 likelihood。文章的一个重要观察是，LLM 在“报告自己认为证据有多大信息量”和“真正把这些信息落实到更新后的分布”之间经常存在系统性落差。

和已有“LLM 是否 Bayesian”的工作相比，这篇文章的区别不在于构造一个标准答案后看误差，而在于把模型自身输出的概率对象放进一个闭环里检查一致性。也因此，它更像是在测模型内部概率语义是否稳定，而不是测它会不会做一道贝叶斯计算题。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果看，最重要的结论有四个。第一，BP 模式下模型的 information processing gap 普遍更小，也就是更接近贝叶斯更新；但 batch 模式的最终任务表现通常更好。这说明“更一致”不等于“更有用”，模型在 batch 场景里可能调用了更强的任务启发式。第二，要求模型显式按 Bayes 公式更新，并没有稳定优于直接让模型给出 belief update；有些设置下甚至更差。原因不是公式错，而是模型给出的 likelihood 本身未必是它真正用于决策的内部统计量。第三，当模型的 post-data belief 与它自己报出的 likelihood 不一致时，post-data belief 往往反而更接近由更强 LLM 提供的 oracle likelihood 所诱导的更新结果。也就是说，模型口头上报的 likelihood 可能较弱，但最终答案使用了更复杂的隐式启发式。第四，batch-mode 的 information processing gap 与 BP 模式下的任务性能存在较强 Spearman 相关，这给了一个实用诊断：如果某个任务上 batch gap 很大，就不宜太相信该模型在逐步证据整合场景中的概率更新。

从任务形式看，实验集中在多项选择 QA 的 sequential evidence 版本，重点不是 benchmark 刷分，而是比较不同 elicitation 方式下的概率一致性。文中更有价值的是图表里不同模式的相对排序、gap 分解和相关性分析，而不是单个绝对数字。若是从预训练视角阅读，建议把注意力放在“同一模型、同一任务、不同提示结构导致更新规则改变”这一现象上。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：先看引言和“Measuring information processing capabilities”部分，把 Δ(q) 的定义、为何 Δ=0 等价于贝叶斯更新、以及它不依赖外部 oracle 这三点读明白。然后直接看实验总表和比较 BP / batch / explicit Bayes 的主结果图，抓住文章最重要的反直觉结论：更贝叶斯不一定带来更高任务表现。接着看 gap decomposition 和与 oracle likelihood 对比的分析，这部分最能说明模型“说的概率”和“用的概率”不是一回事。最后再回看方法细节，理解作者如何从 LLM 中稳定 elicitation prior、likelihood 和 posterior。

如果时间有限，30-40 分钟足够抓住主线。若想深挖，重点想两个问题：一是这种不一致到底来自 next-token 训练目标，还是来自概率 elicitation 本身；二是如果把这种 gap 当作训练期或 mid-training 的辅助约束，是否能改善 uncertainty calibration 而不损失任务性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether an LLM gets the final answer right: when the model has an initial belief, then receives new evidence, what update rule is it actually using? The target is the internal consistency among three elicited objects from the same model: a prior over hypotheses, a likelihood for the new evidence, and an updated belief after seeing that evidence. Existing “are LLMs Bayesian?” work often compares against an external oracle or a fully specified statistical model. This paper instead studies whether the model is self-consistent as an information processor, even when no gold posterior is available. That matters for uncertainty-aware use of LLMs, because a model can sound probabilistic while still failing to combine evidence in a coherent way.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the contribution is less about benchmark gains and more about diagnostics. First, it introduces a way to probe whether a language model has learned a stable belief-update mechanism, rather than only measuring answer accuracy. Second, it shows that prompting format changes the update rule: stepwise belief propagation is more Bayesian, while batch evidence integration often performs better downstream. That is a useful clue that current LMs may not implement a single context-invariant probabilistic operator; instead they may switch between explicit probability reporting and task-tuned heuristics. Third, the paper shows that forcing explicit Bayes-rule computation does not reliably improve task performance. This is a meaningful result for anyone thinking about Bayesian prompting, uncertainty calibration, or training objectives that aim to make LMs more probabilistically coherent.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central object is the information processing gap, Δ(q). For a hypothesis variable θ and evidence sequence X1:n, the model is prompted to produce: (1) a prior π(θ|X1:n), (2) a likelihood for the next evidence item, ℓ(Xn+1|θ,X1:n), and (3) a post-data belief q(θ|X1:n+1). From π and ℓ one can also construct the Bayes posterior p. The authors define input and output information as expectations of log-probability terms under q, and use an information-theoretic optimality result to show that Δ(q)=0 if and only if q equals the Bayes posterior induced by π and ℓ. Positive gap means the model’s stated prior, stated likelihood, and stated updated belief are not mutually consistent.

This setup is attractive because it does not require π, ℓ, and q to come from a true joint distribution, and it does not require access to a gold posterior. It only asks whether the model is internally coherent given its own probabilistic claims. The experiments instantiate this on sequential multiple-choice QA, where evidence is revealed piece by piece. The paper compares at least three elicitation regimes: belief propagation mode, where the model explicitly updates after each evidence step; batch mode, where multiple pieces of evidence are integrated together; and explicit-Bayes mode, where the model is asked to combine its own prior and likelihood according to Bayes’ rule. The analysis also decomposes the gap into interpretable components, helping separate errors in the model’s stated likelihood from failures to faithfully use that likelihood in the final update.

Relative to prior work, the novelty is not another benchmark for Bayesian reasoning. It is a self-consistency framework for probabilistic belief updating inside the model’s own reported semantics.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical findings are qualitative but important. First, belief propagation mode is consistently closer to Bayesian updating, in the sense of lower information processing gap, than batch mode. Second, despite being less Bayesian, batch mode often yields better downstream task performance. This is the paper’s key tension: probabilistic consistency and task utility are not aligned. Third, explicitly forcing Bayes-rule computation does not consistently improve performance over the model’s direct update behavior. That suggests the elicited likelihood is often not the same object the model implicitly uses when making its final judgment. Fourth, when the model’s updated belief disagrees with the posterior implied by its own likelihood, the updated belief is often better aligned with an oracle likelihood from a stronger LLM. In other words, the model’s explicit probability report can be weaker than the heuristic actually driving its answer.

Another useful result is the strong Spearman correlation between batch-mode information processing gap and belief-propagation task performance. That gives a practical diagnostic: if the batch-mode gap is large, one should be cautious about trusting the model’s sequential evidence integration behavior. The experiments are built around sequentialized multiple-choice QA rather than large-scale pretraining ablations, so the value is in the pattern of comparisons, the decomposition plots, and the mismatch analyses, not in any single headline score.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the section defining the information processing gap. The key thing to understand is why Δ(q)=0 characterizes exact Bayesian updating and why this does not require an external oracle posterior. Then jump to the main experimental comparisons between belief propagation, batch integration, and explicit-Bayes prompting. Those figures carry the paper’s main message. After that, read the decomposition analysis and the oracle-likelihood comparison; they are the most informative parts if you care about the difference between what the model says its probabilities are and what it actually seems to use.

For a skim, 30 to 40 minutes is enough. If reading more carefully, the two questions worth keeping in mind are: whether the inconsistency is mainly a property of next-token pretraining or of probability elicitation, and whether a gap like this could become a training-time auxiliary objective for improving uncertainty handling without hurting task performance.

recommendation.zh: 建议看指标定义和非 Bayesian 胜出那组实验；若 setup 干净，它会削弱“LLM 内部近似 Bayesian world model”的朴素 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the metric and the cases where non-Bayesian updates win; if the setup is clean, it weakens the naive Bayesian-world-model prior.

paper.title: Understanding Performance Collapse in Layer-Pruned Large Language Models via Decision Representation Transitions
paper.abstract: Layer pruning efficiently reduces Large Language Model (LLM) computational costs but often triggers sudden performance collapse. Existing representation-based analyses struggle to explain this mechanism. We propose studying pruning through decision representation. Focusing on multiple-choice tasks, we introduce two metrics, Decision Margin and Option Frequency, and an Iterative Pruning method to analyze layer-wise decision dynamics. Our findings reveal a sharp decision transition that partitions

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想解释 layer pruning 中常见的“性能断崖”：为什么隐藏表示和原模型仍然相似，最终选择题准确率却会突然崩掉。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型压缩的启发在于，它提醒我们不要只用 representation similarity 判断模型能力是否保留。作者发现，CKA 这类表示相似性指标在高剪枝率下仍可能很高，但决策行为已经失败。更有用的分析对象是“正确答案何时在层间出现”。这对理解 transformer 层深的功能分工、剪枝安全边界、logit-lens 诊断都有参考价值，但它主要是机制分析和压缩诊断，不是新的预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把层剪枝问题转成决策形成过程的分析。作者用 logit lens 将中间层 hidden states 经过最终 RMSNorm 或 LayerNorm 对齐后投到词表空间，再在多选题选项上计算 Decision Margin，即正确选项相对最强错误选项的优势。DM 为负表示模型还没有形成正确决策，DM 转正表示正确选项开始占优。作者还引入 Option Frequency，统计每一层预测各个选项的频率，用来观察模型是否陷入固定选项偏置。基于这两个指标，模型层被划分为 Silent Phase 和 Decisive Phase：前者 DM 多为负，预测分布容易塌到单一选项；后者 DM 转正，选项分布更平衡。为了避免一次性剪掉多层带来的混杂，作者使用 Iterative Pruning，逐层贪心移除，对决策转折点如何移动进行追踪。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaMA3-8B、LLaMA2-7B、Qwen3-4B 等模型，并集中在多选题场景。一个关键观察是，即使 50% 剪枝时任务性能已经完全崩掉，CKA 仍显示剪枝模型和原模型在多数层保持较高语义对齐。另一个结果是，逐层剪枝通常先移除 Decisive Phase 中的层，因为这些后段层存在较强结构冗余；此时性能相对稳定。一旦剪枝进入 Silent Phase，尤其是在后段冗余层已经被移除之后，模型深度不足以让 DM 完成由负到正的转折，转折点被推到网络末端之外，性能随即崩塌。消融的核心信息是：剪掉“已经形成决策之后”的层影响较小，破坏“形成决策之前的支架层”影响很大。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 CKA 与性能冲突的图、DM/OF 的定义，以及 Iterative Pruning 轨迹图。最值得关注的是 transition point 的定义和它在剪枝过程中的移动方式。若做模型压缩，可以细看 pruning 策略部分；若做机制分析，可以关注 logit-lens 前加入最终归一化层这一处理，因为它会影响中间层 logit 的可比性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why layer-pruned LLMs often show a sharp performance collapse even when their hidden representations remain close to those of the dense model.
summary_en.importance: The main value is diagnostic. It argues that representation similarity is not a reliable proxy for preserved task competence under pruning. CKA can remain high after aggressive pruning, while the model has already lost its ability to select the correct answer. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is the layerwise emergence of decisions: depth is not only storing semantic features, but also providing the computation needed for a decision transition. This is relevant to pruning, depth scaling, logit-lens analysis, and layer functional studies, though it is not a new pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze pruning from a decision-centered view. They project intermediate hidden states to the vocabulary space with a logit-lens setup, applying the model’s final normalization layer before the LM head so that logits across depths are more comparable. They define Decision Margin as the gap between the correct option and the strongest competing option on multiple-choice tasks. A negative margin means the correct option has not emerged; a positive margin means it has become the leading choice. They also define Option Frequency to track whether intermediate predictions collapse to a dominant option. These metrics split the network into a Silent Phase, where the model has not yet formed the correct decision, and a Decisive Phase, where the correct answer becomes stable. Iterative Pruning is then used as an analytical probe: layers are removed greedily one at a time, and the movement or disappearance of the transition point is tracked.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include LLaMA3-8B, LLaMA2-7B, and Qwen3-4B on multiple-choice tasks. A central result is that at a 50% pruning rate, task performance can fully collapse while CKA still indicates high semantic alignment with the dense model across most layers. The pruning trajectory is also consistent across models: greedy pruning first removes layers in the Decisive Phase, where there is substantial redundancy and performance remains stable. Collapse happens when pruning reaches the Silent Phase. At that point, especially after later layers have already been removed, the remaining network no longer has enough depth to complete the negative-to-positive Decision Margin transition. The transition point is effectively pushed beyond the final layer.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the figures contrasting CKA with task performance, the definitions of Decision Margin and Option Frequency, and the plots showing the pruning trajectory. The most useful part is the transition-point analysis: it gives a more actionable failure signal than hidden-state similarity. Readers working on compression should inspect the iterative pruning procedure; readers working on interpretability should check the normalization choice before logit-lens projection.

recommendation.zh: 结论有点反直觉：真正脆弱的不是“出答案”的后段，而是前面看似沉默的层；先看指标定义和 phase 划分，若成立，会改变你做 layer drop 的 prior。
recommendation.en: The interesting twist is that the fragile part is not the late 'answering' stage but the seemingly silent early layers; read the metric definitions and phase split first—if it holds, it changes how you think about layer dropping.

paper.title: When Does a Language Model Commit? A Finite-Answer Theory of Pre-Verbalization Commitment
paper.abstract: Language models often generate reasoning before giving a final answer, but the visible answer does not reveal when the model's answer preference became stable. We study this question through a narrow computable object: \emph{finite-answer preference stabilization}. For a model state and specified answer verbalizers, we project the model's own continuation probabilities onto a finite answer set; in binary tasks this yields an exact log-odds code, $δ(ξ)=S_θ(\mathrm{yes}\midξ)-S_θ(\mathrm{no}\midξ)

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型最后答了什么”，而是“模型在什么时候已经把答案定下来了”。作者把这个问题收缩到一个可精确计算的对象：给定有限答案集合和对应 verbalizers，在每个生成前缀状态上，直接用模型自己的 continuation probability 投影出一个有限答案分布，并据此定义 commitment time、answer onset 和 lead。这样做是在避开两类常见但不够干净的替代方案：一类是看 greedy rollout，它只能看到已经生成出来的轨迹，容易把生成顺序和内部偏好顺序混在一起；另一类是 hidden-state probe，它能测到“可线性读出的信息”，但不能直接定义模型此刻真正偏好的答案。论文关心的核心问题因此很明确：在答案尚未可解析地写出来之前，模型对有限答案的偏好是否已经稳定，以及这种稳定偏好在表征空间里如何存在。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的训练目标，而在于给“中间推理是否忠实”“latent reasoning 是否先于 verbalization”“hidden state 里到底存了什么”这些长期争议提供了一个可计算、可复现实验框架。它的贡献更像测量学而不是建模学：先把 target 定义清楚，再讨论 probe 是否能恢复这个 target。这个顺序很重要，因为很多关于 reasoning trace 的讨论都卡在 target 不清。对基座研究员来说，这个框架有三点启发。第一，它把“答案形成”从 token-level 事件改成 state-level distributional event，更接近训练时模型真正优化的对象。第二，它说明 hidden state 中可线性恢复的信号，未必对应一个跨 prompt、跨 verbalizer 不变的几何坐标，这对 interpretability 和 representation analysis 都是约束。第三，它给 post-train 阶段常见的 CoT、delayed answer、self-rationalization 提供了更细的分析工具：如果正 lead 普遍存在，那么可见 reasoning 的一部分可能发生在答案已定之后，这会影响对 rationale faithfulness 的判断。量级上，这不是会立刻改写预训练配方的工作，但在机制分析和训练信号解释上是扎实的一步。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的关键是把“commitment”定义成模型自身条件分布上的一个有限答案投影，而不是外加分类器。设冻结的 decoder-only LM 处于状态 ξ，对每个候选答案 a 预先给定 verbalizer 集合 Σ(a)，作者计算完整 verbalizer continuation 的 autoregressive log-probability，并在 verbalizer 层面做边缘化，得到答案级别分数。二分类时，这个对象可以压成一个精确的 log-odds code δ(ξ)=Sθ(yes|ξ)-Sθ(no|ξ)。后续所有时间定义都建立在这个 δt 上：answer onset 是输出流中第一次能被 parser 唯一判定答案的位置；commitment time 是 onset 之前最早一个时刻，此时有限答案分布的赢家已经与最终答案一致，margin 足够大，并且之后不再 flip；lead 则是 onset 与 commitment 之间的 token 距离。这里有几个设计点值得注意。第一，作者坚持用完整 continuation 的总 log-probability，而不是长度归一化分数，因为他们要测的是模型分给有限答案 continuation 的概率质量；若做 length normalization，测量对象就变了。第二，任务被刻意设计成 delayed-verdict 模板，让答案出现时间和模板推进解耦，便于精确测 onset，也便于 exact scoring。第三，probe 只在 target 已经定义之后才出现。作者用 compact hidden-state summary 去线性回归或分类恢复 δ，而不是让 probe 反过来定义 commitment。第四，论文还尝试把 commitment 与 realization progress 分离成低维因子，并用控制实验、transfer、bootstrap、多随机种子来验证这种分离不是模板伪影。第五，作者加入了 quality-gated 模板、在线校准规则和 activation steering，分别检验结论对模板洁净度、在线可预测性和局部因果干预的敏感性。整体上，这是一套先定义可计算 target，再做表征恢复和因果扰动的分析链条。
summary.experiments: 实验主体放在受控 delayed-verdict 任务上，模型是 Qwen3-4B-Instruct。论文的主结果不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是几类稳定现象。第一，正 lead 普遍存在：在答案尚未被 parser 读出前，有限答案投影已经稳定到最终答案，且这种现象在 prompt、verbalizer、task family 变化下仍能看到。第二，精确 commitment code δ 可以从紧凑 hidden-state summary 中线性恢复，说明相关信息不是深埋在复杂非线性子空间里，而是相当可读。第三，跨条件迁移并不支持“一个零样本通用线性坐标”这一更强说法：在一种 prompt 或 verbalizer 上学到的线性读出器，迁到另一种条件时会退化，说明信息可线性访问，但几何对齐依赖分布条件。第四，parser-clean 模板会保留正 lead，但 lead 变短，说明一部分长 lead 可能来自模板冗余或表面格式，而不是纯粹的深层 deliberation。第五，在线校准规则能在 held-out trajectory 上提前预测最终答案，但它和 retrospective commitment 定义并不等价，说明“可在线预测”与“事后定义的稳定承诺”是两个不同对象。第六，exact activation steering 可以局部推动 δ 的变化，却不能稳定翻转最终生成答案，这个结果很关键：它提示 commitment code 虽然可读、也可局部扰动，但未必是单一充分因果变量。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，提供的全文片段也未列出所有表格数值，因此不适合编造具体 lead 长度、AUC 或 transfer drop；阅读时应直接看实验章节和附录中的定量表。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合按“定义—测量—恢复—干预”四步读。先读 Introduction 和 Finite-Answer Commitment，把 target 定义吃透，尤其是为什么要用 finite-answer projection、为什么用完整 continuation 概率而不是长度归一化。然后看定义 onset、commitment time、lead 的章节，确认 retrospective 条件和 margin 条件是怎么设的。实验部分先抓主图：δt 随生成位置的轨迹、lead 分布、不同 prompt/verbalizer/task family 下的稳定性。接着看 probe 章节，重点不是 probe 精度本身，而是“同条件可线性恢复、跨条件不形成单一不变坐标”这个更细的结论。再看 commitment 与 realization progress 的低维分解和控制实验，判断作者是否真的把“答案已定”和“模板还在继续写”分开了。最后看 quality-gated、online rule、activation steering 三组诊断，它们决定这篇工作的边界：作者没有声称测到了 unrestricted belief，也没有证明所有 CoT 都不忠实。预计泛读 30–45 分钟能抓住主线；若做机制分析或 latent reasoning 相关研究，建议连附录一起精读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and cleaner question than “what answer did the model finally produce?” It asks when the model had already settled on that answer. The authors formalize this as finite-answer preference stabilization: given a finite answer set and answer verbalizers, they project the model’s own continuation distribution at each prefix state onto that answer set, then define commitment time, answer onset, and lead from that projected distribution. This avoids two common but unsatisfactory proxies. Greedy rollouts only observe the realized trajectory and conflate generation order with preference formation. Hidden-state probes can reveal accessible information, but they do not define the model’s current answer preference. The core problem is therefore whether answer preference stabilizes before any answer token becomes externally parseable, and how that state-level preference is represented.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is not a new objective or architecture, but a cleaner measurement framework for questions around rationale faithfulness, latent reasoning, and internal answer formation. The contribution is mainly methodological: define the target first, then test whether probes can recover it. That ordering matters. A large fraction of the reasoning-faithfulness literature is ambiguous because the target itself is underspecified. For foundation-model researchers, the paper offers three useful lessons. First, answer formation is better treated as a state-level distributional event than a token-level visible event, which is closer to what language modeling actually optimizes. Second, linearly recoverable information in hidden states does not imply a single invariant linear coordinate across prompts or verbalizers; that is a meaningful constraint for representation analysis and interpretability. Third, if positive lead is common, then part of visible reasoning may happen after the answer preference has already stabilized, which affects how we interpret CoT traces produced during post-training. This is not a paper that changes the pretraining recipe tomorrow, but it is a solid step in measurement and mechanism analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key move is to define commitment directly from the model’s conditional distribution rather than from an auxiliary classifier. For a frozen decoder-only LM at state ξ, each candidate answer a is associated with a set of verbalizers Σ(a). The model scores full verbalizer continuations with autoregressive log-probability, marginalizes over verbalizers, and obtains answer-level scores. In the binary case, this collapses to an exact log-odds code, δ(ξ)=Sθ(yes|ξ)-Sθ(no|ξ). All temporal notions are then defined from δt. Answer onset is the first output position where a parser can uniquely determine the answer. Commitment time is the earliest pre-onset position where the induced winner matches the eventual answer with sufficient margin and never flips afterward. Lead is the token distance between commitment and onset. Several design choices are important. First, they use total continuation log-probability rather than length-normalized scores because the object of interest is probability mass assigned to finite answer continuations; length normalization would define a different target. Second, they deliberately use delayed-verdict templates so that answer visibility is separated from template progress, making onset detection reliable and exact scoring feasible. Third, probes are introduced only after the target is defined. Compact hidden-state summaries are used to linearly recover δ, not to define commitment. Fourth, the paper attempts to separate commitment from realization progress via low-dimensional factors, and validates that separation with controls, transfer tests, bootstrap analyses, and multi-seed evaluation. Fifth, it adds quality-gated templates, online calibrated rules, and activation steering to test robustness, online predictability, and local causal sensitivity. Overall, the paper builds a careful pipeline: define a computable target, recover it from representations, then perturb it.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are built around controlled delayed-verdict tasks using Qwen3-4B-Instruct. The main findings are structural rather than benchmark-style. First, positive lead is common: the finite-answer projection often stabilizes on the eventual answer before the answer becomes parseable in the generated text, and this persists across prompt variants, verbalizer choices, and task-family shifts. Second, the exact commitment code δ is linearly recoverable from compact hidden-state summaries, suggesting that the relevant information is fairly accessible rather than buried in a highly nonlinear subspace. Third, cross-condition transfer does not support the stronger claim of a single zero-shot invariant linear coordinate: a readout trained under one prompt or verbalizer condition degrades under another, so the information is linearly accessible but geometrically condition-dependent. Fourth, parser-clean templates preserve positive lead but shorten it, which suggests that some long leads are amplified by template redundancy or surface formatting rather than deep deliberation alone. Fifth, calibrated online rules can predict final answers on held-out trajectories before answer onset, but they are not identical to the retrospective commitment definition, so online predictability and retrospective stabilization are distinct objects. Sixth, exact activation steering can locally shift δ without reliably flipping the generated answer, which is an important boundary result: the commitment code is readable and locally perturbable, but not obviously a single sufficient causal variable for final generation. The excerpt provided does not include the full quantitative tables, so exact lead lengths, transfer drops, or probe metrics should be taken directly from the main experiments and appendix rather than inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in four passes: definition, measurement, recovery, intervention. Start with the introduction and the finite-answer commitment section. The crucial point is why commitment is defined through finite-answer projection and why full continuation probability is used instead of length-normalized scoring. Then read the sections defining onset, commitment time, and lead, paying attention to the retrospective non-flip condition and the margin threshold. In the experiments, first look for the main trajectory plots of δ over generation, the lead distributions, and the robustness checks across prompts, verbalizers, and task families. Next read the probe section. The interesting conclusion is not merely that hidden states predict the answer, but that within-condition linear recovery coexists with weak cross-condition invariance. Then examine the low-dimensional decomposition of commitment versus realization progress and the control analyses that argue this is not just a template artifact. Finally, read the quality-gated, online-rule, and activation-steering diagnostics, because they define the scope of the claims. The paper does not claim to measure unrestricted semantic belief, nor does it prove that all visible reasoning is unfaithful. A quick read takes about 30–45 minutes; a careful read with the appendix is worthwhile if you work on interpretability, latent reasoning, or rationale faithfulness.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，但测量对象定义得很干净；做 CoT/latent reasoning 的人应先看定义和 lead 结果，别急着上 probe。
recommendation.en: It does not change the model, but the measurement target is unusually clean; if you study CoT or latent reasoning, read the definitions and lead results before reaching for probes.

paper.title: HyperLens: Quantifying Cognitive Effort in LLMs with Fine-grained Confidence Trajectory
paper.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, their inference dynamics remain poorly understood because of the limited resolution of existing analysis tools. In this work, we identify an intrinsic magnification mechanism in transformer architectures: deeper layers inherently magnify the small changes of layer-wise confidence, providing a fine-grained confidence trajectory. Building on this insight, we introduce HyperLens, a high-resolution probe designed to

summary.core_problem: 现有逐层置信度探测工具（如Logit Lens、Tuned Lens）分辨率不足，无法区分简单与困难任务的置信度轨迹，因而不能量化LLM推理过程中的"认知努力"。Logit Lens假设中间表示与输出空间线性对齐，但因各向异性和表示漂移，表现为"近视观察者"；Tuned Lens引入外部学习适配器，又会带来"有偏失真"。
summary.importance: 提出了一种高分辨率的可解释性工具HyperLens，能定量刻画模型的认知努力。特别有价值的发现是：SFT会导致"盲目自信"现象——在域内任务上Ω异常下降，说明模型跳过了低置信度的"挣扎"阶段直接给出答案，这为SFT后性能退化提供了可解释性解释。
summary.technical_approach: 发现Transformer层内部存在固有自放大机制：将中间隐藏态在投影前先传播通过k个未来层（称为"焦深"focal depth），可以放大置信度信号。当焦深足够大时，简单任务的置信度快速上升而困难任务长时间处于低置信度，两者轨迹清晰分离。定义"细化面积Ω"（magnified置信度曲线上方的面积）作为认知努力的量化指标。
summary.experiments: 在8个模型、8个数据集上验证了任务难度与Ω的正相关性。以Qwen2.5-7B为例，代码任务中简单样本Ω=1.78，困难样本Ω=3.05。SFT实验发现"盲目自信"效应：简单SFT导致域内任务Ω异常下降且伴随性能退化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看第3节的自放大机制阐述和图1展示的焦深效果，第5节核心实验结果，以及第6节关于SFT"盲目自信"的发现。阅读时间约15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing layer-wise confidence probes (Logit Lens, Tuned Lens) have insufficient resolution to distinguish confidence trajectories between easy and hard tasks, making it impossible to quantify the 'cognitive effort' during LLM inference. Logit Lens assumes linear alignment of intermediate representations with output space but suffers from anisotropy and representation drift; Tuned Lens introduces external learned adapters but brings biased distortions.
summary_en.importance: Presents HyperLens, a high-resolution interpretability tool that quantifies a model's cognitive effort. A particularly valuable finding is the 'blind confidence' effect: SFT causes abnormal decreases in Ω on in-domain tasks, suggesting the model shortcuts the low-confidence 'struggle' phase, which provides an interpretability explanation for performance degradation after SFT.
summary_en.technical_approach: Discovers an intrinsic self-magnification mechanism in transformer layers: propagating intermediate hidden states through k future layers (called 'focal depth') before projection magnifies confidence signals. At sufficient focal depth, easy-task confidence rises rapidly while hard-task confidence stays low for much longer, clearly separating the trajectories. Defines 'refinement area Ω' (area above the magnified confidence curve) as a quantitative cognitive effort metric.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 8 models and 8 datasets, showing consistent correlation between task difficulty and Ω. For Qwen2.5-7B on code tasks, Ω=1.78 for easy samples vs Ω=3.05 for hard samples. SFT experiments reveal 'blind confidence': naive SFT causes abnormal Ω drops on in-domain tasks with accompanying performance degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 3 for the self-magnification mechanism and Figure 1 showing focal depth effects, Section 5 for main results, and Section 6 for the SFT 'blind confidence' finding. Reading time ~15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和轨迹图就够；“认知努力”命名偏大，但若 probe setup 干净，可用于检查 SFT 是否压坏推理动态。
recommendation.en: Read the method and trajectory plots; the “cognitive effort” framing is broad, but a clean probe setup could help test whether SFT distorts reasoning dynamics.

paper.title: TACT: Mitigating Overthinking and Overacting in Coding Agents via Activation Steering
paper.abstract: When language model agents tackle complex software engineering tasks, they often degrade over long trajectories, which we define as *agent drift*. We focus on two recurring failure modes *overthinking* and *overacting*, i.e., where the agent repeatedly reasons over information it already has, and where it issues tool calls without integrating recent observations or acquiring new evidence. In this paper, we introduce TACT (Think-Act Calibration via activation Steering), to detect and mitigate age

summary.core_problem: 长程编码Agent执行复杂软件工程任务时会出现轨迹推进过程中的性能退化（Agent漂移），具体表现为对已有信息重复推理的过度思考、不整合观测就盲目调用工具的过度行动两类失效模式；现有干预均为行为层面的黑盒调整，只能在失效发生后补救，无法在行为显现前提前修正。
summary.importance: 将表示工程方法引入Agent长程轨迹校准场景，证明Agent的步骤级校准状态可在Transformer残差流中线性区分，为Agent推理过程的底层干预提供了新路径，对预训练后模型的推理控制、Agent行为对齐研究有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三阶段TACT流程：1）设计带滚动状态审计的LLM-as-judge标注管线，结合全轨迹上下文标注每一步为过度思考、过度行动或校准状态；2）提取标注步骤的</think>token隐藏态，用平衡均值差法计算两类漂移的对比方向轴，经Gram-Schmidt正交化后实现独立引导；3）测试时将每步隐藏态投影到两个轴上，漂移超过阈值时沿对应轴反向调整残差流，无需微调或修改提示词。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0、CLAW-Eval三个编码Agent基准上测试，Qwen3.5-27B的任务解决率提升5.8个百分点，Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it提升4.8个百分点，解决问题所需步数最多降低26%；标注步骤的隐藏态聚类AUC约0.9，验证了线性可分性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节的标注管线设计和第4节的激活轴提取方法，附录的标注质量校验部分可快速浏览，总阅读时间约20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon coding agents suffer from performance degradation over extended trajectories (agent drift) when tackling complex software engineering tasks, manifesting as two failure modes: overthinking (repeated reasoning over already acquired information) and overacting (issuing tool calls without integrating recent observations). Existing behavioral black-box interventions can only remediate failures after they occur, rather than correcting issues before behavioral manifestation.
summary_en.importance: This work applies representation engineering to agent trajectory calibration, proving that step-level calibration states of agents are linearly separable in transformer residual streams. It provides a new path for low-level intervention of agent reasoning processes, and offers reference for inference control of post-pretrain models and agent behavior alignment research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The three-stage TACT pipeline includes three steps: 1) An LLM-as-judge annotation pipeline with rolling state audit labels each trajectory step as overthinking, overacting, or calibrated, considering full trajectory context instead of isolated steps; 2) Hidden states of the </think> token from labeled steps are extracted, two contrastive drift axes are computed via the balanced mean-difference method, then orthogonalized via Gram-Schmidt for independent steering; 3) At test time, hidden states of each step are projected onto the two axes; when drift exceeds a threshold, the residual stream is adjusted backward along the corresponding axis, with no fine-tuning or prompt modification required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three coding agent benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.0, and CLAW-Eval. It improves resolve rate by 5.8 pp on Qwen3.5-27B and 4.8 pp on Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, and reduces steps-to-resolve by up to 26%. The hidden states of labeled steps achieve a clustering AUC of ~0.9, verifying linear separability of the three states.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the annotation pipeline design and Section 4 for activation axis extraction. The annotation quality validation in the appendix can be skimmed. Total reading time is around 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 hidden-state 线性分离和 steering ablation；若 AUC 跨模型成立，会改变对 agent drift 的归因。
recommendation.en: Read the hidden-state separability and steering ablations; if the AUC transfers across models, it changes how to attribute agent drift.

paper.title: The Predictive-Causal Gap: An Impossibility Theorem and Large-Scale Neural Evidence
paper.abstract: We report a systematic failure mode in predictive representation learning. Across 2695 neural network configurations trained to predict linear-Gaussian dynamics, the optimal encoder tracks the environment rather than the system it is meant to model. The mean causal fidelity -- the fraction of encoder sensitivity allocated to system degrees of freedom -- is 0.49, and only 2.5% of configurations exceed 0.70. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个比“预测做得好是否就学到了正确状态表示”更尖锐的问题：当训练目标只是最小化未来预测误差时，学到的表示是否会优先编码真正的系统因果变量，而不是更容易预测、但对因果解释无益的环境变量。全文给出的答案是否定的，而且不是优化没做好，而是目标函数本身就有结构性偏置。在线性高斯动力系统里，只要环境模态更慢、更稳定、噪声更小，最优预测表示就会偏向环境而非系统，出现作者称为 predictive-causal gap 的现象。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于它直接给出一个可用的新算法，而在于它明确指出了“纯预测目标”的边界。很多自监督预训练、世界模型、表征学习方法默认把 next-step prediction 或 latent prediction 当作通用代理目标，隐含假设是：预测得越好，表示越接近可迁移、可解释、可控制的潜在状态。全文证明这个假设在相当干净的设定下都不成立。对 LLM 和更广义 foundation model 而言，这个结论提醒两点：第一，压低训练 loss 不等于学到任务所需的因果结构；第二，当数据里存在更稳定、更低熵、但并非目标机制本身的统计线索时，模型会系统性地吸附到这些“容易预测的慢变量”上。这对预训练目标设计、数据构造、世界模型表征、以及 post-train 阶段为什么需要额外监督或交互信号，都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分两层。第一层是严格的构造性定理。作者从二维线性高斯系统出发，把状态分成 system 变量 s 和 environment 变量 e，考虑一维线性编码器 y_t = w^T x_t，并配最优线性一步预测器。核心分析对象是稳态下的最小 latent self-prediction risk。作者先写出平稳协方差满足的离散 Lyapunov 方程，再在上三角动力系统下给出闭式解，随后比较三类编码器：只看 system 的 NZ projector、只看 environment 的编码器、以及任意角度的混合编码器。结论是，NZ projector 不仅可能输给纯 environment 编码器，还可能输给一个内部角度的混合最优解。补充材料里给了显式参数例子：a_s=0.05, a_e=0.98, c=-0.90, q_s=0.05, q_e=0.10 时，R(w_NZ)≈0.174，R(w_env)=0.100，而全局最优角度在 43.7° 左右，风险约 0.074。也就是说，最优预测表示既不是纯系统，也不是纯环境，而是朝着更可预测的方向倾斜。

第二层是大规模神经实验验证。作者并不满足于线性定理，而是系统扫描 2695 个神经网络配置，在更高维线性高斯动力学上训练预测模型，统计 encoder sensitivity 分配到 system 自由度上的比例，定义为 causal fidelity。结果显示平均 causal fidelity 只有 0.49，超过 0.70 的配置仅 2.5%。随着维度增加，问题急剧恶化；在 N=100 时，最优编码器对 system 几乎失明，fidelity 约为 1e-8，但预测误差却比“因果表示”低 92%。这一步很关键，因为它把“存在反例”推进成“在大范围配置下普遍发生的训练偏置”。

从机制上看，作者的论证很清楚：预测目标奖励的是可压缩的时间稳定性，而不是因果相关性。慢变量、低噪声变量、强自相关变量，会在一步预测里贡献更高的可预测性，因此编码器会把有限表示容量优先分给它们。若 system 变量更快、更噪、或被 environment 驱动，单纯预测就没有理由恢复 system 本身。
summary.experiments:
关键实验分成理论例证和神经网络扫描两部分。

1. 理论构造例子：在二维系统中，作者给出闭式可算的反例。对参数 a_s=0.05, c=-0.90, a_e=0.98, q_s=0.05, q_e=0.10，NZ 编码器的最小预测风险约 0.174，纯环境编码器为 0.100，而最优混合编码器达到 0.074，最优方向约 43.7°。这说明“只编码系统变量”在预测目标下严格次优，而且次优不是边界现象，最优点稳定地落在内部角度。

2. 高维神经实验：作者训练了 2695 个神经网络配置来做预测表示学习，覆盖不同维度、噪声和动力学设定。总体平均 causal fidelity 为 0.49，只有 2.5% 的配置超过 0.70，说明大多数模型并没有把主要敏感度放在 system 变量上。

3. 维度效应：随着状态维度增大，predictive-causal gap 明显放大。在 N=100 时，最优编码器的 causal fidelity 下降到约 10^-8，几乎完全不看 system；与此同时，它的预测误差比因果表示低 92%。这组数字很有说服力，因为它说明错误表示不是“性能差不多但解释不同”，而是预测目标会主动偏好错误但更易预测的表示。

4. 鲁棒性：补充证明里用隐函数定理说明内部最优角度对参数扰动是稳定的，不是某个精细调参点才成立。也就是说，这个 gap 不是 measure-zero 异常，而是一个开放邻域内都存在的结构现象。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着问题读，而不是顺着摘要读完就结束。

建议先看主文里对 predictive-causal gap 的定义，以及 causal fidelity 的度量方式，先把作者到底在比较什么弄清楚。随后直接看定理陈述和二维反例，不必一开始就陷进全部证明细节。真正值得精读的是补充材料 S1：
1. 看离散 Lyapunov 方程和上三角系统的闭式协方差解，理解风险为什么能写成显式函数；
2. 看 Proposition / Lemma 中 NZ、environment、interior optimum 三者的比较，尤其是为什么最优解会落在内部角度；
3. 看高维嵌入论证，理解这个现象如何从 2D 反例推广到更高维。

如果时间有限，优先抓三件事：一是 impossibility theorem 的逻辑结构；二是 2695 个配置的神经实验统计；三是维度升高后 fidelity 崩塌而 prediction error 继续改善这一组结果。阅读时间大约 30–45 分钟可以抓住主结论；若要把证明吃透，可能需要 1–2 小时。

值得深挖的点有两个。第一，作者分析的是一步 latent self-prediction，这和语言模型的 next-token 目标并不等价，迁移到 LLM 时要注意目标结构差异。第二，论文给出的是“不可能性”而不是“修复方案”，因此更像一个警示：如果目标里没有显式区分因果变量与环境慢变量的机制，单靠预测损失很难自动学出来。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether predictive representation learning can recover the causal state of a system, rather than merely whatever is easiest to predict. The answer, under a clean linear-Gaussian setting, is no. When the objective is only to minimize future prediction error, the optimal encoder can systematically track environmental modes instead of the system variables one actually wants. The paper calls this mismatch the predictive-causal gap, and argues that it is a property of the objective itself rather than an optimization failure.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mostly diagnostic, not algorithmic. Many self-supervised and predictive objectives rely on an implicit hope: if a representation predicts well, it should also capture the right latent structure. This paper shows that the implication can fail even in a simple, analyzable regime. For foundation-model researchers, the message is concrete: lower predictive loss does not guarantee recovery of task-relevant or causally meaningful structure. If the data contain slower, cleaner, more persistent nuisance factors, a predictive objective may allocate representation capacity to those factors first. That has implications for world models, latent-state learning, multimodal pretraining, and for why post-training or interaction-derived signals may be needed to correct what pure prediction leaves unresolved.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two main components.

First, it gives a constructive impossibility result in linear-Gaussian dynamics. The state is decomposed into a system variable s and an environment variable e. A one-dimensional linear encoder y_t = w^T x_t is paired with the optimal linear predictor for y_{t+1} from y_t. The authors derive the stationary covariance through the discrete Lyapunov equation, obtain closed forms for upper-triangular dynamics, and compare the predictive risk of three encoder families: the NZ projector that keeps only the system coordinate, a pure-environment encoder, and general mixed encoders. The key result is stronger than a simple counterexample: the causal encoder can be strictly suboptimal, the environment-only encoder can outperform it, and the global optimum can lie in the interior, meaning the best predictive representation is a mixture tilted toward the more predictable direction.

The supplementary proof gives an explicit parameter setting: a_s=0.05, a_e=0.98, c=-0.90, q_s=0.05, q_e=0.10. Under this setup, the NZ encoder has predictive risk about 0.174, the environment encoder 0.100, and the globally optimal mixed encoder about 0.074 at an angle near 43.7 degrees. The interior optimum is also shown to be stable under small perturbations, so the phenomenon is not a knife-edge artifact.

Second, the paper scales the argument beyond the linear proof by running a large neural sweep over 2,695 network configurations trained on predictive tasks over linear-Gaussian dynamics. The authors define causal fidelity as the fraction of encoder sensitivity allocated to system degrees of freedom. This lets them quantify how much of the learned representation is actually devoted to the intended causal variables. The empirical result is that predictive training usually does not recover them.

Mechanistically, the paper is clear: predictive objectives reward temporal persistence and low-noise structure, not causal relevance. Slow, stable, low-entropy modes dominate one-step prediction, so the encoder spends capacity on them. If the true system variables are faster, noisier, or partially driven by the environment, pure prediction has no reason to isolate them.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is centered on large-scale neural evidence rather than a broad benchmark suite.

1. Explicit analytic counterexample: in the 2D linear-Gaussian construction, the causal NZ encoder is strictly worse than both a pure-environment encoder and an interior mixed encoder. For the reported parameters, R(w_NZ) is about 0.174, R(w_env) is 0.100, and the global optimum reaches about 0.074 at roughly 43.7 degrees.

2. Neural sweep: the authors train 2,695 neural-network configurations on predictive representation learning tasks over linear-Gaussian dynamics. The mean causal fidelity is only 0.49, and only 2.5% of configurations exceed 0.70. So even when prediction works, the learned representation usually does not concentrate on the system variables.

3. Dimensional scaling: the failure worsens sharply with dimension. At N=100, the optimal encoder becomes nearly causally blind, with fidelity around 1e-8, while still achieving 92% lower prediction error than the causal representation. This is the most important quantitative result in the paper, because it shows that the wrong representation is not merely competitive; it is actively preferred by the predictive objective.

4. Robustness: the supplementary analysis argues that the interior optimum persists in an open neighborhood of parameters, so the gap is structurally stable rather than a single pathological construction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem setup and the definition of causal fidelity. Without that, the theorem can look like a narrow linear-algebra statement when it is really about objective mismatch.

Then read the main theorem and jump quickly to the supplementary proof in Section S1. The most useful parts are:
1. the stationary covariance derivation via the discrete Lyapunov equation;
2. the comparison between the NZ encoder, the environment encoder, and the interior optimum;
3. the higher-dimensional embedding argument showing the result is not confined to 2D.

If time is limited, focus on three items: the impossibility theorem, the 2,695-model neural sweep, and the dimensional-scaling result where fidelity collapses while predictive error improves. That is enough to understand the paper’s main contribution in about 30–45 minutes. A full pass through the proof will take longer.

One caution is important for LLM readers: the analysis is built around latent self-prediction in linear-Gaussian systems, not autoregressive next-token language modeling. The paper is best read as a warning about predictive objectives in general, not as a direct theorem about language models.

recommendation.zh: 读定理条件和 N=100 结果即可；它不能直接外推到 LLM，但会削弱“预测即因果”的默认乐观。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem conditions and the N=100 result; it does not transfer directly to LMs, but it weakens the casual “prediction learns causality” prior.

paper.title: Elicitation Matters: How Prompts and Query Protocols Shape LLM Surrogates under Sparse Observations
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as surrogate models for low-data optimization, but their optimizer-facing prediction and its uncertainty remain poorly understood. We study the surrogate belief elicited from an LLM under sparse observations, showing that it depends strongly on prompt text and query protocol.
